article.articleHeadline: People Coming to US Will Have to State That They Have Not Visited DRC Within 21 Days - CDC
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, amid an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) announced a flight-screening measure for air travelers to the United States. Passengers must provide to the airline or operator a paper or digital attestation stating they have not visited the DRC within the previous 21 days. The requirement, reported by RIA Novosti, aims to reduce importation risk during the ongoing Ebola outbreak and adds a layer of pre-embarkation verification for arrivals from the DRC. The policy underscores heightened public health preparedness as authorities monitor cross-border transmission risks.

triage.headline_ja: 米国入国者はDRCを過去21日以内に訪問していないことを申告する必要がある－CDC
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを受け、米国が渡航制限（自己申告義務）を導入したことが報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクに対する米国の入国時渡航申告措置に関する内容。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC国内の感染規模・死亡者数等の詳細情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Mỹ siết chặt kiểm soát hành khách quốc tế nhằm ngăn ngừa dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Tightens Controls on International Travelers to Prevent an Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 9,704 Ebola cases and 4,687 deaths (case fatality ~48%), with related cases in Kenya and Nigeria signaling cross-border transmission risk. The United States CDC tightens air-travel controls by requiring inbound passengers to declare and confirm travel history to the DRC within the previous 21 days, supplementing an existing ban on travelers who had been in the DRC within 21 days before boarding US-bound flights. The World Health Organization and partners intensify testing, contact tracing, isolation, and border surveillance, yet response faces challenges from security instability, weak health systems, and no licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Japan has pledged emergency assistance to the DRC to bolster outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱流行を防ぐため国際線旅客への管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で9,704例・致死率約48%という大規模なエボラ流行が継続し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播や米国の渡航制限措置まで報じられており、IHR基準の複数に該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの関連症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。米国・日本は対応措置の主体であり発生国ではないため除外。Bundibugyoエボラウイルスに対するワクチン未承認という点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: 美, 내달부터 입국자에 '에볼라 진원지 민주콩고' 방문 여부 확인
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. to verify whether entrants have visited the Ebola epicenter in the Democratic Republic of the Congo starting next month.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts new U.S. border controls starting November 3, 2026: all international air passengers bound for the United States must submit a written or digital pledge stating they have not visited or stayed in the DRC in the previous 21 days. The CDC will require pre-boarding documentation for every inbound traveler. This tightens prior measures that barred entry for foreigners who had recently visited the DRC (May) and extended to U.S. citizens (July). In addition, foreign nationals who travelled to or stayed in Uganda or South Sudan within 21 days are barred from entering the U.S. There are no confirmed Ebola cases in the United States to date. Briefings with major airlines are scheduled for October 23, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、来月からDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）渡航歴を入国者に確認へ─エボラ発生地
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱流行を受け、米国がCDC主導で入国制限・渡航申告義務を段階的に強化しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の入国規制強化が主題だが、根本原因はDRCでのエボラ流行継続。ウガンダ・南スーダンへの渡航歴者も入国禁止対象だが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。米国も対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: EUA vão reforçar triagem do Ebola com novas declarações dos passageiros aéreos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US to bolster Ebola screening with new declarations from air passengers
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa driven by Bundibugyo strain, with about 4,700 deaths and no vaccine available; spread concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. The US CDC announced a new border measure: starting November 3, air passengers bound for the United States must present a digital or paper attestation that they have not been in the DRC within the previous 21 days. This expands prior restrictions that already barred entry for travelers who had visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the three weeks before travel, and that restriction was extended to US citizens in July. The policy aligns with ongoing efforts to prevent exposed individuals from entering the US, as no cases have been detected in the United States. The CDC also prohibits entry of foreigners who had been in Uganda or South Sudan within three weeks. Airlines will receive guidance via teleconferences.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、航空旅客への新たな申告義務でエボラ出血熱の水際対策を強化へ
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンで約4700人の死者を出すエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が継続し、ワクチンもない中、米国が渡航制限・申告義務を導入するなど国際的対応が取られているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンも流行地域として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国は渡航制限措置の実施国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm A gia tăng ở trẻ em, cảnh giác nguy cơ biến chứng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A on the rise in children, beware the risk of complications.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A rising among children at Vin Phuc General Hospital in Vinh Phuc Province, Vietnam. The Pediatrics Department reports average daily admissions of 8–12 children for influenza A, up from roughly 5–10 per week previously. Transmission is mainly through respiratory droplets; schools, nurseries, and households are high-risk settings. Typical onset includes fever, chills, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, muscle aches, and fatigue; in young children, irritability, poor feeding, vomiting or diarrhea can occur. Most recover in a few days, but some progress to pneumonia or respiratory distress. Urgent care is advised for signs such as difficult or rapid breathing, chest retractions, cyanosis, seizures, lethargy, or dehydration. Extra caution for children under 5 and those with chronic conditions. Home care: rest, fluids, appropriate nutrition, monitor temperature; antivirals only as prescribed; avoid unnecessary antibiotics. Vaccination, hand hygiene, cough etiquette, and staying home when symptomatic are encouraged.

triage.headline_ja: 子どものA型インフルエンザが増加、合併症リスクに警戒
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常の増加であり、特定病院での小児患者増加に関する一般的な医療情報記事。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 一病院における季節性インフルエンザAの小児患者増加に関する啓発記事。重症例や死亡者数の急増、異常な流行パターンの報告はなく、通常の季節性疾患情報の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: US to make Ebola attestation mandatory for air travelers entering the country starting Nov. 3: Report
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused over 4,000 deaths among more than 9,000 confirmed cases. The United States plans to require air travelers entering the country to present an attestation that they were not in the DRC in the last 21 days, effective November 3, 2026. Attestations can be paper or digital; the CDC memo Reuters obtained indicates airlines are being briefed on compliance, though no formal notification has been released. This tightens May rules restricting entry for those who visited the DRC in the prior three weeks (extended to U.S. citizens in July). Separately, Nigeria reports an active Ebola case imported from Uganda, sparking outbreak fears in Uganda, which denies that the case originated there; Uganda was declared Ebola-free by WHO in August. WHO regional director Mohamed Janabi calls the current situation a more complex outbreak landscape than the continent has seen before.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、11月3日からエボラに関する渡航者の自己申告書提出を義務化へ：報道
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は9000例以上・死亡4000人超と深刻で、ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへの拡大や米国の渡航制限措置を伴うなど国際的関心・影響が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダでの新規症例報告はあるが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めず。米国の渡航制限措置はDRCでの流行への対応であり、発生国としては該当しない。WHO地域局長が『大陸がこれまで見た中で最も複雑な流行状況』と発言している点も重大性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 70 pessoas 'pegaram' sarna em escola do interior de SP - Sim Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 70 people contracted scabies at a school in the interior of São Paulo state - Sim Notícias
article.articleSummary: More than 70 people contracted scabies at a municipal school in Atibaia, interior São Paulo, Brazil. At the Prefeito Walter Engrácia de Oliveira school, 51 students and 20 teachers were affected, prompting closure for cleaning and disinfection on Friday, October 28. The outbreak is described within a broader endemic pattern, with additional cases reported from August to October in Lagoa Santa (MG), Estrela d'Oeste (SP), and Brodowski (SP). Scabies is a skin disease caused by mites and spread mainly through prolonged direct skin contact; less commonly, sharing clothing or bedding can transmit it. It is common in early education settings due to close contact. The Secretaria de Educação e Saúde said preventive measures have been implemented and health teams are caring for those affected while monitoring the situation.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・サンパウロ州内陸部の学校で70人以上が疥癬に感染
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とはならず、学校内の局地的な集団発生であり重症度・拡大リスクも低いため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 疥癬はダニによる皮膚疾患で、致死性や重症度は低く、学校など密接接触のある環境で局地的に流行する一般的な疾患。地域保健当局が通常の予防・対応措置を実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: 코미팜, 국제 양돈학술행사서 ASF 백신 임상 데이터 공개
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Komipharm releases ASF vaccine clinical data at an international swine science conference.
article.articleSummary: ASF vaccine development company Komipharm presented comprehensive development data and large-scale field trial results for an African swine fever vaccine at the 15th Leman China Swine Conference in Zhengzhou, China, detailing the progression from laboratory work to on-farm trials and reporting safety and efficacy data. The presentation by Seo Jeong-hyang, a veterinary pathology expert and institute director, was delivered as an officially invited speaker, with organizers covering travel and accommodation. International regulatory steps are underway: the Philippines filed product registration on September 9, with supplementary materials submitted on October 6, and the review reportedly nearing completion. Other Southeast Asian countries are also processing registration procedures. Komipharm aims to leverage the accumulated research and clinical data to secure approvals and strengthen global marketing and export opportunities for the ASF vaccine, reinforcing its international presence as an ASF vaccine developer.

triage.headline_ja: コミファーム、国際養豚学術行事でASFワクチン臨床データを公開
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はASFワクチンの開発・臨床データ発表および規制登録状況に関する企業広報的内容であり、新規の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はASF発生そのものではなく、ワクチン開発企業の学会発表とフィリピン等での製品登録手続き状況を報じるもの。感染症発生地点の特定はできないため、対象国の実発生事例としては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : une nouvelle chaîne de transmission à Mandima fait craindre une hausse des cas - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: a new transmission chain in Mandima raises fears of a surge in cases - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: New Ebola virus disease transmission chain detected in the Yakoto health area, Mandima, Ituri, raising fears of a case surge. Incident Manager Prof. Steve Ahuka Mundeke reports rising case numbers on the ground and warns of mounting pressure on care facilities as transmission evolves. Operational challenges persist, with active foci in southern Ituri and northern Nord-Kivu and insecurity that hinders access to Musienene and Kalinguta in Beni. The response includes remote support from WHO and Médecins Sans Frontières to ensure uniform outbreak control across the province. High population mobility increases cross-border transmission risk, prompting calls for stronger interprovincial coordination and entry-point surveillance. Nevertheless, some zones show a decline in cases due to community engagement with response teams. Communities are urged to maintain collaboration. The mission, supported by Africa CDC, WHO, and the Provincial Health Division, visited Musienene, Kalinguta, and Butembo GHRs. 23 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：マンディマで新たな感染連鎖が発生、症例増加が懸念される－LePotentiel
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新規感染連鎖がイトゥリ州マンディマで確認され、治安問題によるアクセス制限と越境移動による拡大リスクが指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: エボラは継続中の既知のアウトブレイクであり『異常/予想外』には該当しないが、新たな感染連鎖・治安による対応困難・越境移動リスクから深刻性と国際拡大リスクが高い。WHO・MSF・Africa CDCが既に関与しており、国際支援は継続的に必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF Ghana Humanitarian Flash Update No. 1 (Yellow Fever Outbreak), 1 - 18 October 2026 - Ghana
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever outbreak declared in Ghana's Upper West Region on 9 October 2026, affecting Wa West, Sissala West and Sissala East. By 12 October, 121 suspected cases in 7 of 11 districts; 19 IgM-positive; 3 confirmed; all three died. These districts account for 86 cases. About half of suspected cases are children under 15. A reactive vaccination campaign began 14 October, targeting 244,870 people aged 9 months-60 years in three districts, with mop-up from 19 October. Samples tested at the National Public Health and Reference Laboratory; some referred to Dakar for confirmatory testing; 3 cases confirmed in Dakar, all died. Deaths include 8 institutional and 5 community; not all confirmed. UNICEF supported the campaign, procuring ~190,000 doses and coordinating RCCE across seven districts; 432 frontline workers trained, 7 radio stations, 250,000 reached. Border mobility and refugee/livestock populations pose transmission risks; response emphasizes surveillance, vaccination, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEFガーナ人道フラッシュアップデート No.1（黄熱病アウトブレイク）、2026年10月1日～18日 - ガーナ
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ北西部で黄熱病アウトブレイクが宣言され、複数地区に拡大、死亡例（確定例全例死亡）あり、国境を越えた移動や難民・家畜人口によるさらなる伝播リスクが指摘されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際支援（UNICEF）が既に関与している。
triage.notes: セネガル・ダカールは確定診断のための検体送付先（国立リファレンスラボ連携）として言及されているのみで、アウトブレイクの発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 为防范埃博拉疫情 美疾控中心发布航空旅客入境及乘机新规
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CDC Issues New Rules for Inbound Air Travelers and Boarding to Prevent Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: On Oct 22, 2026, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) announced new inbound air travel rules to prevent Ebola importation. Starting at 23:59 Eastern Time on November 3, all passengers on international flights to the United States must sign a written or electronic declaration confirming that in the 21 days prior to departure they have not visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The measure aims to reduce Ebola virus importation risk. Additionally, travelers who have recently visited Uganda or South Sudan face entry restrictions; U.S. citizens meeting entry conditions must undergo public health screening at designated airports. The policy signals heightened vigilance amid ongoing Ebola concerns linked to Central and East Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行を防ぐため、米疾病対策センター(CDC)が入国航空旅客・搭乗に関する新規則を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）を含む中央・東アフリカでのエボラ流行を受け、米国が入国制限・検疫強化措置を講じており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大、渡航制限）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はCDCによる米国内への入国制限措置が主題だが、背景にDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラ流行がある。ウガンダ・南スーダンも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国自体も対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Đặc khu Côn Đảo: Chủ động "giăng lá chắn" phòng, chống dịch viêm não mô cầu tại các cơ sở giáo dục
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Con Dao Special Administrative Region: Proactively casting a protective shield to prevent and control meningococcal meningitis outbreaks at educational facilities.
article.articleSummary: Cases of meningococcal meningitis detected in Ho Chi Minh City in recent days prompt proactive protective measures in the Con Dao Special Administrative Region’s schools. Meningococcal meningitis is a highly transmissible, acute infection spread via respiratory droplets; onset is abrupt with fever, headache, nausea, and sore throat and can rapidly progress to meningitis, septicemia, shock, and multiorgan failure within hours to days. In response, Huong Duong Kindergarten and other Con Dao schools implement comprehensive prevention following guidance from Ho Chi Minh City’s Department of Education and Training, the Con Dao authorities, and local health agencies. Measures include intensified health communications (loudspeakers, notices, social media), daily health checks, reinforced personal hygiene (soap handwashing), regular cleaning and disinfection with Chloramine B, weekly full-school sanitation, and prompt isolation/referral for suspected cases. Secondary schools also activate contingency plans to reinforce infection control and protect students, families, and staff.

triage.headline_ja: コンダオ特別行政区：教育機関における髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の予防・対策のための積極的な「防護壁」構築
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の症例が確認され、学校での予防策強化が報じられているが、症例数・重症度・死亡者数等の詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎はヒト-ヒト感染（飛沫感染）し、急速に重症化しうる疾患だが、本記事では具体的な症例数・死亡者数・重症度の詳細は記載されていない。地方自治体レベルでの予防対応が主な内容であり、現時点では局地的な対応事例と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Globe at a glance: From Tibet's deadly earthquake to the US's new Ebola declaration for air travellers
article.articleSummary: US to require Ebola declaration from air travellers: The United States will require all incoming air travellers to submit digital or paper declarations confirming they have not visited the Democratic Republic of Congo in the previous 21 days. The rule takes effect on November 3, amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak, and is designed to strengthen border health surveillance for travel-associated risk. Declarations can be completed digitally or on paper and apply to passengers arriving on international flights into the United States. The policy adds to existing screening measures as authorities monitor the outbreak in the region. No specific case counts are cited in this update; the development underscores heightened vigilance in travel-related public health security during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 世界の動向ひとめぐり：チベットの致命的地震からアメリカの新たなエボラ渡航申告義務化まで
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行を受け、米国が渡航者に申告義務を課すなど国際的な対応が取られており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限）に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の渡航者申告義務化という政策対応が主題であり、感染拡大自体の最新症例数等は記載されていない。実際の発生地はDRCであり、米国は対応措置の実施国に過ぎないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Giải đáp thông tin về viêm màng não do não mô cầu và vắc xin phòng ngừa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clarifying information about meningococcal meningitis and preventive vaccines.
article.articleSummary: Since Oct 16, VNVC has administered over 40,000 meningococcal vaccine doses nationwide, triple the level of the same period last year; in Ho Chi Minh City, doses rose 125-fold. The surge follows four meningococcal meningitis cases at a school in HCMC, with one death. From the start of 2026 to date, the southern region reports 42 cases and 7 deaths. To help parents recognize, treat, and prevent meningococcal meningitis, VNVC hosts a program titled 'Information about meningococcal meningitis: Recognition, Treatment & Prevention,' airing at 20:00 on Friday 23 Oct 2026. Panel includes BS.CKII Nguyễn Thị Hạnh Lê, Head of Pediatrics, Tam Anh Clinic, District 7; BS.CKI Danh Thị Mỹ Hồng, VNVC Medical Manager; TS-BS Nguyễn An Nghĩa, Deputy Head of Pediatrics–Neurology, Children’s Hospital I. The program streams online via thanhnien.vn, vnvc.vn, tamanhhospital.vn and related VNVC/Thanh Nien channels. For guidance or vaccination bookings, call 028 7102 6595 or visit vnvc.vn.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎と予防ワクチンに関する情報解説
triage.triage_reason: 南部ベトナムで学校集団発生を含む髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎42例・7死亡が確認され、致死率が高く、ワクチン接種が急増するなど社会的関心も高まっているためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 南部地域で2026年初来42例・7死亡と致死率が高く、学校でのクラスター発生とワクチン接種急増が報告されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する情報は記事中にないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Bontoc urges vigilance as ASF threat spreads
article.articleSummary: ASF threat spreads in Bontoc, Mountain Province, prompting strict quarantine and entry restrictions ahead of All Saints' Day and All Souls' Day. The Office of the Municipal Agriculturist, under Executive Order No. 60, Series 2026, tags Alab Proper, Alab Oriente, and Guina-ang as areas of concern, with Sagada, Natonin, and Paracelis in neighboring towns also affected. Movement and zoning follow DA-BAI Administrative Circular No. 2, Series 2022. Biosecurity checks will be enforced at municipal borders; travelers and livestock haulers entering Bontoc must undergo mandatory checkpoint inspections. Transport of live pigs, fresh pork, and processed pork from identified areas is subject to strict regulatory requirements; traders, distributors, and haulers must secure valid permits and complete documentation. ASF poses no human health threat but is highly contagious among pigs, causing high mortality and substantial economic losses for hog raisers, necessitating community vigilance to protect livestock and food security.

triage.headline_ja: ボントックでASF(アフリカ豚熱)の脅威拡大、警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱(ASF)は人獣共通感染症ではなく人への健康被害はなく、動物疾病としての地域的な家畜管理問題であり、公衆衛生上の国際的懸念基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: ASFは人には感染せず、豚のみに影響する家畜疾病。地方自治体レベルでの検疫強化措置であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては該当しない。農業・畜産業への経済的影響に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Premium Times Reports Call for Nigerian Experts to Lead Ebola Response | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: One case of Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease was confirmed in Nigeria’s Federal Capital Territory (Abuja) on Oct 20; the patient, a woman who had recently arrived on a flight from Uganda, is in isolation, with 44 close contacts identified for monitoring. WHO timelines show illness onset on Oct 7, first medical visit on Oct 11, and lab confirmation on Oct 20—13 days from onset to confirmation, nine days from first care to confirmation. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control activated its incident management system, with WHO and partners aiding investigation, contact tracing, and infection control. Uganda MoH said the patient traveled via Uganda en route to eastern DRC for business; infection source and exposure history remain under investigation. Adewuyi urged reliance on about 500 local epidemiologists for leadership, citing a 7-1-7 surveillance target. Nigeria’s 2014 outbreak had 19 lab-confirmed, 1 probable, 8 deaths, and was declared transmission-free that year.

triage.headline_ja: プレミアム・タイムズ紙、ナイジェリア人専門家によるエボラ対応主導を求める報道
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでエボラ（ブンディブギョ・ウイルス病）の新規症例が確認され、国際的な移動歴・感染源不明という点でIHR基準を複数満たすため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 発生国ナイジェリア、経由国ウガンダ、渡航予定先DRCはいずれも対象国リストに含まれないか、主題国ではないため verified_locations は空配列とした。DRCは渡航予定先としてのみ言及されており、実際の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 香港12岁女童感染甲流死亡 第二宗儿童甲流死亡个案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong 12-year-old girl dies of influenza A; second pediatric death from influenza A.
article.articleSummary: In Hong Kong, the Centre for Health Protection reported on Oct 21, 2026, the death of a 12-year-old girl from influenza A. She developed fever, cough and diarrhea from Oct 17, deteriorated Oct 19, and died after treatment at Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital from influenza A–related septic shock, disseminated intravascular coagulation, and multiple organ failure. She had no travel during incubation and was unvaccinated for the 2026–2027 seasonal flu; a household contact had mild upper-respiratory symptoms but did not require hospitalization. CHP will continue investigation and refer to the coroner. Since late June Hong Kong entered the flu season, with locally high activity; this season there have been 25 pediatric severe influenza cases: 20 recovered, 1 serious, 2 critical, and 2 deaths, including the above. Vaccination reduces risk and severity; good hygiene and avoiding gatherings are advised; seek medical care for fever/cough.

triage.headline_ja: 香港12歳女児がインフルエンザA型感染で死亡、今季2例目の小児甲型インフルエンザ死亡例
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる小児死亡例（今季2例目）が報告され、重症例・死亡例が継続して発生しており社会的関心も高いため、経過確認としてピックアップする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（甲型/Influenza A）による香港の小児死亡例。今季25例の小児重症インフルエンザのうち2例が死亡。香港衛生防護中心（CHP）が調査継続中。新型株や異常な病原性の報告はなく、通常の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられるが、死亡例の継続発生のため動向注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mengenal Black Death: Wabah Mematikan yang Mengubah Sejarah Eropa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Getting to Know the Black Death: The Deadly Plague That Changed European History
article.articleSummary: Black Death, one of history’s deadliest plagues, struck Europe in the mid-14th century, killing millions and disrupting trade and daily life as contemporary medicine could not explain its source or transmission. The illness is caused by Yersinia pestis. Ancient-DNA analyses published in Nature identify evidence of the bacterium in 14th-century burials at Kara-Djigach and Burana in the Chüy Valley, now Kyrgyzstan, dating to 1338–1339 and linking the strain to ancestors of later outbreaks. The spread followed Eurasian trade routes from Central Eurasia to the Black Sea and Mediterranean ports. By 1346–1347 it moved toward the Black Sea region and then to Messina, Sicily, in October 1347, before expanding to Italy, France, Spain, and England in 1348–1349. By 1350–1353 the main wave waned, but demographic and economic impacts persisted. WHO notes plague is associated with rodents and fleas, with human infection via flea bites.

triage.headline_ja: 黒死病を知る：ヨーロッパの歴史を変えた致命的な疫病
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は14世紀の黒死病（ペスト）に関する歴史解説記事であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではないため、トリアージ対象外とする。
triage.notes: 記事は歴史的な黒死病（14世紀のペスト流行）に関する教養・歴史解説記事であり、現在発生している感染症イベントを報じるものではない。発生地域として挙げられたタイ（Bangkok/Kingdom of Thailand）を含む対象国も、記事本文では言及されておらず、現在の感染事例とは無関係と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: ナイジェリアで約10年ぶりのエボラ患者、ウガンダで感染か
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient in Nigeria for the first time in about 10 years, possibly infected in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease case in Nigeria is the first in about ten years. The patient, Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat stationed in Abuja, is hospitalized with symptoms. Nigeria confirmed the infection on May 20 amid a Congo DR outbreak that has affected four African countries. Swiss authorities say she likely contracted the virus during a Uganda trip about two weeks before hospitalization, though WHO and Africa’s major health agencies have not confirmed that she visited the Democratic Republic of Congo. Uganda had reported around 20 infections in May–June before WHO declared the outbreak over in August; Ugandan officials on Oct 22 said there are no Ebola cases in Uganda. The Nigerian case underscores cross-border transmission concerns.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで約10年ぶりのエボラ患者、ウガンダで感染か
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻性・異常性・国際拡大の3項目に該当し、ナイジェリアでの約10年ぶりのエボラ症例かつ国境を越えた感染拡大が疑われるため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（スイス人外交官夫人）の症例とウガンダでの感染疑いだが、両国とも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コンゴ民主共和国はアウトブレイクの背景として言及されており対象国に該当するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: FG warns 15 states to speed up readiness
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak response in Nigeria tightens as 21 states have accelerated preparedness while 15 have not updated their response plans. The Federal Government directs hospitals nationwide to increase isolation bed capacity and strengthen infection prevention and control to protect frontline health workers after an imported Ebola case was confirmed in the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Abuja. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC), coordinated with WHO and Africa CDC, activated the incident management system to scale up surveillance, contact tracing, and reporting from private facilities. The infected woman had initially sought care at a private facility before confirmation; authorities are tracing contacts to prevent community transmission. Genomic sequencing will be conducted with genomics expert Prof. Christian Happi to better understand the Bundibugyo strain linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Additional funds have been allocated to bolster the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：連邦政府、15州に対応体制の迅速化を警告
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでDRC由来のエボラ輸入症例が確認され、WHO・Africa CDCと連携した緊急対応が発動されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる事象はナイジェリア（対象国外）での輸入症例対応だが、感染株はDRCのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）に由来するとされ、DRCでの継続的流行が示唆されるためDRCのみを検証済み地域として記載。ナイジェリア自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 미국행 승객 전원에 '콩고 안 갔다' 서류 요구 추진⋯백신·치료제 없는 에볼라 확산
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US-bound passengers to be required to present a document certifying they have not been to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as Ebola spreads with no vaccines or treatments.
article.articleSummary: Starting November 3, all international air passengers must show a document certifying they have not stayed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) in the previous 21 days, electronically or on paper. The outbreak in Ituri Province is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no approved vaccine or treatment exists for this strain. As of October 21, CDC counts 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths (≈48% CFR), the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. WHO’s public health emergency of international concern remains, with contact tracing around the 80% range (below the 85% target) and transmission linked to healthcare settings and unsafe burials. Kenya reports 9 cases in Nairobi; Nigeria records the first West Africa case from a Ugandan traveler. DRC has allocated 70,000 Ervebo doses (Zaire ebolavirus) with first batch arriving, though not proven effective against Bundibugyo. Experimental MBP134 antibody and remdesivir are in trials.

triage.headline_ja: 米国行き全乗客に『コンゴに行っていない』証明書類を要求へ⋯ワクチン・治療薬のないエボラが拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）アウトブレイクが9,704症例・4,687死亡（CFR約48%）に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへも拡大。米国が渡航制限措置を導入し、WHOのPHEICも継続しておりIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ケニア（ナイロビ9例）、ナイジェリア（ウガンダ人渡航者による西アフリカ初症例）、アンゴラ、ウガンダへの波及も報じられているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株である点は特に異常性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: ナイジェリアで約10年ぶりのエボラ患者、ウガンダで感染か | ニューズウィーク日本版 オフィシャルサイト
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient in Nigeria, the first in about ten years; possibly infected in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has been confirmed in Nigeria, marking the first Nigerian case in about ten years. The patient is the wife of a Swiss diplomat stationed in Abuja and was born in Uganda; she is hospitalized in a private clinic in Abuja with symptoms for about a week. Nigeria disclosed the infection on Oct 20. The case comes amid a Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC)–origin Ebola outbreak that began in May, with four African countries reporting infections to date. Swiss authorities told Reuters the woman is believed to have contracted the virus during a Uganda trip roughly two weeks earlier; however, WHO and Africa’s major health agencies have not confirmed she visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Uganda’s government late on Oct 22 said there are no Ebola cases in the country. Uganda had reported 20 infections in May–June, with the WHO declaring the outbreak over in August.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで約10年ぶりのエボラ患者、ウガンダで感染か
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで約10年ぶりのエボラ患者が確認され、国際移動を伴う越境感染の可能性があり、DRC起源の既存アウトブレイクとも関連する公衆衛生上の重大イベントであるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（約10年ぶりの症例）とウガンダ（感染経路の疑い）だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは今回の症例と直接の関連は未確認だが、同時期に進行中のDRC起源のエボラアウトブレイクが明記されているため対象国として記録。

article.articleHeadline: Africa's Greater Horn region is facing a looming polycrisis fueled by conflict, prices, climate and disease
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, the Greater Horn of Africa faces a looming multicountry polycrisis driven by El Niño–related climate shocks, conflict, and disease. Short rains in late 2025 and long rains (Mar–May 2026) were well below average in eastern Somalia, eastern Kenya, and eastern Ethiopia; the northern Horn (Ethiopia highlands, parts of South Sudan and Sudan) is forecast drier-than-average. A developing super El Niño could trigger drought and extensive flooding, displacing populations and undermining livelihoods. An Ebola variant is active in Congo and Uganda; cross-border spread to South Sudan could complicate responses. Most Horn countries—except Kenya—are mired in protracted conflict, hindering resilience to shocks. Fertilizer shortages linked to the Iran war threaten harvests and lift food prices, while global humanitarian funding has declined, increasing reliance on local actors and prompting calls for enhanced funding and local-led action.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ大角地域は紛争・物価高騰・気候変動・感染症が重なる複合危機に直面
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでエボラの変異株が活動中とされ、南スーダンへの越境拡大リスクが指摘されているため、重篤な公衆衛生インパクトと国際的拡大の可能性がありフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は地域全体の複合危機（干ばつ、紛争、食料価格高騰）を扱う広範な分析記事で、エボラに関する詳細（症例数、対応状況等）は記載されていない。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。続報で具体的な症例データの確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 美增强埃博拉防疫 所有入境航班旅客须申报
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. strengthens Ebola prevention and control; all inbound flight passengers must declare.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) has caused about 4,700 deaths in Africa with a case fatality around 50%; no approved vaccine or treatment is available. US CDC announced on Oct 22 that from Nov 3 all international air passengers entering the United States must declare whether they have visited the DRC in the preceding 21 days to prevent virus importation. Declarations may be electronic or paper-based and must be completed before boarding; airlines must verify and keep records for 42 days. The rule applies to all inbound travelers irrespective of nationality; CDC will brief major US and foreign airlines on Oct 23. Earlier measures included May restrictions for travelers with Congo exposure and July expansion to include US citizens, plus restrictions for some travelers who visited Uganda and South Sudan. Canada also imposes temporary inbound rules requiring a 21‑day stay outside Canada for those who have been to the DRC."

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ対策を強化 すべての入国便旅客に申告義務付け
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行（致死率約50%、死者約4700人）を受け、米国・カナダが渡航制限・入国申告義務を導入しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は米国・カナダの渡航対策を主題としているが、実際の流行発生国はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）。米国・カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダ・南スーダンも過去の渡航歴関連措置として言及されているが対象国リストに非該当。

article.articleHeadline: US Makes Ebola Attestation Mandatory for Air Travellers From November 3 | Outlook India
article.articleSummary: US CDC will require Ebola attestation for passengers on inbound flights to the United States starting November 3, 2026, confirming they have not been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) during the previous 21 days. The attestation can be paper or digital; airlines must collect and retain declarations for 42 days and present them to authorities on request. Non-compliance may lead to denied boarding; false statements could incur criminal penalties. The measure targets the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC, which has killed over 3,000 people and continues in remote areas, though CDC says no cases linked to the outbreak have been detected in the United States and the overall risk remains low. The rule adds to existing travel restrictions, with separate limits for foreign nationals recently in Uganda or South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、11月3日より航空旅客に対しエボラ出血熱に関する誓約を義務化 | Outlook India
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で3000人以上の死者を出しているエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行を受け、米国が入国者に渡航制限措置を導入するなど国際的な対応が取られており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の流行に対する米国の渡航対策。ウガンダ・南スーダンは別の渡航制限の対象国として言及されているのみで、本件の発生地域ではない。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Pune tops Maha in dog-bite cases, rabies deaths this year
article.articleSummary: Pune district topped Maharashtra in dog-bite cases and rabies deaths for January–September 2026, recording 77,286 dog bites and 14 rabies fatalities, plus 18,335 other animal bites, for a total of 95,621 animal-bite cases. Rabies deaths in Pune rose from 10 in 2025 to 14 in 2026. Among other districts, Thane had 26,683 dog-bite cases and 7 rabies deaths; Ahilyanagar, 30,413 dog bites and 8 deaths; Solapur, 28,620 dog bites and 6 deaths. Statewide, Maharashtra logged 480,206 dog-bite cases and 118,021 other animal bites in the first nine months of 2026, with 59 rabies deaths (up from 33). The 2026 animal-bite total reached 598,227, down from 667,744 in 2025, per IHIP and CIF data. Officials urge strengthening the Animal Birth Control (ABC) programme, vaccination, timely reporting, and stray-dog shelters, noting many Pune patients originate from western Maharashtra.

triage.headline_ja: プネー、犬咬傷および狂犬病死者数で今年マハラシュトラ州トップに
triage.triage_reason: インド国内で毎年報告される風土病的な狂犬病統計記事であり、突発的な異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドで風土病的に発生しており、本記事は年次統計報告であって突発的な公衆衛生危機を示すものではない。動物由来感染症でヒト-ヒト感染がないため国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria detecta caso de Ébola tras 13 días de síntomas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria detects an Ebola case after 13 days of symptoms.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola case in more than a decade after a patient spent 13 days with symptoms before testing. The patient, wife of a Ugandan-origin Swiss diplomat, arrived in Abuja on 3 October after two weeks in Uganda, developed symptoms three days later, and sought care at several centers under malaria suspicion before an Ebola test on 19 October. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya said Nigeria was not initially on the risk list but will be added. Authorities have identified 44 direct contacts, with numbers likely to rise. The outbreak began in May in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and has since reached Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria, marking the second-largest Ebola epidemic and widest geographic spread in Africa. Nigerian Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate says no confirmed travel path; Ugandan authorities cite possible infection in Uganda or after Congo exposure. WHO’s Marion Koopmans urged clarifying the itinerary to assess border-control gaps; the situation is not over.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、症状発現から13日後にエボラ出血熱の症例を検出
triage.triage_reason: DRC発の大規模エボラ流行がウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ拡大し、対象国であるDRCが流行の起点であること、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当し国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 本記事はナイジェリアでの症例確認が主題だが、流行は5月にDRCで開始し、対象国リストにあるのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Africa Ebola Outbreak: Indonesia Monitors Crisis as Virus Spreads Beyond Congo - Best Breaking News and Beyond: Singapore, Batam and some say JB
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak expands region as Kenya reports its eighth case. The first Kenyan patient, who traveled from DRC through Uganda and arrived in Kenya on Oct 3, died Oct 5 in Nairobi. A 49-year-old man in quarantine tested positive after developing fever, headache, and muscle pain; three relatives and three healthcare workers also tested positive, with about 130 contacts identified (128 in quarantine) and six other patients stable on supportive care. Inside DRC, Nord-Ubangi province reports cases, marking the eighth province affected and one death. The Times of India cites roughly 9,400 cases and more than 4,500 deaths since mid-May. Regional measures: Kenya tightens border screening, opens an emergency hotline, and establishes a gate at Nairobi airport for flights from 10 high-risk countries; Tanzania adopts 21-day traveler monitoring. Indonesia monitors developments and issues travel guidance.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ流行:コンゴを越えて感染拡大、インドネシアも危機を監視
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行がケニアへ越境拡大し、複数国で渡航制限措置が取られているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ケニア・タンザニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドネシアは渡航ガイダンスを発行・監視しているのみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: After suspected dengue death of girl, PMC reviews preventive measures
article.articleSummary: Pune, India: A nine-year-old girl from Lohegaon died on Oct 18 at Ruby Hall Clinic; dengue is suspected with a positive non-ELISA NS1 test, and the death will be treated as suspected dengue until PMC’s health audit confirms the cause. From Jan 1 to Oct 20, Pune recorded 2,413 dengue cases. The PMC reviewed preventive readiness, including diagnostics and treatment. Free rapid dengue tests are available at all PMC dispensaries; confirmatory testing at sentinel centers Dr Naidu Hospital, Dr Kotnis Hospital, Kamala Nehru Hospital; IHIP portal registration required. Private facilities have about 8,400 beds (670 ICU); civic hospitals 333 beds (6 ICU); roughly half the beds are vacant. Dr Naidu Hospital reserved 50 dengue beds; treatment is free. Vector-control focuses on inside-home fogging for 20 minutes, biological larvicides for stored water, and targeted spraying; nets in dengue wards. Authorities urge residents to prevent stagnation and seek care; beds available citywide.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱による少女の死亡疑いを受け、プネー市当局(PMC)が予防対策を見直し
triage.triage_reason: インド・プネーでデング熱の流行（年間2,413例）と疑い死亡例が報告されているが、既知の季節性感染症であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで毎年流行する既知の媒介感染症であり、地域当局が独自に対応能力を有している。死亡例は1件で疑い例の段階。

article.articleHeadline: สสจ.ราชบุรี ลงพื้นที่ช่วยผู้ประสบภัยน้ำท่วม 15 หลังคาเรือน เตือนระวังโรคที่มากับน้ำ - สยามรัฐ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ratchaburi Provincial Public Health Office conducts field visits to assist 15 flood-affected households, warns of waterborne diseases.
article.articleSummary: On 23 October 2026, the Ratchaburi Provincial Public Health Office conducted field visits to assist 15 flood-affected households in Sankhu Community, Na Muang Subdistrict, Mueang District, Ratchaburi Province, Thailand. Led by public health teams, including MCATT (Mental Health Crisis Assessment and Treatment Team) and SEhRT (Special Environmental Health Response Team), the outreach distributed essential supplies, foot-care medications for water-related foot conditions, and EM microbial treatment for wastewater, with demonstrations on use and provision of household cleaning equipment. A bed-ridden patient in Sankhu was also visited. Officials urged residents to guard against flood-associated diseases, notably leptospirosis, water-logged foot disease, and dengue fever. Local leadership and village health volunteers participated, reinforcing integrated public health, environmental hygiene, and mental-health support for affected households.

triage.headline_ja: ラチャブリー県公衆衛生事務所、洪水被災世帯15軒を訪問支援 水系感染症に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の通常の公衆衛生対応・注意喚起に関する記事であり、異常な流行や重症例の報告はなく、国際的な拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 洪水被害に伴う地域レベルの予防的公衆衛生活動の報告であり、具体的な感染症の症例数や流行の兆候は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 450 Get Anti-Rabies Vaccine After Consuming Milk From Suspected Rabid Cow
article.articleSummary: Approximately 450 people in Dadi Khas village, Gorakhpur district, Uttar Pradesh, received anti-rabies vaccination after consuming charanamrit made from a cow that died amid suspected dog bite. Vaccination occurred across two days: ~50 on Tuesday at a CHC and ~400 on Wednesday via a health camp. The cow’s owner, Navami Yadav, said veterinarians and a local doctor suspected canine bite; the animal died Tuesday evening. Milk from the cow had been supplied to two shops and several households. A health team led by pharmacist Siddharth Singh administered vaccines; CHC in-charge Amarendra Thakur urged medical assessment and adherence to the vaccination schedule, ensuring vaccine availability. Rabies transmission through milk is not established, but exposure to saliva or other infectious material warrants prompt medical advice and possible post-exposure prophylaxis; laboratory confirmation is required to prove rabies in the cow.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病感染の疑いがある牛の乳を摂取した後、450人が狂犬病予防ワクチンを接種
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病が疑われる牛由来の乳を摂取した住民への予防的ワクチン接種事例であり、人への感染確定例はなく、インドでは狂犬病自体が風土病的に発生しているため異常性は低い。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもない。
triage.notes: 牛からのミルク摂取による狂犬病感染は科学的に確立されておらず、予防的措置として地域の保健チームが対応済み。人獣共通感染症としての狂犬病自体はインドで一般的であり、特段の異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Korban Keracunan MBG di Cirebon Tembus 395 Orang, 218 Dirawat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MBG poisoning victims in Cirebon reach 395 people, 218 hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: MBG mass food poisoning outbreak in Cirebon, West Java, has sickened 395 people as of Oct 22, 14:00 WIB; 218 remain hospitalized and 177 are treated as outpatients or discharged. Approximately 700 people consumed MBG meals. No cases require intensive care, and patients are generally stable, with diarrhea the most common complaint. The Cirebon Health Department (Dinkes) is investigating the source and incubation period, consulting clinical microbiology specialists to identify the causative pathogen and timeframe. Laboratory confirmation is pending to determine the cause and guide further action. Cases are spread across multiple health facilities, with kindergarten-age children representing the highest proportion. Authorities continue monitoring and await test results to clarify whether contaminated MBG food caused the illness. Published Oct 23, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: チルボンでのMBG食中毒被害者395人に達し、218人が入院
triage.triage_reason: 大規模な食中毒事例で多数が入院しているが、感染症（病原体）起因か化学物質起因か不明であり、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクも低いため、続報を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: 原因物質（感染性か化学性か）が未確定であり、検査結果待ちの段階。MBG（給食プログラム）による集団食中毒事例で、感染症イベントというより食品安全事案の可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Afrika berdepan penularan Ebola yang 'rumit' selepas merebak ke Nigeria - WHO | Berita Harian
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa faces 'complicated' Ebola transmission after it spread to Nigeria - WHO | Berita Harian
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) caused by the Bundibugyo strain has been detected in Nigeria for the first time, in the wife of a diplomat who traveled from Uganda to Abuja. Nigerian authorities report contacts identified and high-risk individuals quarantined; no evidence of community transmission. The Bundibuguro (Bundibugyo) lineage is driving a large outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with more than 9,000 confirmed cases and over 4,000 deaths since mid-May; the strain has no available vaccine or specific treatment. WHO Africa Director Mohamed Janabi warns of a more complex transmission landscape. Nigeria’s case follows East Africa’s spread; Kenya has reported nine cases since Oct 6. Nigeria previously recorded 19 cases and seven deaths in this outbreak but has contained spread domestically. Lagos airport screening is heightened amid concerns, recalling the 2013–2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak which claimed over 11,000 lives.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ、ナイジェリアへの拡大後『複雑化』するエボラ感染 - WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高く、DRCでの大規模流行（9000症例以上、4000死亡以上）とナイジェリアへの新規拡大という国際的に重大な公衆衛生イベントであるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアへの新規拡大だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは今回の大規模流行（Bundibugyo株、9000例超・4000死亡超）の発生源として記事内で明確に言及されているため含めた。ケニア・ウガンダも言及されているが対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Российские туристы массово заболевают новым штаммом коронавируса
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian tourists are falling ill en masse with a new strain of coronavirus.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 Stratus strain (variant XFG) is causing a mass illness among Russian tourists in Kazakhstan, per the Mash Telegram channel. Infected individuals report family clusters lasting three to four weeks, with symptoms including vomiting, diarrhea, chills, myalgia, fever up to 38°C, sore throat, and later cough; some cases require hospitalization. Virologist Viktor Zuev suggests the virus may have been introduced to Kazakhstan by Kazakhstani tourists returning from China. In Russia, officials note that about 90% of people previously infected with COVID-19 show memory impairments due to microvascular damage, with early cognitive deficits potentially more modifiable through treatment. Separately, Russian researchers have developed cognitive training for COVID-19 survivors, reflecting ongoing concerns about long-term sequelae even as variants emerge.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人観光客の間で新型コロナウイルスの新変異株が集団感染
triage.triage_reason: 対象国（ロシア・カザフスタン）はトリアージ対象地域リストに含まれず、中国は原因推測として言及されているのみで実際の発生国ではない。また既知のXFG変異株による通常の症状であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はカザフスタン在住ロシア人観光客間でのCOVID-19新変異株（XFG/Stratus）流行であり、対象国リストに含まれるのは中国のみだが、中国は感染経路の推測として言及されているに過ぎず実際の発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Pune Dengue Death | पुण्यात ८ वर्षांच्या मुलीचा डेंग्यूने संशयित मृत्यू; वर्षभरात ८ बळींमुळे मनपाची तातडीची बैठक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pune Dengue Death | Suspected dengue death of an eight-year-old girl in Pune; Pune Municipal Corporation calls emergency meeting due to eight deaths in a year.
article.articleSummary: Eight-year-old girl dies suspected dengue in Pune; Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) convened an emergency meeting after eight dengue-suspected deaths this year within the city limits. Of these eight cases, five are PMC residents and three involve patients outside the corporation area. Final cause awaits medical records and autopsy review by a Death Audit Committee; PMC Health Chief Dr. Neina Borade noted conclusions require documentation and history. The Lohgaon girl had fever and abdominal pain for 4–5 days; dengue was diagnosed at Ruby Hall Hospital, after which she was moved to a nearby facility; her condition deteriorated and she died despite treatment. The death also involved other comorbidities, so attributing death solely to dengue is premature before the audit. Dengue data show August 568 suspected, September 726, October 553; January–October total 2,413. Public-health measures focus on vector control, waste management, larviciding at construction sites, and timely reporting by private hospitals; citizens urged to keep surroundings clean.

triage.headline_ja: プネーでのデング熱死亡 | プネーで8歳の女児がデング熱疑いで死亡；今年8件の死亡によりプネー市当局が緊急会議を招集
triage.triage_reason: インドで地域流行性のデング熱による季節的な症例・死亡報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、地元自治体により既存の対応体制（死亡監査委員会、媒介昆虫対策）で管理されている。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで毎年流行する地方風土病であり、本記事はプネー市内の季節的な症例報告・自治体の対応を伝えるもので、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Confirms First Human Case Of Animal-Linked Shamonda Virus In France; Patient Dies
article.articleSummary: France reports the first documented human Shamonda virus infection in an immunocompromised patient who died; transmission route remains under investigation. Shamonda virus, previously detected only in animals such as cattle, sheep, goats and horses, is thought to spread among animals by Culicoides midges. The patient lived in an area where the virus circulated in animals and midges were present; exact human-to-human or environmental transmission pathways are not yet defined, and the WHO is coordinating investigations with French authorities to identify the infection source and assess public health risk. Nigeria confirms an imported Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease case in the Federal Capital Territory, Abuja; 44 contacts are being monitored. The patient is a woman who recently travelled from Uganda; her symptoms began October 7 and she sought care October 11. Nigeria is the fifth country to detect the virus since the DRC outbreak began on May 15, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、動物由来シャモンダウイルスのフランスでの初のヒト感染例を確認；患者死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5月に始まったエボラ（スーダン/ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクが既に5カ国に拡大しており、国際的拡大・重症度の観点からIHR基準複数該当。加えて新規人獣共通感染症（シャモンダウイルス）の初症例も報告されており社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はフランスでのシャモンダウイルス初ヒト感染例と、ナイジェリアで確認されたエボラ（ウガンダから渡航した女性の輸入症例）の2件を扱う。エボラアウトブレイクはDRCで2026年5月15日に開始し既に5カ国に拡大中と記載されているためDRCを発生国として計上。フランス・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。
