article.articleHeadline: 12岁女童感染甲流死亡！从出现症状到离世仅隔3天 呼吁接种流感疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 12-year-old girl dies after contracting H1N1 influenza! Only three days from onset of symptoms to death. Calls for flu vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong recorded a pediatric death from influenza: a 12-year-old girl with lab-confirmed H1N1 influenza died Oct 20 after three days of symptoms. She developed septic shock, DIC, and multi-organ failure, after fever, cough, diarrhoea, and vomiting. She had not received the 2026–27 seasonal flu vaccine. A household contact had mild upper respiratory symptoms but was not hospitalized. The case was reported Oct 21 by the CHP; it will be referred to the coroner. Hong Kong’s flu season, active since late June, has seen about four months of high activity, including 25 severe pediatric influenza cases; 20 recovered, 1 serious, 2 critical, and 2 deaths (including this case). Authorities urge vaccination for everyone aged 6 months and above, especially high-risk groups, and continued hygiene measures. Unvaccinated children have about fivefold higher risk of severe disease or death than vaccinated peers; unvaccinated elderly in care homes have about fourfold higher risk to compare. Implementing vaccination is emphasized to reduce severe outcomes and death.

triage.headline_ja: 12歳女児がA型インフルエンザ(H1N1)に感染し死亡！発症から死亡までわずか3日、インフルエンザワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる小児死亡例であり、重症度・流行継続性・流行しやすさの基準に該当し、社会的関心（ワクチン接種呼びかけ、当局報告）も高いためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 香港衛生防護中心(CHP)が報告した季節性H1N1インフルエンザによる小児重症・死亡例。季節性流行の一環であり、新規病原体や国際的拡大のリスクは示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Newcastle em SC: emergência zoossanitária dura 60 dias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle Disease in Santa Catarina: Zoosanitary Emergency Lasts 60 Days.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease prompted a 60-day zoosanitary emergency in Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim in western Santa Catarina after confirming a Newcastle disease focus at a commercial turkey farm housing about 6,000 birds. The focus was confirmed on 18 October 2026 following analyses at the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense in São Paulo (LFDA-SP). Depopulation of two sheds occurred 19–20 October, followed by cleaning and disinfection under established protocols; the farm remains under sanitary restrictions with restricted access and entry/exit disinfection measures. Surveillance covers properties within a 10-km radius, targeting roughly 133 rural operations, with nine veterinary teams conducting clinical checks and sampling, prioritizing nearby establishments and those shipping birds for slaughter. Brazil notified the OIE and trade partners; MAPA and Cidasc coordinate actions with public and private sector support. While marketed products remain safe for consumption, ongoing surveillance and trade restrictions may persist.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州のニューカッスル病：家畜衛生非常事態が60日間継続
triage.triage_reason: 本事例は家きん（七面鳥）に限定した動物疾病（ニューカッスル病）であり、ヒトへの健康影響は報告されていない。既存の家畜衛生プロトコルに基づき殺処分・消毒・サーベイランスが実施されており、通常の家畜疫学対応の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病はOIE通報対象の家きん疾病であり、ヒトへの感染・健康影響は極めて限定的（まれに結膜炎程度）。本記事はブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の商業用七面鳥農場での発生に対する家畜衛生当局（MAPA・Cidasc）の標準的対応を報じており、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。国際貿易への影響（輸出制限等）は想定されるが、ヒト感染症としてのRRA対象には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada! Kasus DBD di Sumsel Berpotensi Melonjak Pasca Kemarau El Nino
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning! Dengue Fever Cases in South Sumatra Could Surge After the El Niño Drought.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in South Sumatra could surge after El Niño drought. In Palembang, the South Sumatra Health Office reports, as of Oct 10, 2026, 3,424 dengue cases with 18 deaths, compared with 4,436 cases and 20 deaths in 2025. Weather shifts linked to El Niño—drought and higher temperatures—can accelerate Aedes aegypti lifecycles and biting frequency. Drought also drives residents to store water, potentially creating mosquito breeding containers if not properly managed. Ira Primadesa, Head of Prevention and Control of Communicable Diseases, notes the climate change could raise dengue risk across the region. Authorities anticipate moderate to heavy rainfall beginning in November–December 2026, part of the post-El Niño period, increasing transmission risk. Public health measures and vigilant water management are advised to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 警戒！エルニーニョによる干ばつ後、南スマトラでデング熱症例が急増する可能性
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は南スマトラで季節的に発生している既知の感染症であり、現時点で症例数は前年を下回っているが、気候変動による今後の感染拡大リスクが指摘されており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 2026年の症例数（3,424件、死亡18名）は2025年同時期（4,436件、死亡20名）より少なく、現時点で異常な増加は確認されていない。ただし今後の降雨期における感染拡大が懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en Nigeria: un caso importado activa un llamado de apoyo internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Nigeria: an imported case triggers an international appeal for aid.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Nigeria: a woman who arrived from Uganda tested positive for Ebola virus Bundibugyo on October 20, triggering rapid contact tracing and isolation in Abuja. She landed in Nigeria on October 3, fell ill four days later, and sought care at a private clinic on October 11. Authorities identified 44 contacts and are monitoring them; the infection source remains under investigation. This Nigeria case follows multiple export-linked detections from the DRC outbreak that began in May. Kenya has nine cases linked to one imported infection, while Uganda previously reported Bundibugyo infections but declared its outbreak over on August 27. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO counted 8,728 confirmed cases and 4,205 deaths as of October 6. Africa CDC requests flexible funding, medical supplies, diagnostics, and trained personnel, and urges strengthened community surveillance; WHO recommends enhanced hospital surveillance and infection control, without travel or trade restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでエボラ出血熱：輸入症例が国際的な支援要請を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定8,728例、死亡4,205例）が複数国へ越境しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として重大性・異常性・国際拡大のリスクが高く、Africa CDCおよびWHOへの支援要請も行われているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であり主要な継続アウトブレイク国であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus TBC di Jaksel Tembus 8.662, Semua RW Diminta Siaga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB cases in South Jakarta exceed 8,662; all RW urged to stay vigilant.
article.articleSummary: TB in South Jakarta totals 8,662 cases as of 12 October 2026, with the Jakarta Selatan municipal government pursuing universal Kampung Siaga TBC by converting all RW to TB alert villages. From 2025–2026, Jakarta Selatan has established 260 Kampung Siaga TBC, averaging four per kelurahan; each RW is targeted to become Kampung Siaga TBC, supported by government, health workers, private sector, RT/RW, volunteers, and families to enable earlier case finding, sustain treatment, and reduce stigma. Debi Intan Suri notes that TB control requires community-wide participation beyond puskesmas. The program includes recognition for the top five Kampung Siaga TBC in South Jakarta as part of performance assessment, and the broader province notes about 40,000 TB cases in Jakarta, underscoring ongoing public health efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 南ジャカルタのTB症例が8,662件に達し、全RWに警戒を要請
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアの地域流行疾患であり、本記事は既存の対策プログラム（Kampung Siaga TBC）の推進状況を報じる定例的な内容で、異常な増加や新たな公衆衛生リスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核は長期的な地域流行疾患であり、本記事は地域コミュニティベースの対策強化（Kampung Siaga TBC）に関する行政報告であるため、緊急シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Couvre-feux en France, séisme en Chine, virus Shamonda, BBC : les informations de la nuit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Curfews in France, earthquake in China, Shamonda virus, BBC: tonight's news
article.articleSummary: Shamonda virus marked its first human infection in France, a severely immunocompromised patient who died in early October. The virus, spread by biting insects and previously found in livestock, shows no current evidence of human-to-human transmission, with experts saying population risk remains very low, though unknowns persist about infections in healthy individuals or asymptomatic cases. In Tibet, a magnitude 7 earthquake on Thursday night caused 16 deaths and 46 injuries, with the epicenter ~190 km from Nagchu and ~390 km from Lhassa; over 300 houses collapsed. The region’s seismic activity is linked to India-Eurasia plate convergence; a January 2025 Tingri quake (magnitude 6.8) killed at least 126. In France, curfews were extended in parts of Paris and Marseille, restricting nightly hours and prompting anticipated demonstrations.

triage.headline_ja: フランスでの夜間外出禁止令拡大、中国の地震、シャモンダウイルス、BBC：夜のニュース
triage.triage_reason: シャモンダウイルスの世界初のヒト感染例（かつ死亡例）が報告されており、新規病原体のヒトへの出現という異常性と重大性からフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は複数ニュースの寄せ集めで、シャモンダウイルス感染事例はフランスで発生（対象国リストに非該当のためverified_locationsは空）。中国に関する内容は地震であり感染症事象ではないため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: France Reports First Human Case Of Shamonda Virus After Man In His 60s Dies: Could It Affect India?
article.articleSummary: France reports the first documented human Shamonda virus infection after a man in his 60s from the Lyon area died in early October 2026; case announced October 22, 2026. The patient was severely immunocompromised with a serious underlying illness, and investigations aim to determine whether Shamonda virus caused or contributed to death. Shamonda virus, an Orthobunyavirus, was first isolated from cattle in Nigeria (1965) and has since been detected in Africa, Asia, and European livestock by 2026. Animal infections cause fever, diarrhea, weakness, reduced milk, and reproductive complications; human illness data remain limited. Authorities suspect infection via a Culicoides midge bite in eastern France; no evidence of human-to-human transmission. No identified population risk; no licensed vaccine or proven treatment. ECDC and WOAH monitor; no verified human cases in India, with no indication of wider spread as of now.

triage.headline_ja: フランス、シャモンダウイルスの初のヒト感染例を報告 ― 60代男性死亡、インドへの影響は?
triage.triage_reason: フランスで初の人獣共通ウイルス（シャモンダウイルス）ヒト感染例が報告されたが、患者は基礎疾患を有する免疫不全者であり死因との因果関係は調査中。ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなく、対象国での感染確認もないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 発生地はフランス・リヨン地域であり対象国リストに含まれない。見出しでインドへの影響を示唆しているが、記事本文ではインドでの確認症例はないと明記されており、インドも対象から除外。ナイジェリアは1965年の初分離株に関する歴史的記載であり現イベントの発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Vợ nhà ngoại giao mắc Ebola khiến Nigeria khẩn cấp cấm bay hàng chục người
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wife of a diplomat contracts Ebola, prompting Nigeria to urgently bar dozens of people from flying.
article.articleSummary: On 23 October 2026, Nigeria activated emergency surveillance and banned 46 close contacts after a 42-year-old Ugandan woman, wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja, tested positive for Ebola Bundibugyo. She returned on 3 October from Kampala, with a two-hour layover in Ethiopia; malaria-like symptoms emerged three days later, and she was admitted to a private hospital on 11 October, where the Ebola test was confirmed. No secondary cases detected; she has remained in Abuja. A 21-day medical monitoring period was ordered for 46 close contacts (44 healthcare workers, 2 at the patient’s home). Nigeria and Cameroon tightened airport screening and health declarations. Bundibugyo transmission is via direct contact with blood, feces, vomit and other fluids, not airborne. WHO declared a global emergency over the Congo outbreak, which has over 9,000 cases and 4,000 deaths, raising concern for Uganda and Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: 外交官の妻がエボラ出血熱に感染、ナイジェリアが緊急で数十人の搭乗を禁止
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアへの輸入エボラ症例（ブンディブギョ株）を契機に緊急監視・渡航制限措置が取られ、背景にあるDRC（コンゴ）での大規模流行（9000例超、4000人死亡）に対しWHOが世界的緊急事態を宣言しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアで確認された輸入エボラ症例（ウガンダ在住のスイス人外交官夫人）だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイス・カメルーン・エチオピア・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC（コンゴ）は現行の大規模エボラ流行（WHO世界的緊急事態宣言）の発生地として具体的な疫学データが記載されているため対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Hyderabad: CCMB study identifies Protein that alerts cells about viruses
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-23, Hyderabad-based CCMB researchers identify DZIP3 as an early-warning sensor that detects viral RNA and activates innate immunity. When viral RNA is recognized, DZIP3 undergoes a structural change, translocates to the mitochondria, and tags/activates key antiviral proteins, triggering Type-I interferon production that restricts viral replication. The study, published in The EMBO Journal, shows this pathway protects against multiple viruses, including SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19), chikungunya, and Japanese encephalitis. The work suggests potential for broad-spectrum antiviral therapies by pharmacologically enhancing DZIP3 activity. Researchers led by Dr. Santosh Chauhan at CSIR-CCMB, Hyderabad, are developing small-molecule candidates to boost DZIP3 and strengthen natural defenses. While promising, proposed therapies are experimental and require further safety and efficacy studies. Findings advance understanding of how human cells sense viruses and initiate innate immunity, with implications for emerging viral threats.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード:CCMBの研究、ウイルスを細胞に警告するタンパク質を特定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究に関する科学ニュースであり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は抗ウイルス免疫メカニズムに関する基礎研究の報告であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクや症例を扱っていないため、verified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Cases Top 9,600 as Contact Follow-Up Misses Target | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak has reached eight provinces with 9,637 confirmed cases and 4,646 deaths (CFR 48.2%) as of Oct 19; cases reported in 66 of 178 health zones. In the 24 hours to Oct 19, 85 new cases and 44 deaths were recorded (29 community, 15 in treatment centers); no new health zones. Contact monitoring covered 24,679 of 31,725 contacts (77.8%), short of the 95% target due to insecurity, movement constraints, delayed provider payments, and PPE shortages; some checkpoints lacked ambulances. Nigeria confirmed one Bundibugyo virus disease case on Oct 20 in Abuja; symptom onset Oct 7 after arrival, care Oct 11; 44 contacts identified. Uganda reports the patient traveled to eastern DRC for business and passed through Uganda without symptoms; exposure location under investigation. WHO identifies Bundibugyo virus as the outbreak cause; largest Ebola outbreak in DRC and 17th overall; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例数が9,600人を突破、接触者追跡は目標未達
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大のエボラ流行（症例9,637人、死亡4,646人、致死率48.2%）が拡大中で、ナイジェリアへの国際伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア（アブジャ）で輸入症例が確認され、ウガンダを経由した渡航歴があるが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。主たる流行はDRCで発生している。

article.articleHeadline: UP rabies scare: 450 get anti-rabies vaccine after consuming milk
article.articleSummary: In Uttar Pradesh’s Gorakhpur district, about 450 people in Dadi Khas village and nearby Govindpur received anti-rabies vaccine after consuming charanamrit made from milk of a cow suspected of rabies. The cow reportedly fell ill, behaved abnormally, and died on Tuesday evening; veterinarians have not confirmed rabies, though the animal was suspected to have been bitten by a stray dog. Milk from the cow had been distributed to two shops and several households in the area. Approximately 50 people were vaccinated at a community health centre on Tuesday, with around 400 more vaccinated at a village health camp on Wednesday, bringing the total to roughly 450. Health officials urged concerned residents to seek medical advice and to boil milk thoroughly before consumption, noting no confirmed human rabies cases linked to the incident as of publication.

triage.headline_ja: UPの狂犬病騒動：牛乳摂取後に450人が狂犬病ワクチンを接種
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病が疑われる牛の乳を摂取した住民450人に予防的ワクチン接種が行われたが、人への感染確定例はなく、地域限定の予防的対応にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は通常、咬傷による曝露後感染であり、乳汁を介した感染経路は医学的に確認されていない点に注意。獣医学的な狂犬病確定診断も未了。

article.articleHeadline: How Pastors Mobilize Communities in Congo's Fight Against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Mongbwalu, prompts mobilization by churches to counter fear and misinformation. Deo Kasereka, a catechist at Notre Dame of Maternal Charity church, contracted Ebola after attending a funeral and touching the body, reflecting traditional burial practices linked to transmission. He developed fever, sweating, and cough, with later vomiting and diarrhea. Early outbreak days saw widespread gaps in protective practices. Kasereka’s daughter urged him to seek care at a newly established Ebola clinic; four days after admission and initial positive test, he was released following a negative result. He credits his informed family for seeking early treatment. The article highlights how church networks helped reduce fear and guide timely treatment in Mongbwalu, a remote town near informal gold mines, aiding outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの牧師たちがエボラとの闘いでコミュニティを動員する方法
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の既知のエボラアウトブレイクに関するフォローアップ記事であり、新規の重大な変化（感染拡大や死亡者急増等）は報告されていないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はMongbwalu（DRC北東部、金採掘地域に近い遠隔地）における既存のエボラアウトブレイクに対し、教会ネットワークが恐怖や誤情報に対抗し早期治療を促した事例を紹介するもの。伝統的な葬儀慣行（遺体への接触）が感染経路として言及されている。新規アウトブレイクの発生や拡大の兆候は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: গরুর দুধ দিয়ে চরণামৃত, তারপরই গরুর মৃত্যু, আতঙ্কে শয়ে শয়ে মানুষ, দেওয়া হল জলাতঙ্কের টিকা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Charanamrita made with cow's milk, then the cow dies; hundreds of people panicked; rabies vaccine administered.
article.articleSummary: Rabies fears grip Dadi Khas village in Gola block, Gorakhpur district, Uttar Pradesh after devotees drank charanamrita—consecrated paste made from cow milk—during Durga Puja. A cow reportedly died Tuesday evening after being sick for a day or two; rumors circulated that a street dog may have bitten the animal. In response, health authorities vaccinated about 450 people: roughly 50 at a community health center on Tuesday and about 400 more at a village camp on Wednesday. The cow’s owner, Nabmi Yadav, said the animal had been unwell before death. Veterinarians suspected rabies but cautioned that symptoms alone cannot confirm infection; laboratory confirmation is required. Officials urged the worried to follow medical advice and, if advised, complete the prescribed anti-rabies vaccination schedule.

triage.headline_ja: 牛乳で作ったチャラナムリタを飲んだ後、牛が死亡し、数百人がパニックに陥り狂犬病ワクチンが接種された
triage.triage_reason: インド農村部における牛の死亡を受けた狂犬病疑い事例で、確定診断はされておらず、ヒトの感染例も報告されていない予防的なワクチン接種対応であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドで風土病的に発生しており、本事例は村レベルでの予防的対応（ヒトへのワクチン接種）にとどまる。牛の死亡原因は狂犬病と確定されておらず、検査結果待ちの状態。ヒトの感染例・死亡例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Menkes: Estimasi Kasus Tuberkulosis Menurun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister: Estimated Tuberculosis Cases Have Declined.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's estimated tuberculosis (TB) incidence declined for the first time, per the WHO Global TB Report 2026, with cases dropping to 1,080,000 from 1,092,000 in 2024. Health Minister Budi attributed the decrease to aggressive active-case finding supported by portable X-ray units and Near Point of Care molecular tests across thousands of Puskesmas. As of October 2026, 666,985 TB cases have been detected/reported (61% of a 972,000 target), and 599,425 patients (90% of target) have begun treatment. TB screening was integrated with other services and taken to crowding sites, including 40,910 inmates in prisons, 24,623 santri in pesantren, and 8,914 employees or transport partners like Gojek and Grab. Treatment durations have shortened with modern regimens, and Indonesia is participating in Phase 3 trials of the TB vaccine M72, targeted to begin production in early 2029.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣:結核推定症例数が減少
triage.triage_reason: 結核症例数の減少という好転を示す内容であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急対応の必要性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアの結核対策の進展・症例数減少を報じる肯定的な内容であり、シグナルトリアージの対象となる異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa calls emergency health meeting as Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak spreads
article.articleSummary: Nigeria became the fifth country to confirm Bundibugyo Ebola case as the outbreak spread to three African regions—Democratic Republic of the Congo (Central Africa) and Uganda and Kenya (East Africa). AU Commission Chair Mahmoud Ali Youssouf and Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya urged urgent solidarity, transparency and coordinated continental action to contain the outbreak and protect populations, with timely mobilization of resources. The Africa CDC declared the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak a public health emergency of continental security on May 18, one day after the World Health Organization declared the situation a public health emergency of international concern. An online high-level ministerial emergency crisis meeting is planned for next week, with attendance from health, finance and transport ministers, to advance Africa’s response and preparedness. The message emphasizes strengthened partnerships and Africa’s health security and sovereignty.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ、ブンディブギョ・エボラ出血熱の流行拡大を受け緊急保健会議を招集
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がDRC、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアの5か国に拡大し、WHOがPHEIC、Africa CDCが大陸規模の公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアも流行国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みであり、既にフルリスク評価段階にある可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 美 입국 빗장..."에볼라 발생 민주콩고 방문 안 했다" 증명 요구
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US Tightens Entry Restrictions, Demands Proof That You Did Not Visit the Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo
article.articleSummary: US tightens entry controls over Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The CDC will require all international airline passengers bound for the United States to sign a declaration that they did not visit the DRC within the last 21 days. The measure takes effect November 3 and applies regardless of nationality; previously, since May, foreigners with recent DRC visits faced admission restrictions, and since July, U.S. citizens were barred from boarding private flights within 21 days of DRC travel. Uganda and South Sudan have separate entry limits for foreigners. The CDC will brief airlines on October 23 about the verification process and responsibilities. The DRC outbreak began in May; the virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus with 50% fatality and no approved vaccines or therapies. Africa CDC cites 4,700 Ebola deaths; Nigeria reports first case in a decade; no US cases yet. WHO Director-General Tedros visited Bunia in May.

triage.headline_ja: 米、入国制限強化…「エボラ発生中のコンゴ民主共和国を訪問していない」証明を要求
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率50%のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が継続し、米国・ウガンダ・南スーダンが渡航制限を導入するなど国際的拡大と渡航制限の両基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: ナイジェリアでの10年ぶりの症例報告やウガンダ・南スーダンの入国制限も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。米国の入国規制強化はDRC由来のアウトブレイクへの対応。

article.articleHeadline: Cow Was Bitten By Rabid Dog; More Than 400 People Drank Its Milk During Durga Puja In Uttar Pradesh - What Happened After?
article.articleSummary: Rabies concerns in Gorakhpur district, Uttar Pradesh, after a cow died following a suspected dog bite; around 450 people drank charanamrit made from the cow’s milk during Durga Puja and received anti-rabies vaccines. The cow in Dadi Khas village, Gola block, owned by Navami Yadav, fell ill and died Tuesday evening. About 50 people were vaccinated Tuesday at a CHC, with around 400 more vaccinated Wednesday in a health department drive led by pharmacist Siddharth Singh. Veterinarians Bechan Singh, Hardev Yadav, and clinician Siddiqui cited symptoms suggesting rabies but emphasized the need for veterinary testing to confirm the diagnosis. Drinking milk is not an established rabies transmission route, but anyone exposed to saliva should seek medical assessment for possible post-exposure prophylaxis. Officials advise boiling milk and ensure vaccines are available; vaccination coverage targets those affected in Dadi Khas and Govindpur during Durga Puja.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州でドゥルガー・プージャの最中、狂犬病の犬に噛まれた牛の乳を400人以上が飲む―その後の経過は？
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病疑いの牛からの乳を飲んだ住民への予防的暴露後ワクチン接種が地域保健当局により適切に実施済みであり、人から人への感染拡大リスクや公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 乳を介した狂犬病感染は確立された経路ではなく、暴露の可能性がある住民には既に暴露後予防（PEP）が実施済み。地元の家畜・保健当局が対応しており、インドでは狂犬病は風土病的に発生するため異常事態とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa faces 'complex' Ebola outbreak after spread to Nigeria, WHO warns
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-23, the World Health Organization calls Africa’s Ebola outbreak 'complex' after the Bundibugyo strain crosses from East Africa to Nigeria, marking the first West African case. Nigeria reports an imported Bundibugyo case in the diplomat’s wife, who traveled from Uganda to Abuja; Congo is currently experiencing a major Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo. Nigerian Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate stated that authorities have traced the wife’s contacts since her arrival earlier this month and quarantined an undisclosed number of 'high risk' individuals in a facility. The event underscores cross-border transmission risk and ongoing containment efforts in Africa, with imported exposure monitored and high-risk contacts isolated. Key involved locations include Uganda (origin), Abuja (Nigeria), and the Congo outbreak area, highlighting regional public health coordination needs.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ、ナイジェリアへの拡大後『複雑な』エボラ出血熱の流行に直面とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が東アフリカから西アフリカ（ナイジェリア）へ越境拡大し、WHOが『複雑な流行』と警告。コンゴ民主共和国では大規模流行が継続しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準も広く該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダ発生源の輸入例によるナイジェリアへの越境拡大とコンゴ民主共和国での大規模流行だが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Lubero : deux structures sanitaires restent fermées à
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Lubero: two health facilities remain closed.
article.articleSummary: Two health facilities in Alimbongo health zone, Lubero territory, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo are closed after Ebola cases among staff. Kitsombiro and Kasingiri centers quarantined since Oct 3; closure extended after two additional staff cases detected while quarantined. More than 50 health workers had contact with nine initial confirmed Ebola cases in Kitsombiro and Kasingiri. Reopening and lifting of quarantines depend on evolving situation and laboratory results; a 21-day observation period is planned. Military authorities cite obstacles: community resistance, limited logistics and funds, and occupation by ex-AFC/M23 hindering operations. By Oct 22, Alimbongo reported 19 Ebola cases and 14 deaths; Lubero territory 304 cases, with three patients escaped and two still ill. WHO and IMC aid bring renewed hope; an Ebola treatment center is under construction in Alimbongo and staff capacity is being strengthened.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:ルベロで医療施設2か所が閉鎖継続、アリムボングで職員感染後
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でエボラ出血熱の集団感染が継続しており、医療従事者感染・死者多数・患者逃走など深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威があり、治安悪化で対応が困難なためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 武装勢力(ex-AFC/M23)による占拠やコミュニティの抵抗が対応を妨げており、感染拡大リスクが高い。患者の逃走や隔離中の職員感染など管理上の課題が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: USA: Od 3 listopada restrykcje w ruchu lotniczym z powodu epidemii eboli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USA: From November 3, air travel restrictions due to the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: United States tightens Ebola travel controls: effective 3 November, all passengers to the United States must complete a declaration (digital or paper) confirming they have not spent any part of the previous 21 days in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The CDC order, aimed at curbing exposure amid the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, complements earlier measures: since May, DR Congo contacts were barred; since July, the rule extended to U.S. citizens. DR Congo reports indicate around 4,500 deaths and over 9,000 infections to date. In early October Kenya reported one death and nine infections; Uganda had two deaths and 20 infections earlier, with WHO declaring Uganda Ebola-free in August. Nigeria reported its first Ebola case—a woman in Abuja. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days (typically 8–10). Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, with possible internal/external bleeding. No approved treatment or vaccine; no confirmed U.S. cases linked to this outbreak yet.

triage.headline_ja: 米国：11月3日からエボラ出血熱の流行により航空便に渡航制限
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスの流行により死者約4,500人、感染者9,000人以上が報告され、米国が入国制限を課すなど国際的な対応が取られており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリアでの感染例や米国の渡航制限措置も記載されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主要な発生源であるDRCのみを計上した。

article.articleHeadline: US introduces new Ebola travel declaration as Africa's most populous nation confirms case for first time in over a decade
article.articleSummary: US imposes a new Ebola travel declaration for all air passengers entering the United States, requiring confirmation they have not visited the Democratic Republic of Congo in the previous 21 days. The requirement, effective November 3, mandates digital or paper attestations and places responsibility on airlines to ensure compliance; the CDC will brief major carriers on procedures. This adds to previously announced restrictions tied to the Bundibugyo strain outbreak across Africa, including measures adopted in May and extended to US citizens in July. The announcement follows Nigeria’s report of its first Ebola case in more than a decade, linked to an Uganda-born woman who returned to Abuja on October 3; officials have not tied the Nigerian case to the US measure. Separate entry restrictions apply to foreign nationals who recently visited Uganda or South Sudan. No US cases were reported as of October 20, and risk is considered low.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エビデンス新たな渡航申告制度を導入、アフリカ最大の人口を持つ国（ナイジェリア）が10年以上ぶりにエボラ症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）由来株（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ・ナイジェリアに波及し、米国が渡航制限を導入するなど国際的な公衆衛生対応が取られており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、南スーダンも記事中で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC由来のブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクが主軸であり、米国の渡航制限措置もDRC渡航歴を基準としている。

article.articleHeadline: Can Rabies Spread Through Curd, Buttermilk, Other Dairy Products? Why 450 People In UP's Gorakhpur Got Anti-Rabies Shots
article.articleSummary: Rabies scare in Gorakhpur district, Uttar Pradesh, after a cow that produced charanamrit for Durga Puja fell ill and died on Oct 20. The cow’s owner reported unusual behavior, including barking; veterinarians suspected a dog bite. While linkage to milk or prasad is not an established rabies transmission route and there is no lab-confirmed rabies in the cow, officials organized precautionary vaccination. Health authorities conducted vaccination camps in Dadi Khas and nearby Govindpur, vaccinating about 50 people at a community health centre on Oct 20 and a further 400 at the camp on Oct 21, for a total of roughly 450 people. The vaccination was precautionary; residents who consumed or handled the milk were advised to seek medical advice and follow vaccination schedules. The incident emphasizes cautious handling of animals suspected of rabies and the need for veterinary confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病はヨーグルトやバターミルクなどの乳製品を介して感染するのか？ウッタル・プラデーシュ州ゴーラクプルで450人が狂犬病ワクチン接種を受けた理由
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病疑いの牛からの乳製品を介した感染は科学的に確立された経路ではなく、ラボ確認もなく、地域保健当局による予防的ワクチン接種で対応が完結している単発の地方ニュース事例。
triage.notes: 狂犬病に感染した牛由来の乳製品を介したヒトへの感染は確立された伝播経路ではなく、人獣共通感染症としての狂犬病自体はインドで地方病的に発生しているが、本件は予防的措置の範囲内でローカルに管理されている。

article.articleHeadline: Sospetto caso antrace. Il paziente sta bene: negativo agli esami
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected case of anthrax. The patient is doing well: tests are negative.
article.articleSummary: A Prato resident returning from Zambia, Africa, presented with fever, dyspnea and diarrhea and was hospitalized for suspected anthrax. A precautionary protocol was triggered at Prato and Careggi (Florence); the patient was treated in a controlled room and transferred for further testing. Diagnostic results from Rome’s Istituto Nazionale Malattie Infettive Spallanzani confirmed no anthrax infection, and authorities stated the disease is not transmitted person-to-person. The patient remains in good condition. The episode, linked to travel from an area where local anthrax foci are reportedly present in Zambia, ended as a false alarm with no confirmed cases. Highlights the importance of traveler surveillance and rapid coordination between Prato emergency services, Careggi, and Spallanzani.

triage.headline_ja: 炭疽疑い例。患者は良好な状態：検査結果は陰性
triage.triage_reason: イタリアでの炭疽疑い症例は検査の結果陰性と確認され、実際の感染事例は存在しないため偽陽性（false alarm）として終結した。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリア・プラートでの疑い症例に関するもので、検査により炭疽感染は否定された。ザンビアでの発生は患者の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、ザンビア国内での炭疽流行自体を主題とする記事ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya seeks 10,000 Ebola vaccine doses
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-23, Kenya reports a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak with 1 death and 8 infections, all hospitalized and described as stable after NB134 monoclonal antibody treatment followed by remdesivir. The index case was a Kenyan man who had business in the Democratic Republic of Congo, traveled via Entebbe to Nairobi, and died about 48 hours after onset. Authorities identified 135 contacts, all accounted for, including a Ugandan traveler who entered by air and left by road. Eight patients are receiving NB134 then remdesivir; one experienced desaturation needing supplemental oxygen but none of NB134 caused adverse reactions. Kenya has requested 10,000 vaccine doses, likely Ervebo, for health workers first; WHO notes no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo, use only under a research protocol. Quarantine is being managed with a multi-agency effort, highlighting regional cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラワクチン1万回分を要請
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでブンディブジョ型エボラの発生が確認され、死亡者・複数感染者・135人の接触者が発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大な国際公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: 指数症例はDRCでの就労歴があり、エンテベ(ウガンダ)経由でナイロビに渡航した後発症・死亡。実際の発生・感染拡大はケニア国内で起きており、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。DRC・ウガンダは渡航歴・接触者の文脈のみで記事の主題ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC Chief Warns 'No Country Is Safe' As Ebola Reaches Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo virus remains uncontrolled, centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) since May 15, with 9,735 confirmed cases and 4,690 deaths reported. Nigeria confirms its first case in more than a decade: a woman who returned to Abuja from Uganda on Oct 3, developed symptoms Oct 6, and was diagnosed on Monday after hospital admission on Oct 11; about 44 contacts are being monitored. Infection source is under investigation amid conflicting travel details; the patient reportedly traveled Kampala–Abuja via Addis Ababa after two weeks in Kampala, though Ugandan authorities dispute that she passed through Uganda. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo virus; transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids of symptomatic individuals, with a 21-day incubation and monitoring window. Eight DRC provinces are affected; daily cases around 65–70. WHO declared a global health emergency on May 17, and Africa CDC urges strengthened cross-border surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC代表、ナイジェリアへのエボラ拡大受け『安全な国はない』と警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで制御不能なエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が継続し9,735例・4,690人死亡、さらにナイジェリアへの国際的拡大が確認されたため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のエボラ流行とナイジェリアへの越境拡大。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・エチオピアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Africa facing 'complex' Ebola outbreak after Nigeria reports first case
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports an imported Ebola case of the Bundibugyo strain in a diplomat with travel history to Uganda, marking the first west African case as WHO Africa warns of a ‘complex’ outbreak landscape. Kenya has recorded nine cases since October 6, and Nigeria becomes the fourth African country affected as the Bundibugyo-driven epidemic spreads from east Africa. The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to bear the deadliest outbreak in its history, with 4,381 deaths among more than 9,000 confirmed cases since mid-May. The 2014 West Africa outbreak, which killed over 11,000 people, provides context for regional response. A trial of the Ervebo vaccine is underway in eastern Congo; Ervebo is licensed for the Zaire strain, and about 70,000 doses have been approved for Congo—roughly 50,000 for frontline workers and 20,000 for a Bundibugyo-focused clinical trial, since there is no licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:ナイジェリアで初症例確認後、アフリカは「複雑な」エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準中3つが該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大）し、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）史上最悪規模のアウトブレイクが継続中かつ複数国へ拡大しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・アンゴラ・モザンビークに言及しているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。DRCでは2026年5月中旬以降9,000人超の確定症例、4,381人の死亡が報告されており、同国史上最悪のエボラアウトブレイクとなっている。Bundibugyo株には承認ワクチンがなく、臨床試験中のErveboワクチンの効果は未確定。

article.articleHeadline: Somalia: Somaliland Steps Up Ebola Preparedness, Reports No Cases
article.articleSummary: Somaliland reports no Ebola infections and no confirmed cases as of Oct 22, 2026, but has heightened preparedness to prevent spread of the Bundibugyo strain amid East Africa concerns. Surveillance at Hargeisa international airport and border crossings has been strengthened after a Cabinet briefing by Health Development Minister Dr. Hussein Bashir Hirsi. A permanent Ebola prevention and preparedness committee was activated, and healthcare workers are receiving additional training in detection, prevention, and control. The response is coordinated with interior, aviation, information, education, religious affairs, immigration authorities, and regional and municipal administrations to improve rapid identification of suspected cases. Ebola transmission is via direct contact with infected blood or bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, severe weakness, vomiting, diarrhoea, and bleeding in severe cases. The Bundibugyo strain has been linked to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The government notes continued vigilance as East Africa monitors travel and potential cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: ソマリア：ソマリランドがエボラ出血熱への備えを強化、感染例は報告なし
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）はIHR常時通報対象疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国での発生を背景に越境拡大懸念があるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はソマリランド（対象国外）における予防体制強化であり、同国内に感染例はない。一方、感染源とされるBundibugyo株の実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（対象国）であるため、同国をverified_locationsとして記録した。

article.articleHeadline: बस्तर में मलेरिया से बचाव के लिए 68 करोड़ मिले, कांकेर में 10 दिन में 3 बच्चों की मौत के बाद भी मेडिकेटेड मच्छरदानी नहीं
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ₹68 crore received for malaria prevention in Bastar; even after 3 children died in 10 days in Kanker, medicated mosquito nets are not available.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Bastar division: 8,426 cases this year. In Kanker district, July saw three schoolchildren die within ten days, prompting NHRC to issue notices to the Chief Secretary and Health Secretary. Despite monsoon-driven mosquito surges, medicated mosquito nets have not been purchased; distribution, halted since 2024, remains a gap in prevention. This year’s procurement is via CGMSC with ₹68 crore allotted by the center, but the tender process has not started because CGMSC’s private consultants have not prepared bidding documents. Until bidding, supply, and distribution are completed, villagers will not benefit. In Mardapoti Boys’ Ashram, Kanker, nine-year-old Subhash Kumeti died during treatment; two other schoolchildren also died of malaria, all within ten days.

triage.headline_ja: バスタルのマラリア対策に68億ルピー配分も、カンケルで10日間に3人の子供が死亡したにもかかわらず薬剤処理蚊帳は未配布
triage.triage_reason: インド・バスタル地域でのマラリア流行と対応の遅れを示す地域的な公衆衛生問題だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、WHO通知基準には該当しない。既存の風土病の管理体制不備に関する報道であり、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの風土病であり、本記事は地方政府の対策不備（蚊帳未配布、入札遅延）とそれに伴う子供の死亡例を報じるもの。NHRCが介入しているため政治的関心は高いが、国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: First Nigeria and Kenya Ebola patients may have crossed paths at Uganda airport, officials say
article.articleSummary: Ebola cross-border exposure probes follow both patients' Oct 3 Entebbe airport passage. Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in more than a decade: a 42-year-old Ugandan-born woman living in Abuja who travelled from Uganda, via Addis Ababa, and developed symptoms four days after arriving; she tests positive on Oct 20 and is in isolation, with her Swiss diplomat husband also isolated. Kenya's outbreak includes nine infections, including one death, all linked to the initial Kenyan patient; the patient died after travelling from DR Congo through Uganda to Nairobi on Oct 3, with no confirmed wider community transmission. Investigators are checking whether the two infections intersected at Entebbe or share a common source. WHO notes incomplete travel histories and ongoing Nigerian genomic sequencing; Africa CDC cites additional exposures beyond 44 contacts, mainly healthcare workers and some family; concerns linger about porous borders with DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアとケニアの初のエボラ患者、ウガンダの空港で接触した可能性＝当局
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ感染がウガンダ経由でケニア・ナイジェリアへ国境を越えて拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当し、WHO・Africa CDCが関与する国際的関心の高い事案であるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はDRC由来のエボラウイルスがウガンダ経由でケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的に伝播した事例。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・エチオピアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、感染源とされるDRCのみをverified_locationsに計上した。

article.articleHeadline: 福州疾控提醒：流感季临近，11月前尽快完成接种！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fuzhou CDC reminds: The influenza season is approaching; get vaccinated as soon as possible before November.
article.articleSummary: Influenza season is approaching in Fuzhou, Fujian. For 2026-2027, rural areas offer one free dose of trivalent inactivated influenza vaccine to residents aged 65+ and to compulsory-education students; no vaccine or service fees; identity verified by household register or ID. Vaccination before November is advised; antibodies take 2–4 weeks, and protection lasts 6–8 months. Vaccines are updated annually to match circulating strains; last year’s vaccine may not cover current strains. Production and batch release occur ahead of the season, with WHO GISRS guiding component updates twice yearly. The aim is to prevent severe illness, hospitalization, and death, not complete infection avoidance. Who should get it: all 6 months+, with priority groups including healthcare workers, seniors 60+, chronically ill, residents/workers in care facilities, 6mo–5y children, infants' contacts, people in schools, and pregnant women. Sites: community health centers and township clinics; free vaccine contact numbers provided by Fuzhou CDCs.

triage.headline_ja: 福州疾病予防管理センターが注意喚起：インフルエンザシーズンが近づいています。11月までに予防接種を完了しましょう！
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種の呼びかけに関する行政広報であり、異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンの案内記事であり、具体的な感染拡大や異常事態の報告はない。中国は対象国リストに含まれるが、イベントの性質上シグナルとして扱う必要はない。

article.articleHeadline: Śmiertelny wirus w nowym kraju. Odtwarzają trasę lotu samolotem zakażonej
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly virus in a new country. They retrace the infected woman's flight path.
article.articleSummary: WHO warned of a 'complex' Ebola landscape as the virus travels from East Africa to Nigeria—the first case in West Africa. Nigeria confirmed an imported Bundibugyo Ebola case in the wife of a diplomat who flew from Uganda to Abuja after a stay in Uganda (Sept 16–Oct 3), via Ethiopian Airlines with a connection in Addis Ababa. Contact tracing has identified high-risk contacts placed under full quarantine; Nigeria’s health minister said there is no evidence of community transmission. Nigeria is the fourth African country affected by the outbreak; Kenya has reported nine cases since Oct 6. The outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and remains its deadliest period, with more than 4,000 deaths among over 9,000 confirmed cases since mid-May; Bundibugyo has no vaccine or specific treatment. Lagos is screening arrivals; Uganda asserts it is Ebola-free and rejects links to the Nigeria case.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな国で致死性ウイルス感染確認。感染者の搭乗した飛行機の経路を追跡
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起源とするエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが複数国に拡大し、死亡者数4000人超・確定症例9000人超と深刻で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで継続中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・エチオピア経由で拡大している状況を報じているが、これら周辺国は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: 科学防控传染病 共筑校园"健康盾" 烟台一职开展秋冬季传染病预防专题讲座-今日聚焦-水母网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Science-based prevention and control of infectious diseases, building a campus "Health Shield" — Yantai Yizhi holds autumn and winter infectious disease prevention special lecture - Today Focus - Shuimu Net
article.articleSummary: On Oct 10, Yantai First Vocational Secondary School (Yantai Economic School) held a campus-wide infectious disease prevention lecture led by Guo Ruilai, chief physician in the Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Department of Yantai CDC. Guo, a Xiangya Public Health School alumnus, delivered a campus-focused overview of autumn–winter respiratory infections, including influenza, SARS-CoV-2 infection, Mycoplasma pneumoniae, and Streptococcus pneumoniae. She stressed vaccines as the most cost-effective protection against influenza and pneumococcal disease, and promoted hand hygiene, ventilation, and cough etiquette. The talk also covered norovirus-associated winter vomiting disease and provided monkeypox clinical guidance. She corrected common misconceptions that antibiotics cure viruses and advised against self-medication. The session empowered students to take responsibility for their health and adopt protective habits, while the school pledged ongoing sanitation, ventilation, health education, and reinforcement of a robust campus health shield.

triage.headline_ja: 科学的な感染症予防対策で校園の「健康の盾」を共に築く——煙台市第一職業中等専門学校（煙台経済学校）が秋冬季感染症予防特別講座を開催
triage.triage_reason: 学校での一般的な感染症予防啓発講座に関する記事であり、具体的な感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の感染症発生事例の報告ではなく、学校における季節性感染症（インフルエンザ、マイコプラズマ肺炎、ノロウイルス等）の予防啓発講座についての教育的内容。具体的な患者数や発生状況の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Разследват връзката между заразените с ебола в Нигерия и Кения
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Investigating the link between Ebola-infected people in Nigeria and Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola cases are under investigation for a possible link via Entebbe airport exposure on 3 October, as of 23 October 2026. Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in more than a decade: a 42-year-old woman, born in Uganda and living in Abuja, who returned from about two-and-a-half weeks in Uganda on 3 October, flew via Addis Ababa, developed symptoms four days after arrival, and tested positive on 20 October. She remains in isolation; her husband, a Swiss diplomat who accompanied her to Uganda, is also in isolation but asymptomatic. Kenya has confirmed nine Ebola cases, including one death; the male patient who died had travelled from DR Congo via Uganda and arrived in Nairobi on 3 October. Investigators are examining whether the two patients shared airport facilities or contact, or if a common source exists. WHO says it is too early to determine the Nigerian infection source; Congo’s outbreak approaches 10,000 cases and 5,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアとケニアのエボラ感染者間の関連性を調査
triage.triage_reason: DRCで拡大中のエボラ流行（約1万症例・5000人死亡）に関連し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的な人の移動を介して拡散した可能性が疑われており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる感染源はDRCの大規模エボラ流行であり、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイス・エチオピアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。国際空港を介した感染拡大の可能性があり、WHOも調査中。

article.articleHeadline: 美, 민주콩고 에볼라 확산에 입국 통제...체류 기록 의무 제출
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. imposes entry restrictions amid Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; mandatory submission of stay records.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompt reinforced U.S. entry controls. The CDC will require all international air passengers arriving in the United States to submit a certificate (paper or electronic) stating they have not visited or stayed in the DRC within the past 21 days, effective November 3, 2026. Earlier measures began in May, barring travelers with recent DRC exposure from boarding, and in July expanding the rule to all travelers, including U.S. citizens. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, noting no approved therapies or vaccines for this outbreak, and that the virus has spread to Nigeria and Kenya. The DRC outbreak involves the Bundibugyo ebolavirus lineage, a relatively rare strain compared with previous Zaire-type outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 米、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ拡大受け入国規制強化...滞在歴の提出義務化
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言し、複数国（ナイジェリア、ケニア）への拡大や米国の渡航制限措置が実施されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国・ナイジェリア・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOはPHEICを宣言済み、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo株によるアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: OMS trage un semnal de alarmă: focarul de Ebola se extinde în trei țări africane. Situația devine tot mai complicată
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO issues a warning: the Ebola outbreak is spreading to three African countries. The situation is becoming increasingly complicated.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to grow, with confirmed cases spreading to Nigeria and Kenya, marking three-country involvement. The World Health Organization warns the epidemiology is increasingly complex as investigators seek where the Nigerian patient, the Bundibugyo strain’s first case in Nigeria, contracted the infection and whether there was exposure to Kenya’s first case. The Nigerian patient is the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja; authorities say she traveled from eastern DRC and transited Uganda, but WHO/Africa CDC have not confirmed Congo as the infection source, and Uganda denies on-the-ground infection. Kenya reported its first Ebola case in early October and later eight additional cases, with 135 contacts identified. Nigeria is monitoring about 44 potential contacts. Since May, the Congo outbreak has surpassed 9,000 cases and 4,000 deaths, the deadliest on record for the country.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：エボラの発生がアフリカ3カ国に拡大。状況はますます複雑化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ大規模流行（9,000例超、4,000人超死亡）が国境を越えてナイジェリア・ケニアに拡大し、WHOが警鐘を鳴らしており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する深刻な国際的拡大事例である。
triage.notes: ナイジェリアとケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、DRCでの大規模流行が本事例の中心であり、越境拡大の事実は重要な懸念材料である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'OMS alerte sur une épidémie devenue régionale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO warns of a regional outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus Bundibugyo outbreak remains centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and has extended to Kenya and Nigeria, signaling a regional, increasingly complex situation. Kenya has nine confirmed cases and one death as of 20 October 2026, linked to an imported case from the DRC, while Nigeria confirmed a single imported case in a woman who traveled from Uganda—the fifth country to report a case in this outbreak after DRC, Uganda, France, and Kenya. In the DRC, the virus has spread to eight provinces, with 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths by 21 October 2026 (ECDC). No vaccine specific to Bundibugyo is approved; vaccines based on the Zaïre strain are not sufficiently protective against this variant. Several vaccine candidates are in development, including preclinical and early clinical stages. The WHO urges strengthened surveillance, contact-tracing, and regional coordination to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOが地域的流行に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: DRCを中心にケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、フランスの5か国に拡大し、9,704症例・4,687人死亡という深刻な規模。ワクチンの有効性も不十分でWHOが地域的な警戒を発しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、フランスも感染拡大国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが震源地かつ最大の感染規模であり、同国が主たる対象となる。Bundibugyo株は既承認のZaïre株ワクチンでは十分な防御効果がない点も重要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: 尼日利亚与肯尼亚的埃博拉患者可能曾在乌干达机场相遇，官员称Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻 - NEWS.CHINA.COM.AU 这里是生活在墨尔本咱自家人的地盘！把客场当主场，视异乡为故园。澳洲唐人街 - 中华澳网 China Town News澳洲唐人街;澳大利亚华人社区和主流新闻媒体
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Officials say that Ebola patients from Nigeria and Kenya may have met at an airport in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola patients from Nigeria and Kenya may have met at Entebbe Airport in Uganda on Oct 3, raising transmission concerns. Africa CDC says investigators are evaluating whether shared airport facilities or other contacts could have exposed either patient; no confirmed link yet. Nigerian patient, a 42-year-old woman living in Abuja, travelled via Addis Ababa, stayed in Uganda about 2.5 weeks, returned Oct 3, and developed symptoms four days after arriving in Nigeria; she tested positive for Ebola on Oct 20 after treatment at clinics. Her Swiss diplomat husband is in isolation but asymptomatic. Nigeria is conducting genome sequencing and reviewing travel histories, with more contacts identified beyond 44 contacts; high-risk contacts being isolated. In Kenya, nine infections are confirmed, all linked to the first patient who traveled from Congo DR via Uganda to Nairobi and died; eight remain in isolation. WHO/Africa CDC urge vigilance; no confirmed community spread yet.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアとケニアのエボラ患者がウガンダの空港で接触した可能性、当局が調査
triage.triage_reason: 複数国（ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国）にまたがるエボラ出血熱の感染連鎖の可能性があり、国際的拡大リスクと重症度の両面でIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ケニアの最初の患者はコンゴ民主共和国からウガンダを経由して入国したとされており、DRCが感染連鎖の起点として関連するため verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Chennai vaccinates over 1.5 lakh stray dogs in anti-rabies drive - Bilkul Online
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination drive in Chennai: Greater Chennai Corporation vaccinated 150,303 stray dogs against rabies and provided parasite treatment from Aug 11 to Oct 21, 2026, as part of Tamil Nadu Chief Minister’s directive to make the state rabies-free. Across 15 zones in Chennai, Ambattur recorded the highest vaccinations (21,844), followed by Madhavaram (15,038) and Thiru Vi Ka Nagar (13,849). Perungudi (12,752), Tondiarpet (12,477), and Tiruvottiyur (12,313) also reported substantial figures. Camps continue in Valasaravakkam, Adyar, and Sholinganallur. The campaign complements broader public health efforts to protect residents and reduce rabies risk in Tamil Nadu and aligns with the goal of a rabies-free city.Parasite-control treatment was provided alongside vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイ、狂犬病予防対策で野良犬150万匹以上にワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の発生事例報告ではなく、予防的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はチェンナイ市当局による狂犬病予防のための野良犬へのワクチン接種・寄生虫駆除キャンペーンの実施報告であり、実際の狂犬病症例の発生やアウトブレイクについての報告ではない。対象国は該当するが、イベントとして見送り対象。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes: Ratusan Warga 'Serpong Lagoon' Tangsel Keracunan Air
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Office: Hundreds of residents of 'Serpong Lagoon' in South Tangerang poisoned by water.
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli contamination of the water supply in Serpong Lagoon housing, South Tangerang, Indonesia, has infected 176 residents (up from 146), as of Oct 22, 2026. Water drawn through household pipelines distributed by PT Arfa Putra Soegama tested positive for E. coli; authorities warn the STEC (Shiga toxin-producing E. coli) strains can cause severe gastroenteritis with fever, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea, with one patient hospitalized. The Tangsel Health Office has halted use of the developer-supplied water, ordered treatment and regular quality checks, and arranged bottled-water relief and water tankers. Residents report buying bottled gallons for daily needs, with an estimated cost around Rp200,000 for 10 gallons per day. The DPRD hearing on Oct 14 cited 146 cases; the outbreak is linked to the housing water network. No details are provided about imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局:タンゲランスラタン『スルポンラグーン』の住民数百人が水質汚染で中毒
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア南タンゲランの特定住宅団地における水道汚染によるE. coli感染事例であり、原因（PT Arfa Putra Soegama供給の水道管）が特定され、保健局が給水停止・ボトル水配布等の対応を実施済み。重症例は1件のみで、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは見られない。
triage.notes: 地域ニュースとして保健局・地方議会（DPRD）が対応しているローカルな水質汚染事案。感染源は特定済みで、給水停止・ボトル水配布・水質検査など対策が既に講じられており、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: 450 villagers in UP rush to take anti-rabies shots after consumig 'charnamrit'
article.articleSummary: Rabies fears in Gorakhpur district, Uttar Pradesh, after charanamrit (prasad) made from milk of a cow that died with rabies-like symptoms following a suspected stray-dog bite prompted a precautionary anti-rabies drive for 450 villagers. The cow died on Tuesday; rabies in the animal has not been officially confirmed. Milk from the cow had been used for Durga Puja charanamrit in Dadi Khas and neighboring Govindpur villages. On Oct 21, a Health Department team led by pharmacist Siddharth Singh set up a vaccination camp at the village; Gorakhpur Deputy Chief Medical Officer Dr Rajesh Kumar said 450 people were vaccinated. Owner Nawami Yadav said the bite source is unknown; residents sought help at the local community health centre. The article does not report confirmed human rabies cases.

triage.headline_ja: UP州の村民450人、『チャラナムリット』摂取後に狂犬病予防接種に殺到
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病疑いの牛由来の乳製品を摂取した住民への予防的ワクチン接種事例であり、確定診断や人への感染は報告されていないが、感染経路の特殊性から続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 牛の狂犬病感染は未確認であり、ヒトへの感染症例も報告されていない。乳（チャラナムリット）経由の狂犬病感染は医学的に極めて稀であり、予防的措置として実施された事例。

article.articleHeadline: 450 People Get Anti-Rabies Shots After Consuming Cow's Milk: Can Rabies Spread Through Milk?
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, about 450 people in two Gorakhpur district villages, Dadi Khas and Govindpur in UP, received anti-rabies vaccines after consuming charanamrit made from the milk of a cow suspected of rabies. The cow died following abnormal behaviour; veterinarians suspected a stray dog bite, but rabies was not officially confirmed. An initial vaccination drive treated about 50 people on Tuesday, with a subsequent village camp vaccinating roughly 400 more on Wednesday. Rabies is mainly transmitted via infected saliva, typically through bites. India's National Rabies Control Programme notes no evidence-based reports of human rabies from milk; post-exposure prophylaxis is not required solely due to milk exposure. WHO says raw milk transmission is extremely rare. Anyone worried should seek medical advice; exposed wounds should be washed with soap and water for 15 minutes, and vaccination/immunoglobulin considered. The incident underscores the need for veterinary assessment for unusual livestock behaviour.

triage.headline_ja: 牛の乳を摂取した450人が狂犬病予防接種を受ける：狂犬病は乳を介して感染するか？
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病が疑われる牛の乳を摂取した住民450人に予防的ワクチン接種が行われたが、牛の狂犬病は未確定でヒトーヒト感染や拡大のリスクは低く、国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。地域住民の健康不安への対応として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 牛の狂犬病感染は未確認。乳を介した狂犬病感染は科学的に極めて稀とされ、インドの狂犬病対策プログラムも乳曝露のみでの曝露後予防を推奨していない。地域の予防的対応事例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana strengthens Ebola surveillance amid reported cases in Kenya, Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Ghana strengthens Ebola surveillance as Kenya and Nigeria report cases linked to an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Ghana has not recorded a case but is intensifying border measures, including enhanced airport screening, 21-day traveler monitoring, laboratory preparedness, and simulation exercises at Accra and the Ghana Infectious Disease Centre, with coordination among the Ghana Airports Company Limited and Civil Aviation Authority. Kenya reported an imported Bundibugyo Ebola case from the DRC on Oct 6, 2026; by Oct 17, six additional linked cases emerged, including healthcare workers. Nigeria confirmed a case in the Federal Capital Territory on Oct 20. Ebola symptoms develop 2–21 days after exposure (avg 8–10): fever, severe headache, fatigue, sore throat, chills, sometimes bleeding and confusion. Transmission is by direct contact with blood or body fluids; not airborne. Public urged to seek care, disclose travel history, practice hand hygiene, and avoid contact with febrile people.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ、ケニア・ナイジェリアでのエボラ症例報告を受けサーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ出血熱がケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大しており、医療従事者への感染も確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナの水際対策強化が主題だが、ガーナ国内での症例は未確認。実際の感染発生国はDRC（発端）であり、ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。続報でガーナ国内発生の有無を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of Congo - Ebola response: Strengthening treatment and preserving essential care
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Haut Uélé, Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Isiro. The Bundibugyo virus is responsible. By 19 October 2026, 421 laboratory-confirmed cases and 180 deaths have been recorded across 7 of 13 health zones, with Isiro among the hardest hit. The Isiro General Reference Hospital reorganized to host the Isiro Ebola Treatment Centre (ETC), initially 40 beds and expanded to 50 beds with MSF support; improved conditions include electricity, water, regular cleaning, and better infection-control, enabling the hospital to resume routine services as transmission is curtailed. WHO delivered medicines, oxygen therapy equipment, PPE, beds, and mattresses to sustain essential care. Vaccination of frontline workers with the ERVEBO vaccine is underway nationally for research, with over 9,000 agents vaccinated; effectiveness against Bundibugyo virus remains under investigation. As of 19 October 2026, about 55 patients are hospitalized, reflecting improved capacity and ongoing efforts to preserve essential health services.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 - エボラ対応：治療の強化と必須医療サービスの維持
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）のアウトブレイクで421例確認・180名死亡という重大な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準にも該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHOおよびMSFが対応支援中。ワクチン(ERVEBO)の有効性はブンディブギョウイルスに対して検証中であり、既存のザイール株用ワクチンとの効果差に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 一男子健身房撸铁后没洗手消毒挠了脸，结果长出"小肉球"，医生提醒：系病毒感染，而且会传染，健身后别急着摸脸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man at the gym developed small flesh bumps after not washing his hands or disinfecting and scratching his face; doctors warn it's a contagious viral infection, so don't touch your face after exercising.
article.articleSummary: Fujian, China, Oct 19: a gym-goer developed small flesh-colored bumps on his face after not washing hands or disinfecting and scratching his face. Doctors diagnosed a contagious viral infection and warned it spreads, urging people not to touch the face after exercising. The incident highlights how gym equipment can harbor pathogens, with sweaty hands touching the face facilitating transmission. Precautions include washing hands with soap or using hand sanitizer before and after workouts, carrying disinfectant wipes to clean equipment, and avoiding touching the face. The article cites Dahe Daily and Urban Report as sources; no laboratory confirmation details or specific virus name are provided. Published 2026-10-23.

triage.headline_ja: ジムで筋トレ後、手を洗わず消毒せずに顔を掻いた男性に「小さな肉球」が発生、医師は「ウイルス感染で感染力あり、運動後すぐ顔を触らないように」と注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 単一個人の軽微な皮膚症状の事例報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 単一症例の健康啓発記事であり、ウイルス名や検査確定情報も不明。公衆衛生イベントとしての重大性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO investigates Ebola exposure risk in Nigeria as DRC outbreak spreads to eighth province
article.articleSummary: WHO tracing movements of a woman who arrived in Nigeria from Uganda and tested positive for Ebola disease. More than 40 close contacts identified; sequencing underway to determine if the infection matches Bundibugyo virus circulating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The patient developed symptoms on October 7 and was hospitalized 48 hours later. Nigeria has introduced infection prevention and control measures in health facilities and is engaging private providers to bolster preparedness. The Nigerian case comes as the DRC outbreak spreads to Nord Ubangi, the eighth province, with Mangina (North Kivu) reporting ongoing transmission. The DRC outbreak has more than 4,600 deaths and 9,552 confirmed infections, with about 60% of deaths occurring outside health centres. Kenya has nine cases, Uganda 20 cases, both with deaths, while Uganda’s outbreak was declared over at the end of August. WHO is studying whether the Ervebo vaccine offers cross-protection against Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ナイジェリアでのエボラ曝露リスクを調査中、DRCのアウトブレイクは8県目に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが8県目に拡大し死者4600人超・感染者9552人に達しており、国境を越えてナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダにも感染者が確認されるなど国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い深刻な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアでの症例報告があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主たる発生国として該当。Bundibugyoウイルス株の可能性、Ervebo ワクチンの交差防御効果についても調査中であり続報が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Emergency nurseries rescue DR Congo's Ebola orphans
article.articleSummary: DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri province near the Uganda border, remains uncontrolled five months in, with Mongbwalu hosting 12 UNICEF-supported nurseries for hundreds of Ebola orphans. More than 2,000 child infections accompany 9,704 total infections and 4,687 deaths in the DRC, a case fatality rate near 50%. The Bundibugyo strain drives severe haemorrhagic fever transmitted via bodily fluids; no approved vaccine or targeted treatment exists. Children account for about one-third of deaths and more than a quarter of infections—over 2,000 child infections—while outbreaks have also been detected in Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria. Orphans stay under 21-day observation; some show symptoms after seven days and are admitted to treatment centres. About 8,200 newly orphaned children have been registered since the outbreak began. Response faces resource shortages and armed-group insecurity in Ituri; a clinical trial is underway but no vaccine is available.

triage.headline_ja: 緊急保育施設がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ孤児を救う
triage.triage_reason: DRCの第17次エボラ流行はCFR約50%で5ヶ月間制御できておらず、周辺国への拡散も報告されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでの検出にも言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。主題はDRC・イトゥリ州のアウトブレイクである。

article.articleHeadline: Quảng Ninh tăng cường phòng, chống dịch bệnh mùa thu - đông
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quảng Ninh Strengthens Prevention and Control of Autumn-Winter Diseases
article.articleSummary: Quảng Ninh, Vietnam, strengthens autumn–winter infectious disease prevention. The provincial CDC elevates surveillance and proactive control as seasonal transition, climate change, travel, and school start raise risk of respiratory and gastrointestinal infections: seasonal influenza, COVID-19, pneumonia, pertussis, measles, RSV, and Rotavirus diarrhea, with dengue fever and hand-foot-mouth disease showing early upticks in some areas. Health facilities are urged to closely monitor trends, promptly collect specimens, identify pathogens, and quickly contain outbreaks to prevent spread. Collaboration with local authorities, schools, industrial zones, tourist sites, and malls is emphasized, alongside public messaging on vaccination, personal and environmental hygiene, larval/disease vector control, and food safety. The Expanded Immunization Program should be sustained with catch-up vaccination. Hospitals must plan for surges, enforce infection control, and protect high-risk groups. The International Health Quarantine Center should monitor global trends and reinforce border screening. Reporting must follow MOH Circular 15/2026/TT-BYT (May 17, 2026).

triage.headline_ja: クアンニン省、秋冬の疾病予防・対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の疾病予防に関する一般的な行政広報であり、異常な集団発生や重症例の急増は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 複数の既知季節性感染症（インフルエンザ、COVID-19、麻疹、百日咳、RSV、デング熱、手足口病等）に対する予防強化の通達であり、特定の異常発生事例の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes: Untuk Pertama Kalinya Kasus Tuberkolosis di Indonesia Menurun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: For the first time, tuberculosis cases in Indonesia have declined.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's TB burden is projected to decline to 1,080,000 cases in 2026, down from 1,092,000 in 2024, per the WHO Global TB Report cited by Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin. By October 2026, 666,985 TB cases had been identified and reported (61% of a 972,000 target), with 599,425 (90%) starting treatment. Diagnostic capacity expanded via portable X-ray devices and Near Point of Care molecular testing deployed at thousands of Puskesmas (community health centers). TB screening has been integrated into the Free Health Check program and conducted at mass gathering sites, including prisons (lapas), detention centers (rutan), and pesantren. As of October 2026, 40,910 inmates and 24,623 santri underwent TB screening. Additionally, 8,914 workers and partners in online transport services (e.g., Gojek, Grab) were screened. Treatment regimens have been shortened—from over a year to 12 months, then 6 months, with some regimens as short as 4 months.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省：インドネシアで結核症例が初めて減少
triage.triage_reason: 結核症例数の減少という好転報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性・異常性はなく、既存の慢性疾患に対する施策進展を伝える内容のため見送り。
triage.notes: 結核症例数の減少を報じるポジティブな保健政策報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Naik, Klaim Asuransi Kesehatan dalam Jangka Pendek Ikut Terkerek
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases are rising, short-term health insurance claims are also rising.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising in Indonesia, including subtypes H1N1pdm09 and H3N2, prompting a temporary uptick in health insurance claims for outpatient and inpatient care. The Financial Services Authority (OJK) notes the increase is not yet triggering broad premium hikes, as most insurers hold adequate technical reserves and reinsurance protection, and pricing remains based on long-term actuarial analyses that consider past claims, medical inflation, and risk margins. If any repricing occurs, insurers must report revised product pricing and actuarial evaluations to OJK. The Association of Indonesian Life Insurance (AAJI) reports higher claims at some life insurers but within tolerable limits. Allianz Life Indonesia reports influenza-related claims exceeding Rp13.8 billion for 1,857 cases from January to mid-September 2026, and influenza hospitalizations rose 47% year-on-year from January to August 2026. Health authorities urge early symptom recognition (fever, cough, fatigue) and timely medical care.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA感染者数増加、医療保険の短期的な請求も増加
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで季節性インフルエンザA（H1N1pdm09、H3N2）の症例増加が報告されているが、通常の季節性流行の範囲内とみられ、IHR基準や社会的関心の高まりは明確でないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザAの症例増加による医療保険金請求への影響を中心に報じており、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性を示す情報はない。入院率が前年比47%増加している点は注視すべきだが、季節性変動の範囲内かどうか不明。

article.articleHeadline: Virusul Ebola face mii de victime în Africa; Ce spune ANSP despre riscul de infectare în Republica Moldova
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus kills thousands of victims in Africa; What the ANSP says about the risk of infection in the Republic of Moldova.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in Africa: as of 20 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 9,637 infections and 4,646 deaths. Kenya has 9 cases and 1 death; Nigeria 1 case; Uganda 20 cases and 1 probable, with no active cases currently. Four imported cases were identified in Europe (Germany, Netherlands, France); all recovered. Moldova’s ANSP, citing ECDC, says the risk of introduction into Moldova is very low. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or body fluids of a symptomatic person or contaminated objects; incubation 2–21 days. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, weakness, muscle and joint pain, headache and sore throat, with possible vomiting and diarrhea. Authorities urge hand hygiene, avoidance of fluids from sick or suspected individuals, and prompt medical care for travelers returning from affected regions; inform clinicians of travel history. WHO does not advocate travel restrictions; Moldova cautions against nonessential travel to high-risk zones.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがアフリカで数千人の犠牲者を出す；モルドバ共和国における感染リスクについてANSPが見解
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で9,637例・4,646人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダおよび欧州（独・仏・蘭）へ国際的に拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たしフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はモルドバ視点だが、発生の主体はDRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・独仏蘭は輸入症例または小規模発生で、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola: le Nigeria confirme un premier cas issu de la souche Bundibugyo | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: Nigeria confirms first case stemming from the Bundibugyo strain | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola virus disease (EVD) case caused by the Bundibugyo strain, linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. The patient, a diplomat, arrived in Abuja on Oct 3 from Uganda; her condition deteriorated to multiorgan failure after several days in a private hospital. Three molecular tests confirmed Bundibugyo, per NCDC director Olajumoke Babatunde. Nigeria has identified 44 contacts for monitoring as authorities intensify exposure tracing. The WHO says infection prevention and control measures were reinforced in the private hospital where care was sought. Africa CDC warns of an extremely grave threat. In DRC, the 17th Ebola outbreak since May has surpassed 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths; the virus has spread to Uganda, with Kenya reporting its ninth case.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ナイジェリアがブンディブギョ株による初の症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)症例が確認され、DRCの大規模アウトブレイク(9000例超、4381死亡)からウガンダ・ケニアへも拡大しており、IHR基準の複数に該当する重大な国際的懸念事案。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアは記事の主題国だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは17回目のアウトブレイクの発生源として主題に含まれるため記載。Africa CDCは『極めて深刻な脅威』と警告しており、国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, l'Oms: ora in Anfrica scenario epidemico più complesso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, WHO: now in Africa a more complex epidemic scenario
article.articleSummary: WHO Africa region director Mohamed Yakub Janabi says Africa faces a more complex Ebola epidemic since the virus reached Nigeria, where an imported Bundibugyo ebolavirus case has been confirmed. Kenya has reported nine Ebola cases, including one death. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola has spread to an eighth province, with more than 9,000 confirmed cases and over 4,000 deaths reported up to 20 October. The situation is no longer confined to a single location; it requires regional vigilance and coordinated action. The report underscores an ongoing regional transmission dynamic across West and Central Africa, highlighting the need for strengthening surveillance, cross-border collaboration, and response readiness to manage imported/exported cases and curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、WHO：アフリカはより複雑な流行シナリオに突入
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模流行（9000例超、4000人超死亡）に加え、ナイジェリア・ケニアへの国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOアフリカ地域局長の発言に基づき、DRC・ナイジェリア・ケニアにまたがる地域的なエボラ流行の複雑化を報告。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ（ナイジェリア・ケニアはリスト外）。

article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India, reports a rise in viral fevers. At MYH’s Medicine OPD, about 30–35 of every 100 patients present with fever plus joint and muscle pain, headaches, weakness, and fatigue, with accompanying cold, sore throat, and cough as weather fluctuates (clouds, rain, sun). Clinicians warn that fever with severe joint pain should not be dismissed as routine viral fever, since dengue and chikungunya can present similarly, prompting diagnostic testing when indicated. Some patients have fatigue and body aches persisting after fever subsides; others experience fever and joint pain together. If fever persists for three days after treatment or breathing difficulties develop, further medical evaluation is advised.
