triage.headline_ja: インドール市でウイルス性熱が猛威、毎日35人の患者が病院へ、発熱前に現れる6つの症状
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のウイルス性発熱・デング・チクングニアの一般的な注意喚起記事であり、異常な増加や重症例の集積、国際的拡大の兆候はなく、通常の季節性疾患報道の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 地元医師による季節性発熱に関する一般的な注意喚起記事。具体的な症例数・死亡者数・検査確定例数は不明で、デング・チクングニアとの鑑別診断の重要性を述べるに留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Инфекционист успокоила россиян после сообщений об обнаружении очагов оспы обезьян - Свободная Пресса - Здоровье. ЗОЖ. Составляющие ЗОЖ. Здравоохранение. Здравоохранение Российской Федерации. Медицинская помощь
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An infectious-disease specialist reassured Russians after reports of monkeypox outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Five patients in Moscow region hospitalized with suspected monkeypox were not confirmed; several cases are confirmed in Saint Petersburg. Russia’s consumer health watchdog Rospotrebnadzor says it monitors the situation and has taken necessary measures to identify infections, with monkeypox tests, including for new variants, available in sufficient numbers. Olga Rubleva, chief physician at Instamed clinic, notes monkeypox is a highly contagious viral infection caused by a DNA virus closely related to smallpox. Over the past decades, cases have been reported in Africa and worldwide, including the United States, China, and Europe. Typical illness is mild and self-resolves in 2–4 weeks; complications can include secondary skin infections, pneumonia, sepsis, encephalitis, and rare vision loss. Case fatality in outbreaks can reach 11% but is lower with timely care. Russia’s outbreak risk is low; WHO canceled the public-health emergency in May 2026. Travelers to endemic Africa (Congo, Nigeria, and others) should avoid rodents and primates, eat thoroughly cooked foods, and exercise caution with locals.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症専門医、サル痘（Mpox）発生報道後にロシア国民を安心させる発言
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシア（モスクワ・サンクトペテルブルク）における疑い例・確定例に関する安心情報であり、対象国リストに含まれる国での発生事例ではない。DRC・ナイジェリアは渡航時の注意喚起として言及されているのみで、本事例の発生地ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア国内の懸念に対する安心情報であり、WHOも2026年5月にPHEICを解除済み。DRC・ナイジェリアは流行地として渡航者への注意喚起の文脈で言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生国としては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: L'epidemia di ebola in Africa è la più estesa di sempre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Africa is the most widespread ever.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria signals the outbreak's widest spread, with three regions affected: Nigeria (West Africa), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Central Africa), and Kenya (East Africa). The Nigerian patient, a Ugandan woman married to a Swiss diplomat returning from Uganda, developed symptoms on October 7 and was diagnosed on October 20 after contact tracing identified 44 contacts, many healthcare workers, now under monitoring. As of October 22, three African countries report active Bundibugy o ebolavirus cases; this strain, first identified in Uganda, differs from the 2014 Zaire strain, with about 35% fatality. In the DRC, deaths exceed 4,600 and total cases approach 9,000–10,000. Vaccination efforts using Zaire strain vaccines show encouraging lab signals, with 15,000 doses received in August. Ongoing conflict in the DRC hinders response and fuels spread, while transmission occurs via fluids and unsafe funerary practices.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ流行は過去最大規模に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ナイジェリア・ケニアの3カ国に拡大し、DRCでは死者4600人超・致死率約35%という深刻な流行で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは紛争により対応が困難で、流行の中心地として継続的な監視が必要。国際的な人の移動（外交官家族経由）により越境伝播のリスクが実証されている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Nijerya ve Kenya'daki ilk hastalar Uganda havalimanında karşılaşmış olabilir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The first patients in Nigeria and Kenya may have met at an airport in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in Nigeria and Kenya may be linked to an Oct 3 encounter at Uganda’s Entebbe International Airport, with Africa CDC investigating a possible shared path or equipment; no definitive link yet. In Nigeria, a 42-year-old Uganda-born woman living in Abuja becomes the country’s first Ebola case in more than a decade. She returned from Uganda via Addis Ababa on Oct 3; symptoms began four days later and a Oct 20 test was positive. Her husband is in isolation but asymptomatic. Initial contact tracing, focused on 44 contacts, has expanded to include healthcare workers and several family members. In Kenya, nine cases have been confirmed, including one death; the fatality is a man from the Democratic Republic of Congo who arrived in Nairobi via Uganda on Oct 3. All nine cases are said to be linked to the first patient, with no evidence of community spread; a 21-day quarantine for the initial group has concluded. Ebola spreads through direct contact with infected fluids or contaminated objects, not airborne.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ナイジェリアとケニアの最初の患者はウガンダの空港で接触した可能性
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで10年以上ぶりとなるエボラ症例が確認され、ケニアでも死亡例を含む複数症例が発生、空港経由の国際的な感染拡大の可能性が指摘されておりIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本イベントの発生国はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダであり、いずれも対象国リストには含まれない。DRCは死亡者の出身地として言及されているのみでDRC国内での発生ではないため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。国際的に重要なエボラアウトブレイクであるためPICKUPと判定したが、対象国への直接的関連は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: WHO urges coordinated action as Ebola poses regional threat in Africa
article.articleSummary: Global Ebola outbreak escalates into a regional threat across Central, Eastern, and Western Africa. Nigeria reports its first imported Ebola case caused by Bundibugyo virus; Kenya has nine confirmed cases with one death, eight patients in treatment, and over 120 in quarantine, and Kenya has requested 10,000 vaccine doses from WHO and Africa CDC. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where the outbreak began in May, transmission has reached eight of 26 provinces. As of October 20, the DRC tallies 9,704 laboratory-confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%). About 60% of recent deaths occurred outside treatment centres. Africa CDC will host an extraordinary virtual ministers’ meeting on October 28 to coordinate response. The UN expresses confidence in Nigeria’s containment, while cross-border transmission risks are monitored, with 44 high-risk contacts identified. MDCAN urges provision of essential supplies, isolation facilities, PPE, surveillance, and airport/border coordination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOがアフリカにおける地域的脅威として協調行動を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準中3つが該当し、複数国（DRC、ケニア、ナイジェリア）への国際的拡大が確認されており、死亡率も高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニアでも感染例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCは発生地・主要流行地として主題に含まれるため記載。Africa CDCによる10月28日の緊急閣僚級会合開催予定あり、国際的な関心・支援要請が高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết diễn biến phức tạp tại phường Hạc Thành
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever with a complicated course in Hạc Thành Ward
article.articleSummary: 7 locally acquired dengue fever cases have been recorded in Ha Thanh Ward, Thanh Hoa City, since Oct 16, with 4 cases in Doi Cung 2 neighborhood showing possible secondary transmission. The first case was admitted to Ha Thanh General Hospital on Oct 16 and reported to the Ha Thanh Center after transfer to Thanh Hoa Provincial General Hospital on Oct 20. Three additional cases occurred among family and neighbors; local Aedes mosquitoes were detected. In response, authorities conducted environmental sanitation, water-body management, and a 200-meter radius insecticide spray. As of Oct 23, surveillance still detects larval habitats and vectors in Doi Cung 2. Officials warn transmission could continue if control is incomplete, noting favorable weather for mosquitoes. Among the 7 patients, 3 have recovered and been discharged; 4 remain hospitalized at Ha Thanh General, Thanh Hoa Provincial, and Thanh Hoa Children's Hospitals. Other local dengue cases in Truong Thi, Phan Dinh Phung, and Tien Phong without secondary transmission; vectors present there.

triage.headline_ja: ハックタイン坊でデング熱が複雑な経過をたどる
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム国内の一地域での小規模なデング熱クラスター（7例）であり、地方当局が対応中。ヒト-ヒト感染ではなく蚊媒介の二次感染拡大の可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 地元当局による環境整備・殺虫剤散布などの対応が行われているが、幼虫生息地とベクターが依然検出されており、季節的要因（蚊に有利な気候）により感染拡大の可能性が指摘されている。デング熱はベトナムで季節的に発生する地方病であり、国際的な異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Emergency nurseries take in DR Congo's Ebola orphans - kuwaitTimes
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ituri province, with Mongbwalu as the epicenter, is grappling with its 17th Ebola outbreak, one of the deadliest in the country. As of five months into the epidemic, 9,704 people have been infected and 4,687 killed (roughly a 50% fatality rate). The Bundibugyo strain spreads via contact with bodily fluids; no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists, though a clinical trial is underway. Health authorities report resource shortages and insecurity from armed groups limiting response, with many deaths outside facilities unreported. UNICEF-supported emergency nurseries in Mongbwalu and 11 other sites have taken in thousands of orphans; 8,200 newly orphaned children have been registered since the outbreak began. Incubation is up to 21 days; at least one child developed symptoms seven days after arrival. Some cases have appeared in Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: 緊急保育施設がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ孤児を受け入れ - クウェートタイムズ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率約50%の大規模エボラ流行（感染9,704人、死亡4,687人）が進行中で、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアにも症例が拡大しており、国際的拡大と深刻な公衆衛生影響が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイトゥリ州（モングバルを中心地）での第17次エボラ流行を主題としている。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでも症例報告があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。武装勢力による治安悪化で対応が制限されており、未報告死亡の可能性も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Emergency nurseries rescue DR Congo's Ebola orphans
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo strain, remains uncontrolled five months in, with 9,704 infections and 4,687 deaths in the DRC; cases have reached Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria. Mongbwalu, Ituri province near the Uganda border, is the outbreak epicentre. UNICEF-supported emergency nurseries—12 in the area—care for hundreds of Ebola orphans; caregivers and some nurses work in PPE, disinfect toys with chlorine, and monitor children for 21 days, the incubation period. Children account for about one-third of deaths and more than a quarter of infections; UNICEF cites over 2,000 child infections. Since outbreak began, 8,200 newly orphaned children have been registered; some are placed with relatives, others remain unidentifiable. A clinical trial is underway; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. Insecurity and resource shortages hinder access, and many deaths outside facilities go unreported.

triage.headline_ja: 緊急保育施設がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ孤児を救済
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（感染9,704人、死亡4,687人）がウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアに拡大しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの感染拡大が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Kenya, Nigeria: deux nouveaux pays touchés par l'épidémie d'Ebola dus aux failles de la riposte sanitaire de l'Afrique? | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Kenya, Nigeria: Two new countries hit by the Ebola outbreak due to gaps in Africa's public health response?
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) caused by the Bundibugyo strain is spreading from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) into Africa. By Oct 20, Kenya and Nigeria are affected. Nigeria confirmed its first imported EVD case in Abuja, a diplomat who arrived from Uganda; 44 contacts have been traced after symptoms began around Oct 7 and admission on Oct 11. In Uganda, authorities announced the end of its outbreak on Aug 27 after 20 confirmed cases (15 Congo-derived), 2 deaths, and 18 recoveries; over 800 contacts were followed, with no new cases by Oct 20. Kenya reports nine cases linked to the initial patient who traveled from Congo via Uganda; 135 contacts identified and 134 quarantined. Kenya has strengthened border controls for travellers from 10 high-risk countries, including DRC, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda and Burundi. The outbreak’s cross-border spread highlights surveillance gaps; there is no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo EVD.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、ナイジェリア：アフリカの公衆衛生対応の不備によりエボラ流行の影響を受けた新たな2カ国
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）起源のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへ国境を越えて拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ルワンダ、タンザニア、ブルンジは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。流行の起点であるDRCのみを対象国として記載。ブンディブギョ株には承認されたワクチン・治療薬がなく、国境を越えた拡大がサーベイランスの脆弱性を浮き彫りにしている。

article.articleHeadline: DPKP Palangka Raya perkuat antisipasi penyebaran rabies pada hewan peliharaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DPKP Palangka Raya strengthens rabies prevention among pets.
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention in Palangka Raya, Central Kalimantan, Indonesia, is being strengthened through vaccination of stray and pet animals. The DPKP Kota Palangka Raya targets about 8,000 animals vaccinated in 2026, with at least 80% coverage. As of early October 2026, around 5,000 have been vaccinated. No rabies cases in animals or humans have been reported in Palangka Raya to date. Vaccination focuses on dogs, cats, and monkeys, and includes enforcing owner responsibility to prevent roaming pets. A door-to-door 'jemput bola' outreach is deployed to reach households, while residents can request vaccination or file complaints via official social media and the DPKP SMS Center. The program aims to reduce transmission risk and move toward a rabies-free Palangka Raya. This aligns with public health goals to prevent human exposures and protect animal health.

triage.headline_ja: DPKPパランカラヤ、ペットへの狂犬病予防を強化
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の予防的ワクチン接種活動に関する内容で、現地での人・動物の症例報告はなく、異常事態や緊急性を示す要素もない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的ワクチン接種プログラムの進捗報告であり、症例報告は無し（No rabies cases in animals or humans have been reported）。地方行政の通常業務として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Penularan TBC di Lapas Salemba, Ratusan Warga Binaan dan Pegawai Jalani Rontgen Paru Gratis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent TB Transmission at Salemba Prison, Hundreds of Inmates and Staff Undergo Free Chest X-Rays.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Lapas Kelas IIA Salemba (Salemba Prison) and Puskesmas Cempaka Putih conducted free health screenings and chest X-rays for Tuberculosis (TB) detection for 900 inmates and staff from October 13–23, 2026. Screening was staged with a daily cap of 100 individuals over nine working days, including blood glucose testing and chest radiographs to identify early TB indicators. Medical follow-up actions followed SOP if records indicated further care. Head of Salemba Prison Amico Balalembang emphasized the program as a commitment to health rights and preventive care within the correctional environment. Collaboration with health services strengthens promotive and preventive care, facilitates medical-record monitoring, and raises health awareness among inmates and staff to curb TB transmission in the prison setting.

triage.headline_ja: サレンバ刑務所でのTB感染予防、数百人の受刑者と職員が無料胸部レントゲン検査を受診
triage.triage_reason: これは既知の結核対策としての定期的なスクリーニングプログラムの報道であり、異常な集団発生や急激な感染拡大を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 刑務所という閉鎖空間での結核の長期曝露リスクはあるが、これは予防的スクリーニングプログラムであり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Chandrapur News: चंद्रपुर जिले में डेंगू के 51 और मलेरिया के 134 मरीज मिले | 51 dengue and 134 malaria patients were found in Chandrapur district.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chandrapur News: 51 dengue patients and 134 malaria patients were found in Chandrapur district.
article.articleSummary: Chandrapur district in India reports rising dengue and malaria cases from January–September 2026: dengue 51, malaria 134, with two suspected dengue deaths and no suspected malaria deaths. To curb transmission, insecticide spraying was completed in 122 villages. Laboratory findings show 136,297 blood samples tested for malaria with 134 positives, and 3,479 samples tested for dengue with 51 positives. Residents are urged to seek prompt fever testing, avoid self-medication, and follow physician guidance. Preventive measures include eliminating mosquito breeding sites, covering water storage containers, routine drain cleaning, using mosquito nets, and wearing full-body clothing. The health department, gram panchayats, health workers, and ASHAs are conducting awareness campaigns; special efforts target sensitive villages, with ongoing surveillance, testing, case identification, and treatment in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: チャンドラプール県でデング熱患者51人、マラリア患者134人を確認
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における季節性のデング熱・マラリア発生状況の定期報告であり、地元保健当局が通常の対策（殺虫剤散布、啓発活動、監視）を実施中で、国際的拡大や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱・マラリアはインドの一部地域で毎年流行する風土病であり、地元保健当局による通常の季節的対応（殺虫剤散布、監視、啓発）が行われている。死亡例は疑い2例のみで、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的懸念は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC cảnh báo không quốc gia nào ở châu Phi an toàn trước dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC warns that no country in Africa is safe from the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak spreading across three regions of Africa, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo recording the outbreak since May 2026, now reporting more than 9,000 cases and over 4,300 deaths—the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country's history. Nigeria confirmed its first case: a woman who traveled from Uganda to Abuja; authorities are tracing dozens of close contacts to curb community transmission. Kenya has also reported 9 cases linked to the current outbreak. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya warns that no African country is safe from the outbreak and urges urgent international support—financing, medical supplies, diagnostics, and staff—to stop further spread. The World Health Organization calls for heightened vigilance and surveillance. The Bundibugyo strain has no widely approved vaccine or specific treatment, complicating control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCが警告：エボラ出血熱の流行から安全なアフリカの国はない
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模（9000例超、死者4300人超）のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が発生し、ナイジェリア・ケニアへの国際的拡大も確認されており、アフリカCDC・WHOが国際支援を要請している。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへの拡大も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。ワクチンや特異的治療法がないブンディブギョ株であることも流行のしやすさを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情奪近5千命　緊急育嬰室搶救失親孤兒 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo has claimed nearly 5,000 lives; emergency nursery rescues orphaned infants.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the deadliest on record, with 9,704 infections and 4,687 deaths as of October 23, 2026 (case fatality ~50%). Ituri Province, including Mongbwalu, remains central to transmission, ongoing for five months amid armed conflict that hinders response. UNICEF-supported emergency nurseries—12 nationwide—care for children who have lost parents to Ebola; more than 8,000 orphans recorded, with about 8,200 newly registered since the outbreak began. In the nurseries, caregivers in protective gear feed infants and children undergo 21-day incubation observation. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus lineage, for which there is no approved vaccine or therapy. Uganda reports cross-border cases; security concerns further complicate surveillance, treatment, and family tracing in this humanitarian emergency.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者数5千人近くに迫る　緊急育児室が孤児を救援
triage.triage_reason: 死者4,687人・致死率約50%という史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で、ウガンダへの越境感染も報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき案件。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。承認済みワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による流行で、武力紛争下での対応困難も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Governor Rimbasa, officials inspect Yambio Ebola unit to test readiness - Radio Tamazuj
article.articleSummary: Within Yambio, Western Equatoria State, South Sudan, the Infectious Disease Unit (ETU) with 28 beds across four wards conducted a simulation to test readiness to receive and manage suspected Ebola cases. Governor Badagbu Daniel Rimbasa led a high-level delegation including Health Minister Nama Bukulu, security officials, health partners, and a National Public Health Institute team from Juba. The exercise evaluated screening, isolation capacity, infection prevention, and staff safety; the unit features separate male and female sections, a red isolation zone, and green zones to support health workers. The International Medical Corps administers the facility with support from WHO and UNICEF. The aim is to strengthen surveillance, preparedness, and emergency response to presumed Ebola cases, given proximity to the Democratic Republic of Congo. South Sudan has not reported Ebola cases to date; the exercise seeks to ensure quick response if cases are detected.

triage.headline_ja: リムバサ州知事らがヤンビオのエボラ治療ユニットを視察し、対応準備を検証
triage.triage_reason: 南スーダンにおける訓練・準備態勢の視察記事であり、実際のエボラ症例は報告されていない。対象国（DRC等）での実発生事例でもないため、トリアージ対象外とする。
triage.notes: 記事は南スーダン・ヤンビオにおけるエボラ対応能力検証のための訓練実施に関する内容であり、実際の感染例は確認されていない。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれず、DRCへの言及も近接性の文脈のみで実発生事例ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: क्या गाय को लंपी बीमारी होने के बाद दूध पी सकते हैं, वेटरनरी डॉक्टर से जानें
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can a cow drink milk after contracting Lumpy Skin Disease? Find out from a veterinary doctor.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) in cattle is spreading in India, affecting cows and buffaloes. The causative agent is a poxvirus in the Poxviridae family, causing fever, skin nodules, and reduced milk production. Veterinary officer K. M. Varshney (Uttar Pradesh government) confirms LSD is not zoonotic, so milk from infected cows is not hazardous to humans. Milk should be boiled before consumption, for at least 15–20 minutes, to inactivate potential pathogens. Raw milk from LSD-affected cows should be avoided, and feeding such milk to calves is discouraged; if absolutely necessary, boiled milk may be given to calves. The guidance emphasizes practical precautions for dairy households during the ongoing outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 牛がランピースキン病にかかった後、その牛乳は飲めるか？獣医師に聞く
triage.triage_reason: LSDは動物疾患でヒトへの感染性（人獣共通感染症）がないことが記事内で明確に否定されており、公衆衛生リスクは低い。家畜への影響に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、ヒトの感染症危機管理上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: Lumpy Skin Diseaseは牛痘ウイルス科の動物疾患であり、ヒトに感染しない非人獣共通感染症。記事は家畜飼育者向けの実用的な注意喚起（牛乳の取り扱い）であり、ヒトの公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: EUA exigirão declaração sobre ebola de passageiros vindos do RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States will require an Ebola declaration from passengers arriving from DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: From November 3, the United States will require a passenger declaration from travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to curb entry of those exposed to Ebola. All US-bound flights must have passengers submit a digital or paper form indicating whether they were in DR Congo within 21 days. The CDC had previously restricted boarding for travelers who passed through Congo and extended to include US citizens. The DR Congo outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, declared in May after months of circulation, with about 4,700 deaths in Africa. The variant has roughly a 50% fatality rate and there is no approved treatment or vaccine. As of 2026-10-23, the US has not reported imported cases. Separately, churches in DR Congo are assisting health workers to counter fear; Deo Kasereka contracted Ebola during a funeral in Mongbwalu and recovered after early care.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者にエボラ関連申告書を義務化へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株、致死率約50%、死者約4700人）流行を受け、米国が入国者に申告義務を課すなど国際的な渡航制限措置が取られており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUnited Statesが含まれるが、これは渡航制限措置の実施国であり、感染症の発生地はDRCのみ。米国内での輸入症例は本記事時点（2026-10-23）で報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Africa: cronologia dei focolai e paesi coinvolti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Africa: Timeline of outbreaks and countries involved
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in 2026 spanned the DRC, Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. On 15 May 2026, the DRC confirmed Ebola Bundibugyo in Ituri; Uganda reported an infection in a patient from Congo who died. By July, WHO recorded 2,124 Congo cases and 828 deaths; Uganda reported 20 infections (15 imported from Congo, 5 secondary) and no widespread community transmission, last confirmed 21 June and discharged 16 July. Uganda’s outbreak ended 27 August after 42 days with 20 cases, 2 deaths, 18 recoveries, and over 800 contacts monitored, though cross-border risk persisted. In October, Kenya reported first case (a resident who had been in Congo and traveled via Uganda) with nine cases and one death by 19 Oct; Nigeria confirmed an imported case on 20 Oct (woman from Uganda) with 44 contacts under investigation. As of 22 Oct, ECDC tallies Congo at 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths, led by Ituri with 7,040.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカにおけるエボラ出血熱：発生の経緯と関係国
triage.triage_reason: DRCを中心に9,704症例・4,687死亡という深刻な被害が報告され、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアにまたがる2026年のエボラ流行の時系列まとめ。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCに限定。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria's health minister says first Ebola case remains isolated
article.articleSummary: One confirmed Ebola case in Nigeria remains isolated and not spreading in the community. The patient is a 42-year-old Ugandan-born wife of a diplomat based in Abuja, who had a two-week visit in Kampala before returning to Nigeria. Health minister Muhammad Ali Pate described the case as contained, with the patient stable and recovering; lab results show significant improvement. Contact tracing is ongoing, with all identified contacts in isolation and none yet symptomatic. Authorities have not recommended changes to public gatherings at this time, but will implement further measures if needed. Nigeria has intensified Ebola surveillance at international airports. The outbreak originated in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May and has been detected in three other African countries; this case represents an imported entry into Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア保健相、初のエボラ出血熱症例は隔離継続中と発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ出血熱流行がナイジェリアへ輸入例として拡大し、既に複数国で検出されていることからIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たし、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入エボラ症例（隔離継続中）だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。流行の発生源であるDRCのみ対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Tanzania tightens health screening for international travelers amid Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) concerns trigger tightened health screening for travelers entering Tanzania. In response to an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and a recent Kenya case linked to DRC travel, Tanzania’s Travel Advisory No. 18 requires online health surveillance forms for all arrivals, with a confirmation QR code or reference number for port verification. All entrants through airports, land borders, and seaports undergo health screening, including temperature checks. Individuals suspected of EVD symptoms are managed per national screening procedures. High-risk travelers receive 21 days of daily health monitoring via automated messages or other channels, with mandatory cooperation after departure. The advisory urges infection prevention measures (hand hygiene, sanitizers, reduced contact). Contaminated vehicles, cargo, or human remains will be decontaminated at entry. Suspected symptoms should be reported to the toll-free number 199 or via email [email protected], and the advisory will be reviewed as needed, with travelers advised to follow destination entry requirements.

triage.headline_ja: タンザニア、エボラ出血熱への懸念から国際渡航者の健康検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)で発生中のエボラ出血熱がケニアにも伝播した事例が報告され、タンザニアが渡航者への健康監視を強化するなど、国際的拡大と渡航制限の両方が確認されるため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はタンザニアの渡航者スクリーニング強化策に関する内容だが、感染拡大の起点はDRCでの既存のエボラ流行である。ケニアとタンザニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの流行状況についてはフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Swiss government says Nigeria's patient likely contracted virus in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first imported Ebola case in more than a decade: a 42-year-old woman living in Abuja who recently travelled to Uganda and developed symptoms on 6 October after returning on 3 October. Laboratory confirmation followed; authorities say the infection was identified as an imported case on 20 October. The Swiss government attributes likely Ugandan exposure, though WHO and Africa CDC say travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has not been verified; Nigeria and Uganda are reconstructing her movements to identify the source. Uganda asserts no active Ebola cases, despite a May–June cluster of 20 cases linked to DRC; the WHO declared that outbreak over in August. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is involved, for which there is no licensed vaccine. Nigeria has started contact tracing for about 44 potential exposures and is coordinating with international partners. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected fluids; symptoms include fever, headache, weakness, vomiting, and diarrhoea. The case underscores cross-border transmission risks, with Kenya reporting related cases. The patient’s husband is in isolation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:スイス政府、ナイジェリアの患者はウガンダでウイルスに感染した可能性が高いと発表
triage.triage_reason: 10年以上ぶりとなるナイジェリアへのエボラ輸入症例であり、国境を越えた感染拡大の可能性、重症度の高さ、ワクチン未承認株（ブンディブギョ株）であることから、公衆衛生上の懸念が高く国際的拡大リスクもあるためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例はナイジェリア（輸入症例の診断地）およびウガンダ（感染推定地）で発生しており、DRCへの渡航歴はWHO・Africa CDCにより未確認とされているため、対象国リストに含まれるDRCも含め、いずれの対象国も検証済み発生地域として確定できない。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: "Pourquoi cette maladie a pris ma mère?" Dans l'est de la RDC, au chevet des orphelins d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Why did this disease take my mother?" In eastern DRC, at the bedside of Ebola orphans.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is grappling with Ebola, the worst outbreak in the country’s history, centered in Bunia. The crisis has left hundreds of orphans and children separated from their parents as aid workers operate under humanitarian tents around an Ebola Treatment Center. In Bunia, Neema Nyaloka, a 23-year-old nursing student who survived Ebola, volunteers to care for the infants of patients. A two-month-old baby arrives tearful, wrapped in a wool blanket, and she reassures him, saying, 'Don’t be afraid, I’m here, mom is here.' The infant’s initial distress and reluctance to face caregivers has given way to calmer behavior, illustrating the human toll and frontline response amid the ongoing outbreak. The piece highlights frontline caregivers and the vulnerable children caught in the epidemic’s wake.

triage.headline_ja: 「なぜこの病気は私の母を奪ったのか？」コンゴ民主共和国東部、エボラ孤児たちの傍らで
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部ブニアで「同国史上最悪」とされるエボラ流行が継続しており、重症度・国際的拡大リスク・社会的関心のいずれも高いと判断されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は人道的側面（孤児・ケア提供者）に焦点を当てた報道だが、『同国史上最悪のアウトブレイク』との記述があり、既存の大規模エボラ流行の継続・深刻化を示唆する。フルリスク評価で最新の症例数・致死率・対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: EUA Reforçam Controlo de Passageiros Aéreos Com Novas Declarações Obrigatórias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: U.S. strengthens air passenger screening with new mandatory declarations.
article.articleSummary: US CDC tightens Ebola screening with new mandatory declarations for all passengers bound for the United States, requiring declaration of no Congo exposure in last 21 days; effective Nov 3; digital or paper form. This builds on May rules banning entry for those who spent time in DRC, broadened to US citizens in July. The Bundibugyo strain has circulated undetected and outbreak declared in May; about 50% fatality; no approved treatment or vaccine for this strain. Africa CDC reports about 4,700 Ebola deaths in Africa; no U.S. cases reported to CDC. In addition, since early this year, foreign nationals who've been in Uganda or South Sudan in the prior three weeks are barred. Airlines for America to brief carriers on Oct 23 on procedures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：米国、新たな義務申告制度で航空旅客スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率約50%のブンディブギョ株エボラが未検知のまま拡大し、米国が入国制限・申告義務化などの渡航制限措置を講じており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は主に米国の渡航規制強化を報じているが、発生源はDRCのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行。ウガンダ・南スーダンも渡航制限対象だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: CDC za ta yi taron gaggawa kan Ebola a Afirka
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The CDC will hold an emergency meeting on Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: On October 28, 2026, the Africa CDC will hold an emergency online meeting on Ebola in Africa to bolster cross-border coordination against the outbreak. WHO calls on regional countries to remain vigilant and prepared. Since the outbreak was confirmed in May in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, more than 9,500 people have been infected, with about half dying. WHO describes it as the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history. The outbreak has reached four African countries, with ongoing transmission in two of them.

triage.headline_ja: CDCがアフリカのエボラに関する緊急会議を開催へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認されたエボラ流行が9,500人以上の感染者と高い致死率を伴い、史上最速の拡大速度でアフリカ4カ国に広がっており、Africa CDCが緊急会議を開催するなど国際的関心・対応が高まっているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事では流行がDRC以外の3カ国にも拡大し、うち2カ国で継続的な感染が確認されているとされるが、具体的な国名は本文に記載がないため特定不可。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Ebola patient did not travel to Congo, Swiss government says
article.articleSummary: Nigeria’s Ebola patient case: The Ebola patient in Nigeria—the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja—did not travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Swiss government said. Uganda had suggested she travelled to eastern Congo, where the outbreak began in mid-May and is described as the fastest-spreading on record, but the World Health Organization and Africa CDC had not received confirmed information of Congo travel. This marks Nigeria’s first Ebola case in more than a decade, extending the outbreak to four African countries: Congo, Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria, with Africa CDC attributing about 4,700 deaths. Uganda reported 20 Ebola cases in May and June, mostly imported from Congo; the WHO declared Uganda Ebola-free in August. Uganda’s government spokesperson reiterated there were no cases and that any would be made public.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ患者、コンゴには渡航していなかったとスイス政府が発表
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速の拡大とされるコンゴ（DRC）発のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが4カ国に拡大し、約4,700人の死者が出ている深刻な公衆衛生事案であり、国際的拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAへ進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はナイジェリアの症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アウトブレイクの発生源であるDRCのみを対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор отслеживает ситуацию с распространением коронавируса
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor monitors the situation regarding the spread of the coronavirus.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor states it is actively monitoring the spread of COVID-19 in Russia and abroad via the MAX platform. The agency cites data on alleged mass infection of Russian tourists with the Stratus variant in Kazakhstan, while noting that Stratus is not a fundamentally new lineage and has been known since January last year. Specialists continuously track the epidemiological situation related to the coronavirus both domestically and internationally. Separately, Thai authorities report a surge in cases since the start of 2026, with more than 135,000 infections identified. The announcement underscores ongoing surveillance for imported and exported cases and for sources of infection, while providing no new clinical or laboratory details. The update reflects persistent vigilance as travel resumes and the global situation evolves, with attention to variant activity and cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナドゾル、コロナウイルス感染拡大の状況を監視
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の既知変異株（Stratus）に関する通常の監視報告であり新規性は低いが、タイでの感染者急増(13.5万人超)の情報があり継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: ロシア・カザフスタンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。タイでの感染者急増については詳細な臨床・検査情報が不足しており、続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Babu tabbas ko matar da aka gano ɗauke da Ebola a Abuja ta ziyarci Congo - WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola a Abuja: WHO da CDC ba su tabbatar da cewa matar da aka gano dauke da Ebola a Najeriya ta ziyarci Congo kafin ganinta, duk da cewa hukumomin Uganda da Congo sun jaddada ziyararta a Congo kafin ganinta. Najeriya ta bayyana cewa cutar Ebola ta farko a ƙasar cikin sama da shekaru goma ta shafi wata mata ‘yar Uganda da ta shigo Abuja daga Uganda. Uganda ta kuma bayyana cewa matar ta yi ziyarci Congo, inda aka fara ɓarkewar cutar a tsakiyar Mayu, kuma ta zama ɗaya daga cikin balaguro da ya fi yawa yaɗuwa. A cewar WHO, ba su da tabbaci cewa ta shiga Congo; bayanai da aka bayar ba su hada da balaguro zuwa wata ƙasa bayan Uganda, and ta koma Abuja ranar 3 Oktoba, tun 16 Satumba ta bar Uganda. An ci gaba da bincike kan wuraren kiwon lafiya da ta ziyarta a Abuja saboda alamun cutar suka bayyana kafin a kwantar da ita awanni 48 bayan haka. Jean Kaseya na Africa CDC ya shaida Reuters cewa matar ita ce matar wani jami’in diflomasiyya na Switzerland.

triage.headline_ja: アブジャでエボラ感染が確認された女性、コンゴ訪問は未確認－WHO
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで10年以上ぶりとなるエボラ症例が確認され、ウガンダ・コンゴとの渡航歴を巡り国際機関間で見解が分かれており、国際的拡大リスクが高い事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（アブジャ）でのエボラ確認症例であり、ウガンダ出身の女性でコンゴ訪問歴はWHO/CDCが未確認としている。ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず、DRCは訪問自体が未確定のため、対象国リストに該当する発生国はないと判断し verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Nguy hiểm: Trẻ 5 tuổi mắc cúm A biến chứng viêm não hoại tử
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Danger: A 5-year-old child infected with influenza A develops necrotizing encephalitis.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-23, a 5-year-old in Quảng Ninh Province, Vietnam, was diagnosed with influenza A complicated by necrotizing encephalitis at Việt Nam - Thụy Điển Uông Bí Hospital. On admission the child had fever >40°C, cough, runny nose, vomiting, tachycardia to 190/min, hypotension 80/40 mmHg, cold extremities and altered consciousness. Following evaluation and testing, influenza A with necrotizing encephalitis was diagnosed. The patient received aggressive supportive care, anti-edema therapy, vasopressors, and antibiotics as indicated. Necrotizing encephalitis is a rare but highly dangerous neurological complication related to hyperinflammatory responses during infection, potentially causing seizures, brain edema, and lasting neurological injury or death. Most children with influenza A recover, but severe progression can occur; parents should seek prompt care for high fever with lethargy, confusion, seizures, rapid breathing, or poor responsiveness.

triage.headline_ja: 危険:5歳児がインフルエンザA型感染後に壊死性脳症を発症
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の重症化事例であり、公衆衛生上の広範な影響やヒト-ヒト感染拡大の兆候は確認できないが、重症例として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単発の重症小児インフルエンザ合併症例の報告であり、集団発生や流行の兆候は記載されていない。季節性インフルエンザの重症合併症として国内で散発的に報告される可能性があるため、続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pacientes de ébola en Nigeria y Kenia podrían haberse cruzado en Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patients in Nigeria and Kenya could have crossed paths in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in Nigeria and Kenya may have intersected at Entebbe International Airport in Uganda on October 3, with Africa CDC probing possible exposure via shared equipment or other contact. Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in more than a decade; Kenya has nine infections, including one death. The Nigerian patient is a 42-year-old Ugandan-born woman living in Abuja who traveled through Entebbe and Addis Ababa before returning to Nigeria, developing symptoms four days later and testing positive on October 20. Her husband, a Swiss diplomat based in Nigeria, is in isolation but asymptomatic. The Kenyan patient traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo through Uganda to Nairobi on October 3 and later died, Kenya’s first Ebola death. WHO says the exposure source remains unknown; Nigeria is expanding contact tracing beyond 44 health-care workers. Kenya’s exposed individuals are under a 21-day monitoring period. Cross-border movements between DRC and Uganda remain a concern.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアとケニアのエボラ患者、ウガンダで接触していた可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準に3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大リスク）し、複数国にまたがるエボラ感染事例でWHO・Africa CDCが調査に乗り出しており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる感染確認国はナイジェリアとケニアだが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。ケニアの患者はDRCからウガンダ経由で渡航しており、DRCでの感染曝露が示唆されるためDRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。WHOは曝露源を特定できていないと述べている。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Ebola Patient Did Not Travel to Congo, Swiss Government Says
article.articleSummary: Ebola patient in Nigeria—the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja—did not travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs said on Oct 23, 2026. Ugandan authorities had claimed she travelled to eastern Congo, where an outbreak was declared in mid-May and described as the fastest-spreading on record. The World Health Organization and Africa’s top health agency said they had not received confirmed information that she had travelled to Congo. The Swiss department reiterated that neither she nor her husband travelled to the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ患者、コンゴへの渡航歴なしとスイス政府が発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事自体はナイジェリアの症例とDRCアウトブレイクとの関連を否定する内容だが、背景にあるDRCの『史上最速』とされる進行中のエボラアウトブレイクについては継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの単一症例（スイス外交官の妻）がDRCに渡航していないことの確認であり、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでは2026年5月から継続中のエボラアウトブレイクがあり『史上最速の拡大』と報じられている点が重要な背景情報。ナイジェリア国内での当該症例の感染経路や確定診断状況は記事内で不明。

article.articleHeadline: 援赤几医疗队在对口支援医院开展疟疾防控专项培训
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chad Medical Team Conducts Specialized Training in Malaria Prevention and Control at the Designated Paired-Aid Hospital.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 22, 2026, the 34th Chinese medical team aiding Equatorial Guinea conducted a malaria prevention and control training at Malabo Regional Hospital. Attendees included hospital administrators, clinicians, and team members. Led by laboratory physician Lei Zhihong, the session covered malaria clinical features and epidemiology, and demonstrated standardized microscopy-based Plasmodium detection and testing workflows to bolster early diagnosis and treatment in the Malabo region. Lei, who in 2025 participated in a large mainland Equatorial Guinea malaria campaign, shared frontline experience. The hospital administrator Daniel welcomed more such trainings across pediatrics, emergency, trauma, ophthalmology, and infectious disease prevention. The team also plans to donate a new laparoscopic pneumoperitoneum machine to support safe, routine minimally invasive surgery and ongoing surgical training, signaling expanded China–Equatorial Guinea medical cooperation to safeguard local health.

triage.headline_ja: 中国援助赤道ギニア医療チーム、対口支援病院でマラリア予防対策の専門研修を実施
triage.triage_reason: 赤道ギニアにおける中国医療チームによるマラリア予防研修の活動報告であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は赤道ギニア（対象国リスト外）における医療協力・研修活動の報告。発生地域に中国が含まれるが、これは医療チーム派遣元であり、感染症発生地ではないため China は verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreads to eighth DRC province as WFP delivers food, builds treatment centres and keeps supplies moving
article.articleSummary: Ebola has spread to a eighth province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with WFP delivering food, building Ebola Treatment Centres (ETCs) and maintaining supplies as insecurity and poor roads hamper access. The response covers eastern DRC, including Ituri, Haut-Uélé and North Ubangi, with Musienene’s ETC operational and Bunia’s under construction; four additional ETCs, including one in Goma, are envisaged. Reconnaissance flights are arranged to Bole-Bole (Haut-Uélé), Yakoma (North Ubangi) and Biakato (Ituri). WFP reports nearly 3.5 million people across Ebola-affected areas face Crisis-level hunger or worse (IPC Phase 3+), and 97% of those directly affected require food assistance. The organization has delivered more than 744,000 hot meals in 59 facilities and distributed over 3,000 metric tons of food to patients’ families. The six-month plan includes dry rations for over half a million relatives. WFP’s Logistics/Telecommunications Cluster operates two bases, nine mini-bases and UNHAS flights: 1,255 flights, 10,272 responders, 483 metric tons cargo. Funding need: USD 214 million.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で8番目の州に拡大、WFPが食料支援・治療センター建設・物資輸送を継続
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内で8州目に拡大し、不安定な治安・インフラ状況下で人道危機（350万人が食料危機）を伴っており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内でのエボラ拡大とWFPによる人道支援活動（食料配布、治療センター建設、物流支援）に焦点を当てている。USD214百万の資金需要があり、国際支援の必要性が明確に示されている。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Announces New Ebola Screening Requirement for International Air Travelers
article.articleSummary: Beginning November 3, 2026, U.S.-bound international air travelers must comply with a new CDC screening requirement: they must confirm they have not visited the Democratic Republic of Congo in the prior 21 days and submit a signed declaration before boarding, either electronically or on paper. The measure, part of strengthened Ebola controls, follows restrictions enacted earlier this year after an Ebola outbreak in the DRC. The Bundibugyo strain has been linked to the outbreak, with African health authorities reporting about 4,700 deaths. The United States has not seen any linked Ebola cases. Additional entry restrictions apply to certain foreign nationals who recently traveled to Uganda or South Sudan. Airlines are being instructed on implementing the declaration procedures as the outbreak response continues.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、国際線航空旅客に対する新たなエボラ出血熱スクリーニング要件を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行により約4,700人の死亡が報告されており、米国が渡航制限・スクリーニング措置を導入するなど国際的な影響が明確であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで発生中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対する米国の渡航対策が主題。ウガンダ・南スーダンへの追加入国制限にも言及があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。米国自体も対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Airport Encounter May Have Spread Ebola to 2 Countries
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola patients confirmed in Kenya and Nigeria may have crossed paths at Uganda’s Entebbe International Airport on Oct. 3, triggering intensified contact tracing as Africa fights the continent's widest Ebola outbreak, first detected in Congo in May. Nigeria’s case—linked to an Uganda-traveled individual— is reported as contained with tracing ongoing; additional contacts have been identified. The patient is Uganda-born wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja; she vacationed in Uganda for two weeks in September and returned to Nigeria in early October. Uganda denies exposure at its airport, saying the patient traveled to Congo, a claim health officials dispute. Kenya has nine cases linked to a traveler who returned from Congo via Uganda. Congo has infected more than 9,500 people with about half dying. Reuters notes authorities are tracing people on the same Ethiopian Airlines flight, though she was not believed symptomatic on flight.

triage.headline_ja: 空港での接触がエボラを2カ国に拡大させた可能性
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ史上最大規模のエボラアウトブレイクがコンゴから複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）に国際空港を介して拡大した可能性があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクの起源はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であり、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアは記事の主題国だが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。空港での接触歴を巡りウガンダ政府と保健当局の間で見解の相違があり、国際的な追跡調査（航空便の同乗者含む）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: САЩ затягат правилата за пътуване заради Ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US tightens travel rules over Ebola.
article.articleSummary: US tightens travel rules over Ebola as the 2026 outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues. A CDC memo, effective November 3, requires all airline passengers bound for the United States to declare, in electronic or paper form, whether they have been in the DRC during the previous 21 days (up from 3 weeks). Earlier in May, CDC rules barred entry for travelers who had been in the DRC in the last three weeks; in July, restrictions were extended to U.S. citizens. Airlines for America will brief major carriers on compliance. Earlier this year, the CDC restricted entry of foreign nationals who had been in Uganda or South Sudan within the prior three weeks. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has circulated for months before the outbreak was declared in May, with about 50% fatality and no approved treatment or vaccine. Africa CDC estimates around 4,700 deaths in Africa; the CDC reports no U.S. cases linked to the current outbreak so far.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱を受け渡航規則を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の2026年エボラアウトブレイク（推定約4,700人死亡、致死率約50%）を受け、米国が渡航規制を拡大・強化しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに対する米国の渡航規制強化が主題。ウガンダ・南スーダンへの言及もあるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれず、記事の主題でもないため除外。米国自体も対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: В Роспотребнадзоре рассказали о штамме ковида "Стратус", распространившемся в Казахстане
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor spoke about the COVID-19 strain 'Stratus' that has spread in Kazakhstan.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, the SARS-CoV-2 variant XFG, unofficially named 'Stratus', is not new and has been known since January 2025; it remains under international and national health surveillance. Rospotrebnadzor states Stratus is not a fundamentally new SARS-CoV-2 strain. Infections have spread among Russian tourists in Kazakhstan, with family clusters and illnesses lasting three to four weeks. Common symptoms include vomiting, diarrhea, chills, myalgias, fever up to 38°C, sore throat, and later cough. Virologist Viktor Zuyev suggests the virus may have been introduced to Kazakhstan by travelers from China. The report, citing the Mash Telegram channel, notes no new laboratory-confirmed breakthroughs and adds that Russian researchers previously developed cognitive training for COVID-19 survivors.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁(Rospotrebnadzor)、カザフスタンで拡大したCOVID-19変異株「ストラタス」について説明
triage.triage_reason: 既知の変異株(XFG/ストラタス)であり新規性がなく、当局も「根本的に新しい株ではない」と述べており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 主な発生地域はロシア・カザフスタン（対象国リスト外）。中国は感染流入元として言及されているのみで、対象国として確定的な発生報告はないため参考扱い。既知株であり新規シグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Kongo: Warum der Ausbruch kaum zu stoppen ist
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kongo: Why the outbreak is almost impossible to stop.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in the eastern Ituri region and spreading into central provinces, with Uganda and Kenya confirming cases and Nigeria reporting an infection this week. Since the mid-May first confirmed case, about 9,700 infections and at least 4,690 deaths have occurred from the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant. Experts warn this could become the worst outbreak yet, potentially surpassing the 2014 West Africa epidemic that killed around 11,000. The crisis is amplified by millions of internal displacements and refugee camps, ongoing armed conflict, and a dysfunctional health system in eastern Congo. Distrust of authorities, violence against aid workers, and reliance on private clinics hinder early detection, rapid referral, contact tracing, infection prevention, and safe burials. International funding cuts for development aid and NGO financing gaps further impair the response; building community trust is essential to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：なぜこの流行はほとんど制御不能なのか
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（感染者約9,700人、死者4,690人以上）がウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアに拡大しており、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクに該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、アンゴラは発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。紛争・避難民・医療システム機能不全が流行拡大の主要因として記述されている。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ 5 tuổi viêm não hoại tử do cúm A: Cảnh giác sốt cao, nói sảng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 5-year-old child with necrotizing encephalitis caused by influenza A: Be on the lookout for high fever and delirium.
article.articleSummary: A 5-year-old child with influenza A developed necrotizing encephalitis and required intensive care at Vietnam–Sweden Uông Bí Hospital. The patient presented with fever above 40°C, cough, runny nose, vomiting, tachycardia to 190 bpm, hypotension 80/40 mmHg, cold extremities, and delirium. Clinicians diagnosed influenza A with necrotizing encephalitis, a rare yet severe neurologic complication linked to an excessive inflammatory response. Treatment included antibiotics, measures to reduce brain edema, vasopressors, and intensive supportive care. The condition can rapidly progress to altered consciousness, seizures, brain edema, and may leave permanent neurologic deficits or death. Parents should seek urgent care for delirium or diminished consciousness during fever. Additionally, Vietnam’s health ministry’s 23 Oct 2026 advisory encourages influenza prevention, noting high-risk groups (under 5, elderly, pregnant), respiratory transmission, and measures such as masks, hand hygiene, ventilation, and avoiding crowded places.

triage.headline_ja: 5歳児がA型インフルエンザによる壊死性脳炎を発症：高熱・せん妄に要警戒
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の重症インフルエンザ合併症報告であり、アウトブレイクや国際的拡大の証拠はないが、保健省による注意喚起が出ており経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一の重症小児症例報告であり、集団発生や地域的流行を示す情報はない。ベトナム保健省のインフルエンザ予防に関する一般的な注意喚起も付随している。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Ebola patient did not travel to Congo, Swiss government says
article.articleSummary: Ebola case in Nigeria marks the first in more than a decade, involving the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja. The Swiss government says she did not travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), countering Uganda’s claim that she may have visited eastern Congo, where the outbreak began in mid-May and has since become the fastest-spreading on record. The World Health Organization and Africa CDC had not confirmed travel to Congo. Nigeria’s case underscores the cross-border reach of the outbreak, now affecting four African countries: Congo, Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria, with Africa CDC reporting about 4,700 deaths overall. Uganda previously reported 20 Ebola cases in May–June (mostly imported from Congo) and was declared Ebola-free by the WHO in August. In Lagos, authorities heightened Ebola screening at the airport in response.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ患者、コンゴには渡航していなかったとスイス政府が発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラアウトブレイクが4カ国（コンゴ、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）に拡大し、死者約4,700人と史上最速拡大とされ、IHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ発のエボラアウトブレイクのナイジェリアへの波及だが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Νιγηρία: Η ασθενής με Έμπολα δεν είχε ταξιδέψει στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria: The patient with Ebola had not traveled to the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in over a decade. The patient is a Swiss citizen, wife of a Swiss diplomat of Ugandan origin, who reportedly did not travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo; the Swiss government says the infection was likely acquired during a stay in Uganda. Uganda’s authorities insist there are no Ebola cases in the country, despite earlier reports of 20 cases in May–June largely linked to Congo; the WHO and Africa CDC say there is no confirmed information that the woman traveled to Congo. The multi-country outbreak has now affected four African nations—DRC, Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria—resulting in around 4,700 confirmed deaths. Uganda had faced cases earlier in the year, with WHO declaring Uganda free of the virus in August. Nigeria’s case marks the first in the country in over ten years.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア：エボラ患者はコンゴに渡航していなかった
triage.triage_reason: 多国間に拡大しているエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、ナイジェリアで10年ぶりの症例が確認され、感染経路が不明確（渡航歴なし）という異常性があり、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの新規症例だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは多国間アウトブレイクの発生起点国として明記されているため含めた。ウガンダ・ケニアも言及されているが対象国リストに該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Νιγηρία: Ασθενής με Έμπολα δεν είχε ταξιδέψει στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria: An Ebola patient had not traveled to Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in over a decade, in a Swiss citizen and wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja who developed symptoms in Nigeria. The patient is believed to have contracted Ebola while travelling with her husband to Uganda, where authorities say there are no current cases. Ugandan officials had previously indicated she had travelled to eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak was declared in May, but the WHO and Africa CDC have said they have not received confirmed information that she visited Congo. The Swiss foreign ministry confirmed that neither she nor her husband travelled to DRC. The Nigeria case means the outbreak has spread to four African countries—DRC, Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria—and has killed about 4,700 people per Africa CDC. Uganda had 20 cases in May–June but was declared Ebola-free in August.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア:エボラ出血熱患者はコンゴに渡航していなかった
triage.triage_reason: DRCで始まったエボラ流行がウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアの4カ国に拡大し、約4700人が死亡しているとされる重大な国際的拡大事例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしこれらの国々もアウトブレイクの一部として記事の主題であり、フルRRA実施時には地域拡大状況として考慮すべき。渡航先に関する情報は錯綜しており（ウガンダ側はコンゴ渡航歴を主張、スイス外務省は否定）、感染経路の確認が未了である点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: "Perdu père et mère": en RDC, Ebola fait des centaines d'orphelins
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Lost father and mother": In the DRC, Ebola has left hundreds of orphans.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists nearly six months after a May 15 declaration, driven by Bundibugyo virus and causing severe hemorrhagic fever. The epicenter is Ituri, with spread to North Ubangi and spillovers to Uganda (outbreak declared over in late August), Kenya, and Nigeria. In the DRC, 9,704 infections have been reported and 4,687 deaths, a case-fatality rate near 50%. The outbreak disproportionately affects children: over 2,500 affected, with about one-third of deaths and more than a quarter of cases among children. UNICEF-supported creches in infected zones—twelve in total, including in Mongbwalu—house hundreds of Ebola orphans; more than 8,200 new orphans have been recorded in Ituri since the start. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo; a clinical trial is underway. Access is hampered by armed groups, leading to underreporting, while exposed children undergo a 21-day observation period.

triage.headline_ja: 「父も母も失った」：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が数百人の孤児を生み出す
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyoウイルスによるエボラ出血熱が約5ヶ月半継続し、感染9,704人・死亡4,687人（致死率約50%）、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの飛び火も報告されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（8月に終息宣言）、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの飛び火が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在せず、武装勢力により対応が困難な状況が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Thanh Hóa: Phát hiện 7 ca sốt xuất huyết nội địa, cảnh báo nguy cơ lây lan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thanh Hoa Province: Seven locally transmitted dengue fever cases detected; warning about the risk of spread.
article.articleSummary: Seven dengue fever cases detected in Ha Thanh Ward, Thanh Hoa Province. A four-case cluster occurred in Do Cung 2 Hamlet; the first patient was hospitalized Oct 16 at Ha Thanh General Hospital and reported to Ha Thanh Center on Oct 20. By Oct 23, three more cases among relatives and neighbors were identified, with vectors detected in the area. Environmental cleaning, waterbody sanitation, and an insecticide spray within 200 meters of residence was implemented. Thanh Hoa CDC reports ongoing vector surveillance; larvae remain in Do Cung 2. Three more cases in Truong Thi, Phan Dinh Phung, and Tien Phong wards, with no secondary transmissions yet. Of seven patients, three recovered and were discharged; others remain hospitalized at Ha Thanh General, Thanh Hoa Provincial General, and Thanh Hoa Children’s Hospital. Authorities urge thorough vector control and timely reporting between hospitals to prevent spread; weather favorable for mosquitoes.

triage.headline_ja: タインホア省：国内感染のデング熱症例7件を検出、拡散リスクに警戒
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの一地域での小規模なデング熱クラスター発生であり、地元当局による通常の対応（媒介蚊対策・環境衛生）が実施されている。重症例や二次感染拡大の報告もなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。
triage.notes: デング熱は蚊媒介性で地域流行の可能性があるため疫学的拡大可能性はYesとしたが、現地当局が通常の対応能力範囲で対処しており、社会的関心や重症度の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria steps up airport health screenings over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-23, Nigeria confirms its first Bundibugyo strain Ebola case, exposure linked to a return from Uganda via Addis Ababa. Lagos airport has stepped up health screening for international arrivals, including temperature checks. The patient is isolated and in stable condition; authorities have identified 44 contacts and are expanding contact tracing. The outbreak context shows DR Congo’s ongoing, large Ebola outbreak since May, with Kenya and now Nigeria reporting cases; Uganda was declared Ebola-free in August after 20 cases. The Nigerian case has raised concerns about delays in testing, as the patient was not tested until 13 days after symptom onset. Two other travelers with Addis Ababa layovers—Patrick Akwongu, returning from Italy, and Bezalel Mfashingabo from Nairobi—underline cross-border exposure risks. The WHO warns that east-to-west spread signals a complex outbreak, prompting heightened vigilance at travel hubs.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ懸念で空港での健康検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで初のブンディブギョ株エボラ症例が確認され、DRCの大規模流行を背景に東→西方向への越境拡大が示唆されており、WHOも警戒を表明していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの初症例確認だが、ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・エチオピア・イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは5月以降継続中の大規模アウトブレイクの発生源として明記されているため含めた。検査遅延（発症から13日）や複数国にまたがる接触者の存在が国際的拡大リスクを高めている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: 奈及利亞驚現伊波拉病例　瑞士外交官妻子未赴剛果感染源成謎 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola case detected in Nigeria; wife of Swiss diplomat did not travel to Congo; source of infection remains a mystery - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case in Nigeria in more than a decade, diagnosed in Abuja in a Ugandan-born woman who is the wife of a Swiss diplomat. Swiss authorities say she and her husband did not travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo, contradicting Ugandan officials who claimed she had visited eastern Congo; neither WHO nor Africa CDC have confirmed Congo entry. Nigeria’s case follows Uganda’s May–June Ebola outbreak (about 20 cases, mostly imported from Congo) which WHO declared over in August. The current outbreak is reported to have spread to DR Congo, Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria, with about 4,700 deaths, marking one of the fastest-spreading Ebola waves in history. The infection source remains unknown, and authorities say any domestic cases would be publicly announced.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでエボラ出血熱患者を確認　スイス人外交官の妻、コンゴ渡航歴なく感染源は謎
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち3項目（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当し、既に複数国（DRC・ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア）にまたがる致死率の高いエボラ流行であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは本流行の発生国として記述されているため含める。感染源不明で、WHO・アフリカCDCも渡航歴を未確認としており、情報の不確実性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Theo chân nhân viên y tế trong những ngày phòng bệnh não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shadowing healthcare workers during the days of meningococcal disease prevention
article.articleSummary: Five meningococcal disease cases were confirmed in Ho Chi Minh City during Oct 14–21, including one death. In Hiệp Phước commune, seven continuous-care health teams are door-to-door monitoring close contacts, with daily health checks and guidance. Authorities identified 177 close contacts linked to the cases, including students, households, schools, and venues where children gathered, even after hours such as swimming or fishing. Each contact is assigned to a team; staff visit homes at least daily and log data into a shared surveillance system. Monitoring runs through Oct 25 to complete a 10-day epidemiological watch. Local cadres and community health volunteers assist, addressing hard-to-reach households and sharing official prevention information. Hiệp Phước began this model in July 2026 and now covers about 4,700 residents with 7 teams for 2–3 hamlets.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌感染症予防の日々における医療従事者への密着取材
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市で髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスター（5例・1死亡）が発生し、177名の濃厚接触者に対する10日間の積極的疫学監視が実施されており、WPRO基準の複数（異常性・重症度・曝露継続・流行可能性）に該当し社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市ヒエップフォック地区で髄膜炎菌感染症クラスターに対する地域ベースの濃厚接触者追跡モデル（2026年7月開始、約4,700人をカバー）が運用されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は記事内に見られない。

article.articleHeadline: US monitors new Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain spreading from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Kenya and Nigeria; US offers support as Kenya reports first case on Oct 6 and now 9 infections, with a Kenyan citizen dying in Nairobi after travel from DRC. Nigeria also reports its first known case, in a traveler from epidemic‑hit East Africa. DRC has recorded 9,552 confirmed cases and 4,602 deaths since May, the second‑largest outbreak on record; the strain is described as rare with no approved vaccine or treatment, and early tests missed it, delaying detection. Kenya’s travel advisory was raised to Level 3; US aid offers are reiterated amid controversy over a Laikipia bio‑isolation facility, which Kenyan Ebola patients have not used. Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya notes the Bundibugyo outbreak is now the most geographically widespread, affecting multiple countries across three regions of Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、新たなエボラ症例を監視

article.articleHeadline: Ebola patient in Nigeria did not travel to DRC, Swiss government says
article.articleSummary: As of 23 Oct 2026, the Ebola outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has spread to four African countries: DRC, Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. In Nigeria, the first Ebola case in more than a decade involves a Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja. Swiss authorities stated she did not travel to the DRC and is believed to have contracted Ebola while traveling with her husband in Uganda, where officials say there are no current cases. Ugandan authorities claimed she had travelled to eastern DRC, but WHO and Africa CDC reported they had no confirmed information of such travel. Uganda had 20 Ebola cases in May–June, mostly imported from DRC; WHO declared Uganda Ebola-free in August. The Nigeria case highlights the outbreak's mortality, with about 4,700 deaths attributed to this outbreak by Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ患者、DRCへの渡航歴なしとスイス政府が発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ流行が既に4カ国に拡大し約4,700人の死者を出しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはアウトブレイクの発生源として引き続き主題であるため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội tăng cường phòng chống viêm não mô cầu trước diễn biến phức tạp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi strengthens prevention and control of meningococcal meningitis amid complex developments.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-23, Hanoi reports 2 sporadic meningococcal meningitis cases since the start of the year, with no outbreak detected, while neighboring areas such as Ho Chi Minh City face more complex transmission. Hanoi's CDC and health authorities are increasing surveillance, accelerating early case detection, and reinforcing public communication. Neisseria meningitidis–caused meningococcal meningitis is a highly contagious bacterial infection that can progress rapidly, causing severe complications or death within 24–48 hours; 10–20% of carriers show no symptoms but can transmit disease. Typical onset includes high fever, severe headache, nausea, neck stiffness, or purpuric rash. People are advised to seek prompt medical care if symptoms appear and to avoid self-medication. Preventive measures emphasize vaccination as the most effective protection, along with hand hygiene, masks in crowded places, environmental sanitation, and consulting physicians to choose appropriate vaccine type.

article.articleHeadline: Νιγηρία: Η ασθενής με Έμπολα στη Νιγηρία δεν είχε ταξιδέψει στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria: The patient with Ebola in Nigeria had not traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case in Nigeria in over a decade: a female patient, Swiss citizen born in Uganda, wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, developed Ebola symptoms in Nigeria. She did not travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, contrary to initial reports; Swiss authorities say she likely contracted Ebola while traveling with her husband to Uganda, though Uganda’s government says there are no current cases there and WHO and Africa CDC have not confirmed Congo exposure. The Nigeria case confirms Ebola has spread to four African countries—Congo, Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria—with Africa CDC counting about 4,700 deaths so far. Uganda previously reported 20 Ebola cases in May–June, largely linked to Congo, though the WHO declared Uganda free of Ebola in August. The Nigerian case underscores the ongoing regional outbreak and international tracing by health authorities.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち3項目（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）が該当し、既に複数国にまたがる地域流行の一部としてナイジェリアでも症例が確認されたため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はナイジェリアでの症例だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コンゴ（DRC）は地域流行の中心として明示的に言及されているため含めた。ウガンダ・ケニアも言及されているが対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: "Perdu père et mère": en RDC, Ebola fait des centaines d'orphelins
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Lost father and mother': in the DRC, Ebola has left hundreds of orphans.
article.articleSummary: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the 17th declared on May 15, is the deadliest in the country, with 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths to date (case fatality near 50%). The Bundibugyo strain is driving the epidemic, now reaching Nord-Ubangi province, with recent cross-border cases in Uganda (eradicated by end-August), Kenya, and Nigeria. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment; a clinical trial is underway. The response faces resource shortages and armed groups in Ituri, restricting access to affected areas. The crisis has created a large orphan problem: about 2,500 children have lost parents, and 8,200 new orphans have emerged in Ituri since the outbreak began. UNICEF-supported creches in Mongbwalu provide 21-day observation and care for orphans whose mothers tested positive, amid psychosocial strain and limited contact with surviving relatives.

triage.headline_ja: 「父も母も失った」：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが数百人の孤児を生み出す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模（9,704症例、致死率約50%）のエボラ流行が進行中で、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境例も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ワクチン・特異的治療法が未承認であり、イトゥリ州では武装勢力の活動により対応が制限されている点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: "Perdu père et mère": en RDC, Ebola fait des centaines d'orphelins : Actualités
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "'Lost father and mother': In the DRC, Ebola has left hundreds of orphans: News."
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is in its 17th outbreak, declared May 15 and now about six months old, driven by Bundibugyo virus causing hemorrhagic fever in Ituri’s epicenter around Mongbwalu. The outbreak has reached Nord-Ubangi, with cases reported in Uganda (where Ebola was declared eradicated in late August), Kenya, and Nigeria. Across the DRC, 9,704 infections and 4,687 deaths have been reported (case fatality ~50%). No licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists; a clinical trial is underway, but response capacity is hampered by armed groups in Ituri. The crisis has produced hundreds of Ebola orphans in 12 UNICEF-supported creches in infected zones, notably Mongbwalu, with more than 2,500 affected children and about 8,200 new orphans in Ituri since the start. Children account for roughly one-third of deaths and over a quarter of cases.

triage.headline_ja: 「父も母も失った」：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が数百人の孤児を生む
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ出血熱（第17次アウトブレイク）が感染9,704例・死亡4,687例（致死率約50%）に達し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの感染拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。武装勢力の影響で対応能力が制限されており、ワクチン未承認のまま臨床試験段階にある点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Bacteria linked to leptospirosis found in 5 areas in Manila
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis-causing Leptospira bacteria were detected across five sites along Manila's Estero de Paco waterway, according to University of the Philippines Diliman researchers. In Manila, 448 bacterial isolates from soil and water samples collected at five sites showed leptospiral presence in all locations, with no significant difference between upstream and downstream areas or between soil and water. Researchers identified two strains of Leptospira yasudae, a species known to infect humans and animals, and noted this is the first time the species has been genetically sequenced from a Philippines sample. The study, conducted with the Philippine Genome Center, does not establish whether the detected strains have infected people or contributed to any recent rise in leptospirosis cases. Findings underscore environmental distribution of Leptospira in urban waterways, highlighting potential exposure risk without asserting active transmission.

triage.headline_ja: マニラの5地域でレプトスピラ症関連の細菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 環境中からレプトスピラ菌が検出されたが、実際のヒト感染や症例増加との関連は未確認であり、情報が限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 研究は環境中の菌の存在を示したのみで、ヒト感染やアウトブレイクとの因果関係は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com ebola na Nigéria não viajou ao Congo, diz governo | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient in Nigeria did not travel to the Congo, government says | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: An Ebola patient in Nigeria—the first in the country in more than a decade—likely contracted the disease while abroad; however, authorities dispute travel history to the Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient is a Swiss citizen and the wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, born in Uganda. Swiss government statements to Reuters on 2026-10-23 say she did not travel to Congo, contradicting Ugandan authorities who said she had visited eastern Congo after falling ill in Nigeria. The World Health Organization and Africa's main health agency had not confirmed Congo travel. The Nigerian case expands the outbreak to four African countries: Congo (DRC), Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Africa CDC cites about 4,700 deaths overall; Uganda reported 20 Ebola cases in May–June (mostly imported from Congo) and was declared Ebola-free in August.

article.articleHeadline: Νιγηρία: Η ασθενής με Εμπολα δεν είχε ταξιδέψει στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria: The Ebola patient had not traveled to the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, an Ebola patient in Nigeria—a Swiss citizen born in Uganda and wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja—had not traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), contrary to Ugandan claims. The Swiss Foreign Ministry stated on 23 October that neither she nor her husband traveled to the DRC. article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Sees No Need to Change Gatherings After Ebola Case | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyro (Bundibugyo) virus Ebola case in Nigeria's Federal Capital Territory (Abuja) confirmed Oct 20, 2026, after a woman traveler from Uganda, who arrived earlier and is in isolation. WHO notes symptom onset on Oct 7, with the infection source under investigation. Nigeria identified 44 close contacts for monitoring as of Oct 20; additional contacts reportedly identified and high-risk contacts quarantined per local reports. Health officials say there is no need to change event plans unless public-health conditions worsen, with any restrictions to be set based on evidence. WHO counts Nigeria as the fifth country to detect Bundibugyo virus since the DRC outbreak began May 15, 2026. Laboratory confirmation occurred Oct 20; genomic sequencing is planned but no timetable given. Reports of the patient’s condition have varied, including deterioration to multiple-organ failure and possible recovery as lab results improved.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ症例確認後も集会方針変更の必要なしと表明
