article.articleHeadline: 本港新增兩宗外地傳入登革熱個案｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two new imported dengue fever cases in Hong Kong.
article.articleSummary: Two new imported dengue fever cases were recorded in Hong Kong from Oct 16 to Oct 22, with patients who had travelled to India and Bangladesh. The year-to-date dengue total is 36 cases (34 imported, 2 local). In 2025 HK had 59 cases (all imported); 2024 saw 161 (156 imported, 5 local). Globally, the World Health Organization reports a sustained rise in dengue, with over 14 million cases in 2024 and more than 5 million cases and 4,000 deaths last year across 90-plus countries; January–September 2026 recorded about 2.5 million cases and over 1,500 deaths. Nearby travel destinations remain affected: Bangladesh, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Indonesia, India, Malaysia, and Singapore. Guangdong Province has 586 dengue cases through September (155 in September). Chikungunya fever: no new HK cases Oct 16–22; total 7 this year (6 imported, 1 local). Preventive measures and mosquito control urged, with DEET guidance and the 1823 helpline.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で新たに2件のデング熱輸入症例
triage.triage_reason: 香港における定例的なデング熱・チクングニア熱サーベイランス報告であり、症例数は前年より減少傾向で新規性・異常性は乏しいが、蚊媒介感染症としての継続的な曝露リスクは存在するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は香港（中国特別行政区）の輸入デング熱症例の定例報告が主題。広東省の具体的な現地発生データ（586例）があるためChinaを含めた。インド・バングラデシュ・ベトナム・インドネシア等は患者の渡航先や『影響を受けている近隣諸国』として一般的に列挙されているのみで、具体的な発生データの記述がないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Guvernul elvețian susține că pacienta cu Ebola din Nigeria nu a călătorit în Republica Democratică Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Swiss government says that the Ebola patient from Nigeria did not travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, a Nigerian patient diagnosed with Ebola is the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja. Swiss authorities say she did not travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC); she may have contracted Ebola while with her husband in Uganda, where the government says there are no active cases. Uganda had reported 20 Ebola cases in May–June, mostly imported from the DRC; WHO later declared Uganda Ebola-free in August. Uganda’s government spokesman told Reuters that Uganda has no Ebola cases. The Nigerian case is the first in that country in more than a decade, and the outbreak has spread to four countries: DRC, Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. On Tuesday authorities identified 44 contacts; on Wednesday laboratory confirmation linked the Nigerian case to the Bundibugyo strain, the same lineage seen in the DRC outbreak. The current outbreak has caused about 4,700 deaths per Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: スイス政府、ナイジェリアのエボラ患者はコンゴ民主共和国へ渡航していないと主張
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアの4カ国に拡大し、ナイジェリアでは10年以上ぶりの症例確認、累計死者数約4700人と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があるため。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは出血熱の発生源・拡大先として記事の主題に含まれるため含める。

article.articleHeadline: International passengers face new Ebola attestation rule
article.articleSummary: CDC imposes a new Ebola attestation for international travelers, with a deadline of 11:59 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on Nov. 3, 2026. The declaration may be submitted digitally or on paper and applies to passengers of every nationality departing from any location. Airlines will organize and oversee the attestation process, and must verify submission before boarding. The policy carries penalties for knowingly submitting false or misleading information, including criminal fines and imprisonment. Since July, the entry restriction for travelers who have been in the Democratic Republic of Congo within the previous 21 days has applied to U.S. citizens, nationals and lawful permanent residents. Travelers recently in Uganda or South Sudan face a separate routing rule: entry is limited to three designated U.S. airports. The rule is part of Ebola-related entry controls.

triage.headline_ja: 国際線旅客に新たなエボラ出血熱に関する誓約(attestation)規則が適用
triage.triage_reason: 米CDCがエボラ出血熱に関連し国際線旅客への申告義務・入国制限を新設しており、IHR基準の複数（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本記事は米国の渡航規制政策に関する内容だが、7月以降続くDRCでのエボラ出血熱流行を背景とした措置であり、既存アウトブレイクの深刻度・拡大リスクを反映している。ウガンダ・南スーダンへの言及もあるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kalemie touchée par le choléra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kalemie hit by cholera.
article.articleSummary: Cholera epidemic officially declared in Kalemie, the capital of Tanganyika Province in southeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, by provincial authorities. The declaration was communicated in a statement read on October 22, 2026 by the provincial government spokesperson. The message emphasizes the gravity of cholera and its threat to families, noting the disease can be fatal within hours if patients do not receive rapid, appropriate care. The provincial governor extends condolences to families affected by losses and expresses solidarity. The government urges residents to seek medical consultation promptly upon symptom onset to mitigate transmission and severe outcomes. No specific case counts or laboratory details are provided in the communiqué.

triage.headline_ja: カレミエでコレラが発生
triage.triage_reason: 州政府がコレラ流行を正式宣言し死亡例にも言及しているが、具体的な症例数・検査情報が不明なため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: DRCではコレラが地方的に繰り返し発生している疾患であり、本記事単独では異常性は低いが、州当局が公式宣言し死亡例に言及している点から経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Donna svizzera malata di Ebola in Nigeria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swiss woman ill with Ebola in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, a Swiss woman—wife of a Swiss embassy employee in Abuja, Nigeria—has contracted Ebola and is being treated in a private clinic in Abuja. Diagnosis was confirmed on 20 October. It is presumed she contracted the virus during a trip to Uganda about two weeks earlier. Her husband is in isolation but asymptomatic. The couple did not travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. DFAE, the Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs, confirmed the report to Keystone-ATS, with Reuters reporting the details. The case represents a single imported Ebola infection in Nigeria; no other cases are mentioned in the article.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでスイス人女性がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な感染症の国際的な輸入症例であり、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常/予想外」の2点に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要だが、対象国（DRC）は本事例に直接関与していない。
triage.notes: 本症例はナイジェリアで発症し、感染源はウガンダ渡航と推定されている。DRCへの渡航歴は明確に否定されており、対象国リストに含まれるDRCは本イベントに直接関与していないため verified_locations には含めない。ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento da temperatura eleva chance de internação de crianças por infecção gastrointestinal, aponta estudo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in temperature increases the likelihood of hospitalization for children due to a gastrointestinal infection, study finds.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian study using 2000–2015 data from 1,814 municipalities (covering >78% of the population) finds that rising temperatures linked to climate variability increase hospitalizations for gastrointestinal infections, especially water- and food-borne cases, with infants under 1 year the most susceptible. Published in Science of the Total Environment (2022) and included in the El Niño health dossier, the work attributes higher risk to warmer conditions that boost microbial growth and food spoilage, and to rainfall shifts that impair access to potable water and safe food preparation. Diarrhea and vomiting threaten rapid dehydration in young children; vulnerability is intensified by limited water, hygiene, and health-service access. Regional Brazil effects vary: drought and heat in the North/Northeast; fires and smoke in the Amazon; floods and contaminated water in the South. Also notes PM2.5 and dengue fluctuations linked to El Niño/La Niña.

triage.headline_ja: 気温上昇が子どもの胃腸感染症による入院リスクを高めると研究が指摘
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動と胃腸感染症入院リスクに関する学術研究の紹介記事であり、デング熱を含む特定の感染症アウトブレイクの発生報告ではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にDengueとあるが、記事本文はEl Niño関連の気候と胃腸感染症入院リスクに関する研究紹介であり、デング熱の具体的アウトブレイクの記述はない。Bluedotのタグ付けミスの可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Un estudio español apunta al clima como señal de alerta del riesgo de ébola con meses de antelación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Spanish study points to climate as an early warning sign of Ebola risk with months of lead time.
article.articleSummary: Spanish researchers led by the University of Málaga identify climate oscillations linked to Ebola outbreaks in Africa, offering a six-to-twelve month lead time for heightened risk. The study analyzes 49 outbreaks from 1976–2025 against 26 climate indices, using four teleconnections: Caribbean sea-surface temperature, Indian Ocean Dipole, stratospheric wind quasi-biennial oscillation, and the Pacific Decadal Oscillation (PDO). The PDO was the most frequent signal; the Caribbean index became unavailable after February 2020, limiting future use. The associations are not causal but may reflect environmental conditions that influence outbreak ecology. The aim is to guide surveillance and preparedness rather than provide autonomous predictions. Data up to 2018 were used for modeling, with 2019–2025 reserved for evaluation. A future observatory would integrate fauna, deforestation, macroclimate, and local meteorology. Context: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo totaled 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths as of Oct 20 per ECDC.

triage.headline_ja: スペインの研究、気候がエボラリスクの数ヶ月前の警戒シグナルになると指摘
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は気候変動とエボラ発生の相関を分析する研究報告であり、新規の発生事例や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は気候指標とエボラ発生リスクの相関研究に関するもの。DRCのエボラ流行統計（9,704症例、4,687死亡、ECDC・10/20時点）は文脈情報として言及されているが、これは既知の継続中の流行状況の引用であり、本記事自体が新規シグナルを提供するものではない。スペインは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria aumenta medidas de control ante el primer caso de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria steps up control measures in response to the first Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first confirmed Ebola case, prompting intensified controls at airports and seaports. Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate says the patient is isolated and there is no evidence of community transmission. The imported case had spent two weeks vacationing in Kampala, Uganda, before returning to Nigeria and remains in stable condition and recovering. Authorities have identified 44 people potentially exposed and are expanding contact tracing. No broad disruption to public life has been announced, but additional measures could be taken if the situation evolves. The outbreak traces back to the Democratic Republic of Congo and has spread to several African countries, with more than 4,500 deaths and over 9,000 confirmed cases reported. Ebola is transmitted through contact with blood, bodily fluids, or other secretions from infected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ出血熱の初症例確認を受け統制措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起源とする大規模エボラ流行（死者4,500人超、症例9,000件超）がナイジェリアへも拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。流行の震源地であるDRCは4,500人超の死者、9,000件超の症例を抱える継続中の大規模アウトブレイクの発生国として該当するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: 奈及利亞伊波拉病患未赴剛果　瑞士政府打臉烏干達說法 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigerian Ebola patient did not travel to the Congo; Swiss government refutes Uganda's claim.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, Nigeria has confirmed an Ebola case—the patient is the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat. Switzerland rejected Uganda’s claim that she traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Investigations continue to identify the infection source. The World Health Organization says the exact origin remains unclear, while Africa CDC is examining whether the Nigerian patient had contact with a Kenyan case, since the two left Entebbe International Airport on the same day. Congo’s Ebola incident manager says there is no evidence the patient entered Congo; a link to the Kenyan case remains possible but must be confirmed against onset timing. Across Africa, four countries—DRC, Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria—have confirmed Ebola cases, with about 4,700 deaths from a high-fatality strain. No approved treatments or vaccines exist.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ患者、コンゴには渡航せず　スイス政府がウガンダの主張を否定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、アフリカ複数国にまたがる致死率の高いエボラ流行でWHO・Africa CDCも関与する国際的関心の高い事案であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・スイスにまたがる感染経路の議論が主題だが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。DRCは感染確認国の一つとして言及されている。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ONU: 3,5 millones de personas sufren hambre en zonas afectadas por el ébola en la RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: 3.5 million people are hungry in Ebola-affected areas in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 3.5 million people in Ebola-affected areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo face hunger at crisis level or worse (Famine Phase 3+), the World Food Programme reports. Of those directly affected by the outbreak, 97% still require food assistance. The ongoing Ebola outbreak—DR Congo's 17th—was declared May 15 and now spans eight provinces, with Ituri (epicenter) and North Kivu amid conflict. As of Oct 20, the outbreak has recorded 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths globally. Uganda accounts for 20 cases (15 imported from DR Congo) with two deaths, and the Ugandan outbreak was declared over by WHO on Aug 26. Linked cases have appeared in Kenya (9, including 1 death), Nigeria (1), the Netherlands (1), and France (1). The Bundibugyo strain has no specific treatment; two vaccines are in human trials. The World Food Programme seeks $214 million over six months for meals, logistics, and Ebola treatment centers, constrained by insecurity and poor roads.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ影響地域で350万人が飢餓に直面
triage.triage_reason: DRCで第17次エボラ流行が8州に拡大し、症例9,704件・死者4,687人、複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、オランダ、フランス）への越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際支援要請（WFPの2.14億ドル要請）もあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行による人道危機（食料不安）が主題。ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、オランダ、フランスへの関連症例の波及が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。症例数・死亡者数が過去のエボラ流行と比較して非常に大きい点に留意（記事は2026年の将来日付）。

article.articleHeadline: Deadly Melioidosis Outbreak Claims 40 Lives Across Four Provinces in Thailand with 538 Infected
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis, caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, is driving a deadly outbreak across four northeastern provinces of Thailand: Buri Ram, Surin, Nakhon Ratchasima, and Chaiyaphum. As of Oct 22, 2026, surveillance records 538 infections and at least 40 deaths, though provincial tallies reach 570 cases and 45 deaths, indicating reporting discrepancies. The outbreak disproportionately affects older adults, with people aged 65+ most affected. Transmission stems from exposure to contaminated soil, mud, and floodwater, via skin wounds, inhalation, or ingestion. Farmers and residents cleaning flood-damaged homes are at elevated risk. Authorities urge protective measures—rubber boots, gloves, long pants, waterproof clothing—and advise avoiding open wounds in contaminated environments. Ongoing public health warnings emphasize rapid medical evaluation for suspected melioidosis to improve outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: タイ北東部4県で致死的なメリオイドーシス流行、感染538人・死者40人
triage.triage_reason: タイ北東部4県で538人感染・40人超死亡という高い致死率の大規模流行が確認され、当局が注意喚起を行っていることから、重症度・継続曝露の観点でスクリーニング基準に該当し、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスは土壌・水を介した環境曝露型感染症でヒト-ヒト感染はしないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、洪水後の曝露継続と高齢者を中心とした高い死亡率が懸念される。続報で死者数・症例数の推移と当局の対応状況を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Naučnici otkrili mehanizam proteina koji pomaže u borbi protiv virusnih infekcija
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists have discovered the mechanism of a protein that helps fight viral infections.
article.articleSummary: DZIP3 detects viral RNA in human cells and activates innate immunity by moving to mitochondria and tagging key immune proteins, triggering type I interferon responses that block viral replication. Led by Dr. Santosh Chauhan at CSIR-Center for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB) in Hyderabad, India, the study shows this dual role of sensing and signaling seven years after a hypothesis proposed by the team. The mechanism provides broad protection against SARS-CoV-2, chikungunya virus, and Japanese encephalitis virus, with results published in The EMBO Journal. Building on this, researchers are developing small-molecule drugs to modulate DZIP3 to boost antiviral immunity. This work deepens understanding of human immunity and could enable broad-spectrum antiviral therapies against emerging viral threats.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者がウイルス感染との戦いを助けるタンパク質のメカニズムを発見
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究（タンパク質DZIP3の抗ウイルス免疫メカニズム）に関する科学的発見の報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は研究機関（CCMB, Hyderabad）での基礎科学研究の成果発表であり、実際の感染症流行事例ではないため、発生地域として挙げられているインドも実際のアウトブレイク発生地とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu: le mouvement citoyen préconise l'intensification des mesures barrières - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: the citizen movement advocates intensification of barrier measures - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in North Kivu, DRC, centered in Beni, with the 17th epidemic declared May 15, 2026. In a 23 October 2026 meeting in Beni, members of the pro-democracy Lucha movement urged authorities to intensify barrier measures, emphasize handwashing, and visibly demonstrate the reality of the disease to the public. They called for stronger community involvement and strict adherence to control measures. Economically, they proposed reducing some transport barriers, regulating fares and passenger limits, and capping market vendors, plus improved checkpoint monitoring between Beni, Butembo, and Kasindi. No case or death counts were cited in the article. The outbreak remains ongoing, and authorities are urged to act promptly to restore public trust.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州のエボラ出血熱：市民運動が防護措置の強化を提唱 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で継続中の第17次エボラ出血熱流行であり、重篤な疾患で公衆衛生上の懸念が高く、社会的関心（市民運動の訴え）も確認されるためフルRRAに進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事には感染者数・死亡者数の記載はなく、流行の規模や国際的拡大リスクの詳細は不明。ベニ、ブテンボ、カシンディ間の検問強化が提案されており、越境リスクへの懸念が示唆される。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Descubren que el estudio del clima podría anticipar dónde aumenta el riesgo de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They discover that the study of climate could predict where the risk of Ebola increases.
article.articleSummary: A study led by the University of Málaga (UMA), with Instituto Español de Oceanografía, University of Manchester, and the Center for International Forestry Research, finds Ebola outbreaks are not temporally random but linked to large-scale climate teleconnections. By analyzing 49 African Ebola outbreaks from 1976–2025 against 26 climate oscillation indices, the researchers show that distant climatic oscillations can correlate with outbreak timing in Central Africa. As of 26 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's ongoing Ebola epidemic began in May and has surpassed 8,000 confirmed infections and 3,901 deaths, about 50% fatality. Models built from data up to 2018 were tested for 2019–2025. Published in Stochastic Environmental Research and Risk Assessment (Springer Nature). The authors describe these oscillations as early-warning clues, potentially 6–12 months ahead, not direct causes, offering a surveillance tool to guide preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 気候の研究がエボラ出血熱のリスク増加地域を予測できる可能性を発見
triage.triage_reason: 記事中でDRCの進行中のエボラ流行が8,000人超の感染者、3,901人の死亡（致死率約50%）と報告されており、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事本体は気候とエボラ発生時期の相関を調べた研究紹介が主旨だが、その中でDRCの進行中のエボラ流行（2026年5月発生、2026年9月26日時点で8,000人超感染・3,901人死亡、致死率約50%）という重大な疫学情報が含まれており、これを重視してPICKUPと判定した。スペイン・英国は研究機関の所在地であり発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Governo da Tanzânia Reforça Controlo Sanitário de Viajantes Internacionais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Government of Tanzania Strengthens Health Screening of International Travelers
article.articleSummary: Tanzania tightens Ebola-related health screening for international travelers amid an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and a recent case identified in neighboring Kenya involving a traveler from the DRC. Implemented with immediate effect, the measures require all entrants to Tanzania to complete an electronic health surveillance form before departure or upon arrival, and to keep the QR confirmation or reference number for possible verification at entry points. The Travel Advisory No. 18, signed by Grace Magembe, Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Health, mandates health screening at airports, land borders, and seaports, including temperature checks. High‑risk travelers face daily monitoring for 21 days via automated messages or other channels. Vehicles, cargo, or remains linked to Ebola or other infectious diseases will be disinfected at entry. Travelers should report symptoms and comply with preventive measures and destination country requirements.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：タンザニア政府、国際渡航者への衛生管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行がケニアへ越境し、タンザニアが渡航者スクリーニングを強化するなど国際的な拡大・対応措置が進行しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生したエボラ流行とその越境（ケニアで症例確認）を受けたタンザニアの渡航者対策強化。ケニア・タンザニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: 6 mil perus são abatidos em granja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle Disease: 6,000 turkeys culled on a farm.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle Disease outbreak prompts culling of about 6,000 turkeys at a commercial farm in Nova Itaberada, western Santa Catarina. The birds were housed in two barns and culled on Monday, Oct 19, and Tuesday, Oct 20; carcasses were buried with contact materials, and the farm is undergoing disinfection after environmental authorities approved the process. Surveillance covers a 10-km radius with nine Cidasc teams inspecting commercial facilities and subsistence farms; closer properties prioritized, with plans to slaughter a further 133 birds across about 1,600 properties. MAPA coordinates the response alongside Cidasc. International impact: five countries have suspended poultry imports from Santa Catarina, with Mexico and Malaysia banning all Brazil, while China, Chile, and Saudi Arabia restrict only SC. China imported about US$1.15 billion of Brazilian poultry Jan–Sep this year (~R$5.79 billion). ABPA says no current estimated impact; Cidasc affirms safety of poultry from inspected establishments.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：養鶏場で七面鳥6,000羽が殺処分
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生により複数国が家きん輸入を停止しており、国際的拡大リスクと貿易制限リスクの両基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本事例は家きん（動物衛生）のニューカッスル病であり、ヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生影響は報告されていないが、中国・チリ・サウジアラビア・メキシコ・マレーシアが輸入制限を課しており、貿易・経済への影響が大きいため監視対象とする。対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ（中国・メキシコ・マレーシア・サウジアラビア・チリは輸入制限国であり発生国ではない）。

article.articleHeadline: Камерун вводит экстренные меры по борьбе с Эболой из-за вспышки в Нигерии: почти 10 тысяч случаев
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cameroon imposes emergency measures to combat Ebola due to an outbreak in Nigeria: nearly 10,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Cameroon imposes emergency measures as Ebola risk from neighboring Nigeria prompts border-focused defense. As of 23 October 2026, the global Ebola outbreak totals 9,637 cases with 4,646 deaths (48.2% CFR). The Democratic Republic of Congo remains the main reservoir. In Yaoundé, Health Minister Manaouda Malachy chaired a Strategic Committee meeting on 22 October 2026, endorsing a seven-point plan to prevent cross-border transmission. Key elements include total epidemiological surveillance, rapid-response teams, and upgrading state and private clinics to high readiness; updated diagnostics and treatment protocols. The plan also strengthens cross-border coordination with Nigeria and inter-ministerial cooperation, with clearly reinforced data-sharing chains to isolate patients quickly. Media are asked to share verified information to avoid public panic. The outbreak in Nigeria underpins the tightened border controls in Cameroon.

triage.headline_ja: カメルーン、ナイジェリアでのエボラ流行を受け緊急対策を導入：症例数は約1万件に
triage.triage_reason: 世界的なエボラ流行（約9,637例、致死率48.2%）が進行中で、DRCが主要な感染源とされ、国境を越えた拡大・渡航制限措置が取られており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はカメルーンの国境対策とナイジェリアでの流行を中心に述べているが、ナイジェリア・カメルーンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは『main reservoir』と明記されており、実際の発生国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : recrudescence de cas de diarrhée et décès à la prison de
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: resurgence of diarrheal cases and deaths at the prison of
article.articleSummary: North Kivu's Walikale central prison in the Democratic Republic of Congo reports a diarrheal outbreak since the start of October, with three deaths and several hospitalizations among inmates this week. The epidemic follows extreme overcrowding, planned to house about 100 but the facility now holds nearly 500, paired with dilapidated water and hygiene conditions that hasten transmission. Over the past two weeks, cases of skin infections and diarrhea have risen inside the prison. A local civil society group within the grounds urgent appeals for external medical intervention, noting that the Catholic Church offers only sporadic support while needs remain immense. Prison director Joseph Shuruku says transfers to the General Reference Hospital are unaffordable, underscoring the lack of funds for medical care. He calls for immediate on-site medical teams, a functional infirmary, faster judicial processing to ease overcrowding, and the resumption of state subsidies suspended for two years.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ワリカレ刑務所で下痢症例と死亡者が急増
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内での下痢性疾患の急増により複数の死亡・入院が発生しており、過密収容と劣悪な衛生環境により感染拡大の懸念があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は特定されていないが、下痢・皮膚感染症の急増、過密収容（定員の約5倍）、水・衛生インフラの劣化が感染拡大リスクを高めている。刑務所という閉鎖空間内での発生だが、外部支援（医療チーム派遣、国家補助金再開）が強く求められており、コレラ等の水系感染症の可能性も考慮すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Schweizerin erkrankt: Ebola breitet sich in Afrika weiter aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swiss woman falls ill: Ebola spreads further in Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 23, 2026, Ebola virus disease (EVD) spreads to Nigeria with a case in Abuja. The patient is a 42-year-old Ugandan-born Swiss embassy spouse, diagnosed Oct 20 in a clinic in Abuja after a trip to Uganda about two weeks earlier; her husband is in isolation but asymptomatic. The Swiss EDA says they did not travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The outbreak began in eastern Congo and has reached four countries. Uganda had initial cases; Kenya reported nine cases and one death in Nairobi on Oct 6. The Bundibugyo strain driving the outbreak is highly challenging: no vaccine exists, though several candidates are in clinical trials. Nearly 10,000 infections and over 4,600 deaths so far; it risks becoming the deadliest Ebola outbreak. Distrust, conflict, and alleged misappropriation of aid (about $700 million) hinder response; Congo suspended many NGOs; the Swiss embassy in Abuja remains open.

triage.headline_ja: スイス人女性が感染：エボラ出血熱、アフリカでさらに拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で始まったエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが既に4カ国に拡大し、感染者約1万人・死者4600人超と深刻化しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国で始まったアウトブレイクがウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアに拡大したことを報じているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ワクチンが存在せず、不信・紛争・援助資金の不正流用（約7億ドル）が対応を妨げていると記載されており、史上最悪のエボラアウトブレイクとなるリスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: ONU: 3,5 millones de personas sufren hambre en zonas afectadas por el ébola en la RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: 3.5 million people suffer hunger in Ebola-affected areas in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached its 17th outbreak, declared May 15, affecting eight eastern provinces with Ituri (epicenter) and North Kivu hardest hit. By Oct 20, the outbreak recorded 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths, making it the second-deadliest in history. Cross-border spread includes Uganda, where 20 cases (15 imported from the DRC) and 2 deaths have been reported; linked cases have appeared in Kenya (9, including 1 death), Nigeria (1), the Netherlands (1), and France (1). The UN World Food Programme warns nearly 3.5 million people in Ebola-affected areas are in crisis-level hunger; 97% of those directly affected need food assistance. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain lacks specific treatments, though two vaccines are in early human trials. A $214 million six-month appeal is needed to fund food, logistics, telecommunications, and Ebola treatment centers.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ影響地域で350万人が飢餓に直面
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ出血熱（第17次アウトブレイク）は史上2番目に死者数が多く、複数国への越境拡大と大規模な人道危機を伴うためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、オランダ、フランスへの越境・輸入症例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。主たる発生地はDRC東部（イトゥリ州が震源地）。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Pertama Ebola di Nigeria Tandai Penyebaran ke Afrika Barat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first Ebola case in Nigeria marks the spread to West Africa.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case in Abuja, after a woman arriving from Uganda developed symptoms on October 7 and was hospitalized for four days before Ebola diagnosis. Health authorities are tracing 44 contacts, including her husband and Swiss national who lived with her, plus other passengers who traveled with her from Uganda. This marks West Africa’s latest link to the Congo Bundibugyo outbreak. Nigeria previously faced Lagos’ 2014 Ebola outbreak (20 infections, 8 deaths). Kenya reported its first Ebola case earlier this month, nine infections; Uganda says it has no active cases, though the patient had transited through Uganda after business travel to eastern Congo and Uganda is investigating exposure sites. Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya calls for cross-border cooperation; a regional Ebola task force was formed in June. Nigeria’s CDC says enhanced surveillance and measures: detection, isolation, lab diagnosis, contact tracing, infection prevention, risk communication, and health-worker protection.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ出血熱症例確認、西アフリカへの拡大を示す
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という高致死率疾患がウガンダ経由でナイジェリアに初めて確認され、複数国にまたがる接触者追跡が必要な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）における初のエボラ症例だが、感染源として言及されているコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のBundibugyoアウトブレイクは実際に継続中の発生であるため、DRCのみを検証済み地域として記載。ウガンダ・ケニアも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Pres. Tinubu Approves ₦10bn For Ebola Response, Appoints Gbajabiamila As Task Force Chairman
article.articleSummary: Nigeria approves ₦10 billion emergency funding to bolster Ebola preparedness and other threats, appointing Chief of Staff Femi Gbajabiamila to head a presidential task force coordinating response. The funds will strengthen the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) and support early-detection and containment activities. Amid concerns over Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, the government aims to prevent entry of the disease by expanding surveillance and response capacity. States with international airports and major border corridors are to submit detailed response plans and budgets. Immediate measures include activating isolation and referral centers at Murtala Muhammed International Airport, Lagos, and Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport, Abuja, with similar steps at other airports. A QR code-based pre-arrival health declaration system will screen travellers from designated high-risk countries, alongside airport disinfection and designated terminals for flights from high-risk areas. The goal is swift, coordinated response to protect Nigerians.

triage.headline_ja: ティヌブ大統領、エボラ対応に100億ナイラを承認、グバジャビアミラ氏をタスクフォース委員長に任命
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを受け、ナイジェリアが大規模な緊急対応体制を構築していることから、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限）に該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（対象国外）の予防的対応策だが、背景としてDRC・ウガンダでの実際のエボラアウトブレイクが言及されているため、DRCを発生地域として記載。ナイジェリア自体での感染確認情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Warns Funding Gaps Threaten Africa's Polio Eradication Goals
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, WHO warns funding constraints and vaccination gaps threaten Africa's polio eradication goals. Poliovirus type 1 was detected in Madagascar after a 2025 outbreak closure, underscoring residual risk. The region was certified free of indigenous wild poliovirus in 2020, and independent assessments this year confirmed the closure of poliovirus type 2 outbreaks in Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, Republic of the Congo and Uganda. More than 168 million children received at least one dose between January and September 2026 through 55 vaccination rounds across 22 countries, but unfunded additional rounds are needed for the type 2 outbreak in the DRC. Lake Chad Basin and DRC remain major transmission challenges. Surveillance advances include wastewater testing and geospatial tools; >100,000 polio samples tested in 2025 with >90% analyzed on time. Maiduguri lab accredited; sequencing capacity up to four labs; Direct Detection Nanopore Sequencing shows promise. The Regional Framework for Polio Transition and Sustainability 2026-2035 was adopted to embed polio capacities into health systems.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがアフリカのポリオ根絶目標を脅かす資金不足を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのcVDPV2継続伝播と資金不足による追加接種ラウンド未実施、地域的な伝播リスクの持続がIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ地域全体のポリオ根絶プログラムに関するWHOの資金警告。Ghana・Burundi・Uganda・Guinea-Bissauはtype2アウトブレイクの『終息確認』として言及されており現在進行中の発生ではないため除外。DRCは継続的なcVDPV2伝播と追加接種ラウンドの資金不足が明記されており、現在進行中の課題として含めた。Nigeria（Lake Chad Basin, Borno State, Maiduguri）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: गोरखपुर में गाय की मौत से फैली दहशत, रेबीज की आशंका, दूध से बना पंचामृत-चाय पीने वाले 500 लोगों को लगा टीका
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Gorakhpur, panic after a cow's death, suspicion of rabies; 500 people who drank milk-based panchamrita tea felt vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: In Gorakhpur district, Uttar Pradesh, a village faced Rabies concerns after a cow died on 20 October, during Navratri Panchamrit preparation from its milk and milk-based tea sold at a village fair. The owner, Naumi Yadav, had the cow sick for about a month; a government veterinarian suspected rabies, possibly from a dog bite. In response, about 500 people who drank the Panchamrit and fair tea received anti-rabies vaccination. Initial vaccination saw around 70 villagers travel 11 km to Gola CHC for first doses; the next day a village vaccination camp vaccinated over 450 more, totaling roughly 500. A second dose is planned after one week. Officials from the district and Lucknow are assessing the situation and reassuring residents. Health guidance notes that rabies spreads via saliva; milk consumption does not transmit rabies, though raw milk from suspect animals should be avoided.

triage.headline_ja: ゴーラクプルで牛の死により恐慌拡大、狂犬病の疑い―パンチャムリト・紅茶を飲んだ500人がワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病疑いの牛からの乳製品を介した感染は医学的根拠が薄く、予防的ワクチン接種で対応済みだが、確定診断や追加症例の有無など情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 牛の狂犬病確定診断は未確定（獣医の疑い段階）。乳を介した狂犬病感染は科学的に否定的であり、住民の予防的ワクチン接種は過剰対応の可能性。続報で確定診断や追加感染者の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: PMA advierte sobre enormes necesidades de ayuda alimentaria en zona afectada por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WFP warns of enormous needs for food assistance in the Ebola-affected area.
article.articleSummary: In the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, about 3.5 million people in affected areas face food insecurity, as the World Food Programme appeals for $214 million over the next six months to assist the most vulnerable amid conflict and limited services. The outbreak, the worst in DRC history and the second-largest globally, has recorded over 9,700 Ebola cases and more than 4,700 deaths, with more than 2,600 survivors requiring ongoing care. The crisis is driving food prices up and undermining livelihoods due to isolation and treatment measures. WHO's Catherine Smallwood notes the outbreak is reaching remote areas and a new wave of cases this week emerged in North Ubangi Province in the northwest, which borders the Central African Republic. The briefing highlights the need for intensified international response to both containment and humanitarian needs.

triage.headline_ja: WFPがエボラ流行地域での深刻な食料支援ニーズについて警告
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模・世界第2位の規模のエボラ流行で、9700例超・死亡4700人超に達しており、新たな感染の波も発生。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国との国境地域（北ウバンギ州）で新たな感染の波が報告されており、越境拡大リスクに注意。ただしCARは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 流感｜3岁男童染甲流并发哮喘及脑病变　情况危殆　潜伏期曾访美
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza | A 3-year-old boy infected with H1N1 influenza complicated by asthma and brain lesions; in critical condition; had visited the United States during the incubation period.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, Hong Kong reports an imported case of influenza A(H1N1) in a 3-year-old boy with pre-existing conditions who developed asthma exacerbation, acute necrotizing encephalopathy, and septic shock, currently in critical condition in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit at Tuen Mun Hospital. Laboratory tests confirmed H1N1 infection. The patient had traveled to the United States during the incubation period and was unvaccinated for the 2026/27 seasonal flu vaccine. A household contact had mild upper respiratory symptoms and recovered. The Centre for Health Protection urges vaccination, especially for high-risk groups, and maintains strict hygiene measures. In the past four weeks, influenza-positive respiratory samples ranged 10.04–11.61%, and public-hospital flu-related admissions were 0.46–0.67 per 10,000, above baseline (4.94% and 0.27 per 10,000, respectively). This season records 26 severe pediatric influenza cases (20 recovered, 2 serious, 2 critical, 2 deaths). Vaccination outreach in about 1,000 schools aims to finish by mid-December, earlier than last year.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ｜3歳男児がA型(H1N1)インフルエンザに感染し、喘息発作および脳症を合併　容体危険　潜伏期間中に米国を訪問
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザによる重症小児例（脳症・敗血症性ショックを合併）が報告され、香港では今シーズン既に2例の死亡を含む重症小児例が確認されているため、社会的関心とWPROスクリーニング基準の複数該当がありフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本症例は季節性H1N1インフルエンザであり新型株ではない。患者は潜伏期間中に米国へ渡航していたが、これは季節性インフルエンザの既存流行と関連し、新規の国際的拡大リスクを示すものではない。香港では季節性インフルエンザ活動が基準値を上回っており、今シーズン26例の重症小児例（うち2例死亡）が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Schweizerin in Nigeria an Ebola erkrankt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swiss woman in Nigeria contracts Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Swiss woman contracts Ebola in Nigeria; diagnosis confirmed Oct 20 in Abuja, where she has been treated in a private clinic for about a week. She is the wife of a Swiss embassy employee in Abuja; infection is believed to have occurred during a Uganda trip about two weeks earlier. Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola case this Monday; the patient traveled from Uganda by plane and was treated in a private hospital in the Abuja area; lab results identified Bundibugyo strain. The husband is in isolation but asymptomatic; 25 other embassy staff are well and not required to isolate; the embassy remains open. The Swiss government is considering repatriation. Switzerland’s BAG and WHO are monitoring outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda; overall risk to Switzerland is very low; Ebola spreads mainly via direct contact with bodily fluids; incubation is 2-21 days; no evidence of airborne transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでスイス人女性がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ症例が確認され、ウガンダからの輸入例でスイス大使館職員家族も罹患。国際的な人の移動を伴う拡大事例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（ウガンダ由来の輸入症例）およびスイス人患者の件。DRCは背景情報としてWHO監視対象に言及されているのみで記事の主題ではないため除外。ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、該当する対象国のverified_locationsはなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Reaches Nigeria as Kenya's Screening Is Put to the Test
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo since mid-May has surpassed 9,000 cases and 4,000 deaths (case fatality rate ~48%). The WHO cautions it could exceed West Africa’s 2014–16 epidemic; no licensed vaccine or targeted therapy exists for Bundibugyo, so containment relies on early detection, isolation and contact tracing. Kenya has screened 685,027 at airports, with Gate 16 in Nairobi and a QR-form for 10 high-risk countries, plus five isolation centers; yet the Congo–Uganda–Kenya travel chain produced a case missed at Entebbe and Nairobi who died in Nairobi on 5 October, with nine confirmed cases linked to him, illustrating tracing value and gaps. Nigeria’s index patient arrived Abuja 5 October, developed symptoms 7 October, tested 19 October and was confirmed 20 October; investigators probe a possible Ugandan airport link to Kenya’s case. Lagos, Abuja, Kano and Rivers on high alert; Africa CDC convenes 28 October to push targeted screening and cross-border information sharing, not blanket border closures, and stresses travel-history triage.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがナイジェリアに到達、ケニアのスクリーニング体制が試される
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行が9000例・4000人死亡（CFR約48%）に達し、WHOは2014-16年西アフリカ流行を超える可能性を警告。既にケニア・ナイジェリアへの国境を越えた人伝播が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの流行とその波及（ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ）を扱うが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外した。Africa CDCは国境閉鎖ではなく対象スクリーニングと情報共有を推進する方針であり、渡航・貿易制限は現時点でNoと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria's Ebola patient believed to have contracted virus in Uganda, says Switzerland
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its Bundibugyro Ebola case in Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, believed to have contracted virus during a Uganda trip two weeks ago. She has been treated in an Abuja clinic for about a week after developing symptoms; her husband, who traveled with her, is in isolation but asymptomatic. Africa CDC director-general Jean Kaseya says she returned to Abuja with her husband on Oct 3 after visiting Uganda; investigators are examining whether she traveled to DRC or had contacts there, or visited areas outside Kampala. Uganda authorities say she did not show symptoms in Uganda but became ill after arriving in Nigeria; exposure location under investigation. Kenya reports its first Ebola case, Oct 6; 135 contacts traced, eight more cases; Africa CDC is assessing possible links to Nigeria via travellers from Entebbe. Bundibugyro Ebola has no vaccine or specific treatment; supportive care is critical.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ患者、ウガンダで感染した可能性とスイスが発表
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ型エボラがナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアにまたがって確認され、外交官家族を介した国際的拡大の懸念があり、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例はナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア間での国際的エボラ拡大に関するもので、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には含まれない。DRCへの渡航・接触歴は調査中であり確定情報ではないため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。続報でDRCでの感染確認があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 3歲男童感染甲型流感併發敗血性休克情況危殆　潛伏期曾到過美國
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three-year-old boy with influenza A infection complicated by septic shock in critical condition; had visited the United States during the incubation period.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-23, Hong Kong’s Center for Health Protection reported a severe pediatric influenza A infection in a 3-year-old boy with underlying conditions, currently in critical condition due to septic shock. During the incubation period he had traveled to the United States. He presented with fever and cough, developed shortness of breath, deteriorated to unconsciousness, and required admission to the pediatric intensive care unit. Respiratory samples tested positive for influenza A; the clinical diagnosis included asthma exacerbation, acute necrotizing encephalopathy, and septic shock. He had not received this season’s seasonal influenza vaccine. A household contact had mild upper respiratory symptoms and recovered without hospitalization. So far this season, 26 severe pediatric influenza cases have been recorded in Hong Kong, with 20 discharged, 2 remaining in severe condition, 2 critical, and 2 deaths. The center will continue investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 3歳男児がA型インフルエンザに感染し敗血症性ショックを合併、重体　潜伏期間中に米国へ渡航歴あり
triage.triage_reason: 香港における季節性インフルエンザAの重症小児例（1例）で、基礎疾患のある患者が重篤化した事例。季節性サーベイランスの一環であり、異常株や国際的拡大の証拠はないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 渡米歴は潜伏期間中の渡航であり、感染源が米国である証拠はない。香港における季節性インフルエンザの重症小児サーベイランス報告（今季26例中死亡2例）として継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Bác sĩ chỉ ra 2 triệu chứng điển hình của não mô cầu, phụ huynh cần lưu ý
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A doctor points out two hallmark symptoms of meningococcal disease that parents should take note of.
article.articleSummary: Five meningococcal disease cases (Neisseria meningitidis) in Ho Chi Minh City from Oct 14–20, all students; four in Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School, Hiệp Phước commune, and one at Ngô Thời Nhiệm School, Bình Dương ward. One student died. Meningococcal disease progresses; death can occur within 24 hours without treatment. Two hallmark symptoms are sudden high fever and a purpuric necrotic rash; initial illness may resemble flu but can rapidly progress to meningitis with neck stiffness, seizures, or altered consciousness. Humans are the primary reservoir; about 10–20% of healthy people carry the bacteria, and transmission is mainly via respiratory droplets. Vaccination matters: ACWY (A, C, W-135, Y), MenB, and BC vaccines exist; ACWY does not protect against group B. Parents should verify vaccination status and seek urgent care for fever, headache, vomiting, stiff neck, lethargy, or non-blanching rash. A health team helped contain the outbreak within 24 hours.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が指摘する髄膜炎菌感染症の2つの典型的症状、保護者は注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市の学校で髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスターが発生し死亡例も出ており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）に2項目該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2つの学校で5例の髄膜炎菌感染症が発生し1名死亡。保健当局が24時間以内に封じ込めに成功したとされるが、学生間の呼吸器飛沫感染の可能性があり、続報（ワクチン接種状況、追加症例の有無）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Woman with Ebola in Nigeria confirmed as wife of Swiss diplomat
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Nigeria: a 42-year-old Ugandan-born woman living in Abuja tested positive for Ebola on 20 October, the first confirmed Nigerian case in more than a decade. She is the wife of a Swiss diplomat; her husband is in isolation but asymptomatic. She returned to Nigeria on 3 October after about two and a half weeks in Uganda; symptoms began four days after arriving in Abuja. She spent a week at a private clinic before diagnosis and is in isolation, with the WHO noting improvement. Nigeria’s NCDC is conducting genomic sequencing to assess links to other cases. Investigators are examining a possible connection to a Kenyan man who died of Ebola and travelled via Entebbe airport; Kenya reports nine infections linked to that case, with eight others still in isolation. Authorities are tracing more than 44 contacts, while Africa CDC and WHO call for regional vigilance amid concerns over DR Congo–Uganda cross-border movement.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ感染女性、スイス人外交官の妻と確認
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで10年以上ぶりのエボラ確認例が発生し、ウガンダ・ケニアを含む複数国にまたがる感染連鎖の可能性があり、WHO・Africa CDCが地域的警戒を呼びかけている重大な国際公衆衛生事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la RCA et la RDC unissent leurs efforts pour contenir la propagation du virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the Central African Republic and the Democratic Republic of the Congo join forces to contain the spread of the virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola drives cross-border coordination between the Central African Republic (CAR) and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Health authorities in Bangui and Kinshasa are organizing a joint response to curb transmission, meeting on 22–23 October in Bangui to discuss epidemiological surveillance and alignment of prevention measures. The move signals a coordinated effort to slow the spread of the Ebola virus, with reporting by Astrid de Bonheur Kolengue. The article provides no specific case counts, symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or details on imported or exported cases. The focus is on enhanced surveillance, information sharing, and synchronized public health actions between the CAR and DRC capitals to strengthen containment and protect border regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：中央アフリカ共和国とコンゴ民主共和国がウイルスの拡散阻止に向けて協力

article.articleHeadline: Kasus TBC di Indonesia Mulai Turun, Menkes Budi Ingatkan Pasien Harus Tuntas Minum Obat : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis cases in Indonesia are starting to decline, Health Minister Budi reminds patients to complete their TB treatment.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia’s tuberculosis (TB) incidence is declining over the past two years, Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin says, reflecting government efforts to boost case finding and ensure treatment. WHO-reported TB incidence in Indonesia had risen for several years, with a turning point in 2024. In 2020, estimated TB cases were about 824,000, yet fewer than 400,000 were detected, leaving many undiagnosed and capable of transmission. Screening expansion increased detected cases from roughly 440,000 in 2022 to about 700,000, then 800,000, and 886,000 in the latest update, expanding treatment coverage and reducing transmission risk. Indonesia aims for the 90-95-90 target: 90% of estimated cases found, 95% of detected cases treated, and 90% of treated patients completing therapy successfully.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの結核症例が減少し始める、ブディ保健相が患者に服薬完了を呼びかけ

triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は症例減少という好転トレンドを伝えるもので、緊急性・異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Vệ sinh bàn ghế, đồ chơi để phòng bệnh tay chân miệng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cleaning tables, chairs, and toys to prevent hand, foot, and mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: HFMD is circulating year-round in Vietnam, with peaks in September–October, especially in kindergartens where children share toys and surfaces. It is caused by enteroviruses and spreads via saliva, respiratory secretions, vesicle fluid, and feces; contaminated toys and furniture enable transmission as children touch them and then put hands to the mouth. Incubation is 3–7 days; contagious 2–3 days before symptoms and throughout illness, with viral shedding in stool weeks after recovery in young children. Alcohol-based sanitizers are less effective against these viruses; chlorine-based disinfectants (active chlorine) such as Cloramin B or Javene are recommended at correct dilutions. Cleaning steps: wash toys and learning materials with soap, disinfect with chlorine solution, rinse, and air-dry; launder fabrics and soft toys regularly and air-dry; bathrooms and surfaces require daily cleaning, with intensified disinfection if a case occurs. Infected children should stay home about 10 days from onset until oral ulcers and lesions heal; seek care for severe signs (high fever, lethargy, tremor, vomiting, rapid breathing).

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Bas-Uélé : les autorités administratives et coutumières sensibilisées à la prévention d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bas-Uélé: Administrative and Customary Authorities Sensitized to Ebola Prevention - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola prevention awareness conducted in Bas-Uélé, Democratic Republic of the Congo, specifically in Buta, on Oct 23, 2026, with administrative and customary authorities sensitized. The provincial health division organized training to emphasize collective responsibility in Ebola virus disease (EVD) prevention. Minister Paulin Pusu Koyagba urged authorities to actively engage communities, counter rumors, and promote rapid reporting of suspected cases to health services. Participants were trained on transmission modes, identification of warning signs, and alert mechanisms, alongside adherence to prevention measures. The initiative, supported by WHO, UNICEF, IOM, Africa CDC, AFENET, and FHI 360, aims to strengthen community vigilance and coordination among local actors. Attendance included provincial government members and local dignitaries, underscoring EVD vigilance in Bas-Uélé.

article.articleHeadline: 賦權地區康健中心 全城預防流感 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Empowering District Wellness Centers for Citywide Flu Prevention | am730
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong accelerates influenza prevention through Plan 2.0: The government expanded vaccines (injections and nasal spray) and increased vaccination sites, with over 2 million doses administered in the past year. The next step is a district- and family-centered program: subsidized flu vaccination for foreign domestic workers living with children, the elderly, or the chronically ill—about HK$400–600 per family annually—funded publicly. District wellness centers will host a front-line ‘epidemic nurse team’ to screen, vaccinate, observe, educate, and refer, easing peak-season pressure and enabling career stability for nurses and pharmacists. A two-track service will offer both injected and nasal vaccines across all 18 districts, with real-time stock updates and SMS alerts during peaks. Outreach will be multilingual (Cantonese, Mandarin, English, Indonesian, Tagalog). Annual district prevention funds, year-round planning, and walk-in, non-appointment vaccination slots during flu season aim to ensure people have choice, location, and time—protection takes about two weeks.

article.articleHeadline: La UMA descubre un método para anticipar la aparición de brotes de Ébola con hasta un año de antelación | Diario Sur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UMA discovers a method to anticipate the emergence of Ebola outbreaks up to a year in advance.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in Africa may expand with climate change, as a UMA-led study links outbreak timing to big-scale climate teleconnections rather than randomness. An international team analyzed 49 African Ebola outbreaks (1976–2025) and 26 climate indices, calibrating the model through 2018 and validating with 2019–2025 data. Four predictors emerged for Ebola distribution: Pacific Decadal Oscillation (PDO)—the strongest, Indian Ocean Dipole (DMI), Quasi-Biennial Oscillation (QBO), and Caribbean Sea surface temperature (CAR). The mechanism is ecological: global fluctuations alter Central African rainfall, shifting wildlife–human interfaces; these signals provide a 6–12 month lead time to bolster surveillance and preparedness in high-risk regions. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the ongoing outbreak has reported over 8,000 confirmed infections and 3,901 deaths (case fatality ~50%). Authors Real, Olivero, Farfán, Márquez (UMA) with the Spanish Institute of Oceanography, University of Manchester, and CIFOR aim to create an integrated observatory combining macroclimate, local meteorology, deforestation, and wildlife biogeography to improve early detection.

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria's Ebola case sparks travel dispute, Switzerland denies patient visited Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria, the country’s first in more than a decade, in a Ugandan-born woman living in Abuja who recently traveled to Uganda. She developed symptoms on Oct 7, sought care Oct 11, and tested positive Oct 20; she is isolated and 44 contacts are being traced. The case comes amid a regional outbreak across DRC, Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria, with Africa CDC estimating about 4,700 deaths. Kenya has reported linked infections, first case Oct 6 and four new cases by Oct 18, including healthcare workers. Nigeria prepared for possible importations, with May statements of strengthened surveillance and enhanced airport screening by FAAN. Conflicting travel histories have emerged: the Swiss government says she did not travel to the DRC with her husband; Ugandan authorities had claimed travel to eastern DRC; WHO and Africa CDC say no confirmed information of DRC travel.

article.articleHeadline: चित्रकूट: ओपीडी में 1200 मरीज पहुंचे, वायरल बुखार और डेंगू के बढ़ते केस पर अस्पताल प्रशासन अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chitrakoot: 1,200 patients visit the OPD, hospital administration on alert over rising cases of viral fever and dengue.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 23, 2026, Chitrakoot reports rising viral fever and dengue amid weather fluctuations. By 2 PM, Joint District Hospital logged about 1,200 OPD prescriptions with around 300 patients diagnosed with viral fever; two dengue cases surfaced in the last two days, both discharged after treatment. Other facilities (CHCs and private hospitals) report similar seasonal illnesses. Dr. Rishi, a physician at the hospital, attributes illness to changing weather causing viral fever, cold, and cough. Preventive measures emphasize avoiding cold during morning/evening, drinking clean water, covering mouth and nose while coughing/sneezing, and hand hygiene. For dengue, eliminate standing water around home, regularly change water in coolers and pots, use mosquito nets. Seek medical advice for high fever, persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, or extreme weakness; avoid medications without a doctor's guidance.

article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-23, a 3-year-old boy in Hong Kong with underlying chronic illness infected with Influenza A developed septic shock and acute necrotizing encephalopathy, currently in critical condition in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit at Tuen Mun Hospital. The Centre for Health Protection said his incubation period included travel to the United States, and he had not received this year’s seasonal influenza vaccine. Respiratory testing was positive for Influenza A. Diagnoses included Influenza A with asthma exacerbation, acute necrotizing encephalopathy, and septic shock. A household contact recently had mild upper respiratory symptoms but did not require hospitalization and has recovered. CHP continues investigations. Overall this flu season has seen 26 severe pediatric influenza cases, with 20 recovered, 2 serious, 2 critical, and 2 deaths.

article.articleSummary: A 3-year-old boy with a preexisting chronic illness in Hong Kong tested positive for influenza A(H1) and is diagnosed with asthma attack, acute necrotizing encephalopathy, and septic shock. He remains in critical condition in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit at Tuen Mun Hospital. Onset occurred on Oct 20 with fever and cough; by Oct 22 he deteriorated, lost consciousness, was resuscitated, and admitted to the PICU. Centre for Health Protection preliminary investigation indicates travel to the United States during the incubation period; the child was not vaccinated for the 2026/27 seasonal influenza vaccine. One household contact had mild upper respiratory symptoms and recovered. This season has recorded 26 pediatric severe influenza cases; 20 have recovered, with two cases in severe condition, two in critical condition, and two deaths. article.articleSummary: Gorakhpur district, Uttar Pradesh: A cow reportedly died after a suspected dog bite, triggering panic among devotees who consumed milk-based charanamrita during Durga Puja. No human rabies cases have been reported. The cow’s owner, Navmi Yadav, said the animal had been ill for days; whether a dog bite occurred remains unclear. Health authorities vaccinated about 450 people with anti-rabies vaccine as a precaution—roughly 50 at a community health center on Tuesday and about 400 at a village camp on Wednesday. Veterinarians suspect dog exposure as the cause of the cow’s illness. Officials advised calm and to follow vaccination schedules if needed, noting that boiling milk used for charanamrita reportedly destroys the virus. A circulating video of the incident was not independently verified.

article.articleHeadline: மழைக்கால நோய்களும் பாதுகாப்பு முறைகளும்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monsoon diseases and protective measures.
article.articleSummary: Monsoon season increases disease risk via mosquitoes and respiratory infections. Stagnant rainwater accelerates breeding of mosquitoes, spreading dengue, chikungunya, and malaria. Poor water and food hygiene raise typhoid risk. Higher humidity and weakened defenses heighten influenza and pneumonia threats. Cold-water and unhygienic beverages can cause tonsillitis, with sore throat and hoarseness; sinusitis features severe headache, facial pain, nasal congestion, and sneezing. Asthma patients often struggle more during the monsoon and winter. Immediate treatment and adequate rest are emphasized, with avoidance of neglect. Preventive measures include drying the head after rain or washing, drinking safe boiled water, washing fruits and vegetables, frequent handwashing, avoiding leftover meals and street foods with flies, and eliminating mosquito breeding by netting windows and doors.
