triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippines(Ilocos)が含まれているが、記事サマリー・本文ともにフィリピンへの具体的言及はなく、主題はカナダ・ヨーロッパ間の北極圏協力体制構築である。対象国リストに該当する国は存在しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: técnicos monitoram granjas no Oeste de Santa Catarina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: technicians monitor poultry farms in western Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease keeps western Santa Catarina, Brazil, municipalities on alert as of October 23, 2026. The article details ongoing surveillance in the region, with an ND Group team gaining exclusive access to a local poultry farm to document frontline monitoring by veterinary professionals. Technicians conduct daily visits to properties to track the evolving situation and identify potential risks associated with Newcastle disease in poultry. The reporting emphasizes vigilance and proactive surveillance rather than isolated outbreaks, illustrating routine field work to safeguard flocks in the western portion of Santa Catarina. The piece highlights the collaboration between farm staff and public health authorities to detect signs, confirm infections, and mitigate transmission, although no specific case counts are reported. The focus remains on monitoring, risk assessment, and outbreak preparedness in affected municipalities.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：サンタカタリーナ州西部の養鶏場を技術者が監視

article.articleHeadline: US introduces new Ebola declaration
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-23 the US CDC announced a new declaration requirement for passengers on US-bound flights to prevent importation of Bundibugyo virus disease (a form of Ebola) linked to an outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Beginning November 3, all passengers, including those transiting the United States, must submit a signed declaration (digital or paper) before boarding, confirming whether they have been in the DRC within the prior 21 days. The declaration accompanies existing restrictions: travelers who have been in the DRC in the past 21 days cannot board; those who have been in Uganda or South Sudan in the preceding 21 days also face restrictions. Non-US citizens, including green-card holders, are generally barred from entering the US, while US citizens and nationals must enter via designated airports for health screening. The policy aims to curb importation of Bundibugyo virus disease.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、新たなエボラ関連申告制度を導入
triage.triage_reason: DRCを中心としたブンディブギョウイルス病（エボラの一種）の流行を受け、米国が渡航制限・搭乗前申告を新設するなど国際的な公衆衛生対応が取られており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで発生したブンディブギョウイルス病（エボラ）流行に対する米国の渡航規制強化を報じたもの。ウガンダ・南スーダンも渡航制限対象国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれず、また発生国として明示されていないため除外。米国も対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC calls for urgent Ebola funding as cases spread
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Africa prompts Africa CDC to urge urgent funding and stronger regional readiness as cases spread across borders. Nigeria reports its first Ebola case—a woman who arrived from Uganda—bringing the number of affected countries to five: Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, Nigeria, Kenya, and France. As of week 23, 9,735 confirmed cases and 4,690 deaths (case fatality rate 48.2%) with 2,614 recoveries are recorded. The virus is infectious only when symptomatic, prompting calls for multi-layered detection, including entry-point screening, enhanced surveillance, and laboratory capacity, plus preparedness in non-affected countries. About $3 billion in pledges exist, but only 35% has been disbursed; officials urge immediate release of funds to curb further spread as the outbreak expands beyond Bundibugyo across geographic boundaries.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、エボラ出血熱の感染拡大を受け緊急資金提供を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が複数国（コンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、ケニア、フランス）に拡大し、致死率48.2%と深刻。IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、国際的な資金・支援要請も発生している。
triage.notes: 発生の起点はコンゴ民主共和国（Bundibugyo）だが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニア・フランスは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。資金拠出率が35%にとどまり、国際支援の緊急性が極めて高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Vigilância gaúcha mantém 'régua alta' sobre doença de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande do Sul surveillance maintains a high bar for Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease detected in a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, on Sunday, Oct 18, 2026. Rio Grande do Sul maintains stringent internal surveillance and active coordination with Santa Catarina's official veterinary service, reflecting a zero-tolerance approach: any clinical sign compatible with Newcastle triggers investigation, sampling, and submission to the Ministry of Agriculture’s reference laboratory for confirmation. The case has led to import suspensions: Mexico and Malaysia halted imports of all Brazilian poultry products; China, Saudi Arabia, and Chile restricted shipments from Santa Catarina. Despite the less-than-100-km distance from the RS border, authorities say the situation does not markedly change RS risk assessments, and ongoing notifications continue to be addressed. Agropecuária outlets in Rio Grande do Sul still receive day-old chicks from Santa Catarina for sale; however, turkeys are not being moved.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ・ド・スル州の監視当局、サンタカタリーナ州のニューカッスル病に対し『高い基準』を維持
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病が確認され、メキシコ・マレーシア・中国・サウジアラビア・チリが輸入停止/制限を実施するなど国際的な貿易影響が生じているため、フルリスク評価で経過を精査する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola alert tests Nigeria's health system
article.articleSummary: Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria linked to travel from Uganda, involving a woman who tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain. Nigerian authorities identified 44 contacts for monitoring and are tracing movements and exposures; as of October 22 there is no evidence of wider community transmission. The case highlights cross-border spread risk and the difficulty of early recognition when symptoms resemble common illnesses. Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine or licensed treatment, underscoring rapid diagnosis and strict infection-control measures. The outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May and has reached Uganda and Kenya, underscoring regional vulnerability. Africa CDC calls for stronger regional coordination, focusing on surveillance, rapid diagnosis, contact tracing and preparedness. Nigeria’s immediate tasks: monitor contacts, investigate exposures, assess suspected infections quickly, and communicate clearly to the public. 2014 containment offers lessons; ongoing preparedness remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒、ナイジェリアの医療システムを試す
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダ由来の輸入エボラ症例がナイジェリアで確認され、DRCを起点とする多国間（DRC・ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア）への越境拡大が進行中であり、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株であることからIHR基準を複数満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Health officials race to trace source of Nigeria's Ebola infection
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola patient in more than a decade: Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja. She has not travelled to the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak began mid-May; investigators say she may have contracted the virus during a two-week visit to Uganda before returning to Nigeria. WHO and Africa's authorities cautioned that the source is not yet confirmed and investigations continue. The outbreak has reached four countries—DRC, Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria—marking the widest geographic spread of Ebola to date. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected fluids or contaminated objects; no evidence of sustained transmission outside symptoms. Nigeria tested the patient 13 days after illness onset. Kenyan patient, who flew from Uganda’s Entebbe airport, died in Nairobi two days later. Uganda had 20 May–June cases, mostly imported from Congo, with no cases since June. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for this Ebola species.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局、ナイジェリアのエボラ感染者の感染源究明を急ぐ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC・ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアの4カ国に拡大し過去最大の地理的拡散を示しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクはDRCで5月中旬に発生し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ拡大。これら3カ国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・治療法が存在しない点、感染源が未確定である点から継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: La UMA relaciona los brotes de ébola con oscilaciones del clima que podrían anticipar el riesgo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UMA links Ebola outbreaks to climate oscillations that could forecast the risk.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in Africa are linked to large-scale climate oscillations that could forecast risk with a 6–12 month lead time. A University of Málaga study analyzed 49 African outbreaks (1976–2025) against 26 climate indices, identifying four predictors: Caribbean Sea surface temperature, Indian Ocean Dipole, quasi-biennial oscillation of stratospheric winds, and the Pacific decadal oscillation—the latter most recurrent. The authors stress these signals are indicators, not direct causes, and could flag periods/areas for intensified surveillance and preparedness. Published in Stochastic Environmental Research and Risk Assessment, the work built models with data through 2018 and tested them for 2019–2025. Concurrently, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports an ongoing Ebola outbreak with over 8,000 confirmed infections and about 3,901 deaths (≈50% fatality) as of Sept 26, 2026. The UMA team envisions an observatory integrating climate, fauna, deforestation, and local meteorology; partners include Instituto Español de Oceanografía, University of Manchester, and CIFOR.

triage.headline_ja: マラガ大学、エボラ発生を気候変動の周期と関連付け、リスクを事前予測できる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 記事中でDRCの進行中エボラアウトブレイク（感染者8,000人超、死者約3,901人、致死率約50%）が報告されており、IHR基準の深刻性に該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はマラガ大学による気候振動とエボラ流行の相関研究だが、文中でDRCの進行中エボラアウトブレイクの深刻な統計（致死率約50%）が言及されているため、既存の進行中事案としてPICKUP相当と判断。スペイン・UK・アフリカ大陸は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Autoridades sanitarias africanas buscan localizar con rapidez origen de brote de ébola en Nigeria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African health authorities seek to quickly locate the source of the Ebola outbreak in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: On 23 Oct 2026, African health authorities race to pinpoint the source of Nigeria’s first Ebola case in more than a decade, as the outbreak has reached four countries—Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria—the widest geographic spread on record in Africa. The Nigerian patient, the Ugandan-origin wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja, fell ill and was tested 13 days later. Investigators are assessing whether infection occurred in Uganda during a two-week visit or elsewhere; no definitive link has emerged. A Kenyan patient who flew from Entebbe to Nairobi in early October died two days after admission; authorities say a connection to the Nigerian case is not established. Uganda reported 20 cases in May–June, mostly Congo-imported, with no cases since June. Ebola transmission requires direct contact with infected fluids; the strain has no approved treatment or vaccine. Congo reports about 10,000 infections and 4,600 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの保健当局、ナイジェリアのエボラ出血熱流行の発生源を急いで特定しようとする

article.articleHeadline: A Deadly Virus Has Been Hiding in Brazil for 142 Years - and Scientists Just Uncovered a Hidden Danger
article.articleSummary: Two fatal Sabiá virus infections in Brazil (São Paulo state) were identified by genomic analysis after existing tests failed to detect the virus due to mutations in primer target regions. The cases: a 52-year-old Sorocaba hiker who fell ill Dec 30, 2019, sought care Jan 2020, died Jan 11, 2020; initial tests negative for yellow fever and Sabiá; metagenomic sequencing detected Sabiá in blood. A second case: a 63-year-old rural worker from Assis, admitted Dec 10, 2019, died two days later. Overall, only four fatal Sabiá virus cases have been documented in São Paulo since 1990 (Cotia). Phylogenetic analysis shows the virus circulating in Brazil for about 142 years, far earlier than thought; new detection primers were redesigned and sent to Adolpho Lutz Institute. Unknown animal reservoir; wild rodents suspected; denotes hidden circulation and need for surveillance and diagnostics.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性ウイルスがブラジルに142年間潜んでいた - 科学者が隠れた危険性を発見
triage.triage_reason: 既存の検査では検出できない変異を持つSabiáウイルス（アレナウイルス）による過去の致死例に関する科学研究報告であり、新規アウトブレイクではないが、診断体制の盲点とサーベイランス強化の必要性を示唆するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は2019-2020年に発生した既往の致死例についての遺伝子解析研究報告であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生緊急事態ではない。既存の検査プライマーがウイルスの変異により検出に失敗していた点、未知の動物リザーバーの存在が指摘されており、将来的なサーベイランス改善の必要性を示す内容。新規アウトブレイクのシグナルとしては該当しないが、診断上の盲点として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola patient in Nigeria did not visit DR Congo, escalating concern over spread of virus
article.articleSummary: An Ebola case in Nigeria concerns a Swiss woman, wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, who was Ugandan-born and is believed to have contracted the virus while traveling with her husband in Uganda. She has not travelled to eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, contrary to Ugandan claims. Uganda says there are no active Ebola cases. WHO investigations continue to identify the infection source, with a possible link to a Kenyan Ebola case; Africa CDC notes the travellers left Entebbe airport on 3 October. Nigeria says the case is contained and contact tracing is ongoing. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus, with more than 9,500 infections and about half deaths; confirmed in DRC, Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria and France. It is the largest outbreak in DR Congo’s history and second only globally to 2014–16 West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ患者はコンゴ民主共和国を訪問していなかった、ウイルス拡散への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる大規模アウトブレイク（感染者9,500人超、致死率約50%）が複数国に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Minsa usa nueva tecnología para detectar tuberculosis en 20 minutos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MINSA uses new technology to detect tuberculosis in 20 minutes.
article.articleSummary: Peru's Ministry of Health (MINSA) deployed 67 portable MiniDock molecular biology devices to deliver TB diagnoses in about 20 minutes from sputum or swab samples, eliminating the need to transport specimens to Lima. The rollout targets frontier and hard-to-reach areas, beginning in Loreto and expanding to Junín (14), San Martín (10), Ucayali (8), Madre de Dios (4), Amazonas (2), and Lima Este (2), totaling 67 units at a cost of $62,506 financed by the Global Fund. Training by the National Institute of Health (INS) ensures local staff can use and maintain the devices. Through 2026, MINSA has intensified TB screening with over 119,000 risk-area screenings and more than 300,000 molecular tests. Additionally, a digital X-ray AI network expanded to 70 units to automatically flag suspected TB and triage cases.

triage.triage_reason: ペルー国内での結核診断技術導入に関する行政施策の報道であり、新規の異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではなく、対象国での発生事象でもない。
triage.notes: 記事はペルーにおける結核診断技術の導入に関する行政広報であり、対象国リストに含まれる国での発生事象ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Model maps cheapest routes to end sleeping sickness transmission in DRC
article.articleSummary: Gambiense human African trypanosomiasis (gHAT) in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is analyzed via cost-effectiveness modelling across 165 health zones for 2026–2040. Six strategies—ranging from status quo control to elimination-by-2030 or elimination-by-2040—are assessed within a net monetary framework using costs per disability-adjusted life-year (DALY) averted. By 2030, strategies prioritising elimination predict transmission reduction in 118–134 health zones; by 2040, costs would total $67.8M, $93.3M, and $185M (with wide prediction intervals). A looser 2040 target yields elimination in 152 zones at ~ $158M, leaving 13 zones unmet. In 2026, front-loaded spending differs markedly: status quo about $8.75M versus elimination strategies about $27.0M. Pursuing 2030 elimination could reduce gHAT deaths by 68% (7,979 deaths under status quo to 2,576). Some zones may still need novel tools to close gaps; results are interval-based, not precise forecasts.

triage.headline_ja: モデルがDRCにおける睡眠病（アフリカトリパノソーマ症）伝播終息のための最も低コストな戦略を示す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既知の風土病（gHAT）に対する費用対効果モデリング研究であり、新規の公衆衛生上の異常事態や急性のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾病モデリング研究の紹介であり、実際の発生イベントの報告ではないためトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Top 10 FAQs About Shamonda Virus Answered
article.articleSummary: Shamonda virus, an Orthobunyavirus in the Simbu serogroup, was first isolated from cattle in Nigeria (1965) and had been detected in Africa and Asia, with European farm animals identified in Spring 2026. The first confirmed human case occurred in France, with the country announcing a human-death on October 22, 2026; the patient, severely immunocompromised and being treated for leukemia, died in early October after developing neurological complications. Investigations into whether Shamonda contributed to the death are ongoing, and authorities say there is currently no identified risk to the general population. The case demonstrates possible cross-species transmission and highlights the need for a One Health approach, enhanced surveillance, and diagnostic testing. Transmission in animals occurs via Culicoides biting midges (not mosquitoes). The article also provides India-specific guidance where relevant.

triage.headline_ja: Shamonda(シャモンダ)ウイルスに関するFAQトップ10
triage.triage_reason: フランスで免疫不全患者における初のヒト症例・死亡が報告されたが、一般集団へのリスクは低いとされ、対象国（ナイジェリア・インド等は記事内で事例発生国ではなく参考情報）での実発生は確認されないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事はFAQ形式の解説記事。ヒト症例はフランスで発生（対象国外）。インド・ナイジェリアは歴史的背景・一般的ガイダンスとして言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ベクター媒介性ウイルスでヒト-ヒト感染は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Mesmo com 97% da cobertura vacinal, MS já teve 24 casos suspeitos de sarampo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even with 97% vaccination coverage, Mato Grosso do Sul has already had 24 suspected measles cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reported 24 suspected measles cases in 2026 through Sept 1, with 23 discarded and one still under investigation by the SES. Vaccination coverage is 97.1% for the first dose and 81.8% for the second dose. The last confirmed MS cases occurred in 2020 in Campo Grande; in 2019, two cases in the capital and two in Três Lagoas were reported. The Pan American Health Organization notes that 99.5% of confirmed measles cases in the Americas this year are in the United States, Mexico, Peru, Canada and Guatemala; Brazil has 61 imported or import-related cases. Actions include October vaccination drives (84,439 doses; 4,262 MMR), training across 79 municipalities, and a November school-based initiative ‘Aluno Imunizado’ to expand access and issue Updated Vaccination Declarations. Vaccination schedules emphasize two-dose coverage; symptoms include fever with a red rash, cough, runny nose, or conjunctivitis.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン接種率97%にもかかわらず、マットグロッソ・ド・スル州では2026年にすでに麻疹疑い例24件が報告
triage.triage_reason: 疑い例24件のうち23件は否定され1件調査中で、ブラジルの実際の確定例は少なく高いワクチン接種率も維持されているが、麻疹の輸入例・地域流行の可能性があるため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 米国・メキシコ・ペルー・カナダ・グアテマラは記事内でアメリカ大陸における確定例の多い国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルは疑い例報告と輸入関連例61件の主題国として含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : Vingt-huit nouveaux cas confirmés au 22 octobre 2026 - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: Twenty-eight new confirmed cases as of October 22, 2026 - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of Oct 22, 2026, 28 new confirmed cases rise the cumulative total to 2,291, with 1,325 deaths (case fatality 58%), 265 recoveries, 43 discharged without medical advice, 658 active cases and 2 probable. The new cases span 12 health zones, including Beni (5), Oicha (4), Kalunguta (2), Mabalako (2), Katwa (2), and Lubero (1). Katwa remains the epicenter with 685 confirmed cases (442 deaths, 112 recoveries), followed by Beni with 576 cases (442 deaths, 173 recoveries). Suspected cases total 188 (51 deaths among suspects; 124 samples taken). Nord-Kivu has 34 health zones and 194 affected health areas out of 684. There are 19,511 active contacts listed, with 15,974 being followed (82% follow-up). Response focuses on epidemiological surveillance, contact tracing, and patient care to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州エボラ出血熱：2026年10月22日時点で新たに28例の確定症例
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが大規模化（累計2,291例、致死率58%）しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 致死率58%、活動中の症例658例、接触者19,511人（うち82%追跡中）と、継続的な人対人感染リスクが高い大規模アウトブレイク。12の保健区域に拡大しており、既存のWHO IHR通報対象疾患（エボラ）であることからも即時のフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nuovi casi di legionella a Palermo: "Dove si trova il batterio e le regole per evitarlo"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New cases of Legionella in Palermo: "Where the bacterium is located and the rules for avoiding it"
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, Palermo reports rising legionellosis cases linked to water systems, including three schools, some condominiums, and the regional Energy Department office. A patient initially treated at Villa Sofia was moved to Ismett in critical condition; another Italian patient who had returned from China was discharged on October 16. Legionella is a bacterium naturally in aquatic environments but can proliferate in building water systems when water stagnates, temperatures 25–45°C, and biofilm or scale form in pipes. Transmission occurs mainly via inhalation of aerosolized water; drinking water, simple contact, or person-to-person spread are not typical routes. Symptoms range from fever and cough to malaise, myalgias, and in severe cases pneumonia; Pontiac fever is milder. Diagnosis uses urinary antigen tests, cultures, and PCR on respiratory samples; chest radiography supports assessment. Early antibiotic therapy improves outcomes and reduces complications; prevention focuses on identifying and mitigating contaminated water systems.

triage.headline_ja: パレルモでレジオネラ症の新規症例:「細菌の所在地と回避のためのルール」
triage.triage_reason: イタリア・パレルモ国内の給水設備に関連する局地的なレジオネラ症集団発生であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではなく、人-人感染もしないため国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 記事中の中国への言及は、中国から帰国したイタリア人患者がイタリア国内で発症したという文脈であり、発生国は中国ではなくイタリア（対象国外）。よってverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Chief medical officer assures of Ebola monitoring ahead of CHOGM
article.articleSummary: Antigua and Barbuda is strengthening Ebola surveillance ahead of CHOGM starting November 1, 2026. Chief Medical Officer Dr. Kamaria DeCastro stated monitoring focuses on potential introduction of Ebola linked to the Bundibugyo virus, with the DRC as the current epicenter. While 21 African Commonwealth members are in the grouping, most affected remain DRC, Sierra Leone, Liberia, and Guinea. Antigua's measures include a health declaration via the ArriveAntigua portal, implemented after Ebola was declared a public health emergency of international concern. Immigration and border-control partnerships reinforce passenger screening, with pre-departure checks emphasized. Real-time alerts flow through CARICOM/CARPHA and the Advanced Passenger Information System. Airport screenings are conducted for all arrivals on Air Peace flights, with temperature checks and review of paper declarations by nurses and port/public health staff. The program relies on cross-agency cooperation to identify and respond to potential risks before arrival.

triage.headline_ja: 最高医療責任者、CHOGM開催を前にエボラ監視体制を保証
triage.triage_reason: DRCを震源地とするエボラ流行（Bundibugyoウイルス関連）はPHEICとして既に国際的懸念が表明されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事自体はアンティグア・バーブーダ（対象国外）のCHOGM前監視体制強化を主題としているが、背景となるエボラ流行の発生源はDRCであり、既にPHEIC宣言済みの既知流行に関する続報記事。新規発生地としての情報価値は低いが、国際的な公衆衛生対応の観点からPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Switzerland says Nigeria's Ebola patient is wife of Swiss diplomat, likely infected in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola patient in more than a decade: a 42-year-old Ugandan-born woman living in Abuja, wife of a Swiss diplomat, who tested positive for Ebola on 20 October. The case is considered imported to Nigeria, with the patient having travelled earlier this month to Uganda. Contradicting statements: Uganda's foreign ministry had suggested she travelled to eastern DRC for business, but the Swiss government says she had not visited DRC. Uganda reports no confirmed active Ebola cases and notes that travelling through a country does not prove infection there. The World Health Organization says it is too early to determine the infection source, as investigations piece together her movements and limited interview opportunities in hospital hinder full exposure history.

triage.headline_ja: スイス政府、ナイジェリアのエボラ患者はスイス人外交官の妻でウガンダで感染した可能性が高いと発表
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで10年ぶりとなるエボラ輸入症例が確認され、感染経路（ウガンダ経由か、DRC経由かで情報が錯綜）が未確定であり、国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心が高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRCが含まれているが、記事サマリーではスイス政府がDRC訪問を否定しており、感染地として確定していない。主題国であるナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイスはいずれも対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。感染経路の確定情報（特にDRC関連）には続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US Requires Ebola Travel Declaration for All Passengers Arriving After Nov 3
article.articleSummary: Starting 11:59 pm on 3 November 2026, every passenger boarding a flight to the United States must confirm they have not been in the Democratic Republic of Congo within the preceding 21 days. Airlines must collect the declaration and retain a copy for 42 days after arrival. Directive, issued 22 October, requires carriers to deny boarding to those failing to submit the attestation on all flights, including pre-clearance ports. The rule will affect thousands of Kenyan nationals and other foreigners seeking entry, who must disclose recent travel to the DRC. It follows Kenya's Ebola response after a traveler from the DRC via Uganda arrived in Nairobi on 3 October, dying and infecting nine contacts. Kenya's Ministry of Health has intensified airport screening and contact tracing. The US State Department has raised Kenya to Level 3 travel advisory to reconsider travel due to Ebola and broader security concerns.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、11月3日以降到着する全乗客にエボラ渡航申告を義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ感染がウガンダ経由でケニアに拡大し死亡・9名感染が確認され、米国が渡航制限措置を導入するなど国際的拡大と渡航制限の両方が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC由来のエボラ感染拡大とそれに伴う米国の渡航規制。ケニア・ウガンダ・米国は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際的拡大の事実関係として関連する。

article.articleHeadline: Preço do frango pode cair no Brasil em 2027 após caso de Newcastle, diz Itaú
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chicken prices could fall in Brazil in 2027 after a Newcastle disease case, says Itaú.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease was confirmed Oct 18 at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil, housing 6,526 birds with 26 cases and no deaths. After confirmation, China suspended imports of poultry meat from Santa Catarina; Saudi Arabia and Chile also restricted SC products, and Mexico and Malaysia halted purchases of certain avian products. Santa Catarina, Brazil’s second-largest chicken producer, exported about 63% of its output; in 2025 SC shipped ~1.2 million tons of chicken valued at $2.45 billion, representing 22.5% of Brazil’s export volume and 25% of revenue. Itaú BBA cautions that export restrictions could be short-lived or prolonged; if prolonged, domestic supply would rise, pressuring prices in early 2027. Brazil’s 2026 chicken output up ~6% year-on-year; costs in Santa Catarina fell roughly 3.2% through September.

triage.headline_ja: イタウ銀行、ニューカッスル病の症例確認後2027年にブラジルの鶏肉価格が下落する可能性があると発表
triage.triage_reason: 本件はブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の商業七面鳥農場で確認された家禽のニューカッスル病であり、ヒトへの感染性・公衆衛生上の影響はなく、内容は貿易制限と鶏肉価格への経済的影響に関するものである。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病でありヒト感染症ではないため、公衆衛生危機管理の観点からは対象外。記事内容は農産物貿易・経済への影響分析が中心。

article.articleHeadline: Pune Reports First Suspected Dengue Death Of The Year As 8-Year-Old Dies: How To Keep Children Protected
article.articleSummary: Pune reports first suspected dengue death of 2026: eight-year-old girl from Lohegaon died October 18 at Ruby Hall Clinic after fever and abdominal pain; dengue infection diagnosed with progression to dengue-associated shock and multiple organ dysfunction, culminating in cardiac arrest despite intensive care. Pune recorded over 2,000 suspected dengue cases in 2026, with a surge between August and October, prompting expanded mosquito surveillance and prevention efforts. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes that bite during the daytime and breed in stagnant water in containers such as flowerpots, tyres and coolers. Common symptoms include high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle and joint pains, nausea, vomiting, rash; children may have abdominal discomfort, loss of appetite, and fatigue. Severe dengue can involve plasma leakage, hypotension, bleeding, and organ damage, often as fever subsides. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water, wearing repellents (DEET or picaridin), protective clothing, nets/screens, and prompt medical evaluation for persistent fever.

triage.headline_ja: プネーで今年初の疑い例によるデング熱死亡、8歳女児が死亡：子どもを守る方法
triage.triage_reason: インドのプネーで季節性デング熱の増加と死亡例が報告されているが、インドではデング熱は毎年流行する風土病であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないため、フルRRAには進まず経過観察とする。
triage.notes: インドでは例年デング熱が流行しており、今回の報告は季節性の地域的増加及び単発死亡例であり、国際的な公衆衛生リスクとしての緊急性は低いと判断される。地元自治体による蚊媒介対策の強化が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento da temperatura eleva chance de internação de crianças por infecção gastrointestinal, aponta estudo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in temperature increases the likelihood of hospitalization for children due to gastrointestinal infection, study finds.
article.articleSummary: Brazil—A national study in a climate-health dossier links El Niño–related warming to higher pediatric gastrointestinal infections and hospitalizations. An analysis of 1,814 Brazilian municipalities (covering >78% of the population, 2000–2015; Science of the Total Environment, 2022) found that a 5°C rise in daily mean temperature increased the odds of hospitalization for gastroenteritis in the next nine days by 22%, strongest for water- and food-borne infections. Infants under 1 year were most vulnerable due to dehydration risk from diarrhea and vomiting. Heat and rainfall shifts can compromise water quality and food safety, with regional impacts: drought and fire in North/Northeast/Amazon; heavy rains and floods in the South. The dossier also cites a separate analysis of 57 countries (Americas and Asia) showing El Niño/La Niña conditions linked to about 63% of interannual dengue variation (1980–2024).

triage.headline_ja: 気温上昇が小児の胃腸感染症による入院リスクを高める、研究が指摘
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動と小児胃腸感染症の関連を示す学術研究の紹介記事であり、デング熱を含む特定の急性アウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動（エルニーニョ）と胃腸感染症・デング熱の統計的関連性を示す研究報告であり、具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの発生を報じるものではない。疾患名にDengueとあるが、本文では付随的な言及に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Ebola Mystery Deepens: Swiss Diplomat's Wife is Index Patient, Switzerland Denies DRC Trip, Weighs Evacuation
article.articleSummary: Nigeria’s first Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) case, confirmed as Bundibugyo species, centers on a Swiss woman, wife of a staff member at the Abuja embassy, hospitalized in a private clinic after returning from Uganda. Nigeria reports the index patient with symptoms days after arrival; lab tests identified Bundibugyo, aligning with the ongoing outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo strain across four African countries, which has tallied more than 9,700 cases and 4,690 deaths. The patient’s husband is in isolation; 25 embassy staff are well. Nigeria has traced 44 contacts, with high‑risk individuals quarantined and broader monitoring under the NCDC’s incident management system; no evidence of community transmission yet. The infection source remains unclear: neither patient nor husband traveled to the DRC, though Uganda travel is suspected by some accounts, which Ugandan authorities dispute; Africa CDC/WHO continue movement and exposure investigations, including potential links to Kenya’s Ebola case from Entebbe on Oct 3. Switzerland weighs repatriation with strict infection control.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ出血熱の謎深まる：スイス外交官の妻が初発患者、スイスはコンゴ民主共和国への渡航を否定し退避を検討
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ出血熱症例（ブンディブギョ株）が確認され、感染経路不明のまま国際的な調査・退避検討が進んでおり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価へ進むべき。
triage.notes: 本事例の主な舞台はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）だが、進行中のブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクはDRCを含む複数国にまたがる地域的流行の一部として言及されている。ただし患者本人のDRC渡航歴は否定されており、感染経路は未確定。ウガンダ・ケニアへの言及もあるが対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue grave: estudo revela quais pacientes têm maior risco de morrer após chegar à UTI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe dengue: a study reveals which patients are at greatest risk of death after arriving at the ICU.
article.articleSummary: Severe dengue patients in Brazil who required vasopressors within the first 24 hours in the ICU had a hospital mortality of 55.4%. A study of more than 40,000 ICU admissions, using two Brazilian data sources (UTIs Brasileiras registry and DATASUS), found mortality differences: 8.2% in UTIs Brasileiras vs 18.6% in DATASUS. Age and frailty increased risk: mortality rose from 3.5% in patients ≤40 to 14.4% in >65 in UTIs Brasileiras; in DATASUS, mortality in >65 reached 30%. About 35% had at least one chronic active disease. In the first 24 hours, 5.8% needed invasive mechanical ventilation, 7.2% vasopressors, and 1.7% renal replacement therapy. Researchers from Einstein Hospital Israelita, IDOR, Epimed Solutions, UFRJ, Universidad Autónoma de Chile, and NOVA de Lisboa call for improved triage, regulation and referral to prevent late ICU arrival and worse outcomes in severe dengue.

triage.headline_ja: 重症デング熱:ICU到着後に死亡リスクが高い患者群を研究が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 新規アウトブレイクではなく既存データに基づく研究論文の紹介であり、公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要する事象ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルにおける重症デング熱患者の予後に関する研究結果の報告であり、新規の感染症発生事象ではない。チリ・ポルトガルは共同研究機関の所在地であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 6-year-old dies of cerebral malaria in Godda village
article.articleSummary: Six-year-old girl dies of cerebral malaria in Merdande village, Godda district, as seven to eight other residents reportedly test positive, prompting intensified surveillance in the remote Pahariya settlement. The child had been ill for about a week and initially sought care from an unqualified practitioner. Civil surgeon Dr Subhash Chandra Sharma said a medical team visited on Wednesday after information from Dr Sunil Kisku. The team found her seriously ill, examined her, and treated her; she initially improved. The family later stopped prescribed treatment and consulted a local practitioner on Thursday; after an injection, her condition deteriorated and she died about an hour after admission to the community health centre. Health teams are screening residents and distributing mosquito nets; others affected are stable. Sahiyas were instructed to report fever immediately to enable timely diagnosis, underscoring rapid reporting in malaria-prone areas.

triage.headline_ja: ゴッダ村で6歳児が脳マラリアで死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一村落での散発的なマラリア死亡例であり、周辺住民の一部陽性確認とサーベイランス強化が行われているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等のリスクは認められず、地域の風土病対応の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: マラリア流行地域における地域保健当局の通常対応（サーベイランス強化、蚊帳配布、発熱報告の徹底）が行われており、地方病としての管理可能な事案と判断される。続報があれば感染拡大の有無を確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: First participant vaccinated in pivotal Phase 2/3 Bundibugyo vaccine trial in DRC
article.articleSummary: First participant vaccinated in Tumaini, a pivotal Phase 2/3 adaptive trial of Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) vaccines in Bunia, DRC, on 23 October 2026, as the DRC faces the largest BDBV outbreak and the second-largest Ebola outbreak to date. The outbreak, declared 15 May 2026, has overwhelmed health systems; by 21 October 2026, 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths were confirmed in DRC. There is currently no approved BDBV vaccine. Tumaini will evaluate safety, immunogenicity, and efficacy of vaccine candidates, including Ervebo (EBOV vaccine). The trial uses ring vaccination and an adaptive platform to test several candidates in parallel, with two CEPI-funded BDBV vaccines from Moderna and Oxford/Serum Institute anticipated to enter soon. INRB and University of Antwerp co-lead; DRC Ministry of Health oversight; WHO TAG-CVP guides candidate selection; Africa CDC and CEPI provide strategic support.

triage.headline_ja: DRCで実施中の重要なBundibugyoウイルスワクチン第2/3相治験、最初の参加者にワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目に大きいエボラ(BDBV)アウトブレイクが継続中で、9,552症例・4,602死亡という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、IHR基準にも複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン治験開始のニュースだが、背景としてDRCにおける史上最大規模のBDBVアウトブレイク（9,552症例、4,602死亡、致死率約48%）が報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念が継続している。WHO、CEPI、Africa CDCなど国際機関が関与していることから国際的な注目・支援ニーズも高い。

article.articleHeadline: La Nación / Salud reporta diez semanas sin dengue, pero en tres regiones aumentan las sospechas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Nación / Health reports ten weeks without dengue, but in three regions suspicions rise.
article.articleSummary: Paraguay reports a ten-week stretch with no confirmed dengue cases, signaling a favorable epidemiological window nationwide. Despite this, the Ministry of Public Health warns that recent rainfall and climatic conditions sustain risk for Aedes aegypti breeding. The overall notification curve for suspected dengue remains flat, with a national average of 199 weekly reports; chikungunya shows no new cases. In weeks 39–41, there were no active arbovirus outbreaks or related deaths recorded. Nevertheless, authorities detect a rise in suspected notifications in Central, San Pedro, and Presidente Hayes over the last three weeks, requiring intensified environmental surveillance. Preventive measures focus on eliminating mosquito breeding sites: empty, cover, and discard containers; chlorinate pools; clean gutters; change water in animal waterers daily; keep large items indoors. Seek medical care for fever, headache, or body aches.

triage.headline_ja: ラ・ナシオン／保健省、デング熱なしの10週間を報告するも、3地域で疑い例が増加
triage.triage_reason: パラグアイでは10週間デング熱の確定症例がなく、死亡例もアウトブレイクも報告されていない。一部地域で疑い例増加があるが、既存のサーベイランス・予防対策の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生インパクトは認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippinesが含まれるが、記事内容はパラグアイ国内（Central, San Pedro, Presidente Hayes）のデング・チクングニア監視状況についてであり、フィリピンは誤検知。パラグアイは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Rio Branco está entre as capitais com alerta para casos de síndrome respiratória grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Branco is among the capitals on alert for cases of severe respiratory syndrome.
article.articleSummary: Rio Branco is among four Brazilian capitals with severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) incidence at alert, risk, or high-risk levels, but without a long-term upward trend, per Fiocruz InfoGripe for epidemiological week 41 (Oct 11–17). The other capitals in this category are Belém (PA), Brasília (DF), and Florianópolis (SC). Five capitals show SRAG with a rising trend over the past six weeks: Aracaju (SE), Cuiabá (MT), João Pessoa (PB), Palmas (TO), and Rio de Janeiro (RJ). Nationally, there is an uptick in severe cases linked to metapneumovirus, with modest growth for rhinovirus and COVID-19; severe COVID-19 remains low across the country. Children up to two years are among the most affected by SRAG, while mortality is higher in those aged 65+. Among viruses identified in positives over the last four weeks: rhinovirus 53.7%, RSV 12%, SARS-CoV-2 5.8%, influenza B 5.3%, influenza A 3.4%.

triage.headline_ja: リオ・ブランコ、重症呼吸器症候群の警戒対象州都の一つに
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の季節性呼吸器ウイルス（メタニューモウイルス、RSV、COVID-19等）によるSRAG増加の定期疫学報告であり、国際的な異常事態や渡航制限の兆候はないが、複数州都で増加傾向がみられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: Fiocruz InfoGripeによる国内サーベイランス報告。季節性呼吸器ウイルスの通常範囲内の変動とみられ、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Nigeria's Infected Patient Is Wife Of Swiss Diplomat - Report
article.articleSummary: Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria: a 42-year-old Ugandan-born woman, wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, tested positive on October 20, marking Nigeria’s first confirmed Ebola case in more than a decade. She reportedly spent about a week in a private clinic in Abuja with symptoms before diagnosis, and had returned to Abuja on October 3 after being in Uganda since September 16. Her infection source remains under investigation as authorities reconstruct movements; Ugandan officials say she traveled to eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo before Uganda, but the WHO and Africa CDC have not verified this travel. Nigeria and Africa CDC are coordinating to determine exposure and any import/export considerations. The patient remains hospitalized with improving biochemical markers; her husband, who traveled with her, is in isolation but asymptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリアの感染患者はスイス人外交官の妻だったと報道
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで10年以上ぶりとなるエボラ出血熱の確定症例が発生し、渡航歴や感染経路が不明なまま国際的拡大リスクがあるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 確定症例はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）で発生。DRCやウガンダへの渡航歴はウガンダ当局の主張のみでWHO・Africa CDCは未確認のため、DRCを発生国として確定することはできない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : la crise alimentaire s'aggrave dans les zones touchées par Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The food crisis is worsening in Ebola-affected areas.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak spreading to Nigeria compounds a food crisis in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where nearly 3.5 million people in Ebola-affected areas face IPC phase 3+ hunger. Of those directly affected, 97% require food aid. The virus disrupts markets and livelihoods, limiting access to food. The World Food Programme (WFP) has provided more than 744,000 hot meals in 59 treatment and isolation centers and distributed over 3,000 tonnes of food to patients' families; in the next six months, dry rations will reach over 500,000 relatives and contacts. A funding shortfall of $214 million threatens relief. Regionally, Nigeria reported an imported Bundibugyo case from Uganda, making it the fifth country to report cases (DRC, Uganda, France, Kenya). In the DRC, as of Oct 21, 2026, 9,704 confirmed, 4,687 deaths; eight provinces and 66 health zones affected. No vaccine specific to Bundibugyo is available.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ流行地域で食料危機が悪化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（Bundibugyo株）がDRC、ウガンダ、フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリアの5カ国に拡大し、DRCでは9,704人感染・4,687人死亡という深刻な被害に加え、食料危機も併発しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ、フランスへの感染拡大にも言及しているが、記事主題はDRCにおける食料危機とエボラ流行の複合的影響であり、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。致死率が約48%と高く、ワクチンも未確立のBundibugyo株であることから重症度・緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: САЩ затягат правилата за пътуване заради Ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States tightens travel rules due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-23, the United States tightens Ebola-related travel rules. Effective November 3, all air travelers to the United States must declare, in electronic or paper form, that they have not been in the Democratic Republic of Congo in the prior 21 days. Earlier CDC measures barred entry for travelers who had been in DRC within three weeks (May) and were extended to U.S. citizens (July). Airlines for America will brief major carriers on compliance. Earlier this year, the CDC banned foreign nationals who had been in Uganda or South Sudan in the prior three weeks. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain has spread silently for months; the outbreak was declared in May, with about 4,700 deaths in Africa and roughly 50% case fatality; no approved treatment or vaccine. CDC reports no U.S. cases linked to the outbreak yet.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の影響で渡航規則を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率約50%のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が大流行し約4700人が死亡、米国が渡航制限を強化するなど国際的な対応が進んでおり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ流行を主題とし、米国の渡航規制強化を報じている。ウガンダ・南スーダンは過去の渡航制限対象として言及されているが、現行流行の発生地域としては明記されておらず、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: dudas sobre el papel de Uganda en los casos de Kenia y Nigeria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: doubts about Uganda's role in the cases in Kenya and Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in Kenya and Nigeria heighten scrutiny on Uganda, with investigators probing whether the Kenyan and Nigerian patients met at Entebbe International Airport on Oct 3 and where exposure occurred. Nigeria reports an imported Ebola case in Abuja: a woman who recently traveled to East Africa, including Uganda; she developed symptoms Oct 7, sought care Oct 11, and laboratory tests confirmed infection, with 44 contacts identified. Uganda says there are no active confirmed cases but is under scrutiny as authorities seek location of exposure; transit through Entebbe on Oct 3 is noted, yet the exposure site remains unsettled. Swiss authorities contradict Uganda’s narrative, stating the patient and spouse did not travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo, while WHO and Africa CDC say there is no confirmed information of DRC travel. Kenya’s first Ebola case died in Nairobi on Oct 5 after traveling from DRC via Uganda; new linked infections are reported. Africa CDC plans a virtual extraordinary meeting for Oct 28; Uganda strengthens entry controls and Nigeria increases contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ケニアとナイジェリアの症例におけるウガンダの関与について疑問
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がケニア・ナイジェリアで確認され死亡例も出ており、ウガンダ経由の国境を越えた感染拡大が疑われ、Africa CDCが緊急会合を招集するなど国際的対応が進行中のため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは症例の渡航歴として言及されているが、スイス当局やWHO/Africa CDCがコンゴ渡航の事実を否定しており、感染発生国としての確証は不明瞭。慎重な取り扱いが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola duikt op in Nigeria: besmetting via luchthaven van Uganda onderzocht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola emerges in Nigeria: infection via Uganda's airport investigated.
article.articleSummary: West Africa reports a first Ebola infection in Nigeria, triggering Africa CDC investigations into importation routes. The patient, a Nigerian woman hospitalized, may have been exposed in Uganda after Uganda announced Ebola-free status following earlier outbreaks. Investigators consider a possible exposure at Entebbe International Airport, linked to a Kenyan man who traveled via Entebbe to Nairobi and later died of Ebola; both were on October 3. Nigeria is tracing at least 44 contacts and conducting genetic tests to assess linkage with other cases. Kenya reports eight more infections (four family members, four healthcare workers) with no community transmission. The Bundibugyo variant is now detected in four African countries; isolated cases in France and the Netherlands involve aid workers who had worked in eastern Congo. Congo has about 9,500 cases and 4,600 deaths since mid-May; no approved vaccine or treatment. Airports screen passengers; ministers meet next week to coordinate regional action.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、ナイジェリアで発生：ウガンダの空港経由の感染経路を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大な国際拡大事例であり、コンゴ民主共和国（対象国）で約9,500例・4,600人の死者を出す大規模流行が継続している。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・オランダにまたがる国際的なエボラ感染拡大だが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のみ。DRCでは2026年5月中旬以降約9,500症例・4,600人の死者が報告されており、流行の震源地となっている。他国（ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニア等）は対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: African Union calls for urgent action to contain Ebola outbreak across Africa
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak prompts continental response. The African Union and Africa CDC urge enhanced solidarity and coordinated action to contain the outbreak spreading across Africa. AU Commission Chair Mahmoud Ali Youssouf and Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya call for transparency, timely decisions and urgent mobilization of resources to curb transmission and strengthen public health preparedness. The outbreak has spread across three African regions with confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria; no death counts are cited in the report. Africa CDC plans an emergency ministerial meeting next Wednesday, gathering health, finance and transport ministers to bolster the continent's collective response. The article underscores continental readiness, inter-country cooperation and rapid decision-making to address ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合、アフリカ全土で拡大するエボラ出血熱の抑制に向けた緊急対応を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がコンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアの複数国に拡大し、アフリカ連合・Africa CDCが緊急閣僚級会合を招集するなど国際的関心と対応の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアでも確認例があるとされているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。死亡者数は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Wamenkes tekankan penanganan TBC harus sasar kontak erat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Health Minister emphasizes TB control must target close contacts.
article.articleSummary: In Kota Batu, East Java, Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus urged TB control efforts to target household contacts of TB patients, ensuring comprehensive medical evaluation beyond the index case. He warned that only those with active TB are treated while potential transmission among close contacts is unchecked, emphasizing early detection as crucial in Indonesia, the world's second-largest TB burden. Indonesian clinicians are deemed competent, but uniform deployment of contact tracing and screening remains needed across regions. The government has launched a free health check (CKG) program to accelerate community screening and guarantee medically guided follow-up at health facilities. Beyond TB, screenings can reveal hypertension and diabetes. Batu Mayor Nurochman highlighted that results from Batu’s One Village One Doctor program must be followed by appropriate medical intervention to safeguard public health.

triage.headline_ja: 保健副大臣、結核対策は濃厚接触者を標的とすべきと強調
triage.triage_reason: 既知の結核流行国における通常の政策・対策強化に関する報道であり、異常事態や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 政府の結核対策プログラムおよび接触者追跡強化に関する通常の政策報道であり、トリアージ対象のシグナルイベントには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Sumbawa perluas skrining TB dengan rontgen portabel di 45 desa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sumbawa Regency Government Expands TB Screening with Portable X-ray in 45 Villages.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) screening expanded in Sumbawa Regency, West Nusa Tenggara (NTB), Indonesia, using portable chest X-ray in 45 high TB-incidence villages beginning September 2026, through a collaboration between the P3PL team and Abdul Malik Fadjar Sumbawa Hospital, linked to the Free Health Check program. Aimed at populations with limited access to health facilities to accelerate identification of suspected TB, with intensified screening at all primary health centers. As of October 23, 2026, SITB data show TB service delivery reached 6,708 of 7,474 (90%), while new TB case finding was 676 of 1,384 (49%), leaving 708 cases short of target. Exceeding service targets: Lape 106%, Moyo Hilir 105%, Unter Iwes 104%; lowest: Ropang 20%, Orong Telu 28%, Tarano 30%. Hospital contributions include H.L. Manambai Abdulkadir (83 cases) and Sumbawa Besar General Hospital (74), with Abdul Malik Fadjar Sumbawa (6). The effort seeks enhanced coordination between puskesmas and hospitals for diagnostic follow-up and treatment per health standards.

triage.headline_ja: スンバワ県政府、45村でポータブルレントゲンによるTBスクリーニングを拡大
triage.triage_reason: 通常の公衆衛生プログラム（TBスクリーニング拡大）の報告であり、異常事態や緊急性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による既存の結核対策プログラムの進捗報告であり、通常業務の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Около 3,5 млн человек голодают в Демократической Республике Конго в связи с дестабилизацией ситуации из-за вируса Эбола - ООН
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Approximately 3.5 million people are starving in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to destabilization caused by the Ebola virus - UN.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 3.5 million people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are facing hunger, with food insecurity attributed in part to the rapid spread of the Ebola virus, according to the United Nations World Food Programme. The Brussels-dated report, issued on October 23, 2026, notes that Ebola-related destabilization has disrupted livelihoods and markets, worsening malnutrition and agricultural income in affected areas. The article specifies the link between the Ebola outbreak and rising hunger but does not provide Ebola case or death figures in the excerpt. The humanitarian impact underscores how infectious disease outbreaks extend beyond health, affecting food systems, access to essentials, and regional stability in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスによる情勢不安により約350万人が飢餓に直面 - 国連
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がDRCで社会的不安定化と人道危機（350万人の飢餓）を引き起こしており、公衆衛生・社会経済的影響が深刻かつ国際機関（国連）が関与しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの症例数・死亡者数を明示しておらず、感染状況の詳細が不明。ただし人道危機の規模が大きく、国連WFPが関与していることから社会的関心は高いと判断。続報でエボラの感染規模・拡大リスクの確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US to Require Ebola Travel Declarations from Air Passengers
article.articleSummary: US-bound air passengers will be required to declare whether they have visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) in the previous 21 days, under a CDC order taking effect on November 3. Declarations can be submitted digitally or on paper. The measure aims to curb spread of Ebola amid an ongoing Bundibugyo strain outbreak in Africa. In addition, the CDC has imposed restrictions on foreign nationals who have visited Uganda or South Sudan in the previous three weeks. The United States reports no cases linked to the current outbreak. The CDC will brief major US and international airlines on the new requirements and compliance procedures.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ関連で航空旅客に渡航申告を義務化へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行を受け、米国CDCが渡航申告・入国制限措置を導入するなど、国際的対応が既に発生しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行に対する米国の渡航対策であり、米国内での感染例は報告されていない。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: DRC Begins Trial Of Vaccine Candidates Against Bundibugyo Virus - CEPI - News Agency Of Nigeria
article.articleSummary: DRC launches pivotal Phase 2/3 Tumaini trial to evaluate vaccines against Bundibugyo virus, first participant vaccinated in Bunia. The study, led by INRB and the University of Antwerp with national oversight by the DRC Ministry of Health, uses an adaptive platform and ring vaccination to test multiple candidates, including Ervebo (Ebola Zaire vaccine), plus Bundibugyo-specific candidates developed by Moderna and the University of Oxford with the Serum Institute of India. CEPI states no vaccine is approved specifically for Bundibugyo virus; trial aims to assess safety, immunogenicity, and effectiveness to guide outbreak response. This comes as DRC endures what CEPI characterizes as the largest Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak and the second-largest Ebola outbreak to date. As of Oct. 21, 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths reported. The outbreak was declared May 15 and designated a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern and Africa CDC PHEIC continental security.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱: DRCがバンディブギョウウイルスに対するワクチン候補の臨床試験を開始 - CEPI - ナイジェリア通信社
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のバンディブギョウウイルス病アウトブレイク（9,552症例、4,602死亡）が継続中でWHO PHEIC及びアフリカCDC大陸公衆衛生緊急事態に指定されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるバンディブギョウウイルス病アウトブレイク（既にWHO PHEIC指定・進行中）に対するワクチン臨床試験開始のニュース。インド（Serum Institute of India）はワクチン開発パートナーとして言及されているのみで発生地域ではないため除外。既存のPHEIC事案の続報として引き続き状況を注視する必要がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: देहरादून में डेंगू और चिकनगुनिया का प्रकोप बढ़ा 18 नए मामले सामने आए
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue and chikungunya outbreak has intensified in Dehradun; 18 new cases reported.
article.articleSummary: Eight new dengue and ten new chikungunya cases reported in Dehradun district, raising totals to 356 dengue and 237 chikungunya. Among dengue patients, 167 reside in Dehradun city and 189 in other areas; 23 patients are hospitalized. Chikungunya has seen 237 cases to date. Asha workers and volunteers have surveyed 1,341,497 houses, finding larvae in 22,052. Vector-control teams inspected 8,362,652 containers, with larvae detected in 27,442. In Friday’s checks, volunteers inspected 47,844 containers, with larvae found in 26. Swine flu: two new cases; total positive 704, with 696 recovered and six currently under treatment in hospitals. The data reflect ongoing vector-borne disease transmission and the need for continued surveillance and containment measures in Dehradun as of 23 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: デヘラドゥーンでデング熱とチクングニア熱の流行が拡大、新たに18例報告
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱は地域で季節的に発生している既知の媒介感染症であり、IHR基準の複数該当や国際的拡大リスクは認められないが、症例数増加が継続しているため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 地元自治体による既存のベクターコントロール活動（家屋調査、容器検査）が実施されており、国レベルでの危機とは言えない。豚インフルエンザも軽度の継続例として言及されているが、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは評価されない。

article.articleHeadline: Londrina amplia soltura de mosquitos contra a dengue em 47 bairros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Londrina expands mosquito releases to combat dengue in 47 neighborhoods.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 22, 2026, Londrina launched a new phase of releasing Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes (Wolbitos) to curb dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The expansion covers 47 neighborhoods in Londrina and begins in Cambé, aiming to reach over 150,000 residents in Londrina and about 35,000 in Cambé over six months. Releases will occur weekly for 26 weeks at 3,890 points, supported by a production facility capable of more than one million mosquitoes per week and ovitrampas for monitoring. Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes reduce transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. In the first phase, Wolbachia is present in 85% of covered neighborhoods. Londrina’s 2026 dengue cases are 1,320 (vs 4,881 in 2025, −73%), with notifications down 50% and deaths down 78%. The program is run by Fiocruz with the Health Ministry via Wolbito do Brasil; results are also noted in Niterói, Rio de Janeiro, and planned for Foz do Iguaçu and Cascavel in Paraná.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドリーナ市、デング熱対策として47地区で蚊の放出を拡大
triage.triage_reason: 既知の対策（Wolbachia感染蚊の放出）に関する定例的な報道で、デング熱症例数は前年比大幅減少しており新規の公衆衛生上の脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介性感染症（デング・ジカ・チクングンヤ）対策プログラムの拡大を報じるもので、症例数は前年比73%減少と改善傾向。新規感染拡大や異常事態の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 'Burden and loss' builds in DR Congo, as Kenya strengthens Ebola containment
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola Bundibugjo virus disease outbreak persists with 9,765 cases and 4,727 deaths across eight provinces, latest Nord-Ubangi in the northwest. As of 23 October 2026, roughly 30,000 contacts are monitored daily over a three‑week period. WHO warns that lifting the pedal could trigger a rapid resurgence amid ongoing conflict, hunger and displacement complicating response. The World Food Programme reports a heavy burden on families while Ebola treatment centres are being built; more than 2,000 beds are available toward a 3,000-bed target, and about 2,600 people in the DRC have survived. A smaller Uganda outbreak was declared over in August, with confirmed cases in Kenya, Nigeria and France. Kenya reports its first case and fatality this month, from a Kenyan who worked in the DRC and flew home via Uganda to Nairobi; over 100 contacts identified, some with 21‑day quarantines. Authorities urge non-stigmatization and preparedness, noting late community detection (2–5 facilities visited).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で『負担と喪失』が拡大、ケニアはエボラ封じ込めを強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ・ウイルス病）流行が大規模（9,765症例、4,727死亡）かつ継続中で、ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの国際的な症例拡大が確認されているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・フランスでの症例報告があるが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの紛争・飢餓・避難民状況が対応を複雑化させている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 70 new dengue cases in Chennai takes State tally to over 25K
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Tamil Nadu rise to 25,481 this year, with 332 fresh infections reported on Thursday, including 70 in Chennai, as northeast monsoon rains heighten mosquito breeding risk. The year-to-date total climbs 3,826 from 21,655 in the first week of October. Ten dengue-related deaths have been reported as of October 22. Chennai saw a sharper September surge, recording 1,290 cases compared with 605 in August. Monsoon-driven water accumulation increases vector breeding, prompting intensified fever surveillance, medical camps, and mosquito-control operations across the state. Health Minister K G Arunraj inspected a special monsoon medical camp at SS Puram, Otteri, and urged residents to remove discarded items that collect rainwater, keep water-storage containers covered, and clear potential breeding sites. Officials warn that sustained preventive action is needed as the monsoon continues.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイで新たに70人のデング熱感染確認、州全体の累計が2万5千人超に
triage.triage_reason: タミルナドゥ州における季節性（モンスーン期）のデング熱増加であり、毎年見られる傾向で異常性・国際拡大リスクは低いが、症例数・死亡者数の増加が続いているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: インド・タミルナドゥ州（チェンナイ含む）での季節性デング熱流行。モンスーンによる蚊の繁殖増加が要因とされ、州保健当局が対策を強化中。州内対応で完結しており、国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Afrika: Noch keine Entwarnung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Africa: Still no all-clear.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Africa shows a slight downward trend in transmission per Africa CDC’s weekly briefing, but sustainability remains uncertain. A Nigeria case recently raised the number of affected countries to four; the patient, likely infected during travel in Uganda, developed symptoms after return, with about 44 contacts in quarantine and Nigeria on high alert. Uganda had 20 cases; Kenya reported its first Ebola death linked to a prior stay in Uganda. Since mid-May, total cases reached 9,735 with about 4,690 deaths across four reporting countries; the Democratic Republic of the Congo accounts for 4,687 deaths and remains the epicenter. The outbreak spans 66 health zones, 15 with no new cases in 21 days; declines noted in Bunia, Mongbwalu, Katwa, and Butembo. Security issues and strikes hinder tracing (94.7% of cases in Ituri and North Kivu); 70% face reporting delays; average four days from onset to reporting (10% 11+ days). No licensed vaccine or drug; testing continues. Two Ugandan travelers left on Oct 3, suggesting possible airport transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱：依然として終息宣言なし
triage.triage_reason: DRCを中心に4カ国（DRC、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）に拡大する大規模エボラアウトブレイクで、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアへの拡大も報告しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが依然として疫源地（死亡4,687人）であり主要な対象国として該当。空港経由の感染拡大が疑われる点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: থাইল্যান্ডে সয়েল ফিভারে ৪৫ জনের মৃত্যু, আক্রান্ত ৫৭০
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Thailand, 45 die from Seoul fever, 570 are infected.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis, also known as Seoul fever, has 570 cases and 45 deaths in northeast Thailand as of 22 October 2026 across four provinces: Buriram (245 cases, 12 deaths), Surin (139 cases, 11 deaths), Nakhon Ratchasima (136 cases, 17 deaths), and Chaiyaphum (50 cases, 5 deaths). Most affected are those 65+, followed by 55–64 and 45–54. Prolonged rain and floods raise transmission risk as people contact wet soil, mud, and contaminated water. The bacterium Burkholderia pseudomallei, native to soil and water, can enter through skin wounds, inhalation of dust, or ingestion of contaminated water or food. Farmers and flood-cleanup workers are particularly at risk. Authorities urge avoiding direct soil/water contact when possible and using protective gear—rubber boots, gloves, long trousers, waterproof clothing—plus proper wound care to prevent exposure until healed.

triage.headline_ja: タイで類鼻疽（メリオイドーシス）により45人死亡、感染570人
triage.triage_reason: タイ東北部4県で570例・45名死亡という規模の大きい類鼻疽（土壌媒介性感染症）の発生があり、洪水により曝露リスクが継続している。重症度・持続的曝露の観点でWPRO基準に該当し、当局による注意喚起（社会的関心）も確認されるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 類鼻疽（Burkholderia pseudomallei）はヒト-ヒト感染せず、土壌・水を介した感染症でタイ東北部の風土病的側面がある。洪水による曝露増加が死亡者数・感染者数の増加要因とみられる。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、規模の大きさと死亡者数から続報を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: НАН: Сенатът на Нигерия иска спешно финансиране и задължителен скрининг за Ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: NAN: The Senate of Nigeria seeks urgent funding and mandatory Ebola screening.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's Senate calls for urgent central-budget funds and mandatory Ebola screening as outbreaks persist in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and spread to other countries. The resolution urges immediate allocation from the central budget reserve to curb transmission and mandates health screening at international airports, seaports, and designated land border posts. It requires universal health declarations, temperature checks, and symptom screening for all travelers arriving from abroad, regardless of nationality or origin, with intensified checks for those who have visited or transited through affected areas in the last 21 days. Exit screening would be implemented during declared public health emergencies. The federal government should provide trained health workers, thermal cameras, PPE, and isolation facilities at border points, and ensure readiness of isolation and treatment centers in all 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory. Senate President Godswill Akpabio warned that a single case could trigger widespread transmission without timely containment.

triage.headline_ja: NAN:ナイジェリア上院、エボラ対策の緊急予算確保と義務的スクリーニングを要求
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が継続し他国への拡大が懸念されており、IHR基準の複数（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア上院の対応措置に焦点を当てているが、実際のエボラ発生国はDRC。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、予防的措置の内容のみ記録。DRCでの流行の規模・期間・地理的範囲など詳細情報は記事中に乏しく、フルRRAでの確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Le candidat vaccin contre le virus Bundibugyo administré à une première personne en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine candidate administered to the first person in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine candidate administered to the first person in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). A candidate vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a deadly Ebola virus variant, was given Friday to the inaugural participant in the DRC, with the University of Antwerp and the Antwerp Institute of Tropical Medicine (ITM) involved in the region. Several vaccine candidates are under clinical evaluation within a broad research plan; no vaccine targeting the latest Ebola variant has yet been approved. More than 4,500 deaths have occurred since May. Field response leaders say the study is a crucial step to meet urgent community needs, aiming to halt transmission and save lives while ensuring the investigation is adapted to field operations, according to Steve Ahuka-Mundeke, Ebola outbreak response Field Manager.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスワクチン候補、コンゴ民主共和国で初の被験者に投与
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）による大規模な死者（5月以降4500人超）が報告されており、新規変異株に対するワクチン未承認という異常事態かつ国際的な研究協力も行われているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ベルギー（アントワープ大学・熱帯医学研究所）は研究協力機関として言及されているが、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。死者数「4500人超（5月以降）」はエボラとしては極めて高い数値であり、文脈上ブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクの深刻さを示す可能性が高い。続報で感染拡大状況・他国への波及有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Supaul News: सुपौल : मौसम बदला तो वायरल ने पकड़ी रफ्तार, डेंगू-मलेरिया का भी खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Supaul News: Supaul: When the weather changed, the viral spread gained momentum, dengue and malaria also pose a threat.
article.articleSummary: Supaul, India faces weather-driven rise in viral illnesses as temperatures and humidity fluctuate. Viral fever, cold, and throat infections are increasing; heightened risk of mosquito-borne diseases—dengue, malaria, and chikungunya—after rains when mosquito populations surge. Dengue presents with high fever, headache, body pains, or vomiting; health officials urge early testing and treatment, not self-medication. Preventive measures include cleaning surroundings, eliminating standing water in coolers, pots, tires; use full-sleeve clothing and mosquito repellents. Dr. Raja Ram Gupta emphasizes body acclimatization to temperatures. For agriculture, farmers advised to avoid spraying during bad weather; resume when conditions clear. Nutrient management includes 30 kg nitrogen per hectare for rice; zinc sulfate spray if zinc deficiency; other crop pest controls with neem oil and appropriate drainage. Livestock should have clean drinking water; daily mineral mix; monitor weather apps Meghdoot and Damini for alerts.

triage.headline_ja: Supaulニュース：天候の変化でウイルス性疾患が急増、デング熱・マラリアのリスクも
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の気象変化に伴う一般的な注意喚起記事であり、異常な流行や重篤な集団発生の報告はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 地域の季節性予防啓発記事であり、具体的な感染者数や異常な流行拡大の報告はない。WPRO基準で一部該当するが社会的関心が低くWATCHには至らない。

article.articleHeadline: CDC châu Phi kêu gọi khẩn trương cấp kinh phí phòng chống Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC calls for urgent funding for Ebola prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC warns Ebola is spreading across borders as of Oct 22, 2026, and urges immediate disbursement of pledged funding totaling about $3 billion to bolster prevention and control. Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola case on Oct 20, linked to a woman who arrived on an international flight from Uganda, making it the fifth country affected after the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, France, and Kenya. Nigeria initially listed 44 close contacts; authorities are tracing more and isolating exposed individuals. Africa CDC data through week 23 show 9,735 confirmed cases, 4,690 deaths (case fatality rate 48.2%), and about 2,614 recoveries. Ebola is transmissible only when symptoms appear; officials call for multi-layered preparedness: strong border screening, robust surveillance, and extensive testing, plus other national pillars in countries without current outbreaks. About 35% of the roughly $3 billion pledged has been disbursed; urgent release is urged.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、エボラ対策予防のための緊急資金提供を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国を起点に国境を越えて拡大し、致死率48.2%、国際便を介したナイジェリアへの感染伝播が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国を起点とする多国感染拡大（ウガンダ、ケニア、フランス、ナイジェリア）を報告しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。資金拠出の遅れ（約35%のみ支給）が国際的な懸念材料となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Nigerian medical groups call for nationwide measures after 1st Ebola case
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-23, Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in about a decade: a woman who arrived from Uganda on Oct 3 and tested positive on Oct 20, now isolated in Abuja. Medical groups MDCAN and AMSN urge nationwide measures: activate isolation/treatment centers, strengthen surveillance and contact tracing, ensure PPE for health workers, and tighten border screening and entry-point monitoring. AMSN calls for high-alert protocols; MDCAN seeks emergency operations centers and nationwide screenings. The ongoing Africa Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus (no vaccines or treatments), is the second-largest on record, with 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths (CFR 48.3%) in the DRC. Kenya, Uganda and France have reported cases; no US cases and risk to Americans remains low. Investigations are exploring a possible interaction between Nigeria's and Kenya's cases at a Ugandan airport.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアの医療団体、初のエボラ出血熱症例確認後に全国的な対策を要求
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）がDRCで大規模流行中（約9,700症例、致死率48.3%）であり、ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・フランスへの国際的拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たしシグナルとして識別すべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの初症例だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アウトブレイクの発生源であり統計が示されているDRCのみを対象国として記載。ケニア・ウガンダ・フランス・米国も対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nigéria je v pohotovosti, ebolu do krajiny priniesli diplomati zo Švajčiarska. Po návšteve Ugandy sú v izolácii
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria is on high alert. Ebola was brought into the country by Swiss diplomats. After visiting Uganda, they are in isolation.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case in Nigeria is a Swiss woman, wife of a Swiss embassy employee in Abuja, who recently traveled from Uganda and is symptomatic and hospitalized at a private clinic in Abuja for about a week. The infection is the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, linked to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. She likely contracted the virus during a two-week-ago trip to Uganda; her husband is in isolation and asymptomatic. Nigeria identified 44 contacts. Among embassy staff, 25 individuals (8 Swiss nationals and 17 local staff) are reported to be well and not in isolation after coordination with the Nigerian health ministry and WHO. A potential repatriation of the patient to Switzerland is being considered. Authorities are tracing contacts and implementing public health precautions.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアが厳戒態勢に、スイス人外交官がエボラ出血熱を持ち込む。ウガンダ訪問後に隔離
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の国際的な越境感染事例であり、重症感染症・異常事態・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限の可能性など複数のIHR基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本事例はナイジェリア（スイス人外交官の家族）で確認され、感染源はウガンダ訪問時とされる。DRCは当該エボラ株（ブンディブギョ株）の過去の流行地として言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生国ではないため、対象国リストに該当する verified_locations は空となる。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイスはいずれも対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: 衞生防護中心：3歲男童感染甲型流感併發敗血性休克 情況危殆 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Centre for Health Protection: 3-year-old boy infected with influenza A complicated by septic shock, in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: On 23 October 2026, Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection reported one severe pediatric influenza A (H1) infection, a 3-year-old boy with pre-existing chronic conditions, now in critical condition with septic shock. The child developed fever and cough on 20 October; by 21 October he had mild dyspnea and sought care at a private clinic. On 22 October he deteriorated, presented to Tuen Mun Hospital Emergency Department, briefly lost consciousness, and was admitted to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit. Respiratory samples tested positive for influenza A (H1). Diagnoses include influenza with asthma exacerbation, acute necrotizing encephalopathy, and septic shock. He remains hospitalized in critical condition. Preliminary investigations indicate travel to the United States during the incubation period. He had not received the 2026/27 seasonal influenza vaccine. A household contact recently had mild upper respiratory symptoms and recovered. CHP continues investigations.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生防護中心：3歳男児がA型インフルエンザに感染し敗血性ショックを併発、危篤状態
triage.triage_reason: 香港で季節性インフルエンザA(H1)による重症小児例が1件報告されたが、既知の季節性株であり集団発生や異常な感染拡大は確認されていない。重症度は高いが単発事例であり続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本症例は香港衛生防護中心（CHP）が通常実施している重症インフルエンザ症例の定例報告の一環。H1亜型は季節性株であり新規変異株ではない。患児は渡米歴があるが、感染経路や二次感染の広がりは不明。ワクチン未接種であった点が重症化の一因と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Décès d'Inès, 24 ans, piquée par un moustique en Asie : qu'est-ce que l'encéphalite japonaise ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of Inès, 24, after being bitten by a mosquito in Asia: what is Japanese encephalitis?
article.articleSummary: A 24-year-old woman, Inès, died in Nice on 1 August 2026 after contracting Japanese encephalitis during a trip to Asia (Cambodia and Thailand). She was repatriated to CHU Nice in a brain-dead state following weeks of treatment in Bangkok. Japanese encephalitis is a severe viral brain infection transmitted by mosquitoes; in Asia and the Western Pacific, tens of thousands of cases occur annually, though most infections are asymptomatic. Fewer than 1% progress to acute encephalitis, with fever, headache, altered consciousness, seizures, and potential hearing or vision loss, language/memory problems, or limb weakness. Children have historically borne the heaviest burden, but unvaccinated adults, including travelers, can develop severe forms. Prevention relies on vaccination in appropriate travellers (two injections 28 days apart, completed at least four weeks before travel; accelerated 2-injection, one-week-apart scheme for imminent departures) and mosquito protection (repellents, nets, clothing, air conditioning, insecticides). Some countries require vaccination; France does not automatically. Travelers should consult health professionals before departure.

triage.headline_ja: イネスさん（24歳）、アジアで蚊に刺され死亡：日本脳炎とは何か？
triage.triage_reason: アジア渡航中に感染した日本脳炎による個別症例（渡航者の死亡）の報道であり、流行拡大や異常事態を示す情報はなく、既知の風土病に関する啓発記事の性質が強い。
triage.notes: 日本脳炎はアジア・西太平洋地域の風土病であり、本記事は個別の渡航者死亡例を基にした疾患啓発記事。カンボジアでの曝露も言及されるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。流行や異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Nigeria: onderzoek naar besmetting via Entebbe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Nigeria: Investigation into Transmission via Entebbe.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria is investigating Bundibugyo Ebola virus infection in a 42-year-old Abuja resident—the country’s first Ebola case in twelve years. The patient had been in Uganda since mid-September and flew Entebbe–Abuja on 3 October; symptoms began 7 October, and she was hospitalized 11 October with a malaria diagnosis before an Ebola test on 19 October confirmed the diagnosis on 20 October. Nigeria quarantined 44 contacts, including healthcare workers and travel companions (some reports say 46). Africa CDC is evaluating a possible link to exposure at Entebbe airport, including a Kenyan man who flew Entebbe–Nairobi on 3 October; he had worked in Congo and died in Kenya, where nine cases have been reported. Uganda says she traveled via Congo and only transited in Entebbe; there is no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. Congo’s outbreak data: 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths as of 20 Oct. RIVM says Netherlands risk is small.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでエボラ出血熱：エンテベ経由の感染について調査
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで12年ぶりのエボラ症例が確認され、ウガンダ・ケニア・コンゴを跨ぐ航空機を介した国際的な感染拡大の可能性が示唆されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生地はナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアだが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない。コンゴ（DRC）は進行中の大規模エボラ流行（9,704例・4,687死亡）の発生源として記事内で言及されており、対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Shopping Pátio Aviação recebe campanha contra a pólio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shopping Pátio Aviação Receives Campaign Against Polio.
article.articleSummary: Polio awareness campaign at Shopping Pátio Aviação in Praia Grande, Brazil, organized by the Rotary Club of Praia Grande for World Polio Eradication Day. On Saturday, Oct 24, 2026, from 10:00 to 16:00, visitors can speak with Rotary members to reinforce the importance of routine childhood vaccination and mobilize the community. Under the motto 'Eliminate polio now,' the campaign notes poliomyelitis is a viral disease that can cause permanent paralysis, and vaccination is essential to prevent infection and reduce virus circulation. The event aims to expand access to information and encourage families to keep children’s vaccinations up to date, while highlighting Rotary’s work and contributing to a worldwide public health cause.

triage.headline_ja: ショッピング・パティオ・アビアソンでポリオ撲滅キャンペーン開催
triage.triage_reason: これは実際の症例報告ではなく、世界ポリオ撲滅デーに合わせた啓発・ワクチン接種推奨イベントの告知記事であり、公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はポリオ症例の発生を報じるものではなく、ロータリークラブ主催の啓発キャンペーン告知であるため、感染症イベントとしての実体はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ministry of Health responded to tourist reports about a coronavirus outbreak in Kazakhstan
article.articleSummary: Kazakhstan reports no uncontrollable COVID-19 outbreak; weekly monitoring continues under Chief State Sanitary Doctor Resolution No. 11 (Aug 26, 2026). The Ministry of Health says the epidemiological situation is stable and COVID-19 infections are tracked alongside other respiratory diseases. Since 2026 began, 247 COVID-19 cases have been identified, compared with 942 in the same period last year. The XFG variant known as 'Stratus' remains circulating but is not newly emerged, and the ministry did not provide Stratus-specific case counts, making current prevalence unclear. Social-media reports describe rapid-onset illness with fever up to 38°C, vomiting, diarrhea, chills, or sore throat followed by cough, runny nose, phlegm, and weeks-long loss of smell; isolated hospitalizations are noted. A virologist speculates import from China. Public health guidance urges hand washing, ventilation, masking in public, avoiding crowds, and seeking care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、カザフスタンでのコロナウイルス流行に関する旅行者の報告に回答
triage.triage_reason: カザフスタン保健省は制御不能な流行を否定しており、症例数も前年同期より減少している。対象国（中国含む）での実際の発生事実は確認されず、輸入の可能性は推測に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事はカザフスタンにおけるCOVID-19（XFG/Stratus株）に関するSNS上の不安と当局の公式否定が主題。中国への言及はウイルス学者による輸入元の推測のみで、中国国内での発生事実の記述はないため対象国として検証されない。カザフスタン自体は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO investigates mystery Ebola case in Nigeria as outbreak spreads beyond DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in more than a decade: the patient, a Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, may have contracted the Bundibugyo strain while travelling in Uganda.
