The World Health Organization is evaluating a possible link to a Kenyan patient, with both individuals reportedly passing through Uganda’s Entebbe airport on 3 October; authorities caution that shared travel hubs do not confirm transmission links. Nigeria’s health minister said contact tracing is ongoing to prevent community spread. As of 23 October 2026, the outbreak has spread across Africa to DR Congo, Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria, driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. More than 9,500 infections have been reported worldwide, with nearly half of patients dying. Health experts urged faster information-sharing between countries to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCを超えて拡大するエボラ流行の中、ナイジェリアで原因不明のエボラ症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: DRC、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアの複数国にまたがるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の国際的拡大が確認され、致死率約50%、ワクチン・治療法未承認という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアにまたがるエボラ流行だが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。ナイジェリアでは10年以上ぶりのエボラ症例であり、空港を介した国際移動による伝播の可能性がWHOにより調査中。

article.articleHeadline: The Jumbophage Cocktail Fighting Superbugs and Shrimp Disease
article.articleSummary: Thai researchers at Chulalongkorn University study nucleus-forming jumbophages to combat antibiotic-resistant bacteria in humans and EMS (Early Mortality Syndrome) in shrimp. For humans, Pseudomonas aeruginosa infections are a focus, including a drug-resistant hospital case in April 2026; Thailand has not yet established a regulatory pathway for clinical phage use. A jumbophage named Churi, infecting P. aeruginosa, was found from soil beneath a Chamchuri tree and has a genome over 200,000 bp. In aquaculture, Vibrio parahaemolyticus causing EMS in shrimp near Songkhla is targeted by two jumbophages, Eric and Ariel, forming LeapMicroTech’s 3in1 Jumbophage cocktail. Field tests showed around 100,000 shrimp deaths in an untreated pond by day 29, while a phage-treated pond had no further mortality and the bacteria appeared eliminated, though controlled validation is needed. A Center for Applied Phage Science and Discovery is proposed at Chulalongkorn.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーバグとエビの病気に立ち向かうジャンボファージ・カクテル
triage.triage_reason: 研究開発に関する記事であり、ヒトにおける公衆衛生上の急性アウトブレイクではなく、エビ養殖業におけるVibrio parahaemolyticus対策技術の紹介が主題のため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（ファージ療法開発）に関する内容であり、ヒトの感染症アウトブレイクではなく、エビ養殖業における病原体（EMS/Vibrio parahaemolyticus）対策の技術紹介が中心。ヒトの症例はPseudomonas aeruginosaの単発院内感染事例であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Major Ebola vaccine trial begins in DR Congo as outbreak continues
article.articleSummary: Major Ebola vaccine trial Tumaini began Oct 23 in Bunia, Ituri Province, eastern DRC, amid the largest Bundibugyo virus outbreak on record. The Phase 2/3 adaptive platform trial will evaluate safety, immune responses and effectiveness of several vaccine candidates using a ring vaccination approach targeting contacts of confirmed cases. The first entrant is Ervebo (licensed for Zaire ebolavirus) but not proven against Bundibugyo; two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines—one by Moderna and another by University of Oxford with Serum Institute of India—are expected to join soon. The outbreak has 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths (case fatality 48.3%) as of Oct 20. WHO and regional authorities view Tumaini as crucial for proving protection against Bundibugyo and strengthening response. The DRC outbreak is the largest and deadliest Ebola event there and the second-largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa; it was declared a WHO PHEIC on May 17, and an Africa CDC PHESC.

triage.headline_ja: DRCで大規模エボラワクチン臨床試験開始、アウトブレイクは継続中
triage.triage_reason: WHO PHEIC宣言済みの過去最大級エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクであり、致死率48.3%と深刻。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州Bunia）のみが発生地として言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。本アウトブレイクは既にWHO PHEICおよびAfrica CDC PHESCとして宣言済みであり、既存のフルRRA対象である可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: अफ्रीका में बढ़ा इबोला का खतरा, पांच देशों में केस आए सामने
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola threat rises in Africa as cases emerge in five countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola threat rises in Africa as Bundibugyo Ebola virus spreads from Congo since May to Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria, and France, with Nigeria confirming a first case this month and Kenya reporting nine cases; Congo has over 9,500 infections. Reports link two Nigerian and Kenyan cases to travel at Entebbe Airport on Oct 3. A French doctor who returned from Congo in June was treated and discharged on July 4. Africa CDC notes 44 contacts in Nigeria; Kenya's cases trace to a person who traveled from Congo via Uganda. No approved vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo virus yet. Transmission occurs through contact with blood, vomit, or other bodily fluids; contaminated objects and certain funeral practices also spread infection. Wild animals, notably fruit bats, are reservoirs. Surveillance gaps, conflict, and population movement hinder containment. India had one imported case in 2014 with no local spread.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラの脅威拡大、5カ国で症例確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ発のブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスが複数国に拡大し9,500人超の感染が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ発のエボラ（ブンディブギョ種）流行がウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへ拡大したと報じているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドの2014年輸入症例は過去の事例であり現流行と無関係のため除外。主たる発生国はDRCのみ対象国リストに該当。

article.articleHeadline: Feature: Fighting fear on front lines of DR Congo's Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bunia, DR Congo — Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with fear, isolation and stigma undermining treatment. Psychologist Theophraste Tetunabu notes patients fear death and struggle with isolation from families, complicating care at treatment centers. Psychological support starts at triage by explaining procedures, addressing concerns and reinforcing care. Families worry about livelihoods and housing, while survivors face community rejection post-discharge. The outbreak has 9,704 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,687 deaths across eight provinces as of Oct. 20, according to DRC authorities, with the WHO reporting nearly 11,300 people receiving mental health and psychosocial support in treatment and transit centers during the current outbreak. Recovery emphasizes reintegration and countering discrimination; mental health equals hope, per Tetunabu.

triage.headline_ja: 特集：コンゴ民主共和国エボラ流行の最前線で恐怖と闘う
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,704例・4,687人死亡という大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続中であり、重篤性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの観点からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%と高く、8州にまたがる大規模流行。WHOによる心理社会的支援活動も継続中であり、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの継続報道として重要。

article.articleHeadline: EE.UU. exigirá una declaración por ébola para volar desde Cuba y otros países
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States will require an Ebola declaration to fly from Cuba and other countries.
article.articleSummary: CDC will require an Ebola health declaration for all passengers on international flights to the United States, including travelers from Cuba, Spain, and other countries. Effective November 3 at 11:59 p.m. EST, each traveler must attest, via a signed paper or digital form, that they have not been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) in the 21 days before boarding. Declarations can be collected by airlines through paper, digital signatures, or electronic systems and must be verified prior to boarding; exemptions may apply. The rule covers any international arrival to the US, including passengers continuing to another country and US citizens or permanent residents, with adults signing for minors and accommodations for disabilities. A stay in the DRC includes physical presence or layovers at Congolese airports; overflight alone does not count. The 21-day window reflects Ebola incubation. False declarations carry penalties; carriers must retain documentation. The measure does not create visas, required diagnostic tests, or vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、キューバなどからの飛行便搭乗にエボラ出血熱に関する申告を義務化へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱流行を背景に、米国が渡航制限的措置（健康申告義務化）を導入しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の渡航対策に関する内容だが、根本的な感染症イベントはDRCでのエボラ出血熱流行であるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。米国・スペイン・キューバは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Atwine orders stricter Ebola screening at DRC border crossings - The Observer Media Ltd
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the DRC prompts Uganda to tighten border screening at the Mpondwe-Lhubiriha crossing (Kasese district) and reinforce SOPs in public places and border communities. Health ministry permanent secretary Dr Diana Atwine criticized immigration officers for admitting Congolese nationals without proper checks; offenders face arrest and dismissal. Uganda, with no confirmed Ebola cases, remains at risk as cross-border movement continues and travelers pass through. Kenya and Nigeria reported Ebola patients who traveled via Uganda; Africa CDC says both individuals passed Entebbe International Airport on Oct 3, with investigators weighing exposure through shared equipment and no confirmed link. Uganda has established a DRC-side center where Ugandan doctors treat Congolese nationals seeking care; a one-stop meeting with 11 border districts and a DRC delegation underscored heightened vigilance. Parliament health committee chair Dr Rude Bwambale urged continued vigilance and penalties for officials enabling unsafe crossings.

triage.headline_ja: アトワイン保健事務次官、DRC国境検問所でのエボラ検疫強化を指示
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ発生がウガンダ経由でケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大を引き起こしており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生したエボラ流行とその国境管理対応。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは感染拡大先として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Africa CDCが関与しており国際支援の枠組みが既に機能している可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Lepto-causing bacteria found in Estero de Paco
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis-causing Leptospira detected throughout Estero de Paco in Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines, in five sampling sites along the waterway that serves dense, flood-prone communities near Paco Market and the Pasig River. Soil and water samples yielded 448 bacterial isolates; two strains carried the lipL32 gene associated with pathogenic Leptospira. Genetic sequencing identified these as Leptospira yasudae, a species known to infect humans and animals, marking the first Philippine sample to be sequenced for this species. Philippine strains were genetically distinct from the only other published L. yasudae genomes (Mayotte and Brazil). Researchers warn that the absence of a hotspot means a citywide, whole-waterway approach to surveillance and intervention is needed, rather than focusing on single sources. No infection counts or link to recent cases were established. Study supported by DOST; UPD-CS and Philippine Genome Center.

triage.headline_ja: パコ川（エステロ・デ・パコ）でレプトスピラ症の原因菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: マニラの水路でレプトスピラ属菌（L. yasudaeを含む）が検出されたという環境調査の報告であり、実際の感染者数や発症例との関連は確認されていないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は環境サンプリング研究の結果報告であり、ヒトの感染事例数や発症との関連は明記されていない。マニラの洪水多発地域における衛生監視の必要性を示唆する内容に留まる。ブラジル・マヨットは比較対象として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nigeria : pourquoi aucun vaccin n'est prêt contre la souche Bundibugyo ? - Amphisciences
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Nigeria: why is no vaccine ready against the Bundibugyo strain? - Amphisciences.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Vaccines Ervebo and Zabdeno-Mvabea were designed against the Zaïre species and are authorized only for Zaïre by the WHO, leaving Bundibugyo without validated protection. Monoclonal antibody treatments approved for Ebola target the Zaïre protein and are not authorized for Bundibugyo or Sudan strains. The Pasteur Institute notes there is no human data for Bundibugyo vaccine or treatment, and WHO favored a randomised ring vaccination trial rather than broad deployment. Some animal studies in eight macaques hinted at possible cross-protection via cell-mediated immunity, but sample size is tiny and not translatable to humans. Outbreak history: Bundibugyo caused previous outbreaks in Uganda (2007) and the Democratic Republic of Congo (2012) with an historical case-fatality around 25%, underscoring the need for effective countermeasures.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ出血熱：ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチンがまだ存在しない理由
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブンディブギョ株エボラに対するワクチン・治療薬の不在を論じる科学解説記事であり、現在進行中の感染拡大や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。言及されているのは2007年ウガンダ、2012年DRCの過去の流行史。
triage.notes: 見出しはナイジェリアでの発生を示唆するが、本文内容は過去のウガンダ(2007)・DRC(2012)の流行史とワクチン開発の科学的課題についての解説であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、現時点での発生国として確定できる対象国はない。

article.articleHeadline: La EMA abre la puerta a acelerar las vacunas frente al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The EMA opens the door to accelerating Ebola vaccines.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, the EMA and the African Medicines Agency (AMA), with the WHO, issued a joint guidance to accelerate development of vaccines against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, an Ebola variant driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with cases in Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria. No vaccines or treatments are yet authorized specifically for Bundibugyro, unlike Zaire ebolavirus. The guidance sets minimum requirements to start trials and suggests adaptive designs to accelerate evaluation while preserving scientific rigor and participant safety. Flexibilities include deferring certain animal toxicology studies for well-characterized platforms (e.g., mRNA and certain viral vectors) and using safety data from related vaccines, with non-human primate challenge studies still required before Phase II/III. Early trials should occur in Africa; a pivotal Phase III ring design could test multiple candidates in contacts of cases, prioritizing single-dose vaccines and including children and pregnant women after initial adult safety data. Regulators urge early collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: EMAがエボラワクチンの迅速化に道を開く
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したBundibugyoエボラウイルスの流行がウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアに拡大しており、EMA・AMA・WHOがワクチン開発加速のための共同指針を発表するなど国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高まっている。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国で発生したBundibugyoエボラウイルスの流行とそのワクチン開発加速に関する内容。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの感染拡大が記載されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospira bacteria found in Manila waterway
article.articleSummary: Leptospira bacteria carrying lipL32 were found in Estero de Paco, Manila, Philippines. Researchers from UP Diliman and the Philippine Genome Center collected soil and water samples from five sites, testing 448 isolates; there was no significant difference in presence upstream vs downstream or soil vs water. Two strains carrying lipL32 were identified as Leptospira yasudae, a species that can infect humans and animals; Philippine strains are genetically distinct from L. yasudae strains sequenced in Mayotte and Brazil. This marks the first L. yasudae genome sequence from the Philippines. A companion study reports a draft genome of L. yasudae from Philippine soil (~4.5 Mbp), the 10th L. yasudae genome sequenced worldwide. The studies did not determine human infections or link to recent leptospirosis increases. Funded by the Department of Science and Technology; UP Diliman Institute of Biology and Philippine Genome Center.

triage.headline_ja: マニラの水路でレプトスピラ菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 環境サンプルからレプトスピラ菌の新種を検出した学術研究であり、ヒト感染や症例増加との関連は確認されていないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は環境サンプルからのL. yasudae菌の新種発見を報告する学術研究であり、ヒト感染例やレプトスピラ症の発生増加とは明確に関連付けられていない。ブラジル・フランス(マヨット)は遺伝子比較対象として言及されているのみで、発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases in Aurora climb to 2,799
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Aurora province, Philippines, totals 2,799 cases as of Oct 17, 2026, up from 1,119 in the same period last year, with 8 deaths (case fatality rate 2%). The update adds 77 new cases; ages range 1 month–104 years, median 12; children aged 1–10 account for 1,174 cases (42%), with females making up 50% (1,407). Maria Aurora municipality leads with 598 cases (21% of provincial total); Dilasag records the highest attack rate at 27.8 per 1,000 population, indicating concentrated transmission in the northern town. Health officials warn ongoing transmission, particularly among children, likely due to exposure in homes and schools where daytime-biting mosquitoes are active. Prevention emphasizes the 5S strategy: search and destroy breeding sites; self-protection (nets, repellents, long sleeves); seek early medical consultation; fogging where advised; maintain hydration; and community cleanup of stagnant water to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: オーロラ州のデング熱症例数が2,799人に増加
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・オーロラ州における季節性デング熱の症例増加を報告する定例的な地域ニュースであり、国際的な異常性や渡航制限等の要素は見られないが、媒介動物を介した継続的な感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンの風土病であり、本記事は季節的な症例数増加を伝える定例報告。死亡者8人・致死率2%は一定の重症度を示すが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクを示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. to Require Ebola Health Declaration for Flights from Cuba and Other Nations
article.articleSummary: CDC will require an Ebola health declaration for international flights to the United States, effective November 3 at 11:59 p.m. EST. The declaration, signed on paper or electronically, must state the traveler has not been in the DRC in the prior 21 days. It applies to all international travelers, including from Cuba and Spain, with exemptions; it is not a visa, test, or vaccination requirement. Airlines must collect and retain declarations and ensure completion before boarding; failure to provide may block boarding unless exempt. The 21-day rule covers any presence in the DRC, including layovers at Congolese airports; overflight alone does not count. U.S. citizens and permanent residents are covered; minors require a parent or guardian to sign, and each traveler must have their own declaration. Also applies to transit through U.S. airports. Part of 2026 Ebola-related restrictions targeting DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan; Oct 11 order updated entry limits.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、キューバ等からの渡航者に対しエボラ出血熱に関する健康申告を義務化へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱流行を受け、米国が国際渡航者に健康申告を義務付けるなど渡航制限措置が取られており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱流行を背景とした米国の渡航政策（健康申告義務化）に関する内容。ウガンダ・南スーダンも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国・キューバ・スペインは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya: First group of Ebola contacts 'graduating' from quarantine
article.articleSummary: Kenya is managing its first Ebola Bundibugyo virus case. A locally infected man who had worked in the Democratic Republic of the Congo traveled to Kenya via Uganda on 3 October and died two days later. More than 100 contacts—ranging from family members to airport workers—were placed under a 21‑day quarantine. As of 23 October, the first group of contacts is nearing the end of their quarantine, with some set to be released this weekend. The situation is being overseen in coordination with Kenya's health authorities and the World Health Organization; Dr. Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo, WHO representative to Kenya, is cited in UN News coverage. The movement of the index case from DRC to Kenya marks an imported exposure; details on laboratory confirmation and transmission chains are not provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：エボラ接触者の第一陣が隔離期間を『卒業』
triage.triage_reason: DRCから渡航した感染者がケニアで死亡し、100人超の接触者が隔離されるなど、エボラの国境を越えた拡散事例であり、WHOも関与していることからフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 感染者はDRCで就労していたとされるが、記事の主題はケニアでの隔離対応であり、DRCでの発生自体についての記述はないため、DRCはverified_locationsから除外。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、該当する対象国なし。

article.articleHeadline: Escola de Saúde Pública capacita profissionais do SUS para atendimento à hanseníase
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: School of Public Health Trains SUS Professionals to Provide Leprosy Care.
article.articleSummary: On 23 October 2026, Mato Grosso Public Health School (ESP-MT) completed a service-based training in Comprehensive Care for People with Leprosy for Primary Health Care professionals in Peixoto de Azevedo. The 40-hour program trained 40 health workers from the Vale do Peixoto region, part of a rolling initiative that has already reached Água Boa, Juína and Várzea Grande and will span 32 cohorts across Mato Grosso’s 16 health regions through 2027, totaling 1,280 Primary Health Care professionals. The next regional training will occur in São Félix do Araguaia from 9 to 13 November. The itinerant program aims to bring capacity-building to workers, improving care, reducing stigma, and breaking the transmission chain. Curriculum covers leprosy diagnosis and clinical management, including neuro-dermatologic examination, simplified neurological assessment, and interprofessional primary care, strengthening the SUS response to Hansen’s disease in Mato Grosso.

triage.headline_ja: 公衆衛生学校、SUS専門職向けにハンセン病対応研修を実施
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病に関する医療従事者向け研修の実施報告であり、新規発生や異常な公衆衛生事象ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・マトグロッソ州における医療従事者向けハンセン病対応研修の実施報告であり、発生state事例や流行状況を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Paraná mantém confiança após foco da Doença de Newcastle confirmado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraná Maintains Confidence After Newcastle Disease Outbreak Confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a poultry farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil. In response, three countries suspended imports of Brazilian chicken meat: Malaysia, Mexico, and Kazakhstan. Despite the export suspensions, Paraná’s poultry industry association Sindiavipar remains confident that restrictions should not jeopardize Paraná’s exports, with measures expected to target only the outbreak area. Paraná officials emphasized that the impact on national export performance is unlikely to be material. Mexico already has an agreement to close and reopen the partnership later, suggesting a phased return of trade. The measures are expected to be region-specific and focused on the area where the outbreak was identified, and no additional details on cases or laboratory confirmation are provided. The report highlights ongoing trade frictions linked to animal disease detections, though sector leadership expects resilience.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州、ニューカッスル病の発生確認後も信頼を維持
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（ニューカッスル病）のブラジル養鶏場での発生で貿易制限（輸入停止）が発生しているが、ヒトへの健康影響はなく、IHR基準には該当しない。動物衛生・貿易影響の観点から経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 動物疾患（家禽のニューカッスル病）であり、ヒトへの感染・健康影響の報告はない。輸出停止国（マレーシア、メキシコ、カザフスタン）は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Escola do interior de SP registra mais de 70 casos de sarna e suspende aulas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: School in the interior of São Paulo reports more than 70 cases of scabies and suspends classes.
article.articleSummary: 72 scabies cases reported among students at Colégio Prefeito Walter Engrácia de Oliveira in Atibaia, interior São Paulo, with classes suspended on October 23, 2026. Municipal authorities report coordination between the Education and Health secretariats to curb transmission, alongside ongoing case monitoring. Epidemiological Surveillance and Sanitary Vigilance initiated measures, including environmental assessment, prevention guidance, and identification of new cases. The Health Department has deployed doctors and nurses to evaluate affected individuals, and Community Health Agents are conducting home visits to reinforce treatment and detect additional cases. The Sociedade Brasileira de Dermatologia notes scabies is a human parasitic infestation caused by Sarcoptes scabiei var. hominis, transmitted through prolonged direct contact or via contaminated clothing or objects.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州内陸部の学校で疥癬が70例以上報告され、授業を停止
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重篤性・国際的拡大リスクが低く、地域の公衆衛生対応で管理可能な事案であり、国際的な関心や懸念を要する基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 単一の学校内でのクラスター発生であり、地方自治体（教育・保健当局）が既に対応・監視体制を敷いている。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC calls for urgent Ebola funding as cases spread
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Africa expands across borders: 9,735 confirmed cases and 4,690 deaths (CFR 48.2%), with 2,614 recoveries. Nigeria reports its first Ebola case—a woman arriving from Uganda—flagging the fifth affected country after DRC, Uganda, France, and Kenya. Nigeria has 44 identified close contacts, with more under investigation and quarantine. The virus is only infectious when symptomatic. Africa CDC urges multi-layer detection, including strong entry screening, surveillance, and laboratory capacity to bolster preparedness. In week 23, the outbreak shows 3.2 times more cases and three times more deaths than the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak. Donors pledged about $3 billion, but only 35% has been disbursed; Africa CDC calls for urgent release of funds to accelerate ground actions and avert further spread.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、エボラ出血熱の感染拡大を受け緊急資金提供を要請
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.2%、感染者9,735人・死者4,690人という大規模流行が複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリア）に拡大しており、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性・国際拡大の複数項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ全体の流行状況を扱っており、DRC以外（ウガンダ、ケニア、フランス、ナイジェリア）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。資金不足（$3B中35%のみ配分）が対策遅延のリスク要因として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: ECDC Assesses Ebola Importation Risk in Kenya, Nigeria
article.articleSummary: On 23 October 2026, the ECDC assessed Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus imported into Kenya and Nigeria. Kenya has nine cases with one death; eight cases are linked to the index case who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo through Uganda to Kenya. Nigeria reports one case, with the infection source under investigation. The assessment finds the infection risk for Europeans living in or traveling to affected areas is low, and the risk of further transmission in Europe after an imported case is very low; the overall EU/EEA risk remains very low. Emphasizes continued preparedness: raise awareness among healthcare professionals, ensure facilities and laboratories can identify and safely manage suspected cases, and avoid travel restrictions to/from Kenya or Nigeria. ECDC has deployed experts to DRC and Uganda and coordinates with Africa CDC, WHO, EU Delegation in Nigeria, and Nigeria CDC; a practical readiness checklist is available.

triage.headline_ja: ECDC、ケニア・ナイジェリアにおけるエボラ出血熱の輸入リスクを評価
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起源とするエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダを経由しケニア・ナイジェリアへ輸入例として拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入例だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。発生源であるDRCのみを対象国として記載。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでの続報（症例数増加、二次感染の有無）を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: 'Burden and loss' builds in DR Congo, as Kenya strengthens Ebola containment - Media Monitors Network (MMN)
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak remains the epicenter, declared mid-May in eastern DRC and now spanning eight provinces, latest Nord-Ubangi. Total cases 9,765; deaths 4,727. Daily monitoring of about 30,000 contacts over a three-week period. Uganda's smaller outbreak declared over in August; cases confirmed in Kenya, Nigeria and France. WHO warns lifting containment could trigger a quick resurgence threatening country, region and world. Access challenges persist as the outbreak covers vast, hard-to-reach areas amid conflict and hunger; WFP is expanding food assistance and constructing Ebola treatment centres. In DRC, 2,000+ beds provided against a target of 3,000; 2,600 survivors to date. Kenya reports its first case and fatality this month: a Kenyan man who worked in DRC and returned to Nairobi via Uganda; >100 contacts with 21-day quarantine, some finishing Sunday. Emphasis on vigilance and preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴで『負担と損失』が増大、ケニアはエボラ封じ込めを強化 - Media Monitors Network (MMN)
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクは9,765症例・4,727死亡に達し、8州に拡大。ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの越境伝播も確認されており、WHOが再燃リスクを警告している重大事案。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスでの症例確認は対象国リスト外（ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国に含まれず、フランスは輸入症例）。主たる流行地であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。

article.articleHeadline: CDC issues new travel screening as Ebola outbreak spreads
article.articleSummary: From November 3, all passengers flying into the United States from overseas must sign an attestation stating they have not been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) epicenter in the three weeks before their flight. The paper or electronic statement must be completed; carriers must verify it or passengers will be barred, with a 42‑day record kept after arrival. The rule supplements existing restrictions: no entry for those who have been in the DRC within 21 days, plus Ebola-related entry limits for Uganda and South Sudan. As of 23 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo strain has 9,581 total confirmed cases and 4,605 deaths globally; DRC accounts for 9,552/4,602. Uganda 20/2; Kenya 8/1; France 1 imported case. Ituri and Nord-Kivu are epicenters; WHO PHEIC declared in May; no vaccine or treatment. Two American aid workers infected in the DRC, including Dr. Peter Stafford (May) and a July case, recovered; no US deaths reported.

triage.headline_ja: CDCがエボラ流行拡大を受け新たな渡航スクリーニングを発令
triage.triage_reason: WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCを中心に9,500例超・死者4,600人超に達し、ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・米国にも拡散、米国が新規渡航制限を導入するなどIHR基準を複数満たす重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: IturiとNord-Kivuは震源地としてDRC内の州であり、DRCに統合して扱った。米国・フランス・ウガンダ・ケニア・スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。PHEIC宣言済み、ワクチン・治療法なしという点も重大性を裏付ける。

article.articleHeadline: Health officials race to trace source of Nigeria's Ebola infection
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak spreads to four countries across eastern, central and western Africa, the widest geographic spread yet. Nigeria reports a travel-related infection in Abuja: a Nigerian woman who fell ill there is believed to have contracted Ebola during a two-week visit to Uganda before returning home; Nigerian authorities confirmed the case 13 days after onset. WHO and Africa's health bodies are investigating the infection's source; Uganda says she may have been in eastern Congo earlier, but details remain unconfirmed. The Nigerian case follows Kenya's first Ebola patient, who flew from Uganda's Entebbe on Oct 3 and died in Nairobi two days later; officials caution against assuming a link. Uganda has not reported cases since June; May–June outbreaks totaled about 20, many imported from Congo. The current outbreak's rare species has no approved treatment or vaccine; transmission requires symptomatic contact.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局、ナイジェリアのエボラ感染源の特定を急ぐ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国を起源として複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）に渡航関連で拡大しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアでの症例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コンゴ民主共和国は5〜6月の流行の輸入元として明示されており、実際の発生国として含めた。ウガンダ渡航者が『東コンゴにいた可能性』との記述は未確認情報のため参考情報として扱った。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Vaccine Trial Begins in Congo With Three Shots in Sight
article.articleSummary: Ebola vaccine trial begins in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the origin of the outbreak and where the vast majority of cases and deaths have occurred, as vaccines against the Ebola strain driving the epidemic across parts of Africa are tested. The pivotal study seeks a three-shot regimen and aims to assess safety and immune response in a population affected by transmission. The first participant was vaccinated Friday in Bunia, marking the start of a coordinated effort to accelerate protective immunization amid ongoing spread in the region. Researchers are evaluating dosing intervals and potential performance of vaccines in real-world conditions as cases continue to mount in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラワクチン治験開始、3回接種を視野に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ流行下、症例が増加し続けている中でワクチン治験が開始されており、公衆衛生上の重大性と国際的関心が高いためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン治験開始を報じているが、背景としてコンゴ国内でのエボラ症例増加・継続的な感染拡大が言及されており、既存流行の深刻化・国際支援（治験実施）の必要性を示す内容。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: profissionais visitam propriedades no Oeste de SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: veterinarians visit properties in western Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease is the focus of ongoing surveillance in Western Santa Catarina, Brazil, where veterinarians perform daily visits to poultry-keeping properties. Fieldwork supports monitoring farm conditions, reinforces prevention guidance, and strengthens sanitary vigilance among sites with birds. Newcastle disease is an avian illness that requires continued attention from animal health professionals in the Oeste de Santa Catarina. The reporting emphasizes poultry production, animal health, and on-farm care, with monitoring activities carried out in the western region of Santa Catarina state. The article does not provide case counts, laboratory confirmations, symptom details, infection sources, or information on imported/exported cases; instead, it highlights surveillance, preventive measures, and veterinary guidance to protect poultry health.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：獣医師らがサンタカタリーナ州西部の農場を訪問
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家禽）の疾病で、症例数や感染確認の情報もなく、日常的な監視活動に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の懸念やヒトへの影響は示されていない。
triage.notes: 動物衛生分野の日常的な監視報道であり、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生上のリスクに関する言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Proef met ebolavaccin gestart in oostelijk Congo terwijl Bundibugyo-uitbraak aanhoudt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trial of Ebola vaccine started in eastern Congo as Bundibugyo outbreak continues.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with 9,552 confirmed cases and 4,602 deaths reported as of Oct 21, and cross-border infections signaling regional spread. A vaccine trial has begun in Bunia, eastern DRC, with the first participant receiving Merck’s Ervebo dose; Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus and is being tested for Bundibugyo. Two additional experimental vaccines specifically developed for Bundibugyo— Moderna’s candidate and a University of Oxford/Serum Institute of India collaboration—are expected to join the trial within weeks. The effort is CEPI-supported, with results dependent on recruitment over the coming months. Serum Institute can rapidly scale production (over 600,000 dose-equivalents for the Oxford vaccine after material receipt). If effective, authorities may shift from ring vaccination to broader campaigns in hardest-hit areas. Bundibugyo was identified nearly twenty years ago, but resources have been limited.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が続く中、東コンゴでエボラワクチンの治験開始
triage.triage_reason: 9,552人の確定症例と4,602人の死亡、国境を越えた感染拡大が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる大規模アウトブレイクで、CEPI支援のもと複数のワクチン候補（Ervebo, Moderna, Oxford/SII）が治験段階にある。国境を越えた感染拡大が示唆されており、地域的な公衆衛生上の脅威として継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Супруга швајцарског дипломате заражена еболом у Нигерији, сумња се на боравак у Уганди
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wife of Swiss diplomat infected with Ebola in Nigeria, suspected to have stayed in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus infection in Nigeria among the wife of a Swiss diplomat stationed in Abuja. The patient, born in Uganda, is suspected to have contracted the virus during travel via Entebbe, Uganda, with authorities noting she did not travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo; Ugandan authorities had earlier suggested exposure in Congo. The World Health Organization continues investigating potential sources, including a possible link to a Kenyan case. Nigeria is conducting contact tracing and monitoring exposed individuals; the case is currently under control. The Ugandan epidemic earlier in May–June had been declared over by WHO in August, and Uganda reports no active cases, complicating pinpointing the infection source. Bundibugyo ebolavirus is a rare Ebola strain with no approved vaccine or specific treatment; transmission occurs through contact with blood and bodily fluids or contaminated materials. Cross-border information sharing and rapid contact tracing are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: スイス人外交官の妻、ナイジェリアでエボラに感染、ウガンダ滞在が疑われる
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで稀なブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス感染が確認され、国境を越えた移動歴・感染源不明という国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。ただし発生国は本システムの対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 感染が確認されたのはナイジェリア（外交官の妻）。ウガンダ・ケニアとの関連が疑われているが感染源は未特定。記事中でDRCへの渡航は否定されており、DRCは除外。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアはいずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: 142 года под носом у врачей: Бразилия обнаружила вирус, который научился скрываться от анализов
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 142 years under the doctors' noses: Brazil has discovered a virus that has learned to evade tests.
article.articleSummary: Sabia virus in Brazil has learned to evade PCR diagnostics by mutating primer-binding sites, rendering standard blood tests negative even as it causes fatal hemorrhagic disease and brain damage. Since its first detection in 1990, Sabia has mutated at primer target regions, altering the diagnostic 'lock' so old primers no longer recognize the virus. The clue came from 2019–2020 fatalities: a 52-year-old forest worker with suspected yellow fever; Sabia PCR was negative. Metagenomic sequencing at FM-USP identified Sabia in blood. Archival screening found another infection in a rural worker; the new strains were 89% identical to older versions. Genetic analysis shows Sabia circulating in Brazil for about 142 years, likely predating 1990 and possibly misattributed to other tropical fevers. Updated primers were sent to Instituto Adolfo Lutz in São Paulo; live-virus work in Brazil remains restricted by biosafety limits, with the Orion BSL-4 facility planned in Campinas by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: 142年間医者の目をくぐり抜けた：ブラジルが検査を回避する方法を学んだウイルスを発見
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「国際拡大リスク」の2項目該当。WPRO基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当。診断逃避による突発的な検出であり、出血熱と脳損傷を引き起こす致命的なウイルスの診断回避は深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: Sabiaウイルスは1990年以来既知だが、PCRプライマー結合領域の変異により診断を逃避する能力を獲得。致死的な出血熱と脳損傷を引き起こすが、標準的な血液検査ではしばしば陰性。ジェノミック解析では142年間ブラジルで循環していた可能性を示唆。BSL-4施設の制限により、ブラジルでの生きたウイルス研究は制限されている点が管理可能性の懸念となっている。

article.articleHeadline: First human infected with rare livestock pathogen: what we know about Shamonda virus
article.articleSummary: Shamonda virus, an orthobunyavirus detected in cattle in France’s rural Rhône-Alpes region, caused the first known human infection. A man in his sixties with leukemia and severe immunosuppression developed neurological symptoms (vision loss, confusion) and died on 9 October, 16 days after onset. A Eurosurveillance case report notes he likely contracted the virus via a midges bite; less likely routes—foodborne exposure, blood transfusion, or transplant—are under investigation. No evidence of human-to-human transmission exists, and the overall risk is considered low. The European livestock outbreak was first identified in July. Orthobunyaviruses lack vaccines and antivirals. Experts cite climate change, greater wildlife–livestock–human contact, and rising numbers of immunocompromised individuals as factors increasing zoonotic risk, with isolated consideration of fetal transmission in related outbreaks (Oropouche, Brazil, 2024).

triage.headline_ja: まれな家畜病原体に初めてヒト感染：シャモンダウイルスについて分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: 新規人獣共通感染症（シャモンダウイルス）の世界初のヒト感染例かつ死亡例であり、科学的・社会的関心が高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題はフランスで発生したシャモンダウイルスのヒト初感染・死亡例であり、ブラジル（オロプーシェウイルス、2024年）は胎児感染に関する比較言及に過ぎない。Bluedotの疾患タグ（Oropouche）および発生地域（Brazil, France）は記事内容と一致しない可能性が高く、対象国リストにフランスは含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Was bedeuten die neuen Ebola-Fälle in Nigeria und Kenia?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What do the new Ebola cases in Nigeria and Kenya mean?
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, Ebola cases in Nigeria and Kenya highlight cross-border risk from the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak centered in Kongo-Kinshasa. A Switzerland-born woman infected with Ebola is being treated in Nigeria after likely acquiring the infection abroad; more than 40 of her contacts are in quarantine. In Kenya, a businessman with Ebola has so far infected eight others, with more than 100 people under quarantine. The DRC outbreak center has recorded over 4,600 deaths. The Swiss government and WHO conflicting reports on whether the patient was infected in Uganda or the DRC; Uganda had not reported new cases since August, complicating transmission assessment. Preventing spread hinges on rapid detection, isolation, and contact quarantine. Ebola transmits through direct contact with body fluids, not airborne; incubation 2-21 days; symptoms include fever, headache, and vomiting; mortality around 50%, higher with limited care.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアとケニアの新たなエボラ症例は何を意味するのか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）を発生源とするエボラ流行が国境を越えてナイジェリア・ケニアに拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのコンゴ・キンシャサを中心とする流行がナイジェリア・ケニアに拡大した事例を扱っている。ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ、スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際的拡大の証拠として重要。感染経路（ウガンダ経由かDRC直接か）についてスイス政府とWHOの見解が一致しておらず、情報の不確実性が高い点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Una donna è il primo caso di Ebola in Nigeria: ipotesi contatto in aeroporto. Pregliasco: "Non è impossibile
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman is the first Ebola case in Nigeria: possible contact at the airport. Pregliasco: 'It's not impossible.'
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case: a 42-year-old Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss embassy staff member tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. She has not traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where Bundibugyo has driven a large outbreak since May; investigators are tracing her movements, and her husband is in isolation. A Uganda exposure about two weeks earlier is under consideration, though Uganda had been declared outbreak-free by late July after about twenty cases imported from DRC. Another possibility involves infection at the Uganda airport with Kenya’s first case, a 40-year-old businessman who left the same airport on Oct 3 and died in Nairobi on Oct 5. Virologist Fabrizio Pregliasco warns that tracing transmission routes is complex; Ebola spreads via infected fluids. Incubation is 2–21 days; EU risk is very low per ECDC, but surveillance and rapid diagnostics remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ出血熱症例、空港での接触が疑われる。専門家プレリアスコ氏「あり得ない話ではない」
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準中3項目（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当し、DRC由来のブンディブギョ型エボラがナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ複数国にまたがり拡大している可能性が高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダでの症例だが、これら3か国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源とされるDRCでの大規模流行（5月以降継続）が明記されているためDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。複数国にまたがるエボラ感染拡大事例として継続注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Vaccine Trial Begins in Congo With Three Shots in Sight
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-23, a pivotal Ebola vaccine trial targeting the strain driving an outbreak across parts of Africa began in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the epidemic originated and most cases and deaths have occurred. The first participant was vaccinated on Friday in Bunia, eastern Congo, with Merck & Co.'s Ervebo, which is approved to protect against a different Ebola species. Experimental alternatives include a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine developed by Moderna against Bundibugyo and another by the University of Oxford and Serum Institute of India, which could be tested in the study within weeks. The trial seeks to evaluate vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain implicated in the current crisis and highlights multiple candidates moving into human studies to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラワクチン臨床試験が開始、3種類のワクチンが候補に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクに対するワクチン臨床試験開始という重要な進展であり、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的な対応（複数の国際機関・製薬企業の関与）が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで継続中のブンディブギョ株エボラアウトブレイクに対するワクチン臨床試験開始の報道。インドはワクチン開発パートナー（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Nagaland: Private Doctors play important role on TB treatment
article.articleSummary: Dimapur records the highest number of TB cases in Nagaland as of 23 October 2026, per CMO Dr T Yetovi Tuccu at a TB sensitisation for private practitioners under NTEP at Hotel Grand Vista. About 48.2% of people seek care in the private sector; 67% of private-diagnosed cases are clinical, while 33% receive UDST within 15 days; median private-treatment cost is INR 20,000. Practitioners are urged to follow government guidelines and ensure complete treatment, with referrals to government facilities for free diagnostics, treatment, and nutritional support to prevent relapse and drug-resistant TB. The program supports TB Mukt Bharat, SDG 2030, and Jan Bhagidari, focusing on vulnerable groups and outreach across 56 blocks; Nagaland has 53 designated diagnostic centres. India reports 35-40 crore TB infections and ~28 lakh new TB cases annually; Nagaland’s TB mortality declined 18% and incidence 19% from 2015–2024.

triage.headline_ja: ナガランド:結核治療において民間医師が重要な役割を果たす
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策プログラム啓発活動に関する定例報道であり、異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容はない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ナガランド州における既存の国家結核対策プログラム（NTEP）の推進と、過去10年間の結核死亡率・罹患率の減少傾向を報告する内容であり、新規の異常発生や公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Frango/Cepea: Caso de Newcastle preocupa, mas mercado segue estável
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chicken/Cepea: Newcastle disease case worries market, but the market remains stable.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial farm in Santa Catarina raises concern in Brazil's poultry sector, but Cepea reports no impact on chicken meat prices or traded volumes. Analysts note a stable market early in the month's second half, with supply and demand in balance and no interruptions or price changes linked to the Newcastle case. Nevertheless, the sector remains wary of potential embargoes on meat, recalling last May's avian influenza outbreak in Montenegro, Rio Grande do Sul, which harmed chicken exports. As of Oct 23, 2026, there are no detected disruptions from the Newcastle case, but export risk persists for Brazilian poultry.

triage.headline_ja: 鶏肉/Cepea：ニューカッスル病の症例が懸念材料に、市場は安定を維持
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の商業養鶏場でニューカッスル病が確認されたが、人への健康影響は報告されておらず市場も安定。ただし過去の鳥インフルエンザ輸出禁輸の前例があり、今後の貿易制限リスクを注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本件はヒトの感染症ではなく家禽のニューカッスル病であり、公衆衛生上の直接的な脅威は確認されていない。ただし過去の鳥インフルエンザ流行時の輸出禁輸事例を踏まえ、貿易制限の可能性について継続観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு அதிகரிக்க த.வெ.க-வின் மெத்தனப்போக்கே காரணம்: மேயர் பிரியா சாடல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue is rising: T.V.E.K.'s Metthanappooke is the cause: Mayor Priya Sadal.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is rising in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, as Mayor Priya Sadal blames current rulers’ negligence and TVEK’s Metthanappooke for the surge. She told journalists that during the DMK government, dengue prevention relied on door-to-door campaigns in crowded areas and at every home to raise awareness. She accused the present administration of spending more time celebrating electoral success than implementing control measures, a stance she says has contributed to the outbreak. The mayor specifically named Metthanappooke of TVEK as the primary driver of the increased dengue burden. The report provides no dengue case counts, deaths, laboratory confirmations, symptom profiles, infection sources, or details on imported/exported cases. Date referenced: 23 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱増加はTVEKの怠慢が原因:プリヤ市長が非難
triage.triage_reason: チェンナイでデング熱増加が報じられているが、政治的非難が主題で症例数・死亡者数等の疫学的詳細が一切不明なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は政治的非難が主題であり、デング熱の症例数・死亡者数・検査確定数等の疫学データが全く報告されていない。毎年インドで発生する季節性デング熱の一環である可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cinco países suspendem compras de frango brasileiro após confirmação de doença em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five countries suspend Brazilian chicken purchases after confirmation of disease in Santa Catarina
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil, triggering new export restrictions from five countries. Samples collected in September, with laboratory confirmation on October 18, 2026, after surveillance identified the outbreak; 133 poultry farms across Nova Itaberaba and nearby Nova Erechim, Coronel Freitas, and Águas Frias are under monitoring. The Ministry of Agriculture implements culling, cleaning, disinfection, and ongoing surveillance. Import suspensions include Malaysia and Mexico nationwide, while Saudi Arabia, China, and Chile restrict imports to Santa Catarina-produced products. Santa Catarina accounts for over 20% of Brazil’s chicken exports; Saudi Arabia purchased about 327,800 tonnes (Jan–Sep 2026, ~8% of Brazil’s exports); Malaysia accounts for <0.5%. Authorities say products under official inspection remain safe for consumption, with ongoing negotiations to resume exports under sanitary requirements.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州での疾病確認後、5カ国がブラジル産鶏肉の購入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり、人への公衆衛生リスクはほぼない。貿易制限は発生しているが、IHR・WPRO基準における人の健康への深刻な影響や流行性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家禽のニューカッスル病による貿易制限であり、人の公衆衛生イベントではない。経済・農業分野の影響として扱うべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Bùng Phát Căn Bệnh "Sốt Đất" Tại Thái Lan: Hàng Trăm Ca Mắc Và Hàng Chục Người Tử Vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of the 'land fever' disease in Thailand: hundreds of cases and dozens of deaths
article.articleSummary: Whitmore disease, also called 'earth fever', has triggered a Northeast Thailand outbreak with 570 cases and 45 deaths reported as of 22 October 2026. Buriram leads with 245 cases and 12 deaths, followed by Surin (139 cases, 11 deaths), Nakhon Ratchasima (136 cases, 17 deaths), and Chaiyaphum (50 cases, 5 deaths). The highest incidence is among adults aged 65+, followed by 55–64 and 45–54. Burkholderia pseudomallei, the causative bacterium, thrives in moist soil and contaminated natural water; infection occurs via skin wounds from mud exposure, inhalation of contaminated dust or droplets, and consumption of unsafe water or food. Prolonged rains and flooding heighten exposure. Health authorities urge minimizing direct contact with soil and contaminated water, and outdoor workers should use PPE including high rubber boots, thick gloves, long trousers, and waterproof clothing; open wounds must be protected until healed.

triage.headline_ja: タイで『土熱病』（類鼻疽）が流行：数百人が感染、数十人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: タイ東北部で類鼻疽（メリオイドーシス）が570例・45死亡と重症度が高く、長期的な環境曝露（豪雨・洪水）が継続しているため、WPRO基準に複数該当し社会的関心も見られる。
triage.notes: 類鼻疽はタイ東北部で雨季に季節性に発生する風土病だが、今回は致死率約8%と高く、高齢者層で重症化が目立つため注視が必要。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Refuerzan prevención de contagios de enfermedades transmitidas por animales y mascotas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Step up prevention of disease transmission from animals and pets
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, health authorities in the O'Higgins region, Chile, reinforced epidemiological surveillance and vector control through a Santa Cruz technical meeting led by Health Seremi Dra. Daniela Zavando. The training, organized by the Zoonosis and Vector Control Unit with Epidemiology, focused on preventing and managing zoonoses that can transmit from animals to humans. Participants reviewed protocols for hantavirus, rabies, and management of biting animals, and emphasized active detection of Chagas disease, with input from Gemma Rojo of the University of O'Higgins. The aim is to better coordinate the regional care network and strengthen sanitary protection across communes.

triage.headline_ja: 動物やペットから感染する病気の予防を強化
triage.triage_reason: チリ・オヒギンス州での通常の予防啓発・研修活動に関する記事であり、新規症例やアウトブレイクの報告はなく、対象国（Philippines等）での発生でもないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事はチリ（対象国外）での予防研修に関する内容。発生地域にPhilippinesが含まれるが記事本文に言及なく誤付与と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Bunia: lancement officiel de l'étude clinique vaccinale de contact contre le virus Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bunia: Official Launch of the Contact Vaccination Clinical Trial Against the Ebola Virus - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-23 in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the military governor officially launched the first Congolese contact-vaccination clinical trial against Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (MVE) at the Bunia laboratory site. The study, named TUMAINI, aims to evaluate vaccine efficacy, safety, and immunogenicity, generating data to inform future prevention strategies; progression to Phase 2/3 is planned. Principal investigator Prof. Hugo Kavunga emphasized reliable data under strict ethical standards to improve public health interventions. Ituri's provincial health chief Dr. Kalume highlighted that Bundibugyo virus disease remains under high surveillance, urging adherence to protective measures, contact monitoring, and community mobilization to limit spread. The governor thanked the Republic’s government and technical/financial partners for their support as authorities continue the fight against the deadly Ebola Bundibugyo that continues to mourn families.

triage.headline_ja: ブニア:エボラウイルスに対する接触者ワクチン臨床試験が正式に開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行に対するワクチン臨床試験開始が報じられており、致死的な感染症の継続的流行と国際的支援の必要性が示唆されるためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験（TUMAINI研究）の開始に関する報道であり、現在進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行の文脈で言及されている。新規発生の確認ではなく既存流行への対応策報告のため、詳細な流行状況（症例数・死亡者数・国際拡大の有無）は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Escola do interior de SP registra mais de 70 casos de sarna e suspende aulas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: School in the interior of São Paulo records more than 70 cases of scabies and suspends classes.
article.articleSummary: Atibaia, interior of São Paulo, Brazil — 71 scabies cases linked to Escola Prefeito Walter Engrácia de Oliveira have been reported through October: 51 students and 20 teachers. Classes were suspended on Oct 23 for cleaning and disinfection. Municipal health and education authorities are coordinating a response with epidemiological surveillance, case identification, and prevention efforts; doctors and nurses have been deployed, and Community Health Agents are conducting home visits to affected families. Transmission is human-to-human, via prolonged direct skin contact or through contaminated clothing or objects; the parasite is Sarcoptes scabiei var. hominis. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat (SES-SP) was contacted for comment, with a response pending. The aim is to contain transmission and prevent new infections within the school community.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州内陸部の学校で疥癬が70例以上確認され、休校措置
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症で重篤度が低く、学校内に限定された局所的なアウトブレイクであり、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクもないため。
triage.notes: 地元の学校レベルでの対応で、自治体保健当局が既に対応を開始しており、国際的な懸念事項ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Cisjordania, Sudán, ébola, inteligencia artificial... Las noticias del viernes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Bank, Sudan, Ebola, Artificial Intelligence... Friday's news
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 9,765 confirmed cases and 4,727 deaths, expanding to a eighth province. The World Health Organization cautions that nearly half of confirmed patients have died, while about 30,000 contacts remain under daily surveillance. The response is hampered by conflict, insecurity, and a fragile health system, especially in remote areas. The World Food Programme reports it has distributed more than 3,000 tonnes of food and provided over 744,000 hot meals at treatment and isolation centers to sustain care and prevent gaps in services. To maintain humanitarian operations, the agency seeks $115 million for the next six months to fund food aid, air transport, and related activities. The WHO warns that reducing these efforts could allow the virus to spread to neighboring countries. As of 23 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ヨルダン川西岸、スーダン、エボラ出血熱、人工知能…金曜日のニュース
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが9,765例・死亡4,727例に達し8州に拡大、致死率約50%かつ近隣国への拡大懸念がWHOから示されており、国際的対応が必要な重大事案と判断される。
triage.notes: WFPが今後6か月間の人道活動継続のため1億1500万ドルの資金拠出を要請しており、資金不足が感染拡大・近隣国への波及リスクを高める可能性がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: No confirm case of bird flu in Suriname
article.articleSummary: Suriname reports no confirmed human cases of avian influenza (influenza A H5 or H5N1) as of Oct 19. Public Health Minister André Misiekaba told Parliament that poultry mortality at a farm led to confirmation of influenza A H5 in birds by the Laboratory of Public Health; whether it is H5N1 and its pathogenicity remain under investigation. Samples are being tested in the United States and Brazil, with results pending. No spread beyond the initial farm; disinfection measures were carried out; nasal and throat swabs from exposed workers are negative. Overall risk to the general population is low; well-cooked poultry and eggs remain safe; kitchen hygiene and product origin urged. Farmers should report unusual bird illness and not move or sell sick birds. Separately, Suriname has had no local malaria transmission for over five years, but imported cases average 10–15 per month, mainly from Guyana, with PAHO/ACTO collaborations to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: スリナムで鳥インフルエンザの確定症例なし
triage.triage_reason: 対象国（スリナム）はIHR対象国リストに含まれず、ヒトへの感染も確認されていないため、現時点でピックアップの必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 発生国スリナムおよび検体検査協力国の米国・ブラジルは対象国リストにスリナムが含まれず、ブラジルは検査協力のみで発生国ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。鳥インフルエンザはH5亜型確認のみでH5N1確定前、ヒト感染例なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Africa CDC assures patient confidentiality amid contact tracing
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak context: Nigeria confirms an imported Bundibugyo strain case in the Federal Capital Territory (FCT); the patient, a woman who arrived from Uganda, is in isolation at a private hospital. Africa CDC assures patient confidentiality, sharing data only with authorised investigators for contact tracing; 44 high-risk contacts identified with more to be traced. Investigators are assessing a possible link to a Kenyan case, with both individuals having transited Entebbe, Uganda on 3 October. Africa CDC and WHO bolster surveillance and preparedness, including border testing supplies near the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Separately, the DRC is experiencing a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak: 9,552 confirmed cases and 4,602 deaths as of 19 October (data up to 18 October), spanning 66 of 178 health zones across eight provinces, led by Ituri. Cross-border risk underscores need for rapid case finding, lab testing, and coordinated response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：アフリカCDC、接触者追跡における患者の機密保持を保証
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが継続中（9,552症例、4,602死亡）であり、既に他国への越境拡大（ナイジェリアへの輸入症例、ケニア関連調査）が確認されているため、IHR基準複数該当でフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダでの輸入症例・調査にも言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アウトブレイクの主体はDRCでの継続流行（8州・66保健区）である。

article.articleHeadline: DRC begins trial of vaccine candidates against Bundibugyo virus
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) begins Phase 2/3 Tumaini trial evaluating vaccine candidates against Bundibugyo virus, vaccinating the first participant in Bunia. As of Oct 21, 2026, the Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the DRC has reached 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths, with the outbreak declared a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 15. CEPI describes it as the largest Bundibugyo outbreak and the second-largest Ebola outbreak to date. The trial aims to generate safety, immunogenicity and effectiveness data to guide outbreak response, employing an adaptive platform to assess multiple candidates. The first candidate is Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine); Bundibugyo-specific vaccines from Moderna and Oxford/SII are expected to enter as available. INRB and the University of Antwerp lead the study with DRC MoH oversight; WHO prioritization guides candidate selection, incorporating a ring vaccination approach.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、ブンディブギョウイルスに対するワクチン候補の治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: WHO PHEIC宣言済みの過去最大規模のブンディブギョ（エボラ）アウトブレイクに関する続報であり、症例数・死亡者数が極めて多く公衆衛生上深刻。既にIHR基準を複数満たしており継続的なフルリスク評価対象。
triage.notes: 本件は既にWHOによりPHEICと宣言された既知の大規模アウトブレイク（史上2番目に大きいエボラ関連アウトブレイク）であり、本記事はその中でのワクチン治験開始という進展を報じるもの。継続監視・フルリスク評価の更新が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Man dies of suspected brain fever in Palakkad
article.articleSummary: A 48-year-old man, Abhilash, a native of Thenkara in Mannarkkad and employee of Mannarkkad Cooperative Bank, died on Oct 22, 2026, in a private hospital in Perinthalmanna after developing symptoms of suspected encephalitis (brain fever). He first felt unwell on Oct 21 while at work and was taken to a private hospital in Mannarkkad; as his condition worsened, he was transferred to Perinthalmanna, where he died during treatment. The illness is described as suspected encephalitis; no laboratory confirmation is reported, and no broader outbreak details are provided. This case reflects a fatal brain fever in Palakkad, Kerala, with illness onset on Oct 21 and death on Oct 22, 2026; no additional cases or public health actions are mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: パラッカドで脳炎疑いの男性が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単発の死亡例で病原体不明・検査確認なし、他症例や公衆衛生対応の報告もないため、情報不足だが経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 単一症例の報告であり、病原体・原因不明。続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna humana: como identificar e tratar a doença que suspendeu aulas em escola de Atibaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human scabies: how to identify and treat the disease that suspended classes at a school in Atibaia
article.articleSummary: 71 cases of human scabies among students and teachers at a school in Atibaia, São Paulo, Brazil, led to class suspension on 23 October 2026. The disease is caused by Sarcoptes scabiei and spreads via prolonged skin-to-skin contact or sharing contaminated clothing and objects. It affects households and schools, presenting with intense itching at night and lesions between the fingers, wrists, armpits, waist, genitals, and buttocks; crusted scabies can occur in immunosuppressed individuals. Diagnosis is clinical, based on skin examination and exposure history; cases in the same household or class support the diagnosis. Prevention relies on treating all close contacts the same day and washing or sealing items used in three days. Treatment uses two doses: permethrin lotion and oral ivermectin (not for pregnant individuals or children under 15 kg), spaced one week apart. Persistent itch may last weeks; treatment failure often reflects improper application or not treating contacts.

triage.headline_ja: 人疥癬：アチバイアの学校で授業を停止させた疾患の見分け方と治療法
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は国際的拡大や重症化のリスクが低く、局地的な学校での集団発生にとどまるため、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とは言えない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染性があるが重篤性は低く、学校単位の局地的発生であり国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria taxi driver says no health measures in place despite Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in more than a decade, with the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja confirmed as patient. Nigeria becomes the fourth African country affected by what officials describe as the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, with the patient having not traveled to the Congo. In Abuja, an airport taxi driver says no extra health measures are in place, contrasting with earlier outbreaks when masks, gloves, sanitizers, and handwashing stations were provided. The Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare urges strict compliance with approved Ebola Virus Disease entry protocols at all points of entry. The case highlights ongoing surveillance and rapid spread concerns, emphasizing border controls and public health messaging to reassure travelers and workers.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのタクシー運転手、エボラ症例確認にもかかわらず健康対策が実施されていないと証言
triage.triage_reason: 10年以上ぶりとなるナイジェリアでのエボラ症例確認であり、史上最速の拡大と報じられる複数国にまたがるアウトブレイクの一環であるため、国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクが高く、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの新規エボラ症例確認であり、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。DRC（コンゴ）は流行の発生源として言及されているが、患者本人はコンゴへの渡航歴がなく、記事の主題として直接扱われていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Africa at risk of continent-wide Ebola crisis, health chief warns
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, which began in DR Congo in May, has become a continental crisis with 4,600 deaths and cases across central and eastern Africa. Nigeria confirmed its first Bundibugyo case—a woman who traveled from Uganda and went about 10 days undiagnosed in private facilities before testing; Kenya has nine cases, and Uganda reported 20 but was declared Ebola-free in August. Health authorities warn that transmission could reach every region of Africa; border closures are not advised. Africa CDC head Jean Kaseya says a coordinated regional response is being prepared, with a plan to assign responsibilities among regional bodies and partners by a summit securing funding. Aid funding concerns persist: Africa CDC has traced about $450M of donor funds and says up to $700M reported is missing; Nigeria pledged funding and hosts an Africa CDC team. No vaccine for Bundibugyo; Ervebo is being tested and has reached 9,000 frontline workers.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ、大陸規模のエボラ危機のリスクに直面―保健当局トップが警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCから複数国に拡大し4,600人の死亡が報告されており、国際的拡大リスク・重症度・ワクチン未確立等、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアでの症例も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが発生源かつ主要な影響国として記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle mobiliza 28 equipes e leva vigilância a 352 propriedades em Santa Catarina - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease mobilizes 28 teams and expands surveillance to 352 properties in Santa Catarina - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, triggering regional surveillance. By Oct 22, 28 teams had inspected 352 properties in the area, as Mapa and Cidasc coordinate via Coezoo. Actions began Oct 20 to identify new cases, guide producers, and collect samples for laboratory analyses. Of the inspected properties, 256 are subsistence and 96 commercial. The plan covers 1,680 properties, with 166 within 3 km of the focus and 1,514 within 10 km. Among commercial sites, 68 rear chickens, 26 rear turkeys, one poultry-reproduction facility, and one rearing facility. At the infected farm, 6,526 turkeys and related materials were buried on Oct 21; disinfection continues under veterinary oversight. Four traffic checkpoints monitor and disinfect vehicles and movements of animals and materials. A 60-day zoosanitary emergency is in effect in Nova Itaberaba and the municipalities of Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病によりサンタカタリーナ州で28チームが動員、352農場に監視拡大
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家きん(七面鳥)の疾病であり人獣共通感染症としてのリスクは低いが、ブラジルは主要な鶏肉輸出国であり貿易制限につながる可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事例は家きん(七面鳥)における動物衛生上の問題であり、人の公衆衛生への直接的影響は確認されていない。ただし大規模な商業養鶏場での発生であり、ブラジルの鶏肉輸出への影響（貿易制限）の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉蔓延非洲四國 尼日利亞感染源成謎
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads to four African countries; Nigeria's infection source remains a mystery.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) has spread to four African countries—Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria—as of 23 October 2026. Nigeria reports its first case in more than a decade: a woman born in Uganda whose husband is a Swiss diplomat in Nigeria; she had not visited the DRC, and infection may have occurred during a Uganda trip, though accounts differ. Africa CDC highlights a new clue: both this Nigerian patient and a Kenyan Ebola patient left Entebbe Airport on 3 October, with unclear if contact occurred there. WHO experts urge verification of itineraries and onset timing; Dutch virologist Marion Koopmans cautions that shared airport departures do not prove airport transmission. The outbreak began in May in the DRC, then spread to Uganda and Kenya, now Nigeria. Reported cases exceed 9,500 with nearly half fatal. Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no approved vaccine or treatment, underscoring urgent information sharing and public health response to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカ4か国に拡大、ナイジェリアの感染源は謎のまま
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC・ウガンダ・ケニアに加えナイジェリアにも拡大し、国際的な感染拡大・重症度・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ対象国リストに該当。感染経路（エンテベ空港での接触可能性）については専門家間で見解が分かれており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: OPS llama a la vigilancia epidemiológica por casos de dengue y la reaparición de la transmisión de chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO calls for epidemiological surveillance for dengue cases and the re-emergence of chikungunya transmission.
article.articleSummary: PAHO calls for strengthened epidemiological, virological, and entomological surveillance as dengue cases surge and chikungunya transmission re-emerges in the Americas. In 2026, Brazil, Colombia, Mexico, Panama and Venezuela report circulation of all four dengue serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4); Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guatemala, Paraguay and Peru report three serotypes, and Cuba reports DENV-2 to DENV-4. Through mid-September, the region documented about 1.69 million suspected dengue cases, including 3,413 severe cases and 571 deaths, with a 58% decline versus 2025 but uneven trends, with increases in Andean, Central American, and Caribbean subregions. Chikungunya transmission rose from late 2025 into 2026, with 213,919 suspected cases, 78,481 confirmed and 88 deaths across 20 countries, spreading to new areas. In Panama, 2025 concluded with 40 chikungunya cases; by week 38 of 2026, seven confirmed cases (one imported). Recommendations emphasize diagnostic and vector-control capacity, primary and hospital preparedness, elimination of breeding sites, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: PAHOがデング熱症例とチクングニア熱感染再興に関する疫学的サーベイランス強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大の3基準に該当し、南米複数国での重症例・死亡例増加とチクングニア熱の新規地域への拡大がPAHOにより警告されている。
triage.notes: 記事は中南米地域全体（ブラジル、コロンビア、メキシコ、パナマ、ベネズエラ、コスタリカ、エクアドル、グアテマラ、パラグアイ、ペルー、キューバ、スペイン領カナリア諸島）のデング熱・チクングニア熱動向を扱うPAHOの地域サーベイランス報告。対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみのため、verified_locationsはブラジルに限定した。他国は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Hyderabad Scientists Discover Key Defence Mechanism That Human Cells Use To Fight Invading Viruses
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad scientists at the Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB) have identified a key defense mechanism used by human cells to fight invading viruses. Led by Dr Santosh Chauhan, the team shows that a protein called DZIP3 performs a dual role: recognizing viral genetic material and triggering the innate immune response. When viral RNA enters a cell, DZIP3 changes shape, activates, and moves to the mitochondria, stimulating immune defense proteins there. This triggers a robust response and the release of type I interferons, molecules that help prevent viral replication. The researchers experimentally demonstrated that this mechanism provides protection against several viruses, including SARS-CoV-2 (Covid-19), chikungunya, and viruses that cause encephalitis. Published in The EMBO Journal, the work offers new insights into how human cells detect infections and may inform future strategies to combat viral diseases.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバードの科学者、侵入ウイルスと戦う人間細胞の主要な防御機構を発見
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究に関する科学的発見の報告であり、実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイクに関する情報ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の疾病発生事例ではなく、CCMBによる細胞内免疫機構（DZIP3タンパク質）に関する基礎研究の学術発表。感染症のアウトブレイクやサーベイランス情報ではないため、地域の実発生とは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Africa: Africa CDC Warns Ebola at Risk of Becoming Continent-Wide Crisis
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-23, the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention director-general warned that the Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo risks becoming a continent-wide crisis. Africa CDC did not recommend border closures, arguing such measures would push people to informal routes. In parallel, Switzerland reported a Swiss national infected with Ebola is being treated in Nigeria—the first Ebola case there in more than 10 years—and authorities said the infection likely originated in Uganda. The report highlights the link between the DRC outbreak and an imported Nigerian case, emphasizing ongoing vigilance and public health coordination to prevent further spread as the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：アフリカCDC、エボラ出血熱が大陸規模の危機になるリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱がナイジェリアへの輸入症例やウガンダとの関連を伴い、アフリカCDCが大陸規模の危機拡大リスクを警告しており、国際的拡大と重大な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ナイジェリアの輸入症例やウガンダとの関連が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cai 63,9% em Vitória da Conquista enquanto casos de chikungunya aumentam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue falls 63.9% in Vitória da Conquista as Chikungunya cases rise.
article.articleSummary: Vitória da Conquista, Brazil, week 41 arbovirus bulletin (11–17 Oct 2026) shows dengue declining substantially and chikungunya rising. Dengue: 859 probable cases in weeks 1–41 of 2026, a 63.9% drop from 2,384 in the same period in 2025; 36 of 41 weeks were below 2025, though recent increases in weeks 33, 35, 36, 39 and 41 suggest intermittent transmission. Chikungunya: 94 probable cases through week 41 in 2026, up from 66 in 2025, with peaks in week 9 (13), week 36 (9), and weeks 12 and 14 (8 each). The last two weeks show a decline from 7 to 3, but no sustained trend yet. Emphasis on rapid case identification and community action to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites; prevention steps include removing standing water, covering water tanks, cleaning gutters, and proper waste disposal. Hotline: (77) 3229-3151.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィトリア・ダ・コンキスタでデング熱が63.9%減少する一方、チクングニア熱の症例は増加
triage.triage_reason: 通常の地方自治体の定期疫学速報であり、デング熱は減少傾向、チクングニア熱も小規模な増加に留まり、国際的拡大や異常事態を示す要素がない。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内の一地方都市（バイーア州ヴィトリア・ダ・コンキスタ）の週次アルボウイルス速報であり、通常の公衆衛生モニタリング活動の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: UP to draw up five-year action plan to tackle leprosy
article.articleSummary: Uttar Pradesh will draft a five-year action plan to improve early detection of leprosy, prevent transmission, reduce disabilities, and safeguard the dignity of those affected, aiming for a leprosy-free state. At a two-day conference on accelerating eradication, Health Minister of State Mayankeshwar Sharan Singh outlined ten focus areas, including identifying priority districts and blocks, training health workers, conducting regular reviews, and linking patients with essential services. Principal Secretary V Hekali Zhimomi emphasized intensified active case detection in high-burden districts and strengthening Community Health Officers and frontline workers. State Leprosy Officer Dr Jaya Dehlavi reported 91,783 new leprosy cases in 2025-26 with a treatment completion rate above 97%, and highlighted ongoing efforts to connect people with disabilities to services. The plan envisions cross-sector cooperation and a roadmap toward zero leprosy.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州、ハンセン病対策の5カ年行動計画を策定へ
triage.triage_reason: 通常の公衆衛生プログラム計画に関する行政的報道であり、異常な発生や急性的な公衆衛生リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ハンセン病は既知の慢性感染症であり、本記事は州政府による根絶計画の発表。新規症例数(91,783件)は多いが治療完了率97%以上と管理されており、緊急シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Swiss Diplomat's Wife Confirmed As Nigeria's First Ebola Case In Over A Decade
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Nigeria: A 42-year-old Ugandan-born woman, wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja, tested positive for Ebola on October 20, Nigeria’s first confirmed case in more than a decade. She returned to Nigeria on October 3 after a two-and-a-half-week visit to Uganda; infection source remains unclear. Nigeria’s Centre for Disease Control and Prevention has confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola virus; genomic sequencing is underway to assess links to other cases. Her husband is in isolation but asymptomatic; 25 embassy staff are in good health, and the embassy remains open with safety measures. Authorities are investigating possible exposure to a Kenyan man who died from Ebola after travelling through Uganda’s main airport on the same day. 44 contacts have been identified, with further tracing ongoing. Regional outbreaks include DR Congo and Kenya; WHO and Africa CDC urge vigilance and reinforced surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: スイス人外交官の妻がナイジェリアで10年以上ぶりのエボラ出血熱患者として確認される
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで10年以上ぶりとなるエボラ出血熱の確定例が発生し、感染源が不明で国際的な接触者追跡（在ウガンダ渡航歴、ケニア人感染死亡者との接触疑い）が進行中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 主要な発生国はナイジェリアだが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。記事中で「地域的な流行としてDRCおよびケニアを含む」と明記されているため、対象国であるDRCのみを関連情報として記載。渡航関連の国際拡大リスクが高く、WHO・Africa CDCも警戒を呼びかけている。

article.articleHeadline: Olatubosun-Alakija: Nigeria Already 'Behind the Curve' On Ebola, Next Two Weeks Critical
article.articleSummary: Nigeria faces potential Ebola spread after one index case; health expert Ayoade Olatubosun-Alakija warns the next two weeks will determine if the virus has spread beyond the patient. The outbreak strain is described as 48% lethal, with no vaccine or treatment available. Approximately two weeks passed between the index patient’s arrival and diagnosis, underscoring delays and the need for immediate reporting by private hospitals and clinics. Authorities diagnosed on the 20th after notification on the 19th. She calls for intensified surveillance, mass public education, and expanded contact tracing beyond direct contacts to map possible transmission chains, plus concerns about PPE for healthcare workers. Movement through communities before diagnosis could fuel spread, particularly with large gatherings ahead of political events. The DR Congo example is cited—nearly 10,000 cases and around 4,500–4,600 deaths—as a cautionary benchmark. The next two weeks are critical for containment.

triage.headline_ja: オラトゥボスン・アラキジャ氏:ナイジェリアはすでにエボラ対応で『後手に回っている』、今後2週間が重要
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでエボラの指標症例が確認され、診断までに約2週間の遅延があったこと、致死率48%で治療薬・ワクチンがないこと、大規模集会を控えた地域社会内での拡大リスクが専門家により強く警告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでのエボラ発生であり、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは比較対象（過去の大規模流行例）として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Escola do interior de SP registra mais de 70 casos de sarna e suspende aula | Portal Band
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: School in the interior of São Paulo records more than 70 cases of scabies and suspends classes | Portal Band
article.articleSummary: Atibaia, interior São Paulo, Brazil: 71 scabies cases were reported in October at Escola Prefeito Walter Engrácia de Oliveira, prompting the suspension of classes on 23 October for cleaning and disinfection. Of the cases, 51 involve students and 20 involve teachers. SES-SP had not yet commented at publication. Municipal authorities say Education and Health secretariats are coordinating to curb transmission; infected individuals are monitored and health teams are identifying new cases. Epidemiological Surveillance and Sanitary Surveillance are evaluating school conditions and guiding prevention measures. Officials reinforced hygiene in the premises, handwashing, and announced expanded care with doctors and nurses to assess cases. Community Health Agents are visiting households to identify new infections and advise on treatment. Scabies is a parasitic skin disease caused by Sarcoptes scabiei variety hominis, with intense itching and skin lesions, transmitted mainly by prolonged close contact and sharing contaminated items; treatment and hygiene are essential.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州内陸部の学校で疥癬70件以上を確認、授業を休止 | Portal Band
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は国際的に懸念される重篤な疾患ではなく、単一校内での局地的な発生に留まり、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに該当しないため。
triage.notes: 疥癬は近接接触で感染しやすいが重症度は低く、地元保健当局のみで対応可能な局地的事例。

article.articleHeadline: Woman with Ebola in Nigeria confirmed as wife of Swiss diplomat
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Nigeria: 42-year-old Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja tested positive on Oct 20, the first Nigerian Ebola case since before 2016. She returned to Abuja on Oct 3 after a 2.5-week Uganda visit; symptoms began four days later and she spent about a week at a private clinic before diagnosis. She is in isolation and reportedly improving; the Swiss embassy of 25 staff remains open. The infection source remains unknown; conflicting accounts suggested DR Congo exposure, but Swiss authorities and WHO have no verified evidence of travel to DR Congo. Investigators are examining a possible link to a Kenyan man who died after traveling from DR Congo through Entebbe on Oct 3; Kenya has nine linked cases. Nigerian authorities are tracing contacts beyond 44 identified, with genomic sequencing prioritized to establish connections to regional outbreaks. Border screening challenges and calls for regional vigilance are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ感染女性、スイス人外交官の妻と確認
