triage.triage_reason: 2016年以前以来となるナイジェリアでのエボラ確認例であり、ウガンダ・ケニア・DRCにまたがる感染源調査が進行中で国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 感染源はDRC経由の疑いがあるが、スイス当局・WHOはDRC渡航の確証がないとしており、確定情報ではないため対象国リストには含めなかった。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リスト外。続報で感染源国が確定次第、再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Com ebola avançando para a Nigéria, OMS recomenda preparação redobrada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With Ebola advancing toward Nigeria, WHO recommends redoubled preparedness.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, originating in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has crossed borders to Nigeria and Kenya, marking the fastest-spreading outbreak on record with 9,765 infections and 4,727 deaths over nearly six months. Transmission has reached an eighth Congolese province near the Central African Republic border. About 30,000 contacts are monitored daily to interrupt spread. Nigeria confirmed its first case in a woman who traveled from Uganda via Abuja, triggering rapid contact tracing. Kenya reports cases including a related fatality and enforces strict quarantine and surveillance. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and urges intensified preparedness and surveillance in more than 20 countries across Africa and the Middle East. Over 2,600 survivors remain under medical and psychosocial care amid conflict and displacement complicating response as of 2026-10-23.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱がナイジェリアへ拡大、WHOが対策強化を勧告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言し、コンゴ民主共和国発生のエボラ出血熱がナイジェリア・ケニアへ越境拡大、過去最速の流行となっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCを起点とするエボラ流行がナイジェリア・ケニア・中央アフリカ共和国・ウガンダへ拡大したことを報じているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア・ケニア・CAR・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola s'étend sur une huitième des 26 provinces de la RDC, selon l'ONU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading to one-eighth of the DRC's 26 provinces, according to the UN.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading to about one-eighth of the Democratic Republic of the Congo's 26 provinces, per the United Nations. In affected areas, nearly 3.5 million people face acute food insecurity (IPC phase 3 or higher). Among those directly affected by Ebola, 97% still require food assistance, according to the World Food Programme (WFP). The WFP is requesting USD 214 million for the next six months, including USD 78.6 million for hot meals and dry rations for those directly affected and their families. Previously delivered: over 744,000 hot meals and more than 3,000 tonnes of food. The outbreak began in April 2026. No vaccine or treatment is approved for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、国連報告によればコンゴ民主共和国26州のうち8分の1に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの複数州に拡大し、ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株であり、国際的な人道支援要請（WFPによる2億1400万ドル）もなされており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 2026年4月発生のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がDRC内の複数州に拡大し続けており、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認。食料不安も深刻で国際支援の必要性が高い。フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Pune: Dengue Cases Rise In Pimpri, 203 Infections Reported From January To October 21, Including 81 This Month
article.articleSummary: Pune’s Pimpri area recorded 203 dengue infections from January through October 21, 2026, with 81 cases in October alone (up from 70 in September). NVBDCP monthly data show 5,075 suspected dengue cases examined, of which 203 were confirmed. Across malaria, chikungunya and Zika in 2026, 3,82,010 fever suspects were tested for malaria and 41 were positive; 20 suspected chikungunya cases were reported with none confirmed; no suspected or confirmed Zika cases. Dengue rose steadily since June 2026—2 cases in June, 13 in July, 37 in August, 70 in September, and 81 by October 21—prompting calls for stronger preventive actions. Authorities urge eliminating mosquito breeding sites: avoid water accumulation in flowerpots, containers, tyres and other outdoor items; keep water storage covered and surroundings clean. Seek medical testing if fever develops; Aedes transmits dengue and chikungunya, while malaria is spread by Anopheles.

triage.headline_ja: プネー:ピンプリ地区でデング熱症例が増加、1月から10月21日までに203件の感染、うち今月だけで81件
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱症例増加を報告する定例サーベイランス記事であり、死亡や重症例の報告はなく国際的拡大の兆候もないが、症例数が継続的に増加している点は注視が必要。
triage.notes: NVBDCP（国家ベクター媒介疾患対策プログラム）による月次データに基づく定例報告。6月の2件から10月21日時点の81件へと着実に増加しているが、死亡・重症例の言及はなく、マラリア・チクングニア・ジカの確定例もほぼ無い。地域限定の季節性増加であり、現時点でフルリスク評価が必要な緊急性は低いが、増加傾向の継続有無を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-mysterium vokser
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola Mystery Grows
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in more than a decade, a Ugandan-born woman in Abuja married to a Swiss diplomat. Authorities have not confirmed the exact infection source. Swiss authorities say she has not been to DR Congo, where the outbreak began in May, and suggest she may have contracted the virus during a Ugandan travel with her husband; Ugandan officials had earlier indicated she had visited eastern DR Congo. The WHO is investigating the likely source. The case increases concern as Nigeria becomes the fourth African country affected by the outbreak after DR Congo, Uganda, and Kenya. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Since May 15, the outbreak has infected over 9,500 people with nearly 4,750 deaths. Nigerian authorities say the case is currently contained, with contact tracing underway; both individuals left Entebbe Airport on Oct 3.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの謎が深まる
triage.triage_reason: DRC発の大規模エボラ流行（感染者9,500人超、死者4,750人近く）がナイジェリアにも拡大し、感染経路が特定できていないため国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは本流行の発生源として記事内で明確に言及されているため含めた。承認された治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないBundibugyo株による流行であり、感染経路不明の症例確認は国際的懸念を高める要因。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Enforces Strict Ebola Border Screening Amid DRC Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uganda has intensified Ebola border screening after a neighboring outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Health ministry permanent secretary Dr Diana Atwine ordered heightened screening at all border crossings and strict enforcement of standard operating procedures in border communities and public spaces. At Mpondwe-Lhubiriha border, she rebuked immigration officers for allowing Congolese nationals to enter Uganda without health checks and warned that officials who facilitate unauthorized entries would face arrest and dismissal. Uganda reports no confirmed Ebola cases but remains on high alert as investigators review whether exposure occurred in transit after recent Ebola patients in Kenya and Nigeria passed through Entebbe International Airport on October 3. Local leaders support the response; Ugandan medical teams are assisting Congolese nationals at a center across the border. The response involves eleven border districts and a DRC delegation.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行を受けて国境検疫を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクに加え、ケニア・ナイジェリアでも患者が報告され国境を越えた拡大の兆候があり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生したエボラアウトブレイクへのウガンダの国境対応。ケニア・ナイジェリアでの患者通過情報も含まれるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ウガンダ国内に確定症例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Was The Nairobi Ebola Case A Superspreader?
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, Kenya’s first Ebola case, a 40-year-old man who had lived in Congo for seven years, died in Nairobi after traveling from northern Congo through Uganda. He left Buta, passed Kisangani and Beni, crossed into Uganda by road, then flew to Nairobi on October 3; medicine he was taking masked his symptoms, allowing him to pass airport scanners, and he died two days later. Eight relatives and health workers who treated him have tested positive, all already in quarantine at diagnosis. Kenya’s health ministry has traced 134 of 135 known contacts, with no further transmission so far; healthy contacts will be released from quarantine starting October 25. The eight infections suggest a superspreader event, illustrating overdispersion in Ebola transmission. Control depends on denying settings—funerals, crowded clinics, households—where superspreading concentrates, especially with imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ナイロビのエボラ症例はスーパースプレッダーだったのか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ患者がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し、死亡及び8名の二次感染（医療従事者・家族）を引き起こした国際的拡大事例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ（Buta, Kisangani, Beni経由）からウガンダを陸路で通過し、ナイロビへ空路入国。感染源はDRCの進行中のエボラ流行であり、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの流行状況・感染経路の詳細についてWHO/CDC等の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Сенатът на Нигерия иска спешно финансиране и задължителен скрининг за Ебола | Новини.бг
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Nigerian Senate seeks urgent funding and mandatory screening for Ebola | News.bg
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-23, the Nigerian Senate urged the federal government to allocate emergency funds from the central budget reserve to combat Ebola and prevent its further spread. The resolution, adopted after discussions on rapid measures, calls for mandatory health screening at Nigeria’s international airports, seaports, and designated land borders, including health declarations, temperature checks, and symptom screening for all travelers arriving from abroad, regardless of nationality. It also advocates enhanced screening for passengers who have visited or transited through affected areas in the last 21 days, and exit checks during declared public health emergencies. The Senate urges training of health workers and provision of thermographic cameras, personal protective equipment, and isolation facilities at border points. The outbreak context cited is Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo with spread to other countries.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア上院、エボラ対策のための緊急資金調達と義務的スクリーニングを要求
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱の発生が他国への拡大を伴っており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア上院によるエボラ対策（空港・港湾での義務的スクリーニング強化、緊急資金要求）に関するものであり、ナイジェリア国内での実際の感染事例は記載されていない。発生地域はあくまでDRCであり、Nigeriaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nebulização contra a dengue no Jardim Brasil é reagendada para a próxima semana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nebulization Against Dengue in Jardim Brasil Has Been Rescheduled for Next Week
article.articleSummary: Dengue control activity in Jardim Brasil, Botucatu, Brazil, has been rescheduled to Monday 26th and Tuesday 27th, starting at 8:30 a.m., by Environmental Health Surveillance (VAS). The nebulization targets Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, vectors of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. The 22–23 dates were canceled due to unstable weather; rain and strong winds could compromise insecticide efficacy. If conditions remain unfavorable, the operation may be postponed again. Residents should prepare by opening doors and windows to aid spray reach, covering food and utensils, and managing pets by removing water and food and keeping them outside during application. After spraying, wait at least 30 minutes before re-entering; for homes with residents or unmovable pets, keep them in a closed room during and for 30 minutes after. Despite reductions in dengue cases in Botucatu in 2026, the mosquito persists, with 85% of breeding sites indoors, underscoring ongoing control and resident vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: ジャルジン・ブラジルでのデング熱対策噴霧、来週に延期
triage.triage_reason: 日常的な蚊媒介病対策活動（噴霧スケジュール変更）の報道であり、異常な感染拡大や重症例の報告はなく、2026年はデング症例が減少傾向との記載もある。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体の定期的な蚊駆除スケジュール変更に関する地域報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Adapar reforça ações de vigilância sanitária na Avicultura após confirmação de foco de Doença de New Castle em Santa Catarina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Adapar Reinforces Sanitary Surveillance Actions in Poultry Farming After Confirmation of a Newcastle Disease Outbreak in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed in a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberá, Santa Catarina; Paraná's Adapar intensifies sanitary surveillance statewide to prevent introduction and spread. Paraná reports no detections of Newcastle disease or Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (IAAP) to date. Live-bird transit controls are reinforced at borders and inland, with verification of sanitary documentation, origin/destination, transport requirements, and vehicle disinfection. Veterinary teams inspect properties and monitor flock health, investigating suspicions promptly. Paraná, the largest Brazilian producer/exporter of chicken meat (roughly 35% of national production), produced about 5 million tons in 2025 and exported 2.05 million tons (US$3.53B), reaching 150 markets with major buyers including UAE, China, Mexico, Japan, and Saudi Arabia. The state maintains ongoing surveillance for IAAP and Newcastle; recent cycles were negative. Producers are urged to bolster biosafety, keep poultry housing well-maintained and sealed, restrict access, ensure water quality, and prevent contact with wild birds.

triage.headline_ja: アダパル、サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生確認を受け、養鶏業における衛生監視活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家きん（七面鳥）に限定された動物疾病であり、人への感染や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。パラナ州では未検出で、輸出関連の予防的な監視強化にとどまる。
triage.notes: 本件はブラジル国内（サンタカタリーナ州）の家きん疾病事例であり、人への感染報告はない。日本・中国・サウジアラビア・UAE・メキシコは輸出先として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Adapi alerta criadores de aves no Piauí sobre risco da doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ADAPI alerts poultry farmers in Piauí about the risk of Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease alert issued by Brazil's Piauí's Agência de Defesa Agropecuária (Adapi) warns poultry producers of an avian viral infection with mortality risk. Following a confirmed outbreak in Santa Catarina on October 18, the focus covers about 6,000 turkeys across 133 farms. In Piauí, Adapi intensifies guidance and sanitary vigilance to prevent further cases. Key signs include sudden deaths, sneezing, breathing difficulty, twisted neck, tremors, circling, greenish diarrhea, paralysis of wings and legs, and reduced feed and water intake. Producers are advised to keep housing clean, control access of people and vehicles, use appropriate equipment, and avoid contact with unknown animals. Recommendations also call for sourcing chicks from registered incubators and proper husbandry. Farmers should report unusual bird behavior or deaths immediately via WhatsApp at (86) 99462-1644, the e-Sisbravet system, or in person at the agency office.

triage.headline_ja: ADAPI、ピアウイ州の養鶏農家にニューカッスル病のリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（ニューカッスル病）であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は限定的だが、家禽産業への影響と拡散可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物感染症であり、ヒト感染症ではない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれているが、人獣共通感染症ではなく主にヒト向けのEBS対象外事案である可能性が高い。発生地域はサンタカタリーナ州・ピアウイ州でブラジル国内。

article.articleHeadline: ДР Конго: для борьбы с Эболой срочно требуются дополнительные ресурсы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Urgently Needed Additional Resources to Fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with urgent calls for additional resources. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, began in mid-May and now spans eight provinces, the latest North Ubangi in the northwest. The country has recorded 9,765 cases and 4,727 deaths, and about 30,000 contacts remain under daily observation. A smaller Ebola outbreak in Uganda ended in August; confirmed cases have also been reported in Kenya, Nigeria, and France. The crisis unfolds across vast, hard-to-reach terrain amid conflict, hunger, and displacement, where some communities require days to access care by boat or motorcycle. The WFP is delivering food aid and supporting treatment centers and other response measures. WHO urges more resources: a target of 3,000 treatment beds, with over 2,000 already available, and 2,600 survivors receiving follow-up care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ対策に追加資源が緊急に必要
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が8州に拡大し、死者数が多数（致死率約48%）で、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの波及が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内の流行が主体であり、医療資源不足・紛争・アクセス困難な地理条件が感染拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Igrejinha terá mutirão de combate ao mosquito da dengue neste final de semana | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Igrejinha will host a dengue-carrying mosquito control drive this weekend | abc+.
article.articleSummary: Igrejinha will host a weekend campaign to combat Aedes aegypti, the dengue, chikungunya, and Zika mosquito, on Saturday, October 24 and Sunday, October 25, 2026. The municipal Health Department, in partnership with the Works Department, will run Projeto Desapega to collect discarded items that can accumulate rainwater—tires, bottles, buckets, cans, pots, and other plastic containers—to eliminate breeding sites. The action uses Ovitrampas monitoring to identify neighborhoods with higher mosquito infestation and targets the areas accordingly; officials say it helps maintain a low incidence of new dengue cases. In 2026, Igrejinha has recorded 10 dengue cases, down from 16 in 2025. Community support fuels the effort, complemented by year-round work of Endemic Disease Control Agents during home visits, guidance, enforcement, and monitoring. Preventive measures include covering water tanks, cleaning gutters, changing plant-vase water, and storing containers upside down.

triage.headline_ja: イグレジーニャで今週末、デング熱媒介蚊対策の集中活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の蚊媒介対策キャンペーンであり、症例数も前年より減少しているため、公衆衛生上の深刻な異常事態とは言えない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定例的な蚊媒介対策活動の広報記事であり、症例数も減少傾向にあるためシグナルとしての価値は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Cabo Verde vai reativar plataforma para monitorizar entradas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Cape Verde will reactivate platform to monitor arrivals.
article.articleSummary: Cape Verde will reactivate a platform used during the COVID-19 pandemic to monitor airport arrivals after Nigeria reported its first Ebola case, announced by National Health Director Ana Paula Santos. The system will include a pre-entry questionnaire and bolster surveillance at entry points, with staff trained to recognize Ebola symptoms. Despite WHO designating Cape Verde as low risk, authorities will reinforce risk communication and laboratory capacity, alongside the Pasteur Institute of Dakar as the reference lab. In Nigeria, a diplomat who arrived in Abuja on a flight from Uganda was confirmed infected, with 44 contacts identified. The case marks the fourth African country this year to be affected by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, which has been present in the Democratic Republic of Congo for five months. The DRC has 9,704 cases and at least 4,687 deaths; Uganda had 20 cases and two deaths before declaring transmission eradicated at end-August; Kenya has nine cases. Africa CDC warned of an extremely grave threat and urged international mobilization.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：カーボベルデが入国監視プラットフォームを再稼働へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5か月にわたりブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスが流行し9,704例・4,687死亡に達し、ナイジェリアなど複数のアフリカ諸国に拡大。Africa CDCが国際的な動員を要請するなど公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC発のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行が主題で、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・カーボベルデ・セネガルも言及されるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarna fecham escola municipal e mobilizam saúde em Atibaia | Portal Band
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of scabies shut down a municipal school and mobilize health services in Atibaia
article.articleSummary: On 23 October 2026, Escola Municipal Prefeito Walter Engrácia de Oliveira in Jardim Cerejeiras, Atibaia, São Paulo, suspended activities after identifying human scabies cases. Municipal Health and Education secretariats monitor the health status of 51 students and 20 teachers diagnosed or under suspicion. The building's temporary closure enables a cleaning drive, disinfection of facilities, and laundering of clothes and shared materials used at the school. Affected families receive technical guidance on treatment and measures to interrupt the transmission chain. The report does not specify laboratory confirmation details. The response prioritizes containment within the school setting to prevent further spread to households and the broader community.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬の症例により公立学校が閉鎖、アチバイアで保健当局が対応に乗り出す
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は局地的な学校内アウトブレイクであり、国際的拡大リスクや重篤性は低く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず社会的関心も限定的と判断される。
triage.notes: 疥癬はヒト-ヒト接触で広がる慢性皮膚疾患であり、重篤性・致死性は低い。地元保健当局・教育当局のみで対応可能な事例。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le premier participant à l'essai clinique "Tumaini" est vacciné contre le virus Bundibugyo à Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the first participant in the clinical trial "Tumaini" is vaccinated against Bundibugyo virus in Bunia.
article.articleSummary: First participant vaccinated in Bunia, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, under the Tumaini trial evaluating vaccines against Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), which drives a form of Ebola. The phase 2/3 study responds to a major BDBV outbreak declared May 15, 2026; by October 21, 2026, the country reported 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths. No BDBV-specific vaccine is approved. Tumaini uses an adaptive platform to test several candidates within one protocol and applies ring vaccination to immunize contacts and exposed individuals. The initial vaccine integrated is Ervebo, approved for Zaire EBOV. Two additional BDBV candidates—developed by Moderna and by the University of Oxford (with the Serum Institute of India)—are expected to join soon. CEPI funds the effort; WHO's technical advisory group guides selection; Congo's ACOREP must approve protocol adaptations. INRB and the Global Health Institute (Antwerp) co-lead, with the Ministry of Health coordinating nationally.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：臨床試験「Tumaini」の最初の参加者がブニアでブンディブギョウイルスワクチンを接種
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ(BDBV)アウトブレイク（9,552症例、4,602死亡）に関する内容であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性からIHR基準を2つ以上満たし、国際支援体制（CEPI、WHO）も確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRCで継続中のBDBV型エボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言）に対するワクチン治験開始に関する報道。ベルギー・インドの地名は共同研究機関（Global Health Institute Antwerp、Serum Institute of India）の所在地であり、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。既存の大規模アウトブレイクの深刻度から、続報を含めフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Medidas de biosseguridade alerta produtores para a prevenção da doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Biosecurity measures alert producers to the prevention of Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease alert in Rondônia reinforces poultry biosecurity after Cidasc confirms a Newcastle disease focus at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina. Despite virus detection, birds showed no clinical signs; all birds were culled. The disease, caused by avian paramyxovirus type 1, is lethal to birds and can infect domestic and wild birds; in humans it may cause transient conjunctivitis, not via meat. Wild and synanthropic birds like pigeons can disseminate it. Idaron/MAPA advises strict biosecurity: restrict visitors; disinfect trucks; use dedicated clothing and footwear; secure coop screens to deter wild birds; separate production from backyard or ornamental birds; control rodents and insects; ensure safe water and protected feed; routine cleaning and disinfection; monitor for sneezing, nasal discharge, neurological signs, decreased egg production, and sudden mortality; suspected cases must be reported to Idaron. Meat/eggs remain safe if from inspected facilities (SIM/SIE/SIF).

triage.headline_ja: 生物保安対策、生産者にニューカッスル病予防を警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の商業養鶏場でニューカッスル病の病巣が確認され防疫措置が取られたが、臨床症状はなく、ヒトへの影響も軽微（一過性結膜炎のみ）であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 主にヒトへの影響は極めて限定的（一過性結膜炎のみ、食肉経由ではない）。家禽衛生上の注意喚起記事であり、ヒト公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての緊急性は低いが、継続的な家禽疾患の監視対象として経過観察する。

article.articleHeadline: ▷ Suiza aclara que su ciudadana contagiada con ébola viajó a Uganda y no al Congo #23Oct
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Switzerland clarifies that its citizen infected with Ebola traveled to Uganda and not to the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Switzerland clarifies its citizen diagnosed with Ebola in Nigeria did not visit the Democratic Republic of Congo, but had recently traveled to Uganda about 15 days earlier. The patient, a Ugandan-born Swiss national, was diagnosed on 20 October after a week in a private clinic in Abuja. She traveled to Uganda with her husband, a diplomat at the Swiss Embassy in Nigeria, who is under preventive isolation; 25 other embassy staff in Abuja are healthy and not quarantined. This case marks the first Ebola infection detected in Nigerian territory amid the Congo-origin outbreak, which has more than 9,700 cases and over 4,600 deaths. Internationally, cases linked to the outbreak have occurred in Kenya (nine), France (one), and the Netherlands (one), with Nigeria and Uganda monitored under Africa CDC guidance.

triage.headline_ja: スイス、エボラに感染した自国民がコンゴではなくウガンダに渡航していたと説明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ起源の大規模エボラ流行（9,700例超、4,600人超死亡）がナイジェリアで初の症例確認に至り、ケニア・フランス・オランダなど複数国に拡大していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ウガンダでの個別症例だが、これはコンゴ(DRC)起源の進行中のエボラ流行（9,700例超、4,600人超死亡）に関連する国際的波及事例であり、対象国リストに含まれるDRCでの流行継続が背景として確認される。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・オランダ・スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Россиянам объяснили, что известно о коронавирусе "Стратус" в Казахстане - АБН 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians were told what is known about the Stratus coronavirus in Kazakhstan - ABN 24.
article.articleSummary: Russians were told there is no new coronavirus strain in Kazakhstan; Rospotrebnadzor debunked reports that Russian tourists were infected with a novel SARS-CoV-2 variant, clarifying it concerns the long-known COVID-19 XFG variant, informally named 'Stratus'. The variant has been under monitoring by international and national health authorities since January 2025, and claims of a completely new coronavirus do not align with official information. The agency urged travelers to be vigilant about health and not self-diagnose based on isolated symptoms. If infection signs appear during travel or after returning, medical professionals should establish the cause and, if needed, provide treatment. Earlier, Russians arriving from Thailand had their temperatures measured.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人向けに、カザフスタンの『ストラタス』コロナウイルスについて何が分かっているかが説明された - ABN 24
triage.triage_reason: 既知のCOVID-19変異株(XFG/ストラタス)に関する誤情報を否定する内容であり、新規性・異常性がなく公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の変異株XFG(ストラタス)に関する誤情報を保健当局が否定する内容。カザフスタン・タイ・ロシアへの言及があるが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない（カザフスタン・ロシアは非対象、タイは文脈上単なる渡航経由地としての言及で感染発生地ではない）。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de Newcastle em Santa Catarina preocupa setor avícola, mas mercado de frango segue estável
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease case in Santa Catarina concerns the poultry sector, but the chicken market remains stable.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial farm in Santa Catarina, Brazil, raises sector concerns. As of 23 October 2026, Cepea reports the chicken meat market remains stable, with no observed changes in prices or traded volumes. The market shows a balance between supply and demand in early October, with negotiations continuing normally and no disruptions attributed to the Newcastle case. The main worry is potential export restrictions: Malaysia and Mexico have suspended imports of Brazilian poultry, while Saudi Arabia, China, and Chile have restricted shipments specifically from Santa Catarina. The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock (Mapa) continues to monitor sanitary status and importer measures. The duration and scope of restrictions will determine effects on shipments and the domestic market. So far, no perceptible impact on internal trade; attention remains on evolving sanitary and trade measures that could affect exports in coming weeks. The episode recalls the May 2025 avian influenza outbreak in Montenegro, Rio Grande do Sul.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州でニューカッスル病発生、家禽業界に懸念も鶏肉市場は安定
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州での商業養鶏場におけるニューカッスル病確認を受け、マレーシア・メキシコが輸入停止、サウジアラビア・中国・チリが同州産品の出荷制限を実施しており、異常性と貿易制限の2つのIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 本事案は動物（家禽）における疾病であり、ヒトへの感染報告はない。疾病リストに『Human Infection with Avian Influenza』が含まれるが、記事内容はニューカッスル病の家禽発生と貿易影響が主題。中国・ブラジルは対象国として輸入制限・発生国の立場で関与しているが、実際の発生国はブラジルのみ。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 奈及利亞每年五千萬人染食源性疾病　專家呼籲設專責食安機構 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Nigeria, 50 million people contract foodborne diseases each year; experts call for establishing a dedicated food safety agency | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: Nigeria faces severe food safety challenges: about 50 million people contract foodborne diseases annually, causing over 53,000 deaths and 4.26 million healthy life years lost; children under five bear more than 80% of the burden, with over 40 million diarrheal cases linked to Salmonella and E. coli. Current oversight rests with the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC), whose broad remit yields fragmented regulation—especially in informal markets. Christine Ikpeme urges a dedicated national food safety agency, independent and led by food science/technology experts, focusing on farm-to-table packaged foods and drinking-water safety. States would establish local food-safety authorities; powers should be clearly delineated among NAFDAC, the Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON), and the Health and Agriculture Ministries. On July 21, 2026, the Senate passed a second reading of the act. International experience from the UK (2000), Ireland, and India (2006) supports labs, funding, and independent inspectors for success.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで毎年5000万人が食源性疾患に罹患、専門家が食品安全専門機関の設置を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア国内の慢性的な食品安全問題に関する政策・制度議論であり、対象国における急性の感染症アウトブレイクイベントではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアの食品安全行政・制度改革に関する内容。インド・英国・アイルランドは成功事例として参照されているのみで、実際の感染症発生地域ではない。対象国リストに該当する発生国なし。

article.articleHeadline: Preço do frango pode cair após caso de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The price of chicken could fall after a Newcastle disease case in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed in Santa Catarina, Brazil, at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba (Oeste de SC). The facility housed 6,526 turkeys; 26 cases were identified with no mortality. Samples collected Sept 21; positive Oct 14; confirmed Oct 18. A 60-day zoosanitary emergency was declared for Nova Itaberaba, Nova Erechim, Coronel Freitas, and Águas Frias; roughly 133 commercial farms lie within 10 km. Exports restrictions followed: China suspended purchases from Santa Catarina (affecting 14 of 61 Brazilian export plants); Saudi Arabia also halted imports; Chile restricted SC; Mexico and Malaysia banned imports of Brazil. In 2025, Santa Catarina exported 1.2 million tonnes of chicken (22.5% of Brazil’s total), earning US$2.45 billion and ranking second in national production (1.9 million tonnes). Itaú BBA warns prices could fall in Q1 2027 due to higher domestic supply, though national exports may be less affected; storage costs and domestic redirection are risks.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリナ州でのニューカッスル病発生後、鶏肉価格が下落する可能性
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾患であり人への健康被害はほぼなく、本記事は貿易・価格への経済的影響が主題であるため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）におけるニューカッスル病の発生であり、人獣共通感染症としてのリスクは低い。中国・サウジアラビア・チリ・メキシコ・マレーシアはブラジル産鶏肉の輸入停止措置を取った貿易相手国であり、発生地そのものではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Un nou studiu clinic pentru vaccinuri împotriva Ebola a început în Congo, în plină epidemie. Peste 4.600 de decese raportate
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new clinical trial for Ebola vaccines has begun in Congo, in the midst of an epidemic. More than 4,600 deaths reported.
article.articleSummary: Phase 2/3 Tumaini trial began Oct 23, 2026 in Bunia, Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo to evaluate Ebola Bundibugyo vaccines. The adaptive platform recruits contacts of confirmed Ebola cases to test safety, immune responses, and efficacy of multiple candidates, starting with Ervebo (Ebola Zaire vaccine) whose effectiveness against Bundibugjo is unproven; two additional Bundibugyo-targeted vaccines—one from Moderna and another from the University of Oxford with the Serum Institute of India—are expected to join soon. The DR Congo outbreak is the largest and deadliest on record in the country, with 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths as of Oct 20 (case fatality 48.3%). The outbreak, first reported May 15 and designated a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later, has prompted Africa CDC to declare a continental security health emergency. WHO officials say the trial will generate crucial evidence to guide vaccination and outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラワクチンの新たな臨床試験が開始、感染拡大の最中に4,600人超の死亡が報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模・致死率48.3%のエボラアウトブレイクが継続中でWHO PHEICおよびAfrica CDC大陸緊急事態に指定されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: インドはワクチン製造元（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。既にWHO PHEIC指定済みの既知のアウトブレイクであり、本記事はワクチン臨床試験開始に関する続報。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழகத்தில் ஒரே நாளில் 332 பேருக்கு டெங்கு காய்ச்சல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever hits 332 people in Tamil Nadu in a single day.
article.articleSummary: 2026-10-23 Tamil Nadu logged 332 dengue cases in a single day, with the season total surpassing 25,500; Chennai reported 70 cases. The northeast monsoon has intensified transmission across the state, as Aedes mosquitoes breed in stagnant rainwater on roads, in settlements and containers. Coimbatore’s Government Medical College Hospital reported dengue patients, prompting authorities to bolster containment and stock medicines; special dengue wards have been established in government hospitals. Preventive measures focus on eliminating breeding sites in outdoor containers—cement tanks, water pots, plastic items, coconut shells, and tires. Health officials are inspecting residential complexes, commercial establishments, schools, shops, wedding halls, and theaters, issuing removal and remediation directives where vector habitats are found. Separately, flash floods in the Kodai (Kodaikanal) hills have stranded villagers.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州で1日に332人がデング熱に感染
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱流行でインド・タミル・ナードゥ州内の症例数は多いが、国際的拡大やIHR基準への該当は確認されず、国内の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: モンスーン季に伴う例年の蚊媒介感染症の増加であり、州内の医療機関が対応中。死亡者数や重症度の詳細情報は記事に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito larvae found at pvt hospital in Mohali
article.articleSummary: Mohali district health authorities found and destroyed dengue-vector mosquito larvae at two locations inside a private hospital during the Har Shukarvaar, Dengue Te Vaar prevention drive on 23 Oct 2026. Civil Surgeon Dr Sangeeta Jain warned hospital management to submit their mosquito-control SOPs and ensure water tanks are cleaned at least weekly, promising strict action if larvae are detected at the next inspection. District Epidemiologist Dr Anamika Soni sensitised hospital staff on prevention, noting that Aedes aegypti mosquitoes breed in clean, stagnant water and bite during daytime. Officials urged institutions and residents to inspect water containers regularly to prevent breeding. Dengue symptoms include high fever, severe headache, joint pain, nausea, and, in severe cases, bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: モハリの私立病院で蚊の幼虫が発見される
triage.triage_reason: デング熱患者の発生報告ではなく、通常の蚊媒介対策活動（幼虫駆除・啓発）に関する内容であり、異常性や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的な防疫活動（幼虫駆除・病院への注意喚起）の報告であり、実際の症例数や流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | пятница: Западный берег, Судан, Эбола, Йемен
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top News of the Day | Friday: West Bank, Sudan, Ebola, Yemen
article.articleSummary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres voiced alarm over sweeping Israeli restrictions on Palestinians in the West Bank, including home demolitions in Hebron and potential forcible displacement, urging an immediate halt to violence. In Sudan, UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk condemned a sharp drone-attack escalation, documenting at least 306 deaths and hundreds wounded in the first three weeks of October, with attacks attributed to both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces. Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo, now affecting eight provinces; nearly 10,000 cases have been reported and about half of those infected have died, underscoring urgent resource needs. In Yemen, more than 268,000 people have been displaced since fighting began in August; Taiz remains isolated for 20 days amid severe shortages of fuel, medicines and food, with humanitarian access severely limited.

triage.headline_ja: 本日の主要ニュース｜金曜日：西岸地区、スーダン、エボラ、イエメン
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8州にまたがりエボラ感染者が約1万人、致死率約50%という極めて深刻な状況が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はUNニュースの複数トピック要約であり、エボラに関する詳細情報（症例の内訳、州別分布、対応状況等）は限定的。報告された感染者数・致死率（約1万人、約50%）は過去のDRCエボラ流行と比較して異例に大規模であり、数値の正確性を含め続報の確認が必要。西岸地区・スーダン・イエメンは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Prvi stanovnik Konga primio eksperimentalnu vakcinu protiv Bundibugjo virusa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first resident of Congo received an experimental vaccine against Bundibugyo virus.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo — the first resident today received an experimental vaccine against the deadly Bundibugyo virus, one of the Ebola virus strains. The announcement came from the University of Antwerp and the Institute of Tropical Medicine, whose field teams are on the ground in the region. The vaccination is part of a clinical trial testing several experimental vaccines, with the study simultaneously evaluating multiple vaccine candidates. This marks a significant step in the international effort to develop vaccines against Ebola virus disease, conducted in the DRC by collaborating researchers in a field setting. The article notes that multiple vaccine candidates will be assessed within the same study.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの住民が初めてブンディブギョウイルスに対する実験的ワクチンを接種
triage.triage_reason: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョウ株）ワクチン臨床試験の開始を報じるものであり、実際の症例発生や流行状況についての情報がなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも明確に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はワクチン臨床試験開始の報道であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク（症例数・死亡者数等）に関する情報は含まれていない。現行の流行状況が不明なため、続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Godda News: ब्रेन मलेरिया से मौत के बाद परिजन ने अंतिम संस्कार से किया इनकार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Godda News: After death due to cerebral malaria, the family refused to perform the last rites.
article.articleSummary: On 23 October 2026, in Meherede village, Boarijor Block, Meghi Panchayat, Godda district, Jharkhand, a 6-year-old girl died from cerebral malaria after delays in reaching care due to lack of roads. Following the death, villagers refused last rites, demanding road, electricity, and water and urging a visit by the District Commissioner. A health team screened 11 residents; all tested positive for cerebral malaria and received treatment; fogging was proposed. Officials, including Block Development Officer Mithilesh Kumar Singh, Circle Officer Kedarnath Singh, and Acting Medical Officer Sunil Kumar KisKu, visited the village and announced rapid steps. They pledged road construction under the VB-G Ram Ji Yojana, repair of a water tower and hand pumps by PHED, and immediate restoration of electricity. The district authorities provided a mobile contact for reporting problems, and, following these assurances, villagers agreed to perform the last rites.

triage.headline_ja: ゴッダ・ニュース：脳性マラリアによる死亡後、遺族が葬儀を拒否
triage.triage_reason: インドの一村落における散発的なマラリア死亡例（1名死亡、11名陽性）であり、既存の風土病への対応であって国際的な公衆衛生上の異常性・拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地元自治体（州・郡レベル）が道路・電気・水道インフラの不備に迅速に対応しており、国家・国際的な支援要請は見られない。マラリアはジャールカンド州で風土病的に発生しており、本件は単発の村落事例。

article.articleHeadline: Amroha News: डेंगू के मरीज मिलने पर दौड़ी स्वास्थ्य टीम, कराया एंटी लार्वा का छिड़काव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amroha News: When dengue patients were found, the health team rushed, and larvicidal spraying was carried out.
article.articleSummary: On 23 October 2026, Amroha district, Uttar Pradesh, India, reported dengue activity in Papasara village, a high-risk area. After three dengue cases emerged in Papasara, the health department launched an investigation and control campaign, testing residents for dengue, malaria, and typhoid and providing medicines. Anti-larval spraying and fogging were carried out with local support. CMO Ramakant Sagar, District Epidemiologist Dr. Javed Akhtar Siddiqui, and District Malaria Officer Sudhir Kumar led the response on Friday. Surveillance found no additional new dengue cases in Papasara during the visit, but one new dengue case was identified in the district, taking the total dengue cases to 24. Patients were admitted to the district hospital dengue ward for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: アムローハ・ニュース：デング熱患者発生で保健チームが急行、殺幼虫剤散布を実施
triage.triage_reason: インド・アムローハ県での局地的なデング熱発生（累計24例）であり、既に地元保健当局が通常の防除・調査対応を実施している。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られず、通常の季節性感染症対応の範囲内。
triage.notes: 地元保健当局による通常のデング熱対応（殺幼虫剤散布、患者調査）であり、季節性・局地的な流行事例。重症例や死亡者の報告はなく、地域の自助努力で管理可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Probable Dengue Cases Drop Sharply in Brazil
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports a roughly 70% drop in probable dengue cases in 2026 versus the same period in 2025. As of September 26, 470,500 probable dengue cases were counted nationwide, down from 1,500,000 in the year-ago period. Chikungunya totaled 67,902 cases, 43% fewer than 118,885 in 2025. Zika stood at 2,141 cases, 35% below 3,724 in the prior-year period. The data reflect a sharp year-over-year reduction across these arboviruses by late September 2026. The report provides domestic case counts with no laboratory-confirmation details or information on infection sources or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでデング熱の推定症例数が急減
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱いずれも前年比で大幅減少しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念や異常事態とは言えないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 症例数は減少傾向を示す統計報告であり、流行拡大や異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Patient Showing Signs Of Recovery, Says FG
article.articleSummary: An Ebola case in Nigeria’s Federal Capital Territory, Abuja, involving a Ugandan-born woman hospitalized with Ebola and previously experiencing multi-organ failure, is showing signs of recovery. Nigerian authorities report no evidence of community transmission; contact tracing and monitoring continue with 44 contacts identified. The patient has been confirmed to have the Bundibugyo species of Ebola, the strain driving the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, for which there are no specific vaccines or treatments. Swiss authorities say the patient is the wife of a Swiss embassy staff member in Abuja; she became symptomatic and has been hospitalised in a private clinic for about a week. Infection may have occurred during a Uganda trip roughly two weeks earlier; the husband is in isolation but asymptomatic. Twenty-five other embassy staff, including eight Swiss nationals and 17 locals, are doing well, with Bern considering potential repatriation of the patient.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者、回復の兆候を見せていると連邦政府が発表
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでウガンダ由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）輸入症例が確認され、スイス大使館関係者を含む国際的な接触者（44名）の追跡が行われており、国際的拡大リスクと重症度の観点からIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 事例はナイジェリア（Abuja）で発生しており対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。DRCは当該エボラ株（ブンディブギョ種）の流行源として言及されているのみで、本事例の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC says global health agencies 'not interested' in Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain has no vaccine and no cure; WHO and Africa CDC confirm absence of a vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain diagnosed in Nigeria, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and other parts of Africa. The outbreak has killed more than 4,500 people across the DRC, Uganda, and most recently Kenya. Africa CDC director-general Jean Kaseya accused Western countries and other international health agencies of disinterest in vaccine development, arguing vaccines would be available if outbreaks occurred in the West; Africa CDC is working with an Egypt-based manufacturer to conduct clinical trials. A Nigerian case, a female diplomat, is in critical condition after multi-organ failure; identity withheld. She was born in Uganda and had traveled to East Africa since Sept 16. The Nigeria CDC notes the travel link and emphasizes ongoing risk; trials ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、バンディブギョ型エボラワクチンに世界の保健機関が「関心を示していない」と発言
triage.triage_reason: ワクチンのないエボラ出血熱（バンディブギョ株）が複数国で4500人以上の死者を出し、ナイジェリアでも渡航歴のある重症例が確認されるなど国際的拡大が進行しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域に複数のアフリカ諸国（エジプト、モザンビーク、ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア）が含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ワクチン未整備の深刻なエボラアウトブレイクが国境を越えて拡大しており、国際的な注目度と支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Jaunpur News: संचारी रोगों से बचाव के लिए चलाया अभियान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jaunpur News: Campaign launched to prevent communicable diseases.
article.articleSummary: Jaunpur district, Uttar Pradesh, launched an October 1, 2026 campaign to curb communicable diseases with cleanliness drives, fogging, and larviciding. Breeding sources were removed from 45,998 homes. Fever patients: 179 tested for dengue and malaria; none infected. Since January 2026, dengue 26 cases and malaria 19 in Jaunpur. Vector control included cleaning 1,733 locations and 1,688 drains by Panchayati Raj; 18,196 drains cleaned by municipalities; 380 localities fogged. Outreach targeted 329 pig farmers for mosquito prevention and 780 agriculture sessions on scrub typhus and leptospirosis. Education dept held 2,184 awareness programs; 98,708 prayer gatherings engaged students in disease prevention. Government facilities offer free testing and treatment for dengue, chikungunya, and malaria, with a dengue ward, ELISA machine, and platelets at the district hospital.

triage.headline_ja: Jaunpurニュース:感染症予防のためのキャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性ベクター媒介感染症対策キャンペーンの報告であり、感染者数も低く異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による通常の防疫・啓発活動の報告記事。デング・マラリア感染者数も少なく(年間計45例程度)、特段の異常は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: ŠVAJCARSKA DRŽAVLJANKA ZARAŽENA BUNDIBUGJO SOJEM EBOLE!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swiss citizen infected with Bundibugyo ebolavirus!
article.articleSummary: A Swiss citizen, wife of a Swiss embassy employee in Abuja, Nigeria, has been infected with Bundibugyo ebolavirus. She and her husband recently traveled to Uganda; neither stayed in DR Congo, the epicenter. She was hospitalized in Abuja clinic with symptoms; her husband is in isolation but asymptomatic. Nigeria confirmed its Ebola case, a woman who arrived in Abuja from Uganda; 44 contacts have been identified. Bundibugyo virus has no specific vaccine or therapy and is linked to the DR Congo outbreak ongoing since May. WHO notes symptom onset Oct 7, care sought Oct 11, positive Oct 20. The Swiss embassy reports 25 other staff (8 Swiss, 17 locals); no quarantine for others. Bern considers transferring the patient to Switzerland. WHO continues contact tracing; travel restrictions are not advised. Nigeria is the fourth country affected after DR Congo, Uganda, Kenya, with >9,000 cases and >4,300 deaths in DR Congo’s outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: スイス人女性、ブンディブギョ株エボラウイルスに感染！
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクがナイジェリアへ国際拡大し、スイス人も感染。IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）での輸入症例だが、感染源であるDRCの継続的アウトブレイク（>9,000例、>4,300死亡）が本事案の背景として重要。ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニア、スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Prvi stanovnik Konga primio eksperimentalnu vakcinu protiv ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first resident of Congo received an experimental vaccine against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: First resident of the Democratic Republic of Congo receives an experimental Ebola vaccine targeting Bundibugyo virus in a clinical trial led by the University of Antwerp and the Institute of Tropical Medicine. As of October 23, 2026, there is no approved vaccine for the latest Bundibugyo strain; several experimental vaccines will be evaluated concurrently in the field. The vaccination marks a pivotal step toward stopping transmission and saving lives, with research aligned to frontline teams. Medecins Sans Frontieres’ local director underscored community engagement as essential for trial participation. Since the May start of the Bundibugyo outbreak in DR Congo, the virus has spread to Uganda, France, and Kenya, with Nigeria reporting its first case on October 20. Global spread has raised concerns about the virus infecting more than 9,000 people and causing over 4,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの最初の住民がエボラの実験的ワクチンを接種
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo株エボラがDRCを起点に複数国（ウガンダ、フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリア）へ拡大し、9000人超の感染・4300人超の死亡という深刻な国際的アウトブレイクとなっており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にフランス、ベルギー、ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリアが含まれるが、対象国リスト（GeoNames ID指定）に該当するのはDRCのみ。ワクチン治験の主題もDRCでの実施が中心。多国間拡大の規模・死亡者数からIHR・WPRO両基準で高い懸念が示される。

article.articleHeadline: Varanasi News: रहस्यमयी बुखार से चार की मौत, सौ से अधिक बीमार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Varanasi News: Four Die from Mysterious Fever, Over a Hundred Sick.
article.articleSummary: Four people died and more than 100 villagers fell ill in Manglapur village, Kashi Vidyapith Block, Varanasi district, Uttar Pradesh, over the past month due to a mysterious fever. Health officials visited families but could not provide laboratory reports and deny a confirmed outbreak or deaths. House-to-house screening is set to begin from Saturday. Deceased include Jamaluddin (35), Gulam Rabbani (65), Aisha Begum (52), and Madar Begum (48); families could not show test results. Locals attribute deaths to dengue, malaria, or chikungunya, while some report a viral fever. Additional fever patients—Narain, Taufeeq Ansari, Salauuddin Ansari, Jardari Ansari, and Ram Sundar—are admitted to private hospitals. Joint pain in hands and feet is noted. Former village head Babur Ansari says the issue has persisted about 1.5 months and mentions insecticide spraying.

triage.headline_ja: Varanasiニュース：原因不明の熱病で4人死亡、100人以上が発症
triage.triage_reason: 単一村落での原因不明熱による死亡・多数の発症が報告されているが、検査確定情報がなく、公式には集団発生を否定しているため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 死因はデング・マラリア・チクングニアと住民が推測しているが、検査結果は未確認。保健当局は集団発生を否定しており、確定診断待ちの段階。

article.articleHeadline: 肯亞通報第2起伊波拉死亡病例　非洲多國疫情持續擴散 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports its second Ebola death; outbreak continues to spread across multiple African countries.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its second Ebola death on Oct 23, 2026, raising fatalities to 2 among 9 confirmed cases. The decedent, a 65-year-old woman, was a close contact of the first Kenyan patient, a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Nairobi and died Oct 5. Authorities have traced and quarantined 135 contacts; seven other confirmed cases remain in two isolation facilities; no evidence of domestic transmission in Kenya. The outbreak originated in the DRC and has spread to East, Central, and West Africa, marking Africa’s broadest Ebola geographic spread. Nigeria reported its 4th case on Oct 20; investigators are probing transmission from a patient who had not traveled to the DRC. In the DRC, nearly 10,000 infections and over 4,600 deaths. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding; there is no approved treatment or vaccine for this strain. The US State Department has raised travel advisories for Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで第2のエボラ死亡例を報告、アフリカ複数国で感染拡大続く
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を起点にケニア・ナイジェリアなど複数国へ拡大し、死者数が急増、ワクチン・治療法未承認かつ渡航制限措置も発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大な国際公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア・ナイジェリア・アンゴラ・モザンビークにも言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCが感染拡大の起点かつ最大の感染・死亡数を抱えるため、対象国としてDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya reports second death from Ebola
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola death, a 65-year-old woman who developed symptoms during quarantine and was a close relative of a Kenyan man who died earlier this month. The outbreak began in Democratic Republic of Congo and has spread to four countries—the widest spread in Africa. Kenya’s first case, a man who travelled from Congo to Nairobi, died Oct 5. Since then, 135 contacts have been traced and quarantined; nine cases are confirmed. Death was a direct contact of index patient. Two of the nine have died; seven remain in two isolation facilities; no evidence of community transmission in Kenya. US advised reconsidering travel to Kenya; Nigeria reported a fourth African case; the patient had not travelled to DRC. Congo has nearly 10,000 infections and over 4,600 deaths; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and bleeding; transmission occurs only from symptomatic individuals; no approved treatment or vaccine for this Ebola species.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱による2人目の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大、渡航制限）し、コンゴ民主共和国を起点に複数国へ拡大する大規模アウトブレイクであるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生国はコンゴ民主共和国（起源・最大感染地、約1万人感染・4600人超死亡）。ケニア、ナイジェリア、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Reports Second Death From Ebola
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death as of Oct 23, 2026. The 65-year-old woman developed symptoms in quarantine and was a direct relative of a Kenyan man who died earlier this month, bringing Kenya’s fatalities to two among nine confirmed cases. The outbreak, which began in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has spread to four countries across eastern, central and western Africa—the widest geographic spread yet. The index patient, a man who traveled from Congo to Nairobi and died Oct 5, prompted tracing of 135 contacts, all quarantined; seven patients remain in two isolation facilities. There is no evidence of community transmission in Kenya. Nigeria became the fourth African country to report a case; the US warned against travel to Kenya. Congo reports nearly 10,000 infections and over 4,600 deaths; the strain has no approved treatment or vaccine, and transmission requires symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラによる2人目の死亡者を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当し、DRC発生のエボラ流行が既に4カ国に拡大、死亡者多数・渡航警告も発令されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはケニア・ナイジェリア・米国・コンゴ民主共和国が含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。流行の起源かつ主要被害国であるDRCを検証済み地域とした。ケニア・ナイジェリアでの拡大は国際拡大リスクの根拠として記述に反映。

article.articleHeadline: V Keni zomrela na ebolu ďalšia pacientka. Úrady hlásia už dve obete a deväť potvrdených prípadov
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kenya, another female patient died of Ebola. Authorities report two deaths and nine confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, Kenya reports a second Ebola-related death, with nine confirmed cases and seven patients under care. The deceased woman, 65, developed symptoms in quarantine and was a relative of Kenya’s first case, who died in early October. All nine Kenyan cases stem from a single outbreak, with no evidence of broader transmission. The other fatality is a man who lived in Congo and traveled to Nairobi via Uganda; he developed hemorrhagic fever symptoms upon arrival and tested positive. Uganda has 20 cases and two deaths; the Ugandan outbreak was declared over by WHO in August. The ongoing outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine. Congo has reported nearly 10,000 cases and about 4,600 deaths. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids, including from the deceased; symptoms include fever, vomiting, and diarrhea.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱によりさらに1人の女性患者が死亡。当局は死者2人、確定症例9人を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクがウガンダ、ケニアへ国境を越えて拡大しており、死亡例も発生していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 主な発生地はケニア・ウガンダだが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは流行の起源地として具体的な症例数(約1万例、死者約4600人)が記事中で言及されているため対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ytterligere én person døde av ebola i Kenya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another person died of Ebola in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, Ebola has claimed a second death in Kenya, where a 65-year-old woman died after developing symptoms while in quarantine. Kenya reports nine confirmed Ebola cases, with seven patients still receiving treatment at two isolation facilities; two have died. The first Kenyan death was a man who had traveled from Congo to Nairobi, and authorities have recorded 135 close contacts. The outbreak began in Congo and has now been reported in four African countries—Congo, Kenya, Nigeria and Uganda—marking the widest geographic spread on the continent. More than 4,600 people have died of Ebola in Congo. The circulating Ebola variant has no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラにより新たに1名が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴから複数国（ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ）に拡大し、ケニアで死亡者が発生、承認された治療薬・ワクチンもないため国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクはコンゴ(DRC)で始まり、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダに拡大しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。コンゴでは既に4,600人以上の死者が出ており、承認された治療法・ワクチンがない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya reports second death from Ebola
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death on 2026-10-23: a 65-year-old woman in quarantine who was a direct contact of an earlier Kenyan index patient, a man who died after travelling from the Democratic Republic of Congo. The outbreak, which began in DRC, has spread to four African countries across eastern, central and western Africa, the widest geographic spread on record. In Kenya, authorities have traced 135 contacts, with nine laboratory-confirmed cases; the fatality brings deaths to two among nine confirmed, while seven others remain in two isolation facilities with no evidence of community transmission. The United States has advised Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya. Nigeria became the fourth country to report a case, with the patient not travelling to DRC. In Congo, the outbreak has infected nearly 10,000 and killed more than 4,600; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding; there is no approved treatment or vaccine for this rare Ebola species.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラによる2人目の死亡者を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ（希少種、ワクチン・治療法未承認）が4カ国に拡大し、過去最大の地理的拡大を記録。致死率が高く、米国が渡航注意喚起を出すなど国際的関心・影響が大きいためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが発生源かつ主要被害国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: В Кении зарегистрировали второй случай смерти от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records second Ebola death.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola virus disease death in Nairobi on 23 October, bringing the outbreak to nine confirmed cases, with two deaths and seven patients still under care in two isolation facilities. The deceased is a 65-year-old woman who was a close relative of the first fatal case and had direct contact. Symptoms appeared October 13 during quarantine; she was hospitalized and died on October 23. All cases belong to a single group of known contacts, with no evidence of broader community transmission. The first case, registered October 6, was a man who had previously lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo and arrived in Kenya on October 3 via Uganda; he died October 5. The Health Ministry is organizing the funeral with appropriate sanitary-epidemiological measures.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱による2例目の死亡が確認される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定例9例・死亡2例が確認されており、国境を越えた渡航歴（DRC→ウガンダ→ケニア）もあることから、重篤性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの観点からIHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべき事案である。
triage.notes: 発生地はケニア（ナイロビ）であり対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。DRCは最初の症例の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地ではないため除外した。感染はいずれも既知の接触者グループ内に限定され、地域社会内伝播の証拠はないとされている。

article.articleHeadline: Urban Schistosomiasis Persists in Salvador, Brazil, but Falls Sharply Over
article.articleSummary: Schistosomiasis, caused by Schistosoma mansoni, persists in Salvador, Bahia, Brazil, in an urban setting. From 2011–2024, a 13-year longitudinal study followed 6,863 residents who provided stool samples for Kato-Katz; initial community prevalence was 7%. A subset of 3,964 individuals was re-examined up to three times over 1–5-year intervals. Across neighborhoods, prevalence declined by more than half and did not rebound; apparent incidence fell below 0.5% per year after a second treatment period. Most infections occurred in Salvador-born residents with no travel history outside the city, indicating largely local transmission rather than importation. The decline coincided with improved sanitation and reduced contact with surface water, though authors caution against attributing causality to sanitation alone. This long-term, individual-level urban assessment underscores that urban schistosomiasis is a genuine public health concern in Salvador while documenting sustained reductions in prevalence over more than a decade.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・サルバドルで都市部住血吸虫症が持続するも13年間で大幅減少
triage.triage_reason: 長期研究による疫学報告であり、有病率は大幅減少傾向。急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクはなく、対象国（ブラジル）内の慢性的風土病状況の報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事は学術研究報告であり、住血吸虫症は既知の風土病。急性アウトブレイクではなく、13年間の縦断研究結果の公表。エルサルバドルは研究背景の比較対象として言及されているのみで対象国に該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: equipes visitam propriedades diariamente no Oeste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: Teams visit properties daily in the West.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed in the West of Santa Catarina, Brazil. More than 200 professionals are conducting daily monitoring and prevention actions, visiting rural properties, sanitizing vehicles, and collecting samples for laboratory analysis. Four sanitary barriers have been erected on access roads to the monitored area, which includes Nova Itaberaba, Nova Erechim, Coronel Freitas, and Águas Frias. The program also involves visits to poultry-keeping properties within a 10-kilometer radius, covering domestic hen houses and ornamental birds. The Cidasc coordinates the response in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture, and laboratory results may take up to seven days. Ongoing surveillance is vital for Santa Catarina's poultry sector, a key component of the state's agribusiness exports.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：チームが西部の農場を毎日訪問
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州でニューカッスル病が確認され、家禽輸出への影響や国際的な貿易制限リスクが懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（動物）疾病であり人間への直接的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、サンタカタリーナ州は主要な家禽輸出地域であるため、国際貿易制限（輸出停止等）のリスクが高い。続報で輸出停止措置の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ДР Конго: для борьбы с Эболой срочно требуются дополнительные ресурсы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Additional resources urgently needed to fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) from Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with eight provinces affected and North Ubangi the latest to report cases. As of 23 October 2026, there are 9,765 reported cases and 4,727 deaths; around 30,000 contacts are under daily monitoring. A smaller outbreak in Uganda ended in August; cases have also been confirmed in Kenya, Nigeria, and France. The outbreak covers large, hard-to-reach areas where transport is limited; many communities lack routine access to care, and some patients must travel across several facilities before reaching Ebola treatment centers. WHO warns resources must keep pace or the virus could spread to new areas. WFP provides food aid, supports treatment centers, and is expanding capacity, aiming for 3,000 beds (over 2,000 available). About 2,600 survivors are receiving follow-up care.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ:エボラ対策のため追加資源が緊急に必要
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8州に拡大し致死率の高いエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの波及も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行は8月に終息、ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスでの症例確認は対象国リスト外または主要発生国でないため verified_locations には含めず。死亡者数4,727人、致死率約48%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Stanovnik Konga prvi primio eksperimentalnu vakcinu protiv jednog od sojeva virusa ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Congo resident was the first to receive an experimental vaccine against one of the Ebola virus strains.
article.articleSummary: On 23 October 2026, a resident of the Democratic Republic of Congo received an experimental vaccine against Bundibugyo virus, a strain of the Ebola virus, in a clinical trial led by the University of Antwerp and the Institute of Tropical Medicine with field teams on the ground. The trial will evaluate several experimental vaccine candidates in parallel; there is currently no approved vaccine for this latest Ebola strain. The study aims to meet urgent needs of affected communities while prioritizing interruption of transmission and frontline realities. Doctors Without Borders’ local director Bern-Tomas Njangva called the development a key step, emphasizing community engagement. Bundibugyo virus outbreaks spread from DRC to Uganda, France and Kenya, with Nigeria reporting its first case on October 20. The outbreak has infected more than 9,000 people and caused over 4,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの住民がエボラウイルスの一株に対する実験的ワクチンを初めて接種
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスの大規模流行（感染9,000人超、死亡4,300人超）が複数国に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWHO等の国際的対応（ワクチン治験、国境なき医師団の関与）が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）を主な発生国として報じているが、感染拡大先のウガンダ、フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。大規模流行（感染9,000人超、死亡4,300人超）であり、フルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Νεκρός δεύτερος ασθενής με Έμπολα στο Ναϊρόμπι - Ελβετίδα νοσηλεύεται στη Νιγηρία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The second Ebola patient dies in Nairobi — Swiss woman hospitalized in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola death—65-year-old woman in quarantine as a close contact of the first patient—raising total cases to 9, with seven in isolation. The outbreak, linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo, marks Africa’s widest Ebola spread to date, now in four countries. The first Kenyan case was a man who travelled from Congo to Nairobi and died on Oct 5; 135 close contacts are quarantined. The U.S. State Department issued a travel advisory on Monday urging Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya for health reasons. Nigeria reports its first Ebola case, the fourth in Africa, a Swiss woman married to a Swiss embassy staffer in Abuja who had recently travelled to Uganda; 44 close contacts identified and the patient hospitalized in a private Abuja clinic. The strain is Bundibugyo, for which no approved therapy or vaccine exists; Congo reports nearly 10,000 cases and 4,600 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱の2人目の死者、ナイジェリアではスイス人女性が入院
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ4カ国（コンゴ民主共和国、ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ関連）に拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行で、米国が渡航勧告を発出するなど国際的関心・影響が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Malásia e México restringem produtos avícolas de MS após foco de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaysia and Mexico restrict poultry products from Mato Grosso do Sul after Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed 18 October at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil; poultry on the property remained and were not destined for meat production. Consequently, Mato Grosso do Sul poultry products were placed under temporary import restrictions by Malaysia and Mexico; Malaysia bans Brazilian poultry meat, processed products and offal, while Mexico prohibits live birds, poultry meat and offal, fertile eggs, day-old chicks, and certain ornamental/companion birds. Other importers imposed Santa Catarina-specific limits: Saudi Arabia and China suspended imports of poultry meat and products from Santa Catarina; Chile restricted various poultry products including fresh poultry meat, human-consumption eggs, and fertile eggs. MAPA declared a 60-day zoosanitary emergency in Nova Itaberaba and the SC municipalities of Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. By 22 October, sanitary disposal was completed; cleaning/disinfection and epidemiological surveillance of nearby properties continued. Trade negotiations with importing authorities are ongoing; consumption of poultry from officially inspected establishments remains safe.

triage.headline_ja: マレーシアとメキシコ、ニューカッスル病発生後にマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州産鶏肉製品の輸入を制限
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の商業用七面鳥農場で確認されたニューカッスル病（家禽疾患）であり、ヒトへの感染・健康影響は報告されていない。各国の輸入制限は農業・貿易上の措置であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Prvi čovek primio eksperimentalnu vakcinu protiv zaraze koja je ubila više od 4.000 ljudi: I dalje se širi

article.articleHeadline: Kenya announces 2nd Ebola death, a close relative of the first patient
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Health Ministry reports a second Ebola death: a 65-year-old woman, a close relative of the first patient, died after developing symptoms in quarantine in Nairobi. She began showing symptoms 10 days ago and received supportive care; authorities said all measures were taken. Seven Ebola patients remain in two isolation facilities; no new infections were reported. Kenya's first Ebola case, announced Oct 6, involved a 40-year-old Kenyan man who had lived in Congo and traveled to Kenya via Uganda, arriving Oct 3; he tested positive at Nairobi Hospital on Oct 5 and died that day. About 135 contacts were identified, with 118 in quarantine; eight tested positive in quarantine (four health workers, four relatives). Some contacts who complete the 21-day quarantine may be released starting Saturday. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids; Congo's outbreak has caused at least 4,000 deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで2人目のエボラ死亡例、最初の患者の近親者
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という致死性の高い感染症がケニアで確認され、2人目の死亡者が発生。DRCでの進行中の大規模アウトブレイク（死者4000人以上）に由来し、国境を越えた伝播（DRC→ウガンダ→ケニア）が確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya anunță al doilea deces provocat de Ebola. Epidemia s-a extins în patru țări din Africa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya announces the second Ebola death. The outbreak has spread to four African countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak originated in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and has expanded to four African countries across East, Central, and West Africa—the widest geographic spread of Ebola on the continent to date. In Kenya, the Ministry of Health confirmed a second Ebola death: a 65-year-old woman who developed symptoms while in quarantine and was a close relative of a Kenyan man who died on 5 October in Nairobi. The first Kenyan case was identified this month in a traveler who had arrived from the DRC and died in Nairobi on 5 October. The second death underscores transmission risks and the need for vigilant contact monitoring and rapid identification of any new cases to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがエボラによる2人目の死亡を発表。流行はアフリカの4カ国に拡大

article.articleHeadline: Kenia meldt tweede dode door ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports second Ebola death.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports second Ebola death; as of 23 October 2026, nine Ebola infections in Kenya and two deaths. The second fatality is a family member of the index patient who died earlier in October; the index patient was a Kenyan who had lived in the Ebola-hit Congo and traveled to Kenya via Uganda. The Congo has reported over 4,600 Ebola deaths; Uganda’s outbreak was short-lived. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant is involved; no approved vaccines exist for this variant. Existing antivirals are being tested, and a new vaccine is in human trials at Oxford University. Public health monitoring continues for imported or exported cases, with no confirmed widespread transmission yet.

article.articleHeadline: Још једна особа преминула у Кенији од еболе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another person died of Ebola in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: As of October 23, 2026, Kenya reports nine confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and two deaths. A 65-year-old woman, a close contact of the initial patient who also died, succumbed in the evening after developing symptoms while in quarantine on October 13. Seven remaining patients are being treated in two isolation centers; officials say there is no evidence of wider community transmission. All confirmed cases belong to a single known contact chain. The death underscores Ebola’s seriousness and potential for rapid deterioration, with ongoing monitoring for community spread. The report notes concerns about Bundibugyo ebolavirus activity outside the Democratic Republic of Congo, a lineage linked to large outbreaks (over 9,000 infections and more than 4,300 deaths).

article.articleHeadline: Кения регистрира втори смъртен случай от ебола; седем души, които са заразени, остават в болница
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its second Ebola death; seven infected people remain in hospital.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death, with seven infected people still in hospital. The 65-year-old woman died early this morning; she had been under quarantine and was a relative of the man who died earlier this month. With this loss, Kenya’s Ebola death toll rose to two among nine confirmed cases, while seven patients remain under care in two isolation facilities. The outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo and has now prompted cases in four countries across East, Central, and West Africa—the most geographically widespread Ebola outbreak in Africa to date. The first Kenyan case was identified earlier this month: a man who had been ill in DRC about a month before traveling by land to Uganda, then arriving by plane in Nairobi on Oct. 3. He died Oct. 5. Authorities have traced 135 contacts, all quarantined, with nine subsequently testing positive.

article.articleHeadline: Κένυα: Μια 65χρονη είναι ο δεύτερος ασθενής με Έμπολα που πέθανε στο Ναϊρόμπι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: A 65-year-old woman is the second Ebola patient to die in Nairobi.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa persists with Kenya reporting a second fatality in Nairobi. The 65‑year‑old woman developed symptoms while in quarantine as a close contact of a Kenyan man who fell ill and died earlier this month. The outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo and has now been detected in four African countries. Kenya’s first case was a man who traveled from DRC to Nairobi and died on Oct 5. Kenyan authorities have quarantined 135 close contacts; nine total cases have been confirmed, including two deaths, with seven patients in isolation. The U.S. State Department issued a Kenya travel advisory on Monday. Nigeria has recorded a case—the fourth African country—occurring in a Swiss wife of a diplomat in Abuja; she and her husband (in isolation, asymptomatic) had recently traveled to Uganda and not to DRC; 44 close contacts identified. The outbreak is due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. In DRC, nearly 10,000 cases and about 4,600 deaths have been reported.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya reports second Ebola death
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to Kenya, Uganda, and Nigeria. DRC’s 17th outbreak, declared in May, has recorded over 9,000 cases and more than 15,000 deaths in Africa over five decades. Kenya reported its first case on Oct 6, after a Kenyan man who had lived in DRC returned home and died. As of Oct 23, Kenya has seven active Ebola cases, nine confirmed, and two deaths; the latest, a 65-year-old woman, was a direct contact of the first patient and developed symptoms on Oct 13 while under quarantine. All Kenyan cases remain in one cluster with no evidence of community spread and are in two isolation facilities. The United States warned travelers to Kenya after it reported an eighth case. Uganda has 20 infections (mostly travellers from DRC) and two deaths and was declared Ebola-free in August; Nigeria also reports related cases.

article.articleHeadline: Κένυα: Και δεύτερος ασθενής με Έμπολα πέθανε στο Ναϊρόμπι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: A second Ebola patient has died in Nairobi.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-23, Kenya reports its second Ebola death: a 65-year-old woman who died after symptoms emerged while in quarantine as a close contact of a previously ill Kenyan patient. The first Kenyan case—a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Nairobi and died on Oct 5—led authorities to quarantine 135 close contacts. Total confirmed Kenyan cases rise to nine, with seven others in isolation. Nigeria becomes the fourth African country to report an Ebola case; the patient is a Swiss woman, wife of a diplomat’s partner at the Swiss embassy in Abuja, who recently traveled to Uganda. She is hospitalized in a private Abuja clinic; 44 close contacts identified, including her husband, who remains in isolation. The outbreak is due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Congo reports about 10,000 cases and 4,600 deaths.

article.articleHeadline: Ébola vuelve a encender las alertas y México actualiza aviso para viajeros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola once again triggers alerts and Mexico updates its travel advisory.
article.articleSummary: Mexico's Secretaría de Salud updated the Ebola Travel Preventive Advisory (EVE) to high risk, urging avoidance of all non-essential travel to Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, Kenya, and South Sudan. The update, dated October 21, 2026, applies to travelers to these countries. The Democratic Republic of the Congo continues reporting active Ebola outbreaks; Kenya has no cases; Uganda has declared the outbreak over; South Sudan has no reported cases. Authorities say proximity of Uganda and South Sudan to affected zones warrants the alert; travelers should review current epidemiological conditions and entry/exit or transit requirements before travel. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood, secretions, or other body fluids, or contaminated objects; not via casual airborne exposure. Incubation is 2–21 days. Early symptoms include fever, severe weakness, fatigue, sore throat; later vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and organ dysfunction; bleeding is not always present.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が再び警戒を呼び起こし、メキシコが渡航者向け勧告を更新

article.articleHeadline: В Кении от Эболы умерла вторая пациентка
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kenya, the second female patient died of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports the second Ebola death as a 65-year-old woman, a close relative and contact of the first fatality. Symptoms emerged October 13 while she was in quarantine, and she was hospitalized in an infectious diseases unit; she died on October 23. The country has nine confirmed Ebola cases, with two deaths and seven patients still receiving treatment in two isolation facilities. All cases are within a single cohort of known contacts, with no evidence of community transmission to the wider population. Authorities are conducting burials in accordance with sanitary-epidemiological requirements. The first case in Kenya was registered October 6—a man who had previously lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and entered Kenya through Uganda on October 3; he died October 5. Ongoing outbreak linked to cross-border movement.

article.articleHeadline: 50歲長期病患婦染類鼻疽菌 屬散發個案 - 20261024
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 50-year-old female patient with a chronic illness infected with melioidosis; a sporadic case - 20261024
article.articleSummary: A 50-year-old female patient with a chronic illness in Hong Kong is infected with melioidosis, representing a sporadic case under investigation to identify the infection source. Preliminary epidemiological data show no linkage to previously confirmed local cases. The Centre urges heightened personal and environmental hygiene and advises high-risk groups—elderly individuals and those with chronic diseases—to avoid soil or mud water after typhoons or heavy rain. During such events, residents should stay indoors when possible, avoid flood-prone areas, and refrain from wading in or touching sewage-contaminated water or soil. High-risk individuals should also avoid roads near storm drains to reduce exposure to aerosols from sewage. Melioidosis is an annual concern in Hong Kong; as of Oct 22 this year, 10 cases have been recorded, compared with 21 last year.

triage.headline_ja: 50歳の持病を持つ女性が類鼻疽菌に感染、散発事例
