article.articleHeadline: В Кении зафиксировали вторую смерть от вируса Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records second death from the Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, Kenya reports nine confirmed Ebola virus disease cases linked to a single group of known contacts, with two deaths and seven patients still in two isolation units. The 65-year-old woman who died on 23 October was a close relative of the first deceased patient and developed symptoms on 13 October while in quarantine; she died after transfer to an isolation ward. The ministry notes no evidence of broader community transmission. Funeral arrangements will involve relatives with sanitary measures. The outbreak’s index case was a man who arrived from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda, diagnosed in early October and who died on 5 October. The cluster remains confined to known contacts, with ongoing containment and infection-control efforts across Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラウイルスによる2人目の死亡を確認

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria's first Ebola case 'highly similar' to Kenyan one - Minister
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case, a wife of a Swiss embassy staffer in Abuja who returned from Uganda on Oct 3. Genomic tests show the virus closely resembles Kenya's first case earlier this month; health authorities say the Nigerian case is highly similar to the Kenyan index, though there is no evidence linking travel of that case to Nigeria. The patient had not visited the DRC, the outbreak epicenter. This makes Nigeria the fourth African country affected by the Bundibugyo species outbreak, after the DRC, Uganda and Kenya. Kenyan and Ugandan contexts include an outbreak that began in May in northeastern DRC, with Uganda recording 20 confirmed cases and two deaths before it was declared over in August. WHO data as of Oct 20 place the epidemic at over 9,700 confirmed cases and 4,690 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア初のエボラ症例、ケニアの症例と『非常に類似』―保健相
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起源とするブンディブギョ種エボラのアウトブレイクが既に4カ国（DRC、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）に拡大しており、致死率も高く国際的拡大リスクが明確なためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は2026年5月からDRC北東部で始まったブンディブギョ種エボラのアウトブレイクで、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大が報告されている。ただしナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めず、対象国であるDRCのみを記載した。WHO発表（10/20時点）で9,700症例超、死亡4,690人と致死率が極めて高い点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Nigeria's confirmed patient shows signs of recovery - FG
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports signs of recovery in a confirmed Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease case, with no evidence of community transmission. The patient, a Ugandan-born woman who recently travelled to Abuja from Uganda, was confirmed on Oct 20 after laboratory tests; symptoms began Oct 7 and she sought care Oct 11. Forty-four close contacts have been identified and are under monitoring as part of containment efforts; the number has not been revised in the latest update. The WHO is supporting case investigation, contact tracing and infection prevention, while Nigeria’s NCDC activated its incident management system and health facilities strengthen infection prevention and control. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine; transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids. The Nigeria outbreak context follows the May 2026 DRC outbreak; Kenya has nine cases and one death as of Oct 22.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリアの確定患者に回復の兆候 - 連邦政府
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでウガンダ由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）確定例が発生し、国境を越えた伝播とWHOの介入を伴う異常事態であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（ウガンダ由来の輸入症例）とケニアの状況であり、両国とも対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは『2026年5月のDRCアウトブレイク』として過去の文脈で言及されているのみで、現在進行中の発生地としては記載されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Proveržis: Ugandoje atliekami Ebolos vakcinos tyrimai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breakthrough: Ebola vaccine trials underway in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Uganda begins clinical trials of a Bundibugyo virus–specific Ebola vaccine at the Uganda Virus Research Institute in Masaka, enrolling five of 110 participants to assess safety before broader dosing. The vaccine, developed by Oxford University, manufactured in India, and funded by the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations, targets Bundibugyo virus—the existing Ebola vaccine protects a different species. Uganda’s selection reflects its historical link to Bundibugyo, where the virus was first identified in 2007. The World Health Organization declared Uganda’s Ebola outbreak over in August. In the region, the Bundibugyo outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with about 2,500 deaths; Ebola cases have also been reported in Kenya and Nigeria, where Nigeria recently logged its first case. Africa CDC calls an urgent meeting next week to review readiness amid growing regional concern.

triage.headline_ja: ブレークスルー：ウガンダでエボラワクチン治験が進行中
triage.triage_reason: 記事はウガンダでのワクチン治験が主題だが、DRCでBundibugyoウイルスによるエボラアウトブレイクが継続中で約2500人の死者が出ており、ケニア・ナイジェリアにも拡大、Africa CDCが緊急会議を招集するなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する深刻な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのワクチン治験開始だが、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・インドは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCで継続中のBundibugyoウイルス・エボラアウトブレイク（約2500人死亡）が地域的に重大な懸念事項として言及されているためDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。続報としてDRC・ナイジェリア・ケニアでの感染状況の詳細、Africa CDC緊急会議の結果を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie in Afrika: Kenia meldet zweiten Ebola-Toten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemic in Africa: Kenya reports second Ebola death.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola death amid a Central African outbreak. The deceased is a woman who had close contact with first victim and had been quarantined since October 13. The first Kenyan death occurred in early October: a man who had lived in Democratic Republic of Congo died in a Nairobi hospital after treatment in Congo facilities and crossing the border from Uganda. Kenya has confirmed nine Ebola infections to date. The outbreak began mid-May in the DRC, where more than 9,000 cases and over 4,380 deaths have been reported, the worst Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. Uganda affected with several infections and two deaths; the outbreak there was declared over by late August. Nigeria recently reported a single case involving a Swiss national. Ebola spreads via direct contact with body fluids; symptoms include fever, muscle pains, diarrhea, with severe cases causing bleeding and organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの疫病：ケニアがエボラ出血熱による2人目の死者を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模（9000例超、死者4380人超）のエボラ流行が続き、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大が確認されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として深刻度が高い。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアでの発生が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主たる発生源であるDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia meldet zweiten Ebola-Todesfall
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports second Ebola death.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola death after an infected woman died, the health ministry says. She was a direct contact and close family member of the first Ebola fatality and had been in quarantine since 13 October. Nine Ebola infections have been confirmed in Kenya to date. On 6 October, Kenya announced that a Kenyan resident who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo died in a Nairobi hospital; he had fallen ill about a month earlier in the neighboring country and was treated in several hospitals there. He crossed the border into Uganda by land and flew from Kampala to Nairobi on 3 October. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, with more than 9,000 cases and over 4,380 deaths, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで2人目のエボラ死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラアウトブレイク（9,000例以上、4,380人以上死亡）が続いており、国境を越えてウガンダ経由でケニアへ感染が波及し複数の死亡例が確認されている。国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生中のエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株、史上最悪規模）の越境波及によるケニアでの死亡例。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外したが、アウトブレイクの発生源・継続地であるDRCは対象国リストに含まれるため記載した。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Begins Tumaini Trial Against Bundibugyo Ebola
article.articleSummary: DR Congo launches Tumaini Phase 2/3 trial of vaccines against Bundibugyo Ebola; first participant vaccinated in Bunia on 23 October 2026. No efficacy data yet; trial aims to assess safety, immune responses and protection in at‑risk contacts using an adaptive platform and ring vaccination. No vaccine is approved for Bundibugyo virus. Ervebo, licensed for Ebola virus, is the first vaccine evaluated; candidates from Moderna and University of Oxford with Serum Institute of India are planned to join but not confirmed at launch. Research led by the Congolese Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB) and University of Antwerp Global Health Institute, with Congo’s Ministry of Health oversight; CEPI funding and partnerships include Epicentre, Médecins Sans Frontières, Institute of Tropical Medicine Antwerp, WHO and Africa CDC. Nigeria reports an imported Bundibugyo case confirmed Oct 20 in Abuja; outbreak response activities ongoing. Tumaini is separate from the EBO-PEP oral drug research.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ブンディブギョ型エボラに対するツマイニ試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行に対しワクチン治験が開始され、さらにナイジェリアへの輸入症例が確認されており、国際的拡大と公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア（アブジャ）で輸入症例が確認されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。インドのSerum Institute of Indiaはワクチン開発パートナーとして言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 防範伊波拉疫情擴散！烏干達禁曾赴剛果旅客過境 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent the spread of the Ebola outbreak! Uganda bans transit for travelers who have previously been to the Congo
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-24, Uganda's Ministry of Health announced a public health directive to curb Ebola spread by banning transit for travelers with recent travel history to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The measure comes as DRC continues to face a multi-month Ebola outbreak. The ban targets any passenger who has traveled to the DRC and seeks to transit through Uganda. The move follows a Nigerian Ebola case recently reported; the patient had spent up to two weeks in Uganda before returning to Abuja, raising concerns that infection may have occurred during the Uganda stay. Ugandan authorities hope this transit ban reduces cross-border transmission risk as the Nigerian case triggers heightened scrutiny. Reuters reported the development on Friday night.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の拡大防止！ウガンダ、コンゴ渡航歴のある旅客の通過を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が継続する中、ナイジェリアでの症例発生とウガンダの渡航制限措置が確認され、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限の両方のIHR基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のエボラ流行とそれに伴う域外への波及（ウガンダの渡航制限、ナイジェリアでの症例）。ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外し、発生源であるDRCのみを記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria's Ebola Patient Identified as Wife of Swiss Diplomat
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Nigeria: 42-year-old Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja tested positive on Oct 20, 2026, Nigeria's first confirmed case in more than a decade. The patient had returned from Uganda on Oct 3 after roughly a two-week stay and received about a week of care at a private Abuja clinic; she remains in isolation with improving condition. Her husband is in isolation but asymptomatic. Nigeria's CDC is conducting genomic sequencing to assess links to other cases; the virus is the Bundibugyo strain, also implicated in DR Congo outbreaks. Investigations seek the infection source, including possible exposure via a Kenyan man who died after passing through Uganda's main airport on the same day. WHO and Africa CDC emphasize limited interview opportunities. The Swiss embassy remains open; all 25 staff are healthy and under precautionary measures.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ患者、スイス外交官の妻と判明
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで10年以上ぶりとなるエボラ確定例が発生し、国際的な人の移動（ウガンダ、ケニア経由）が関与する可能性があり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生国はナイジェリアであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。DRCはブンディブギョ株の過去流行例として言及されているのみで、本件の発生国ではない。感染源調査中であり、ウガンダ・ケニア経由の感染経路が疑われている点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Vaccine Trials Begin In DRC As Death Toll Nears 4,700
article.articleSummary: Late-stage trials for a vaccine against the Bundibugyo Ebola virus began in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the outbreak’s death toll nears 4,700. The epidemic has surpassed 9,700 confirmed cases across eight provinces, with 4,687 deaths and 482 new cases in the last two weeks. Ituri province remains the epicenter, with more than 7,000 cases and 3,700 deaths. Five countries have reported confirmed cases: Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, France, Kenya and Nigeria. Contact tracing achieves a 79.7% daily follow-up rate, below the 95% target. The Tumaini trial in Bunia, Ituri’s capital, tests several vaccine candidates—Ervebo (Zaire strain), Moderna’s Bundibugyo mRNA vaccine, and an Oxford-Serum Institute viral-vector vaccine—using ring vaccination around contacts of confirmed cases. There is currently no approved vaccine specifically for Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラワクチン臨床試験開始、死者数は4,700人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が9,700例超・死者4,687人に達し、複数国（ウガンダ、フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリア）に拡大、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事項であるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 複数国への感染拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスは対象国リスト外のため除外。致死率やヒト-ヒト感染持続、国際的ワクチン治験（Tumaini試験）実施など高リスク事案。

article.articleHeadline: Sgr, Gbl drinking water contaminated
article.articleSummary: On Oct 23, 2026, Srinagar and Ganderbal in Kashmir report widespread coliform contamination in drinking water. In Srinagar, 94% of samples and in Ganderbal, 88% tested positive for coliforms. Groundwater and springs are especially contaminated, with treated supplies also showing microbial presence. The study analyzed 200 samples across spring and autumn from tap water, groundwater, springs and treatment plants, using the Most Probable Number method. Seasonal variation showed higher coliform levels in autumn. Coliforms indicate possible faecal contamination and potential pathogens linked to diarrhoea, typhoid and hepatitis, raising concerns about water safety beyond appearance. Urbanisation-linked factors may explain higher contamination in Srinagar. The work calls for stronger water monitoring, source protection, and year-round testing across sources and distribution, since chlorination alone is insufficient.

triage.headline_ja: スリナガル・ガンダルバルで飲料水が汚染
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例発生報告ではなく水質調査でのコリフォーム汚染検出結果であるが、チフス・肝炎等の水系感染症リスクを示唆するため継続観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の疾病発症報告ではなく、水質サンプル調査（200検体）に基づくコリフォーム汚染の学術的報告。チフス・肝炎の実症例発生については言及がなく、潜在的リスクの指摘にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: First Volunteer Receives Ebola Trial Vaccine In DRC
article.articleSummary: First participant vaccinated in the Tumaini trial in Bunia, DRC, to evaluate vaccines against Bundibugyo virus amid the largest recorded Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. The study, a Phase 2/3 adaptive platform trial with a ring vaccination approach, will test safety and effectiveness of candidate vaccines among contacts of confirmed cases and others at high risk. No vaccine is licensed specifically for Bundibugyo; Ervebo (Zaire strain) is being considered for evaluation, though its protection against Bundibugyo is unproven. The Tumaini design enables multiple candidates to be assessed within one framework, with two Bundibugyo-focused vaccines—by Moderna and by the University of Oxford with the Serum Institute of India—expected to join as they become available. Co-leaders: Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale and University of Antwerp's Global Health Institute; DRC Ministry of Health oversees, with WHO guidance and CEPI funding. Partners include Africa CDC, MSF, and Institute of Tropical Medicine Antwerp.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ治験ワクチンの初回接種者が決定
triage.triage_reason: DRCで記録上最大規模とされるブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が継続中であり、WHO・CEPI等国際機関が関与する大規模ワクチン治験が開始されたため、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的関心の高い既存シグナルとして継続監視・評価が必要。
triage.notes: ベルギー（アントワープ大学）やインド（血清研究所）は研究・ワクチン開発拠点であり、発生国ではないため除外。既存の大規模ブンディブギョ型エボラ流行（最大規模とされる）への対応としてのワクチン治験開始であり、流行そのものの新規性は低いが規模・重大性からPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Após foco de Newcastle, Santa Catarina já vistoriou mais de 350 propriedades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a Newcastle disease outbreak, Santa Catarina has already inspected more than 350 properties
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompted intensive surveillance around the affected turkey farm identified on Sunday 18/10. Over three days, health teams inspected 352 properties in the Nova Itaberaba region, including 256 subsistence poultry holdings and 96 commercial sites. Of these facilities, 68 house chickens, 26 turkeys, one breeding operation, and one rearing operation. Technicians monitor establishments, advise producers, and collect samples for laboratory analysis. By 22/10, 28 professional groups were deployed. Four traffic-control posts operate in the Nova Itaberaba region: one at the outbreak site and three in the perifocal area within 10 kilometers of the farm, where authorities conduct vehicle inspections and disinfection. Activities are logged electronically to track procedures and consolidate operational information.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病発生後、サンタカタリーナ州は350以上の施設を既に検査
triage.triage_reason: 家禽の動物疾患（ニューカッスル病）であり人への健康影響は想定されないが、商業養鶏業への影響と拡大防止措置が進行中のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事例は動物疾患（家禽のニューカッスル病）であり、ヒトへの感染リスクは報告されていない。商業的・農業的影響の観点から監視対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: DRC begins new vaccine trial as outbreak kills over 4,600
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Bunia, with 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths as of 21 October. The World Health Organization launches Tumaini, a Phase II/III vaccine trial beginning 23 October to assess Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) for cross-protection against Bundibugyo and two Bundibugyo-specific candidates (Moderna and Oxford/Serum Institute). The study uses an adaptive platform design and ring vaccination. It is co-led by the DRC’s Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale and the University of Antwerp Global Health Institute, with national leadership by the Congolese Ministry of Health; WHO provides technical guidance; CEPI funds the trial. Bundibugyo is a distinct Ebola virus species with no approved vaccine yet; the Tumaini trial follows earlier Phase I work on a dedicated Bundibugyo vaccine and seeks safety, immune response, and effectiveness data amid the largest Bundibugyo outbreak to date.

triage.headline_ja: DRCで新ワクチン治験開始、アウトブレイクによる死者は4,600人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる大規模アウトブレイク（9,552症例、死者4,602人）であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本件はブンディブギョ種エボラウイルスによる過去最大規模のアウトブレイクであり、承認済みワクチンが存在しないため、WHO主導のTumaini治験が開始された。ベルギーは治験協力機関（University of Antwerp）の所在国であり発生国ではないため、verified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 流感疫情升溫　南竿半個月近百人確診 - 馬祖日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza outbreak intensifies; nearly 100 confirmed cases in Nangan in the past two weeks - Matsu Daily
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Nangan, Matsu Islands, Taiwan, has risen, with nearly 100 laboratory-confirmed cases in the first half of October, about 20% higher than September, though no severe illnesses have been reported. The Lienchiang County Health Bureau urges residents to vaccinate promptly, wear masks, and practice hand hygiene; symptomatic individuals should seek care promptly and isolate at home to prevent spread. Antiviral medications are in ample supply. Public-funded influenza and COVID-19 vaccines began on October 1 in phased rollout: Phase 1 targets 65+, pregnant women, children 6 months to high school, healthcare workers, and high-risk chronic patients; Phase 2 opens on November 2 for adults 50–64 without high-risk conditions. Self-paid flu shots are about NT$990 per dose; adults 18+ who complete vaccination can receive up to NT$1,350. Vaccination clinics operate at Nangan County Hospital and Beigan, East Juguang, West Juguang, and Dongyin Health Centers.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ流行が拡大、南竿で半月で約100人が確診 - 馬祖日報
triage.triage_reason: 台湾離島(馬祖)における季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行報告であり、重症例もなく、対象国（台湾は対象国リスト外）にも該当しないため見送り。
triage.notes: 台湾（馬祖諸島）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。中国・フィリピンの地名がBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、記事内容は台湾馬祖に限定されており該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue and Its Mosquito Vector Are Climbing Into Latin America's High
article.articleSummary: Dengue, transmitted principally by Aedes aegypti, is climbing to Latin America’s highlands. In Cochabamba, Bolivia, Ae. aegypti populations were found at 2,550 m with 38% larval infestation; Colombia reported vectors up to 2,302 m; Puebla, Mexico, yielded adults and pupae at ~2,150 m; and in Colombia, natural infection of field-caught Ae. aegypti with dengue virus serotype 2 was confirmed by RT-PCR at 1,984 m, demonstrating active viral circulation. Globally, WHO tallies 14.6 million dengue cases and ~12,000 deaths, with the Americas contributing nearly 13 million cases; PAHO notes regional surges in 2026 (Peru +46%, Ecuador +25%, Honduras +55% vs 2024). The expansion correlates with a lowered thermal boundary: life cycle possible at 15–17 C, aided by heat refuges and drought-driven water storage that increases indoor breeding (Cochabamba: 85% of sites). Ae. albopictus reaches ~2,100 m and may act as a transmission bridge. Findings synthesize 28 articles (1981–2025) across Colombia, Mexico, Brazil under PRISMA-ScR.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とその媒介蚊がラテンアメリカの高地へと進出
triage.triage_reason: 対象国（ブラジル等）に関する具体的な発生情報はなく、記事は主にボリビア・コロンビア・メキシコ・ペルー・エクアドル・ホンジュラスの高地への媒介蚊拡大に関する学術的レビューであり、対象国リストの国は主題として扱われていない。
triage.notes: 記事はラテンアメリカ(ボリビア、コロンビア、メキシコ、ペルー、エクアドル、ホンジュラス、ブラジルの文献レビュー対象)における蚊媒介の高地拡大を扱うが、対象国(ブラジルを含む)のいずれも記事の主題として具体的な発生報告の中心ではない。ブラジルはレビュー対象文献の出典国の一つとして言及されているのみで、発生の主体ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya announces 2nd Ebola death, a close relative of the first patient
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Health Ministry reported the country's second Ebola death on Friday: a 65-year-old woman who was a close relative of the first patient and who developed symptoms while in quarantine, dying in Nairobi after receiving supportive care at an infectious disease unit. She began showing symptoms 10 days ago. Seven other Ebola patients remained in treatment at two isolation facilities, and there were no new infections reported. Kenya's first Ebola case involved a 40-year-old Kenyan man living in Congo who traveled to Kenya via Uganda, arriving Oct. 3, tested positive at Nairobi Hospital on Oct. 5, and died the same day. Authorities identified about 135 contacts of the first patient, with 118 in quarantine; eight tested positive while in quarantine (four health workers, four close family). Some contacts who completed the 21-day quarantine would be released starting Saturday. Congo's deadliest outbreak has caused at least 4,000 deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、2人目のエボラ死亡例を発表―最初の患者の近親者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ由来のエボラがウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し、2例目の死亡と家族内・医療従事者への二次感染が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な国際的拡大事例である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおけるエボラの越境伝播と2例目死亡であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない。DRC（コンゴ）は大規模アウトブレイクの発生源として背景的に言及されているが、記事本文の主題はケニアでの感染拡大であるため、DRCは主題国として扱わずverified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Newcastle ameaça 6 mil perus e fecha mercados internacionais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease outbreak threatens 6,000 turkeys and closes international markets.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, involving about 6,000 birds, triggers international export restrictions as authorities depopulate the flock and implement cleaning and disinfection; around 133 regional properties will be monitored. The event underscores Brazil's role as a top global poultry exporter and the broader economic and welfare implications of sanitary crises. Mexico suspended imports of certain Brazilian poultry products, while China and Chile imposed restrictions on products from Santa Catarina. The disease is a highly contagious avian viral infection with respiratory, digestive, and neurological signs and high mortality in some settings. Sinergia Animal calls for integration of biosecurity and animal welfare in risk-management policies, stressing that protecting animal welfare and reducing suffering during depopulation are critical alongside safeguarding exports. The farm is linked to MBRF, a Marfrig-BRF joint supply chain.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病の発生、七面鳥6000羽を脅かし国際市場を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病による動物衛生・貿易上の問題であり、人への感染や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報がないため、人間の感染症シグナルとしては見送りとする。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は鳥類の高病原性ウイルス感染症であり、ヒトへの感染はまれで軽症（結膜炎程度）とされる。本件はブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の商業養鶏場での発生による国際的な輸入規制（メキシコ、中国、チリ）が主な論点であり、動物衛生・貿易影響の事案として扱うべきでEBS（人感染症）シグナルの対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Ebola case linked to virus found in Kenya index case, health minister says
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 23, 2026, genomic analysis shows Nigeria's lone confirmed Ebola case is closely related to the strain detected in Kenya's index case, marking the first genetic link between the outbreaks. Nigeria reports no evidence that the Kenya index case traveled to Nigeria or had a direct link to the Nigerian patient. Contacts linked to the Nigerian case are being traced, quarantined and tested, with some results negative and others pending. Nigeria has recorded a single confirmed Ebola case from a traveler who had visited Uganda. Uganda says it remains Ebola-free but is tightening precautions, reinstating traveler locator forms for all arrivals and barring transit for travelers with recent travel to the DRC, where the outbreak began. The findings underscore cross-border infection risks and the importance of continued genomic confirmation and epidemiologic tracing.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ症例、ケニアの指標症例と遺伝的に関連と保健大臣が発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCを起点に複数国（ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、ケニア）へ国境を越えて拡大しており、渡航制限措置も取られていることからIHR基準を複数満たすシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは今回のエボラ流行の発生源として記事内で明記されているため含めた。複数国にまたがる感染伝播チェーンのため、DRC国内の状況および対応能力についてフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya confirms second Ebola death as cases rise to nine
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death as the outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) expands to nine confirmed cases, with two deaths and seven patients in two isolation facilities. The latest victim, a 65-year-old woman, had been in quarantine after contact with the first confirmed Kenyan case; she developed symptoms on October 13, 2026, and died shortly after admission to an infectious-disease unit. Kenya’s first case was a man who had been living in the DRC and died after returning home; Kenya reported its first Ebola case on October 6. All cases are linked to a single cluster of known contacts, with no evidence of community transmission. Public health guidance urges avoiding contact with infected fluids, washing hands, and not handling deceased bodies. Seek care for fever, weakness, vomiting, diarrhea, or unexplained bleeding. Helpline 719 or WhatsApp 0700 719 719. AP notes DRC outbreak has ≥4,000 deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで2人目のエボラ死亡確認、感染者数は9人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ感染がケニアに国境を越えて拡大し、死亡者も発生しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの感染拡大だが、ケニアは対象国リスト外のため除外。一方、起源かつ現在も進行中のDRCでのアウトブレイク（4,000人以上死亡）が明記されているためDRCを対象国として計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia registra una segunda muerte por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports a second Ebola death.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death amid a Congo-origin outbreak that has spread to Uganda and Nigeria. A 65-year-old Kenyan woman, a close family contact of the first case, died in quarantine after symptom onset on 13 October 2026, raising Kenya’s toll to two deaths among nine confirmed cases, with seven others in two isolation centers. Authorities say there is no evidence of community transmission; all cases originate from a single focus. The index case was a Kenyan resident who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and died after returning on 6 October. The DRC has declared its seventeenth Ebola outbreak since May, with over 9,000 cases and more than 15,000 deaths in Africa across five decades. Uganda reports about 20 infections and two deaths and was declared Ebola-free in August.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱による2人目の死者が報告される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ発のエボラ出血熱がケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへ国境を越えて拡大しており、死亡例も発生していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC発のエボラ出血熱がケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアに拡大している事例だが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Geneva, Switzerland, Oct 23, 2026 (AFP) - Ebola vaccine trial begins in DR Congo: WHO chief
article.articleSummary: Geneva, Switzerland, Oct 23, 2026 (AFP) – Ebola vaccine trial begins in the Democratic Republic of Congo, according to the World Health Organization chief. The report, dated Oct 23, 2026, confirms the initiation of a vaccine trial in DR Congo and notes the involvement of the WHO at the highest level. No case or death counts are provided in the article, and there is no detail on trial design, sites, or enrollment figures. The piece centers on the announcement by the WHO chief about launching the trial, highlighting a milestone in global health efforts against Ebola. The published date anchors the timing of this development within ongoing international responses to Ebola outbreaks, underscoring the role of international health authorities in coordinating vaccine research and deployment.

triage.headline_ja: ジュネーブ、スイス、2026年10月23日（AFP）- WHO事務局長：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチン試験開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行対応の一環としてのワクチン試験開始の発表であり、新規症例や死亡者数など疫学的詳細が不明なため、現時点ではフルRRAに進むには情報不足。今後の進展を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO事務局長によるワクチン試験開始の発表のみで、具体的な症例数・死亡数・試験設計の詳細が記載されていない。既存のDRCにおけるエボラ流行状況との関連性を確認するため続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Botucatu: 85% dos criadouros do Aedes Aegypti estão dentros dos imóveis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Botucatu: 85% of Aedes aegypti breeding sites are inside homes.
article.articleSummary: Botucatu, Brazil reports 72 confirmed dengue cases by October 2026, with 2024–2025 totals nearing 18,000. A rapid LIRAa survey (October 2026) found Aedes aegypti larvae in 1.2% of inspected properties, placing Botucatu in an alert range (1.0–3.9%); 85% of identified breeding sites are linked to containers and structures inside homes, such as gutters, water tanks, toys, bottles, and other outdoor storage. Although not at elevated risk (>4%), authorities urge intensified control ahead of the hot, rainy months to reduce transmission risk of dengue, chikungunya, and zika. Endemic Disease Control Agents inspect properties, advise residents, and promote preventive measures. Prevention requires year-round effort; residents are advised to dedicate about 10 minutes weekly to check for standing water in gutters, drains, tanks, plant pots, and other receptacles. Insecticide fumigation is supplementary, not a substitute for eliminating breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: ボトゥカトゥ:ネッタイシマカの繁殖地の85%が住宅内にある
triage.triage_reason: 通常のデング熱対策・幼虫調査に関する地方自治体の広報的内容であり、異常な増加や重症例の報告もなく、IHR・WPROいずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: リスクレベルは警戒域(1.0-3.9%)だが高リスク域(4%超)には達していない。季節的な定期監視・予防啓発の記事であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : un premier vaccin testé sur l'humain face à une épidémie meurtrière
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: a first vaccine tested in humans amid a deadly outbreak.
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Tumaini vaccine trial has enrolled the first participants, marking the first human vaccination against Bundibugyo Ebola. As of 23 October 2026, the outbreak has surpassed 9,700 cases and 4,600 deaths, the worst Ebola surge on record in the DRC. Tumaini is a framework to assess safety and efficacy of multiple vaccine candidates, while Ervebo (the vaccine approved for Zaire Ebola) will be tested for potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The study will eventually integrate two Bundibugyo-specific candidates in earlier and later phases. The first is an adenoviral-vector vaccine, ChAdOx1, developed at Oxford, and the second is an mRNA vaccine from Moderna. The collaboration reflects ongoing challenges due to the absence of approved vaccines or treatments tailored to Bundibugyo Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行のDRC：致死的なアウトブレイクに対しヒトで初のワクチン試験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が9,700症例・4,600死亡と過去最大規模に達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による過去最大規模のエボラ流行であり、国際的な研究協力（Oxford、Moderna）が進行中。致死率・拡大状況から継続的な監視と早急なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Vaccine Trial Begins In DR Congo - WHO Chief
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, DR Congo, the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine began Friday amid the country’s worst outbreak, now over 9,700 cases with more than 4,600 deaths. Bundibugyo Ebola lacks approved vaccines or treatments; the Ervebo vaccine, licensed for the Zaire strain, will be tested for potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo as part of the Tumaini trial—a DRC-led, single framework to assess safety and efficacy of multiple vaccines. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the start, noting that the trial will show whether Bundibugyo-specific candidates work. In parallel, the Everbo vaccine will also be tested against the outbreak. Tumaini is expected to incorporate two Bundibugyo-specific candidates: a ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector vaccine from Oxford and a Moderna mRNA vaccine. The effort aims to save lives amid the ongoing Bunia-based trial.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチン治験がコンゴ民主共和国で開始 - WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（症例数9,700超、死者4,600超）が継続中であり、承認ワクチンのないBundibugyo株に対する初の臨床試験が開始されたことから、公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性が認められる。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株には承認ワクチンがなく、Ervebo（Zaire株用）の交差防御効果およびOxford/Moderna製の新規候補ワクチンの有効性をTumaini治験枠組みで評価中。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限については記事内に明示情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola vaccine trial begins in DR Congo | New Straits Times
article.articleSummary: On Friday in Bunia, DR Congo, the first Ebola vaccine trial during the outbreak began. The outbreak has surpassed 9,700 cases and more than 4,600 related deaths. Bundibugyo-specific vaccines lack approved options, so the Tumaini trial—described as a single framework to test safety and efficacy of multiple vaccines—will assess whether vaccines designed for Bundibugyo provide protection. Ervebo, a vaccine approved for the Zaire Ebola strain, will undergo a full-scale human trial to evaluate cross-protection against Bundibugyo, while the existing Everbo vaccine will be tested. WHO backs the DRC-led effort to save lives. The Tumaini framework should eventually include two Bundibugyo-specific candidates in earlier-stage trials: a ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector vaccine from the University of Oxford, and a Moderna mRNA vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチン治験開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（9,700例超、死亡4,600人超）が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響とWHO主導の国際的対応（ワクチン治験）が確認されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 本件は既知の継続中アウトブレイクに関する続報（ワクチン治験開始）であるが、致死率が高く国際的な医療支援（WHO、Oxford、Moderna）が関与しているため重要シグナルとして扱う。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の有無については記事内に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Κένυα: Δεύτερος θάνατος από τον ιό Έμπολα - Στους 9 τα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: Second death from the Ebola virus - nine confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in Kenya reaches nine confirmed cases with two deaths as of 2026-10-24. A 65-year-old woman, already quarantined as a close contact of a Kenyan patient who died earlier in October, died of Ebola; Kenya’s first case was a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to Nairobi and died on 5 October, after which 135 close contacts were placed in isolation. The outbreak originated in DRC and has spread to four African countries, marking the widest geographic spread on the continent. Nigeria became the fourth country to report a case, involving a Swiss woman (wife of a Swiss embassy staff member in Abuja) who had recently traveled to Uganda; 44 close contacts were identified, including her husband, who remains in isolation and asymptomatic, while the patient is hospitalized in a private clinic in Abuja. The strain implicated is Bundibugyo Ebola virus; no approved therapy or vaccine exists. The DRC reports nearly 10,000 cases and about 4,600 deaths. A U.S. State Department travel advisory for Kenya was issued.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：エボラウイルスによる2人目の死亡 - 確定症例9人に
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ出血熱がケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへ拡大し、アフリカ大陸での地理的拡散が過去最大規模となっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生起源国はDRCであり、同国は対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは記事の主題国だが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでは累計約1万例・死亡約4600人と報告されており、アウトブレイクの中心地である。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RD Congo supera los nueve mil casos | MÁSNOTICIAS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo surpasses nine thousand cases | MORE NEWS
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has expanded to eight provinces, with 9,765 confirmed cases and 4,727 deaths. The World Health Organization warns that nearly half of confirmed patients have died. About 30,000 contacts are under daily surveillance. Persistent conflict, insecurity, and weak health systems hinder response, especially in remote areas, according to David Stevenson of the World Food Programme. To mitigate the humanitarian impact, WFP has distributed over 3,000 metric tons of food to affected households and served more than 744,000 hot meals at treatment and isolation centers. WFP seeks $115 million over the next six months to sustain food aid, air transport, and other operations. WHO warns that reduced efforts could allow the virus to spread to new areas and increase risk to neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが9000例を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、8州に拡大、約3万人が接触者追跡対象となっており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOおよびWFPが資金・支援不足と紛争・治安悪化による対応の困難さを指摘しており、近隣国への拡大リスクも警告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Ebola case linked to virus found in Kenya index case, health minister says
article.articleSummary: Ebola case in Nigeria is genomically linked to the strain detected in Kenya’s index case, according to Nigeria’s health minister as of 2026-10-23. There is no evidence that the Kenya index case traveled to Nigeria or had a direct connection to the Nigerian patient, who was a traveler with a visit to Uganda. Contacts associated with the Nigerian case are being traced, quarantined and tested; results are mixed, with some negative and others pending. Nigeria has recorded only one confirmed Ebola case to date. Uganda, which borders the DRC and has battled past outbreaks, says it remains Ebola-free but is tightening precautions, reinstating traveler locator forms for all arrivals, and prohibiting transit for travelers with a history of travel to the DRC. The findings highlight cross-border links in Ebola outbreaks and continued surveillance and infection control measures.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ症例、ケニアの指標症例と遺伝的に関連と保健相発表
triage.triage_reason: ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダにまたがる国際的なエボラ感染連鎖が確認され、渡航制限措置も開始されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダでの症例連鎖であり、これらはいずれも対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCは過去の流行地として言及されているのみで、本記事における現時点の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Máxima alerta en África por caso de ébola confirmado en Nigeria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa on high alert over a confirmed Ebola case in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola case in Abuja, Nigeria, marks unprecedented western Africa spread of this strain. A woman arriving on a flight from Uganda developed symptoms four days after arrival and is isolated under medical surveillance. Nigeria is the fourth African country with confirmed infections, after the DRC, Uganda, and Kenya, signaling the widest geographic reach of Bundibugyo to date. Authorities identify 44 close contacts under monitoring; contact tracing is expanding as officials assess exposures. Epidemiological investigations indicate the patient also traveled through Ethiopia and had ties to the DRC, the outbreak epicenter. Bundibugyo lacks authorized vaccines or specific therapies; control relies on case identification, isolation, contact tracing, and supportive care. Case fatality historically 25-50%, with recent data around 48%. Early symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, and sore throat, which can be mistaken for malaria, delaying diagnosis. International mobility underscores the need for solidarity and rapid diagnostics, supplies, and trained personnel.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでエボラ出血熱の感染例が確認され、アフリカ全土が最大級の警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCを起点に複数国へ国際的に拡大し、ナイジェリアでも輸入症例が確認されるなど、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性・国際拡大性に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCを起源とするエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の国際的拡大を報じており、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・エチオピアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは発生地（震源地）として明記されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya announces 2nd Ebola death, a close relative of the first patient
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death: a relative of the first patient died Friday in Nairobi after symptoms began 10 days earlier. Others remain in isolation; no new infections. The first Kenyan case, a man who traveled from Congo via Uganda, tested positive Oct 5 at Nairobi Hospital and died that day. Authorities identified about 135 contacts, with 118 in quarantine; eight tested positive while in quarantine (four health workers, four relatives). Some contacts who complete the 21-day period may be released Saturday. In Nigeria, authorities say the first patient contracted the virus possibly in Uganda, returning to Abuja from Uganda; her husband, a Swiss diplomat, remains in isolation. Africa CDC says both patients traveled through Entebbe Airport on Oct 3. The U.S. now requires travelers to sign a declaration not to have been in Congo in the prior 21 days, amid Congo’s outbreak with about 4,000 deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱による2人目の死者、最初の患者の近親者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で続くエボラ流行（5月以降死者約4000人）がケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大し、渡航制限措置（米国の申告義務化）も発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア・ナイジェリアでの感染例だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の継続流行（5月以降死者約4000人）が明記されているため、DRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。国際的な接触者追跡・隔離措置、米国の渡航申告義務化等、フルリスク評価が必要な重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Κένυα: Δεύτερος νεκρός από τον ιό Έμπολα στο Ναϊρόμπι και νέα κρούσματα στη Νιγηρία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: Second death from the Ebola virus in Nairobi and new cases in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-24, Kenya reports a second Ebola death in Nairobi: a 65-year-old woman who died in quarantine, linked to the first Kenyan death who had returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Kenyan authorities have isolated 135 contacts of the initial patient, with nine laboratory-confirmed cases to date; seven survivors remain in dedicated hospital wards. The outbreak now spans four African countries, with the United States issuing a travel advisory for Kenya amid ongoing transmission. The strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, official counts show about 10,000 cases and 4,600 deaths. Nigeria was added to the outbreak map: a Swiss embassy spouse in Abuja tested positive after visiting Uganda; 44 close contacts have been traced, the husband in strict isolation but asymptomatic. The patient is being treated at a private clinic in Abuja, per Swiss authorities.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：ナイロビでエボラウイルスによる2人目の死亡、ナイジェリアでも新規症例
triage.triage_reason: 複数国（ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、DRC）にまたがるエボラ流行で、死亡者・確定症例が報告され、米国が渡航勧告を発出するなど国際的関心が高く、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア・ナイジェリアでの新規症例だが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ（アウトブレイクの発生源として約1万症例・4600死亡が記載）。ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل الوفاة الثانية بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its second death from the Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its second Ebola death amid the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. As of Oct 23, 2026, Kenya has seven active Ebola infections, nine confirmed cases, and two deaths. The latest death is a 65-year-old woman who was a direct contact of the index case and developed symptoms while in isolation on Oct 13, 2026; all Kenyan cases belong to a single outbreak epicenter with no evidence of community transmission. Current cases are in isolation facilities. The United States warned travelers to Kenya after the eighth case. Uganda reports 20 infections and two deaths, largely among arrivals from the DRC, Ebola-free since August. Nigeria reports its first Ebola case; genetic testing shows the virus matches the Kenyan strain identified earlier this month. The patient is the wife of a Swiss embassy employee in Abuja, who had returned from Uganda on Oct 3; Swiss officials say she did not visit DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラウイルスによる2人目の死者を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起点としたエボラアウトブレイクがケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへ拡大しており、死者増加と渡航警告も発出されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主な報告対象はケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアだが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは今回のアウトブレイクの起点として言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Sai lầm cần tránh khi chăm sóc người bệnh viêm não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mistakes to Avoid When Caring for Patients with Meningococcal Meningitis.
article.articleSummary: Nutrition is pivotal in meningococcal meningitis management in Vietnam, where rapid disease progression—fever, severe headache, nausea, and possible altered consciousness—can deplete energy and protein stores. Caregivers' missteps, such as extreme dieting or over-rich meals, worsen outcomes. During the acute phase, high protein loads strain liver and kidneys; prioritize easily absorbed proteins: skinless poultry, catfish, mackerel, well-cooked eggs, and softened legumes. Do not rely on restrictive diets; ensure a balanced intake of carbohydrates, proteins, healthy fats, and vitamins/minerals (noting risks of zinc, iron, vitamins A/C/D deficiencies). Prevent dehydration and electrolyte imbalance with oral rehydration solutions (ORS) per package directions, small sips, and diluted fruit drinks; avoid plain water-only hydration, sodas, or caffeinated beverages. Avoid very dry, hard foods; feed soft/liquid forms (porridge, soups, specialty liquids) early, advancing to soft meals as swallowing improves. Small, frequent meals (6–8 daily), food safety, weight monitoring, and physician guidance for enteral/IV feeding are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎患者のケアで避けるべき間違い
triage.triage_reason: 個別患者の栄養管理に関する医療情報記事であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎患者の看護・栄養管理に関する一般的な医療啓発情報であり、具体的な発生事例や症例数、アウトブレイクに関する記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Adapi reforça alerta e orienta criadores sobre doença de Newcastle no Piauí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Adapi reiterates the warning and guides breeders about Newcastle disease in Piauí.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease focus confirmed on 18 October in Santa Catarina, Brazil, involving about 6,000 turkeys and 133 farms, according to Sada. The outbreak prompted Adapi, in Piauí, to strengthen surveillance and breeder guidance to prevent spread. Newcastle disease is a highly fatal viral avian infection; typical signs include sudden deaths, sneezing, labored breathing, twisted neck, tremors, circling, and greenish diarrhea, with possible wing and leg paralysis, reduced egg production, and lower water and feed intake. Because symptoms can be subtle, breeders are urged to monitor health and behavior closely. Preventive measures in Piauí include strict biosafety: clean housing, restricted access, proper equipment, no contact with unknown-origin animals, and buying chicks only from registered incubators. Meat and eggs with official inspection seals are safe. Report suspects via WhatsApp (86) 99462-1644, the e-Sisbravet system, or in person at Adapi units.

triage.headline_ja: Adapiがピアウイ州でニューカッスル病について警戒を強化し、飼育者へ指導
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（家禽）のアウトブレイクでヒトへの影響は報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されないが、家禽産業への拡大リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家禽（七面鳥・鶏）のニューカッスル病であり、ヒト感染例は報告されていない。影響カテゴリも'animals'のみ。サンタカタリーナ州での発生を受け、ピアウイ州で予防的な監視強化が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de Ebola na Nigéria está ligado ao vírus encontrado no primeiro caso do Quênia, diz ministro da Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola case in Nigeria linked to the virus found in Kenya's first case, says Health Minister.
article.articleSummary: Genomic analysis shows Nigeria's sole Ebola case is genetically linked to Kenya's first recorded case, with no evidence of direct contact between the two. The Nigerian patient had traveled to Uganda, which remains Ebola-free but is tightening precautions and reintroducing traveler-tracking forms. Nigeria has isolated and monitored the case's contacts, with some tests negative and others pending. Nigerian Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate said there is no indication the Kenyan case traveled to Nigeria or connected directly to the Nigerian case. Nigeria maintains travel restrictions from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak began, to curb spread. Uganda reiterates no confirmed cases and has reimplemented traveler-location forms for all arrivals, regardless of origin.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ症例はケニアの最初の症例で見つかったウイルスと関連している、と保健相が発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が複数国（DRC発端、ケニア、ナイジェリア）にまたがって遺伝的関連を持つ形で確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・ケニア間のエボラ症例の遺伝的関連を主題としているが、ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCはアウトブレイクの発生源として言及されており、対象国リストに含まれるため記載。ナイジェリアはDRCからの渡航制限を継続している点も国際的拡大・渡航制限基準に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Supruga diplomate iz Švajcarske zaražena smrtonosnim virusom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wife of a Swiss diplomat infected with a deadly virus.
article.articleSummary: Swiss embassy employee in Abuja: his wife, a Swiss citizen, is infected with Bundibugjo Ebola, Nigeria's first case. The couple recently traveled to Uganda; neither stayed in DR Congo. The patient was hospitalized in an Abuja clinic about a week ago with Ebola symptoms after arriving from Uganda; her husband is in isolation but asymptomatic. Nigeria has identified 44 contacts. WHO says Bundibugjo, the strain driving the DR Congo outbreak, has no specific vaccine or therapy. She developed symptoms on Oct 7, sought care Oct 11, and tested positive Oct 20. The embassy reports 25 staff in Abuja; after consultations, no quarantine for others. Bern is considering transferring the patient to Switzerland. WHO continues contact tracing; no travel restrictions advised. Nigeria is the fourth African country affected after DR Congo, Uganda, and Kenya; the DR Congo outbreak has more than 9,000 cases and over 4,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: スイス人外交官の妻が致死性ウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）症例が確認され、DRCの大規模アウトブレイクと関連、スイスへの患者搬送検討など国際的拡大の懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（初症例）とスイス（患者搬送検討）であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。DRCのアウトブレイクは背景情報として言及されているが、本記事の主題イベントの発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Nigeria case highly similar to Kenya infection - Minister
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Nigeria is highly similar to Kenya’s first imported case, with genomic sequencing showing the Nigerian and Kenyan viruses differ by only one mutation. Analysis by Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Redeemer’s University Institute of Genomics and Global Health (led by virologist Christian Happi) confirms the similarity but not the infection source. Nigeria still has one confirmed Ebola case; contact tracing and testing continue, with some results negative and others pending. Kenya reports nine confirmed Ebola cases due to Bundibugyo virus, including one death; eight cases linked to the Kenyan index case from the DRC, including four healthcare workers (per ECDC). Africa CDC is probing a possible link, noting both patients travelled through Entebbe, Uganda on Oct 3; Uganda says no confirmed active case and exposure location under investigation. Nigeria’s patient also passed through Uganda; no evidence of airborne transmission; authorities urge vigilance, IPC, and reporting suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリアの症例はケニアの感染と酷似 - 保健相
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ間でのエボラウイルスの渡航関連伝播が確認され、医療従事者への二次感染や死亡例も報告されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: ケニアの指標症例はDRC由来とされ、エボラウイルスの起源地としてDRCが関連するが、主な症例報告国であるナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。DRCは感染源国として関連性が高いため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: WFP Seeks $214 Million for Six Months of Ebola Relief in Congo | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompts WFP to seek $214 million for six months of response. Of this, $78.6 million would fund food for patients and relatives at treatment and isolation facilities to improve care and adherence to isolation. About 3.5 million people in outbreak-affected communities face crisis-level food insecurity; 97% of those directly affected still require food aid. Since the response began, WFP has delivered more than 744,000 hot meals at 59 treatment/isolation sites and sent over 3,000 metric tons of food to families; its air service has moved over 10,000 responders and 483 metric tons of cargo. Musienene’s treatment center is finished; Bunia’s is under construction. As of 2026-10-23, the outbreak is in Nord-Ubangi (eighth province) with two reported cases, per Independent, and security/transport challenges remain.

triage.headline_ja: 世界食糧計画(WFP)、コンゴでのエボラ対応6か月分として2億1400万ドルを要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が継続し新たな州（ノールウバンギ）へ拡大、350万人が食料危機に直面し国際機関が大規模支援を要請しているため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際支援の必要性からフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 新たに8番目の州（Nord-Ubangi）での感染確認が報告されており、地理的拡大と資金調達の規模から継続的な監視・フルリスク評価が必要。治安・輸送面の課題も対応の障壁となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de Ebola na Nigéria está ligado ao vírus encontrado no primeiro caso do Quênia, diz ministro da Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Case in Nigeria Linked to Virus Found in Kenya's First Case, Says Health Minister.
article.articleSummary: Genomic analysis of Nigeria’s only confirmed Ebola case shows the virus is closely related to the strain identified in Kenya’s first case, providing the first genetic link between the outbreaks. Nigerian Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate said there is no evidence that the Kenyan case traveled to Nigeria or connected directly to the Nigerian case. Contacts linked to the Nigerian case are being traced, quarantined, and tested; some tests are negative, others pending. Nigeria’s single case involved a traveler who had visited Uganda. Uganda says it remains Ebola-free but is intensifying precautions, reinstating traveler-location forms for all arrivals, and barring travelers with travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo from transiting through Uganda. No deaths reported in Nigeria; ongoing surveillance and contact tracing continue.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ症例、ケニアの初症例で発見されたウイルスと関連 ― 保健相が発表
triage.triage_reason: 複数国（ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ）にまたがるエボラ症例間の遺伝的関連が判明し、国際的拡大の懸念と渡航制限措置（ウガンダ）が既に取られているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダでのエボラ症例であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは『DRCからの渡航者をウガンダが制限する』という文脈でのみ言及されており、DRC自体での発生を示す記述はないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya announces second Ebola death, says 'no evidence' of community spread
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death, a 65-year-old woman who developed symptoms during quarantine and was a close relative of a Kenyan man who died earlier this month. Seven Ebola cases are in treatment at two isolation facilities, all within one cluster with no evidence of community transmission. Kenya’s first case was a man who traveled from the DRC and died in Nairobi on Oct 5; 135 contacts have been traced and quarantined, with nine confirmed cases, including the two deaths. The Democratic Republic of Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, declared in May, has more than 9,000 cases and over 4,600 deaths, spreading across four countries—the widest geographic spread on record for Africa. Nigeria reported a case linked to the Kenyan index case, while Uganda restricted transit for travelers with DRC history; prior outbreak dynamics included 20 infections and two deaths there before August.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで2人目のエボラ死亡例、「市中感染の証拠はない」と発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラアウトブレイク（9000例超、4600人超死亡）が4カ国に拡大しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの波及にも言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。震源地であるDRCの第17次エボラアウトブレイクはアフリカ史上最大の地理的拡大とされ、既に国際的な渡航制限（ウガンダ）も発生しており、極めて高い優先度でのフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : un essai clinique du vaccin Tumaini a débuté, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: a clinical trial of the Tumaini vaccine has begun, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: On 23 October 2026, the World Health Organization announced the start of the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine, Tumaini, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak. The trial began on Friday 23 October, according to the WHO Director-General. The announcement signals an important step in outbreak response and vaccine development, with scientific optimism cited as hope for control. The article does not provide case counts, deaths, laboratory confirmation, or details on transmission or source. The Tumaini vaccine trial aims to evaluate the vaccine within the context of the current DRC outbreak, reflecting international health authority involvement in accelerating vaccination-based interventions. No information is given on trial design, participant criteria, or timelines in the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（コンゴ民主共和国）：WHOによるとTumainiワクチンの臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対しWHOがワクチン臨床試験を開始したとの発表であり、疾患の重篤性と国際機関の介入の観点からIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験開始の発表が主旨であり、症例数・死亡者数・感染経路等の詳細情報は記載なし。既知の進行中アウトブレイクを背景とした国際的対応の一環と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Newcastle en Brasil: Uruguay suspende temporalmente el ingreso de aves y productos avícolas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease in Brazil: Uruguay temporarily suspends the entry of birds and poultry products.
article.articleSummary: Uruguay suspends entry and transit of birds, poultry, and related products from Brazil after confirmation of Newcastle disease at a turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. Brazilian authorities confirmed the outbreak on 18 October and notified the OIE on 20 October. The measure, under DGSG Resolution No. 244/2026, applies to products produced after 6 September 2026, with exceptions for goods meeting international sanitary standards or treated to inactivate the virus, with veterinary certification. MGAP urged producers to strengthen biosecurity to prevent contact between domestic and wild birds, including securing enclosures, using dedicated clothing and footwear, and intensifying cleaning, disinfection, and access controls on people and vehicles. Uruguay has had no Newcastle cases in poultry since 1984. Newcastle is a notifiable disease; suspected signs or unusual mortality should be reported to MGAP offices by email or phone. Regional monitoring will continue.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでニューカッスル病発生：ウルグアイが鶏類・鶏肉製品の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ニューカッスル病）であり人への直接的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、貿易制限措置が発生しており、家禽産業・貿易への影響として継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾患であり人獣共通感染症としての重大なヒトへの健康被害は報告されていない。ウルグアイは対象国リストに含まれないため、Brazilのみを検証済み発生国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Swiss Government Disputes Uganda Account Of Nigerian Ebola Patient's Travel To Congo | Naija247news
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Nigeria: Swiss government disputes Ugandan claims that a Nigerian Ebola patient—reported as a Swiss national, Ugandan-born wife of a diplomat in Abuja—travelled to the Democratic Republic of Congo. Swiss FDFA says she and her husband did not travel to DRC, contradicting Ugandan assertions of a Congo visit. WHO and Africa CDC say they have not received confirmed information of travel to Congo. Uganda reported 20 Ebola cases in May–June, mostly imported from Congo, and was declared Ebola-free by WHO in August. Nigeria’s infection is the first Ebola case there in more than a decade, raising concerns about cross-border transmission and the effectiveness of contact tracing and public-health investigations. Africa CDC notes the broader outbreak has spread to DRC, Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria, with about 4,700 deaths; the infection route remains unresolved pending verified epidemiological evidence.

triage.headline_ja: スイス政府、ナイジェリア人エボラ患者のコンゴ渡航に関するウガンダ側の説明に異議を唱える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC・ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアに拡大し約4,700人の死者が出ている大規模アウトブレイクであり、ナイジェリアでは10年以上ぶりの症例確認、国境を越えた感染経路や接触者追跡の有効性に懸念があるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイス・ケニアを中心に言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。渡航履歴の真偽や感染経路は未解決であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Catarina mobiliza equipes para monitorar 352 propriedades por causa da doença de Newcastle | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina Mobilizes Teams to Monitor 352 Properties Due to Newcastle Disease | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil, with the focus identified on Oct 18. By Oct 22, 28 teams had surveyed 352 rural properties surrounding the farm as part of a coordinated operation by Mapa and Cidasc via Coezoo, involving federal and state agencies and industry representatives. On Oct 21, authorities completed the disposal, burying 6,526 turkey carcasses and related materials; cleaning and material removal were finished, while disinfection continued under veterinary oversight. Surveillance now covers 1,680 properties, including 166 within 3 km and 1,514 within 10 km of the focus. Among commercial properties inspected, 68 rear chickens, 26 rear turkeys, one breeding operation, and one rearing operation were identified. Four traffic checkpoints regulate movement with vehicle inspection and disinfection; data are recorded electronically. Newcastle disease is a viral avian disease with economic impact; authorities emphasize updated farm registrations and ongoing containment, noting prior zoosanitary emergencies elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州、ニューカッスル病のため352農場を監視するチームを動員
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾患であり人への健康被害は報告されておらず、ブラジル当局により迅速に封じ込め対応（殺処分・消毒・監視）が行われているため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）農場での動物疾患であり、ヒトへの感染・影響は報告されていない。ブラジル当局（Mapa・Cidasc）により感染源の特定、殺処分、消毒、周辺農場の監視（最大10km圏内1,680農場）、検問所設置などの封じ込め対応が既に実施されており、管理可能な状況と判断される。貿易上の影響（家禽輸出制限）の可能性はあるが、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Swiss Diplomat's Wife Confirmed As Nigeria's Ebola Patient As Authorities Probe Infection Source | Naija247news
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Nigeria: a 42-year-old Ugandan-born woman living in Abuja tested positive on October 20, becoming Nigeria’s first confirmed Ebola case in more than a decade. She returned to Nigeria on October 3 after about two and a half weeks in Uganda and spent a week in a private Abuja clinic before diagnosis. Nigeria’s CDC, with WHO and Africa CDC, expanded contact tracing beyond 44 contacts; genomic sequencing is underway to assess links to regional cases. The infection has been identified as the Bundibugyo strain, the same as the Congo outbreak. Investigations examine travel history and possible cross-border exposure; accounts differ on Congo travel, and no verified link to DRC travel has been established. Authorities are also probing a possible connection to a Kenyan patient who died after traveling via Uganda; no confirmed transmission chain yet. The Swiss diplomat’s wife is isolated; the embassy remains open with health measures, and staff are healthy.

triage.headline_ja: スイス人外交官の妻がナイジェリアのエボラ患者と確認、当局が感染源を調査
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで10年以上ぶりに確認されたエボラ出血熱症例であり、ウガンダ・DRC・ケニアとの越境感染可能性が調査されている。WHO・Africa CDCが関与し、国際的関心・対応の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: イベントの主体はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）での症例。DRCとの渡航歴は「確認されたリンクはない」と明記されており、DRCでの発生が確定していないため verified_locations には含めない。ブンディブギョ株であり、DRCの流行株と同一である点は今後の続報で地域拡大の有無を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia anuncia 2da muerte por ébola, la de un familiar cercano del primer paciente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya announces second Ebola death, that of a close relative of the first patient.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death: a 65-year-old woman who was a close relative of the first patient and developed symptoms while in quarantine in Nairobi, dying Friday night. Seven remaining Ebola patients are in two isolation facilities; no new infections have been reported. Kenya’s index case was a 40-year-old Kenyan who had lived in Congo, traveled to Kenya via Uganda (arriving October 3), tested positive October 5, and died that day. Authorities identified about 135 contacts of the first patient, with 118 placed in quarantine; eight tested positive during quarantine—four health workers and four close family members. Some quarantined contacts who complete the 21-day observation without symptoms may be released starting Saturday. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated materials. Congo is experiencing its deadliest outbreak, with at least 4,000 deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラによる2人目の死者を発表 ― 最初の患者の近親者
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでエボラの二次感染・死亡例が確認され、DRCの大規模流行(4000人超死亡)からの越境伝播事例であり、IHR基準の複数(深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大)に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生国はケニアだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。index caseはDRC在住歴があり、ウガンダ経由でケニアに入国。DRCでは現在進行中の大規模エボラ流行(5月以降4000人超死亡)が背景として明記されているためDRCをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle e alta do petróleo marcam a semana no agro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle Disease and the Rise in Oil Prices Mark the Week in Agriculture.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Santa Catarina, Brazil, marking a direct hit to aviculture and potentially broader poultry and pork output. The ABPA warned the outbreak could reduce poultry and pig production capacity by up to 5%. Brazil suspended chicken meat exports to China, with Mexico and Chile also restricting imports. Oil prices rose to their highest since May, while Brazil became the second-largest crude supplier to China, overtaking Saudi Arabia. Mato Grosso expanded DDG exports to China by 35%. Brazil’s exports to Canada hit a record this year, led by gold and beef. The Ministry of Agriculture expects to restart poultry meat and honey exports to the European Union, initially planned for November, possibly extending to December.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病と原油価格上昇が今週の農業分野を特徴づける
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家きん(七面鳥)の動物疾病であり人への健康被害の報告はなく、記事内容も主に農産物輸出・経済への影響に関するもので公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は家きん(七面鳥)の動物疾病（ニューカッスル病）に関する経済・貿易記事であり、ヒトの健康被害は報告されていない。中国・メキシコ・チリ等は輸入制限措置を取った貿易相手国であり、発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Editorial: Ebola Returns!
article.articleSummary: Latest Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria highlights persistent gaps in preparedness despite lessons from 2014 and the COVID-19 era. The editorial argues Nigeria must strengthen surveillance, border screening, contact tracing, testing and infection prevention to prevent outbreaks from spiraling. Citing the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak as a warning, it also honors Dr Stella Adadevoh for her 2014 courage and proposes a national medical institution named in her honor for infectious disease research, emergency preparedness and public health training. The piece calls for airport, seaport and land-border screening to be intensified with no exemptions for politically connected individuals, reform of Port Health Services, and investment in modern equipment and trained personnel aligned with international standards. It urges attention to internally displaced persons camps, markets, schools and other crowded settings. Funding for laboratories, health facilities and frontline workers must be a national priority, transcending partisan politics.

article.articleHeadline: Efter ebolautbrottet - vaccin testas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the Ebola outbreak - vaccines tested.
article.articleSummary: Clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine begins in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as part of the outbreak response. The first human test of an Ebola vaccine associated with this outbreak has been launched, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. A vaccine previously approved for use against another Ebola variant will now be tested in the DRC to determine whether it can provide protection against the strain driving this outbreak. The country is experiencing its worst Ebola outbreak in its history, with more than 4,600 deaths reported to date. The development highlights ongoing efforts to evaluate cross-variant vaccines in real-time, aiming to accelerate protective tools for affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行を受け、ワクチンの試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪のエボラ出血熱流行（死者4,600人超）が継続しており、新規変異株に対する交差ワクチン試験が開始されたことからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長がワクチン臨床試験の開始を発表しており、国際的な関心・支援の動きが明確。史上最悪規模の流行かつ新変異株であることから、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクについては続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情嚴峻　新疫苗人體臨床試驗正式啟動 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; clinical trials in humans for a new vaccine officially launched.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the ongoing Ebola outbreak—driven by Bundibugyo virus in Ituri Province and centered in Bunia—has surpassed 9,700 cases and more than 4,600 deaths, marking the nation’s worst outbreak. As of 2026-10-24, the World Health Organization launched human clinical trials for a new Ebola vaccine regimen named Tumaini (Swahili for 'hope'). First doses were administered in Bunia, with a ring vaccination design targeting high-risk contacts. The trial will assess safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity across multiple vaccines, starting with Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) to evaluate cross-protection against Bundibugyo; vaccines from the University of Oxford (adenovirus-vectored) and Moderna (mRNA) may be added after early results. Pregnant women and children aged 12 and older are included. The outbreak began May 15 as the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行深刻化、新ワクチンのヒト臨床試験が正式開始
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模なエボラ流行（9,700例超、死者4,600人超）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: WHOは既に本流行をPHEICと宣言しており、過去最大規模の国内エボラ流行。新ワクチン（Tumaini）の臨床試験開始も国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Polícia investiga mortes de 36 bebês por infecção em hospital na zona leste de SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Police investigate the deaths of 36 babies due to infection at a hospital in the East Zone of São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, in São Paulo’s East Zone, 36 infant deaths at Hospital Salvalus in Mooca are under police investigation for possible hospital-acquired infections. Six cases are formally registered as police inquiries, with 30 more under analysis. The fatalities occurred over the year, involving babies aged 0–3 years with diverse clinical histories, ranging from serious medical conditions to simple throat infections. Mothers of the deceased have organized a group and staged protests outside the hospital seeking answers. Hospital Salvalus says it is cooperating with investigators and providing support, but notes it is premature to pin a single cause due to the varying medical backgrounds. Investigators continue to listen to witnesses and review hospital protocols for possible negligence or procedural failures. The case has sparked public attention due to clustering of similar deaths at the same facility in a short period.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ東部の病院で乳児36人が感染症で死亡、警察が捜査
triage.triage_reason: 単一病院内で短期間に36人の乳児が院内感染疑いで死亡しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常なクラスター事例として警察・社会的関心が高いため。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は未特定（Unknown Illness）。院内感染の可能性が高く、国内の単一施設に限定された事例と見られるが、死者数が多く社会的関心が非常に高いためフルリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تدعو لتعزيز المراقبة الوبائية بعد رصد بؤر جديدة لـإيبولا بالكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization calls for strengthened epidemiological surveillance after detecting new Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, the World Health Organization reports new Ebola virus outbreaks in remote areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The DRC has recorded 9,765 confirmed Ebola cases, with around half resulting in death; over 2,600 people have recovered. Health teams monitor roughly 30,000 contacts daily as they pursue containment amid security and logistical challenges that limit access to affected regions. WHO's outbreak response lead, Catherine Smolwood, urged increased funding, medical and logistical support, and strengthened local capacities, emphasizing rapid case finding, especially in zones affected by conflict, displacement, and food insecurity. The agency called for intensified epidemiological surveillance and border health checks by regional countries, while reiterating that it does not recommend travel or trade restrictions with the affected states.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国で新たなエボラ出血熱の発生拠点確認を受け、疫学的監視の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,765例・致死率約50%という大規模エボラ流行が継続し、WHOが資金・医療支援と監視強化を要請しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOは渡航・貿易制限を推奨していないと明言しているが、紛争・避難民・食料不安地域での感染拡大リスクと高致死率を踏まえ、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola vaccine trial begins in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: On Oct 23, 2026, in Bunia, Ituri province, DR Congo, the first clinical Ebola vaccine trial began under the Tumaini framework to test multiple vaccines against Bundibugyo virus using a ring vaccination approach. Ervebo, approved for the Zaire Ebola strain, will be evaluated for cross-protection and safety/efficacy in this outbreak. The DR Congo outbreak has surpassed 9,700 cases with over 4,600 deaths, described as the second-most lethal on record, and is spreading about five times faster than earlier outbreaks. The Tumaini trial will incorporate two Bundibugyo-specific candidates—ChAdOx1 (Oxford) and Moderna mRNA—funded by CEPI and expected to enter trials soon. The study includes pregnant women and children aged 12 and older, aiming to generate robust evidence on vaccine performance to curb transmission and bolster preparedness, per WHO and CEPI leadership.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラワクチン治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は既に9,700例以上・死者4,600人超と史上2番目に致死的な規模に達しており、感染拡大速度も過去最速級であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な関心・支援（WHO・CEPI主導のワクチン治験）も高い。
triage.notes: 本記事はブンディブギョ株に対するリングワクチン接種治験（Tumainiフレームワーク）開始に関する内容だが、背景として既存のDRCエボラ流行が過去最悪級の規模・拡大速度であることが強調されており、フルリスク評価が妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Folha da Região: Suspeita de sarna humana afasta 71 pessoas de escola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Folha da Região: Suspected human scabies keeps 71 people out of school.
article.articleSummary: Atibaia, a city about 66 km from central São Paulo, Brazil, reports suspected or confirmed human scabies, prompting the exclusion of 71 people (51 students and 20 staff) from a municipal preschool. The Prefeito Walter Engrácia de Oliveira School closed on Friday, 23 October 2026, to intensify cleaning and disinfection. Since the first case was notified, Epidemiological Surveillance and Sanitary Surveillance teams visited the school to assess environmental conditions and advise on cleaning and proper hand hygiene. The report does not specify laboratory confirmation or the infection source, and there is no mention of additional cases beyond those temporarily removed from the school. Public health authorities are applying standard outbreak-control measures in response, with ongoing monitoring of the situation.

triage.headline_ja: フォーリャ・ダ・レジオン紙：疑われるヒト疥癬の発生で71人が学校から隔離
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上重篤性が低く、局地的な学校閉鎖対応に留まり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染するが重症度は低く、学校単位での一時休校・消毒対応で管理可能な事例。検査確定や追加感染の記載もなく、地域的な衛生対応事案と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola vaccine trial begins in Democratic Republic of Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, the worst to date, has surpassed 9,700 cases and 4,600 deaths. The first clinical vaccine trial in the country began Oct 23 in Bunia, Ituri province, with Ervebo (Zaire strain) used to test cross-protection while two Bundibugyo-specific candidates advance. The Tumaini trial, a ring-vaccination framework, aims to assess safety, efficacy and immunogenicity of multiple vaccines, including two candidates: ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector (Oxford) and Moderna's mRNA vaccine, both CEPI-funded and expected to enter the trial soon. The study will include pregnant women and children 12 years and older. If successful, it could yield the first clear evidence of Bundibugyo vaccine protection and transform outbreak response and preparedness. WHO declared the 17th Ebola outbreak in May, with a PHEIC two days later; Ebola spreads via bodily fluids causing haemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチン治験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模（9,700例以上、死者4,600人超）のブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中で、WHOがPHEICを宣言済み。IHR基準の複数に該当し、国際的な支援（ワクチン治験等）が進行している。
triage.notes: 既にWHOがPHEICを宣言している進行中の大規模アウトブレイクであり、本記事はワクチン治験開始という続報。フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: PHP爆重大漏洞全球網站急下線　非洲伊波拉蔓延4國 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PHP reveals a major vulnerability as global websites go offline worldwide; Ebola spreads to four countries in Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-24, Ebola outbreaks have extended to four African countries: the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Kenya's health ministry confirms a second Ebola-related death, a household contact of a previously diagnosed patient. Nigeria reports its first confirmed case in more than a decade, with genomic sequencing showing the Nigerian virus is highly related to the Kenyan case, prompting intensified cross-border surveillance and public health response. Authorities are investigating infection sources and expanding laboratory confirmation to prevent further spread. The widening geographic footprint underscores ongoing regional risk and the need for rapid containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: PHPの重大な脆弱性により世界中のウェブサイトが緊急停止、アフリカでエボラ出血熱が4か国に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国からウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへと4か国に拡大し、国際的拡大が確認され、ナイジェリアでは10年ぶりの症例確認とゲノム解析による感染経路の関連性が判明しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の全項目該当が認められる重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国を含む複数国へのエボラ拡大であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として高い優先度でフルリスク評価が必要と判断する。

article.articleHeadline: Biến chứng nguy hiểm do cúm A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Serious complications due to influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Two elderly patients with influenza A complications in Hanoi, Vietnam: at the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases, a 72-year-old man with long-standing hypertension and prior stroke developed fever, progressive dyspnea, and severe pneumonia with lung injury, requiring oxygen at 40–50% and non-invasive ventilation. After three days, fever subsided but pulmonary injury remained severe, prolonging respiratory support. A second patient, a 73-year-old man with COPD and heavy smoking history, presented with cough, increasing shortness of breath and fever; he tested positive for influenza A at a local clinic, and on admission developed rapid respiratory failure, necessitating endotracheal intubation and critical care, but his condition deteriorated. Clinicians emphasize that flu severity cannot be judged by fever alone; COPD and airway inflammation worsen ventilation and gas exchange during influenza.
