Preventive measures include hand hygiene, masking, ventilation, social distancing, and annual vaccination for high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAによる重篤な合併症
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる個別の重症例報告であり、異常な病原体変異や集団発生、国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。高齢・基礎疾患患者における既知の合併症であり、通常の臨床症例報告に留まる。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAによる高齢者2名の重症肺炎症例報告。基礎疾患（高血圧・脳卒中既往、COPD）を有する患者における既知の合併症であり、新規株や異常なクラスター発生の記載はない。公衆衛生上の緊急性は低く、臨床啓発目的の記事と判断される。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Vandalur zoo to reopen tomorrow after bird flu scare
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza detected in water birds at Arignar Anna Zoological Park (AAZP) in Vandalur, Tamil Nadu, prompting closure for disinfection and precautionary measures. ICAR-NIASD, Bhopal confirmed infection in water birds; bird enclosures remain cordoned off while birds are closely monitored and reported healthy. Health Department screened 26 animal care staff on Oct 22; all 26 tested negative by RT-PCR. Comprehensive disinfection and biosecurity measures have been implemented, with reopening planned for Sunday, Oct 25, 2026. No human infections reported. A 13-year-old tiger captured in Gudalur on Oct 22 was brought to the Vandalur Rescue and Rehabilitation Centre for ongoing veterinary care and monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: バンダルール動物園、鳥インフルエンザ騒動後に明日再開へ
triage.triage_reason: 動物園の水鳥でH5N1が確認されたが、スタッフ26名は全員陰性でヒト感染は報告されておらず、再開も予定されているため影響は限定的。ただしH5N1の動向として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 動物園内の水鳥に限定された事例で、スタッフの検査は全て陰性。ヒトへの感染拡大は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo dá início a testes de vacina contra tipo de ebola sem imunizante aprovado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Begins Vaccine Trials Against an Ebola Strain for Which No Vaccine Has Been Approved.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts a Bunia-based vaccine trial named Tumaini. The study evaluates vaccines for protection against Bundibugyo; the first candidate is Ervebo (licensed for Zaire ebolavirus). Two additional vaccines from Moderna and from the University of Oxford with the Serum Institute of India are being prepared to join the study. The aim is to create a protective ring around confirmed cases to interrupt transmission while assessing safety and efficacy. As of October 21, CEPI reported 9,552 confirmed cases and 4,602 deaths, the largest Bundibugyo outbreak on record and the second-largest Ebola outbreak overall. Bundibugyo was first identified in Uganda in 2007 and also caused a Congo outbreak in 2012.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、承認されたワクチンがないエボラ株に対するワクチン治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ・エボラアウトブレイクは症例9,552人・死者4,602人に達し史上最大規模であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的なワクチン開発支援も動いているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: インド（Serum Institute of India）とウガンダ（株の起源国）は記事に登場するが、現在のアウトブレイク発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola death during its first outbreak, a 65-year-old woman who was a close family member of the first patient and died in quarantine. The initial case, a man who fell ill in September after travelling from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and treated in DR Congo hospitals, arrived in Nairobi and died on Oct 5. Seven other Ebola patients remain in treatment at two isolation facilities. All cases are within one cluster with no evidence of community spread. Across Africa, more than 4,000 deaths have occurred since Ebola was confirmed in May in DR Congo. The Bundibugyo strain is rare, with no approved vaccine or treatment (trials under way). Transmission is via contact with infected bodily fluids. Kenya has boosted screening for travellers from DR Congo and nine high-risk countries (Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, Angola, Zambia, Ethiopia, South Sudan, Central African Republic) with digital forms and QR codes; enhanced aircraft screening. Nigeria reports one confirmed case genetically linked to a Kenyan strain; investigations ongoing; some results negative or pending; possible Entebbe route.

triage.headline_ja: 65歳女性、ケニアで2人目のエボラ死亡例に
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで死亡者が発生し、ナイジェリアへの国境を越えた感染拡大（遺伝的関連株）も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 初発患者はDRCで発症・治療後ケニアへ渡航し死亡。DRCでは5月以降エボラ確認が続き、アフリカ全体で4,000人超の死者が出ている。ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外したが、DRCは発生源として明記されているため含めた。ワクチン・治療法未承認（治験中）であり、国際支援（WHO等）の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolavaksine testes i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola vaccine tested in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing the country’s worst Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus variant, with about 9,700 confirmed cases and over 4,600 deaths. In Bunia, the World Health Organization launched a vaccine trial on Friday named Tumaini (Swahili for 'hope') to test protective strategies against Bundibugyo. The study will evaluate Ervebo, a vaccine approved for the Zaire strain, for potential cross-protection, while efforts aim to determine if any existing vaccines can mitigate this strain. The first participants were vaccinated in Bunia, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who emphasized that the trial seeks answers and lives saved. Over time, Tumaini will also include two Bundibugyo-focused vaccine candidates under development.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラワクチンの試験実施
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo株による過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（約9,700症例、4,600人以上死亡）が継続中であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的な対応（WHOによるワクチン治験開始）が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 本記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）におけるBundibugyo株エボラ流行の過去最悪規模の拡大と、WHO主導の新規ワクチン治験（Tumaini試験）の開始を報じるもの。致死率・症例数共に極めて高く、既存の対応能力を超える国際支援が必要とされている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Inicia ensayo clínico de nueva vacuna para frenar el brote de ébola en RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A clinical trial of a new vaccine begins to curb the Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-23, the first human trial of an Ebola vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain began in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as part of the Tumaini (hope) study. The DR Congo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 9,700 cases with over 4,600 deaths. A lack of vaccines or approved treatments for Bundibugyo has complicated responses, though Ervebo, approved for Zaire ebolavirus, is being tested for potential cross-protection. Tumaini uses a ring-vaccination approach, targeting high-risk contacts. Authorities plan to add two Bundibugyo-specific candidates in early-stage trials: a ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector vaccine from the University of Oxford and an mRNA vaccine from Moderna. The trial represents large-scale human testing to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo and to bolster outbreak control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなワクチンの臨床試験が開始、DRコンゴのエボラ流行抑制を目指す
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が9,700例・死亡4,600人超に達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるため、フルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株に対する承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在せず、リング接種法による大規模臨床試験が進行中。既存の大規模アウトブレイク(9,700例超)の継続事例であり、続報・国際支援動向の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: NSA sounds fresh alarm on screening
article.articleSummary: Nigeria tightens Ebola screening after reports of entry point breaches, prompting an October 22, 2026 circular from the Federal Ministry of Health that mandates strict, non-discriminatory enforcement of entry protocols, health declarations and surveillance, and improved interagency coordination. Lagos’ isolation facility in Yaba, once used for COVID-19, has been repurposed as a nursing school, underscoring preparedness gaps; 15 states have yet to update Ebola plans, and some markets lack handwashing facilities. In Abuja, an imported Ebola case was confirmed in a 42-year-old Ugandan-born woman, wife of a Swiss diplomat; she arrived from Uganda, tested positive for Bundibugyo virus, and was admitted to a private hospital and placed in isolation. Public health teams are tracing 44 contacts. The infection source is under investigation; Ugandan officials say she travelled to eastern DRC before Uganda, while WHO and Africa CDC have not verified that visit; Swiss authorities say she contracted the virus in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:国家安全保障顧問(NSA)、スクリーニング強化について改めて警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでウガンダから輸入されたエボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)症例が確認され、44名の接触者追跡や複数州での準備不足が報告されており、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（輸入症例）とウガンダ（感染源）であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。DRCへの渡航歴はウガンダ当局の主張のみでWHO・Africa CDCが未確認のため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Reported Echinococcosis in Xinjiang Peaked in 2017 and Fell to a 2022 Low,
article.articleSummary: Xinjiang, China reported 20,302 echinococcosis cases from 2010–2024, peaking in 2017 and declining to a 2022 low, based on the China Infectious Disease Surveillance and Reporting System. Joinpoint regression showed an APC of 8.91% (2010–2017) followed by -12.56% (2017–2024); overall AAPC was -2.42% (CI -5.80 to 0.83%), with results sensitive to model specification. Monthly notifications shifted over time. In forecasting, five time-series methods were evaluated for 2020–2024 using 2010–2019 training data under a fixed-origin setup and four error metrics: RMSE, MAE, MAPE, sMAPE. In fixed-origin, LSTM yielded the lowest errors (RMSE 47.08, MAE 39.24, MAPE 105.91%, sMAPE 46.07%). Under expanding-window rolling-origin, SARIMA delivered the best RMSE/MAE/sMAPE, with LSTM comparable. Conclusion: forecast performance depends on the evaluation framework, not just epidemiology.

triage.headline_ja: 新疆におけるエコノコックス症(包虫症)の報告数は2017年にピークを迎え、2022年に最低水準まで低下
triage.triage_reason: 過去の疫学統計・予測モデル研究に関する学術的報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 2010年〜2024年の長期サーベイランスデータに基づく予測モデル比較研究であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではないため対象国の該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola en RDC - Une ONG invite à des "clarifications" sur la gestion de fonds décaissés par les bailleurs
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola in the DRC - An NGO calls for clarifications on the management of funds disbursed by donors.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, a funding accountability dispute surrounds Ebola response funds. Africa CDC director-general Jean Kaseya says 962 million USD pledged by donors has been disbursed, yet only just over 200 million can be traced by authorities, leaving about 700 million unaccounted for by Oct 23, 2026. Jimmy Kande, president of the Pan-African Network Against Corruption (Unis), urges independent clarification and transparent expenditure tracking, asserting NGOs and international agencies must justify resource use to both donors and affected populations, while warning that untraceable funds do not automatically imply misappropriation. The discourse underscores governance and coordination gaps impacting outbreak response. Separately, Nord-Ubangi province reports two Ebola cases in Wapinda near Bas-Uélé, with one death; the national tally stands at 9,415 confirmed cases and 4,536 deaths. The situation follows the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country, with ongoing concerns about resource mobilization and utilization.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱 - あるNGOがドナーから拠出された資金の管理について「説明」を求める
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて新規感染者・死亡例が報告されており、累計死者数も多数に上るため、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的対応が必要な継続的シグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は主にエボラ対応資金の透明性・ガバナンス問題を扱っているが、Nord-Ubangi州Wapindaで新規感染2例（うち1例死亡）が報告されており、進行中の第17次アウトブレイクの一部として継続的なリスク評価が必要。資金管理の不透明さは対応能力（manageability）にも影響する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل الوفاة الثانية لمصاب بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records the second death of an Ebola virus patient.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Kenya reports the second Ebola virus–related death in an outbreak linked to Democratic Republic of Congo clusters. Nine confirmed cases have been recorded in Kenya, with two fatalities; seven cases remain in isolation facilities, and health authorities say there is no evidence of sustained community transmission. The deceased is a 65-year-old woman who had direct, close contact with the family of the first fatal case and developed symptoms after entering quarantine on 13 October. The Kenya Ministry of Health notes all recorded cases belong to a single outbreak cluster. The outbreak began after a case who traveled from Congo to Nairobi and died in hospital on 5 October, signaling a cross-border element. Infections have been detected in Uganda and Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラウイルス感染者の2人目の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大し、死亡例も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの死亡例だが、アウトブレイクの起源はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）由来のクラスターであり、対象国リストに該当するためDRCのみを記載。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Cidade registra 4 mortes suspeitas de febre maculosa e decreta emergência - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City records 4 suspected deaths from Brazilian spotted fever and declares a state of emergency - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleSummary: Amparo, São Paulo, Brazil, declared a Public Health Emergency after four suspected deaths from Brazilian spotted fever (febre maculosa) in 2026. A pesqueiro (fish farm) in Chácara São João was interdicted due to an epidemiological link to two fatalities; the site remains closed pending safety assessments. The four male patients died after presenting compatible symptoms; the first death occurred on July 12, with the other three between September and October, including two on October 2. Samples have been sent to Instituto Adolfo Lutz for laboratory confirmation; cases remain suspected pending results. Authorities will intensify environmental surveillance, vegetation management, tick control, and warning signage. The Municipal Health Department advises clinicians to treat suspected clinical-epidemiological cases without waiting for lab confirmation when indicated, given rapid disease progression. Symptoms include fever, severe headache, muscle pains, and prostration; exposure areas include forests, parks, riverbanks, fish farms, and capybara habitats, with up to 14 days of potential incubation.

triage.headline_ja: 市が紅斑熱の疑いによる4人の死亡を記録し、緊急事態を宣言 - ACidade ON Campinas
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州アンパロ市で紅斑熱（Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever）疑いによる4人の死亡が発生し、公衆衛生緊急事態が宣言されたため、自治体・行政の関心が高く重症度も高い。
triage.notes: 紅斑熱（febre maculosa）はダニ媒介性疾患でヒト-ヒト感染はないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地方自治体レベルで緊急事態宣言が出され、死亡者が複数発生している点で注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El ensayo clínico 'Tumaini' en busca de una vacuna contra el ébola, se pone en marcha en Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The 'Tumaini' clinical trial in search of an Ebola vaccine gets underway in Bunia.
article.articleSummary: CEPI announced the start of a phase II/III clinical trial named Tumaini, meaning 'Hope' in Swahili, to evaluate an Ebola vaccine in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo. Tumaini targets Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo, for which no licensed vaccine currently exists. The trial seeks to assess safety and efficacy of an experimental vaccine as part of ongoing preparedness efforts. Images accompanying the report show a patient receiving a dose of the experimental Tumaini vaccine in Bunia. The initiative underscores continued global efforts to develop vaccines against Ebola viruses and to fill critical gaps in outbreak response for Bundibugyo Ebola. As no approved intervention exists for this strain at this time, results from the phase II/III study will inform potential future approvals and deployment strategies.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチン開発を目指す「Tumaini」臨床試験、ブニアで開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）ワクチンの臨床試験開始を伝える予防研究に関する報道であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの発生を示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は臨床試験開始の告知であり、現時点での疫病発生や症例報告を示すものではない。将来的なワクチン承認・配備に関する続報があれば経過観察対象となり得る。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kaltim ingatkan risiko penyakit hepatitis B akut dan kronis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Kalimantan Health Office warns of the risks of acute and chronic hepatitis B
article.articleSummary: East Kalimantan's Health Office warns of acute and chronic hepatitis B (HBV) risks in Samarinda, urging awareness of transmission via contaminated blood from shared needles and non-sterile tattoo tools, perinatal transmission from infected mothers, unsafe sex, and sharing personal items such as toothbrushes, razors, and nail scissors. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, reduced appetite, mild fever, right upper quadrant pain, jaundice, and dark urine; many patients may be asymptomatic early. Prevention emphasizes CEGAH: complete vaccination, personal hygiene, safe/protected sex, and avoiding shared items, with early detection through periodic blood testing. For H1 2026, the province reports 100% coverage of DDHBC across all 10 districts/cities, 83.08% average coverage among at‑risk populations, 61.34% DDHB coverage among pregnant women, and 770 new hepatitis B cases detected province‑wide.

triage.headline_ja: 東カリマンタン州保健局、急性・慢性B型肝炎のリスクに注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 地域保健局による一般的な啓発・予防呼びかけであり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念も認められない。
triage.notes: B型肝炎は既知の地方流行性疾患であり、本記事は定期的な予防啓発キャンペーンの一環。770件の新規症例は年間報告の一部であり、急激な増加や異常クラスターを示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Swiss Officials Point to Uganda in Nigeria Ebola Case Investigation | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: One case of Bundibugyo virus disease (EVD) confirmed in Abuja, Nigeria, on Oct. 20, with 44 contacts monitored. The patient, a woman in Nigeria, had traveled after a business trip to eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo; Uganda’s Ministry of Health had said she transited through Uganda symptom-free before illness. The Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs contests Uganda’s account, stating neither the patient nor her husband visited the DRC and viewing the Uganda period as the probable exposure source. Uganda’s MOH says exposure location remains under investigation, describing eastern DRC travel followed by symptom-free transit through Uganda. The World Health Organization notes the DRC Ebola outbreak is its 17th since 1976 and the largest on record. Investigations continue into exposure location and potential imported risk to Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: スイス当局、ナイジェリアのエボラ症例調査でウガンダを指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）のナイジェリアへの輸入症例が確認され、DRCの過去最大規模のアウトブレイクに関連する国際的な感染拡大・外交的対立が生じており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 主な症例はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）およびウガンダ（対象国リスト外）で発生しているが、感染源とされるDRCの進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（1976年以降17回目、過去最大規模）が記事の背景として直接関連するため、DRCのみを検証済み発生地域とした。曝露地（ウガンダ経由かDRC渡航歴か）は調査中で不明な点が多い。

article.articleHeadline: Proef ebolavaccin van start in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola vaccine trial begins in Congo.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola vaccine clinical trial underway in the Democratic Republic of Congo as WHO reports. The outbreak is the worst in the country, with over 9,700 cases and more than 4,600 deaths. The trial, named Tumaini (Swahili for 'hope'), tests several candidate vaccines against the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. The study also includes a broader assessment of Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV), approved for the Zaïre (Zaire) variant, to determine whether it offers cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The trial marks a milestone in vaccine development for the Bundibugyo variant. Results should clarify whether cross-protection is possible.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラワクチン治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模（症例9,700超、死者4,600超）のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続中であり、承認ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないため国際的な治験が開始された。重症度・規模・流行継続性の観点からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はコンゴ民主共和国における過去最悪規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行に対するワクチン治験（Tumaini試験）開始を報じるもの。WHOが関与しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項として既にフルリスク評価の対象となっている可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Δεύτερος θάνατος από Έμπολα στην Κένυα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second Ebola death in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 October 2026, the second Ebola death in Kenya confirms the ongoing East Africa outbreak. A 65-year-old woman, quarantined as a close contact of the first patient, developed symptoms and died at Nairobi’s specialized infectious diseases unit. In total, about 135 contacts of the first case, a 40-year-old Kenyan who lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and traveled via Uganda, were identified; 118 were quarantined and eight tested positive—four health workers and four family members—underscoring nosocomial and household transmission risk. The outbreak began in May in DRC and has since spread to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no approved vaccine or targeted therapy; management relies on supportive care and strict tracing. Genomic analyses link the Kenyan patient zero strain to Nigeria’s first case, implying cross-border transmission risks and the need for vigilant border and airport surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱による2人目の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大が既に発生、渡航制限リスク）し、複数国にまたがるエボラアウトブレイクでヒト-ヒト感染・院内感染が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクはDRCで2026年5月に発生し、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへ拡大。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ（ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、モザンビークはリスト外）。ゲノム解析によりケニアの症例とナイジェリアの症例に関連性があり、国境・空港での監視強化が必要とされている。ワクチンや特異的治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスである点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: WHO announces start of Ebola vaccine clinical trial in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: On 24 October 2026, the WHO announced the first Ebola vaccine clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), focusing on the Bundibugyo strain. In Bunia, Ituri province, participants are vaccinated with Ervebo (Zaire strain) to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, declared in May, has surpassed 9,700 cases and 4,600 deaths, with the WHO declaring a public health emergency of international concern. The outbreak now spans four countries across eastern, central and western Africa, the widest geographic spread in Africa to date. The Tumaini trial uses a ring vaccination framework to test the safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity of multiple vaccines, including two Bundibugyo-specific candidates: the ChAdOx1 vaccine from Oxford and Moderna's mRNA vaccine, funded by CEPI. The study includes pregnant women and children aged 12 and older.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの臨床試験開始を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCの第17次エボラ流行はPHEIC宣言済みで症例9,700超・死者4,600超、4カ国に拡大するアフリカ史上最大規模の地理的拡大を見せており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事では流行が4カ国に及ぶと言及されているが、具体的な国名（DRC以外）は記載がなく対象国リストとの照合ができないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含めた。PHEIC宣言済みであり、既にWHO通知相当の重大イベントとしてフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Κένυα: Και δεύτερος ασθενής με Έμπολα πέθανε στο Ναϊρόμπι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: A second patient with Ebola died in Nairobi.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola death: a 65-year-old woman who developed symptoms while in quarantine as a close contact of a Kenyan man who died earlier this month. The first Kenyan case was a man who travelled from the Congo to Nairobi and died on Oct 5. Total confirmed Kenyan cases stand at 9, with 2 deaths and 7 patients in isolation. On Monday, the U.S. State Department issued a Kenya travel advisory urging Americans to reconsider travel for health reasons. Nigeria became the fourth African country to report an Ebola case: a Swiss woman, wife of a Swiss embassy official in Abuja, who had recently travelled to Uganda; 44 close contacts identified, including her husband in isolation. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with no approved treatment or vaccine. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, nearly 10,000 cases and about 4,600 deaths have been recorded.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：ナイロビで2人目のエボラ患者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべて該当し、複数国（ケニア・ナイジェリア・DRC）にまたがるエボラ流行で米国が渡航勧告を発出するなど国際的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 主な発生国はケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダだが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは記事内で約1万症例・4600人死亡と言及されており対象国として含めた。Bundibugyo株による流行で承認済み治療法・ワクチンがない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Liberação de milhões de mosquitos com bactéria na Espanha e no Brasil atrai atenção; entenda o plano | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Release of millions of bacteria-carrying mosquitoes in Spain and Brazil draws attention; understand the plan | A TARDE
article.articleSummary: Barcelona's Public Health Agency released over 1.5 million male Aedes albopictus mosquitoes infected with Wolbachia to curb reproduction, targeting about 80,000 releases per week as a Europe-first strategy complementing habitat removal and insecticides. In Brazil, Fiocruz runs the Wolbachia approach using Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti to reduce transmission of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. In Niterói, Rio de Janeiro, studies show ~70% dengue, ~60% chikungunya, ~40% Zika reductions; Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, also uses the method. Campinas, São Paulo state, will receive releases, starting May 2027 with first results expected in 2028. The tiger mosquito (Aedes albopictus) breeds in small water containers, complicating control; Wolbachia is not a substitute for surveillance or elimination of breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: スペインとブラジルで細菌を持つ何百万もの蚊の放出が注目を集める；その計画を理解する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱等の実際のアウトブレイクではなく、Wolbachia感染蚊を用いた媒介蚊制御プログラム（予防的公衆衛生対策）の紹介記事であり、新規感染症イベントのシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の発生状況ではなく、Wolbachia感染蚊放出による媒介蚊制御の科学的・政策的取り組みを報じたもの。スペインは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Begins Ebola Vaccine Trial in Congo Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo hosts the first Ebola vaccine trial, Tumaini, in Bunia, Ituri province, amid the 17th and worst Ebola outbreak since May. WHO reports more than 9,700 cases and over 4,600 deaths; PHEIC declared. The trial tests cross-protection of Ervebo (Zaire strain) against Bundibugyo. It uses ring vaccination, immunising high-risk contacts; includes pregnant women and children 12 and older. Two Bundibugyo-specific candidates enter soon: ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector from Oxford and an mRNA vaccine from Moderna, funded by CEPI. Tumaini is a single framework to assess safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity of multiple vaccines. The outbreak has spread to four countries across eastern, central, and western Africa—the widest Ebola geographic spread on the continent to date. The trial is underway in Bunia; vaccines will enter shortly.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴのエボラ出血熱流行でワクチン治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みの過去最大・最悪のエボラ流行（9,700例超、死者4,600人超）で4カ国に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（Ituri州Bunia）でのワクチン治験開始を主題としている。流行は4カ国に拡大と記載されているが、具体的な対象国名は本文に明記されていないためDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。PHEIC宣言済みで国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い重大事例。

article.articleHeadline: "치명률 최대 90%" 에볼라 공포...미국, 콩고 방문 확인 의무화
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Fatality rate as high as 90%" Ebola fear... U.S. requires verification of Congo visits.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 23, 2026, the U.S. CDC tightened Ebola-related border controls: all international air travelers must prove they have not visited or stayed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the previous 21 days, with the rule taking effect on Nov 3. U.S. citizens who have stayed in Uganda or South Sudan must enter via designated airports for enhanced screening; the measure expands an earlier restriction on boarding following Congo visits. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever; four of six known Ebola viruses have infected humans: Zaire, Sudan, Bundibugyo, and Tai Forest. The current outbreak is the rapidly spreading Bundibugyo strain; in 2018, Zaire reached 1,000 cases in 235 days, Bundibugyo in 40 days. Fatality rates range 25–90% by virus and setting; Congo’s current fatality is 45.7%, with concern it could rise due to variants. No Korean cases; WHO PHEIC declared; five African countries—DRC, Uganda, South Sudan, Ethiopia, Rwanda—are designated focus quarantine regions.

triage.headline_ja: 「致死率最大90%」エボラの恐怖...米国、コンゴ訪問歴の確認を義務化
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した急速拡大中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクであり、米国が渡航制限措置を発動するなど国際的関心・影響が極めて高い。IHR基準の複数に該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、南スーダン、エチオピア、ルワンダも重点検疫対象地域とされているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国・韓国は渡航制限実施国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Δεύτερος νεκρός από τον ιό Εμπολα στην Κένυα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second death from the Ebola virus in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Ebola virus disease (EVD) surveillance shows spread across four African countries, with Kenya reporting its second death. A 65-year-old woman died after presenting symptoms while in quarantine as a close contact of a Kenyan man who had fallen ill and died earlier in October; Kenya has confirmed 9 cases, including 2 deaths, with 7 patients in isolation and 135 close contacts in quarantine. The first Kenyan case was a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Nairobi and died Oct 5. In Nigeria, the fourth African country to report a case, a Swiss woman—wife of a Swiss embassy partner in Abuja—tested positive; the couple had traveled to Uganda, not DRC. 44 close contacts identified; husband in isolation; patient hospitalized in Abuja. The outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo strain; no approved vaccine or treatment. DRC records about 10,000 cases and 4,600 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラウイルスによる2人目の死者
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCを起源に4カ国（DRC、ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ）へ拡大しており、死亡例・国際的拡散・渡航への影響が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCを起源としたエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の多国間拡大を報じている。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCは約10,000症例・4,600死亡と報告され、依然として中心的な発生地域として言及されているため含めた。ワクチン・治療薬未承認であり、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 一名 65 岁肯尼亚女性成为该国第二例因埃博拉病毒去世的患者Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻 - NEWS.CHINA.COM.AU 这里是生活在墨尔本咱自家人的地盘！把客场当主场，视异乡为故园。澳洲唐人街 - 中华澳网 China Town News澳洲唐人街;澳大利亚华人社区和主流新闻媒体
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 65-year-old Kenyan woman becomes the country's second person to die from Ebola virus disease.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 October 2026, Kenya confirms its second Ebola virus disease death: a 65-year-old woman, a direct relative of a male patient from Democratic Republic of the Congo, who died after isolation. Seven other Ebola patients are treated across two isolation facilities; all cases are in one cluster with no community transmission. Symptoms include vomiting and diarrhea. Since May, Ebola in the DRC has caused over 4,000 deaths, making this Africa’s second deadliest outbreak. The latest Kenyan victim developed symptoms on 13 October; the first death occurred 5 October after illness in DRC, followed by travel to Nairobi. Ongoing treatment includes three relatives of the first patient, three health workers. Kenya has tightened border screening for travelers from DRC and nine high-risk countries, with electronic forms, QR codes on arrival, and enhanced airline screening. Nigeria reports a linked case; investigations ongoing; both cases may have passed through Entebbe, Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 65歳のケニア人女性がエボラウイルス病で死亡、同国2人目の死者に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5月以降4000人超の死者を出す大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大と渡航制限措置が確認されているため、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで5月以降発生している大規模エボラ流行（アフリカ史上2番目の致死的流行）とその越境拡大（ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ経由）。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外し、流行の発生源であるDRCのみを記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Announces Second Ebola Death, Cites No Community Spread
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola death in a quarantined relative of a Kenyan man who died earlier this month; seven cases are receiving treatment in two isolation facilities, all within one cluster with no evidence of community spread. The latest patient is a 65-year-old woman who developed symptoms during quarantine. Kenya’s first case was a man who traveled from the DRC and died in Nairobi on Oct 5. Following contact tracing of 135 contacts, nine cases have been confirmed, including the two deaths. DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, declared in May, has lately surpassed 9,000 cases and 4,600 deaths; the outbreak has spread to four countries in eastern, central and western Africa. Nigeria reported a related case; Uganda barred transit for travellers with DRC history, and has seen 20 infections and two deaths before being declared Ebola-free in August. No Kenyan community spread detected.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、2人目のエボラ死亡例を発表、地域社会への感染拡大はないと発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つ全て満たし（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限の発生）、DRC発のエボラ流行が複数国に拡大している国際的に重大な事案であるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ死亡例だが、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは本流行の発生源として実質的に詳述されているためverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo indleder vaccineforsøg midt i historisk ebolaudbrud
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo launches vaccine trials amid historic Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo has begun a vaccine trial to curb the Bundibugyo-ebola variant, the driver of the worst outbreak in the country’s history, with more than 4,600 deaths and about 9,700 infections since mid-May. There is currently no approved vaccine specific to Bundibugyo. The first participants were vaccinated today in a new trial vaccine named Tumaini, Swahili for hope, as announced by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. In the meantime, two Bundibugyo-targeted vaccines are in early clinical trials, while DR Congo plans to use Everbo, a vaccine approved for other Ebola variants, in the interim. WHO supports the DR Congo-led initiative and says the Everbo trial will yield useful data on whether vaccines developed specifically for Bundibugyo may work. A potential Bundibugyo vaccine is from Moderna, and another from researchers at the University of Oxford. Ebola symptoms include severe fever and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴ、史上最悪のエボラ流行の最中にワクチン試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（死者4,600人超、感染者約9,700人）であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、国際機関(WHO)も関与していることからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラによる史上最悪規模の流行。WHOが支援するワクチン試験(Tumaini)が開始されたことが本記事の主題。死亡者数・感染者数は過去最大規模であり、フルリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Un essai de vaccin contre Ebola débute en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A vaccine trial against Ebola begins in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization announced the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, launched on Friday amid the country’s ongoing Ebola outbreak. The effort comes as the DRC reports the death toll surpassing 4,600 from the disease. This outbreak marks the 17th Ebola outbreak to strike the country. The vaccine trial represents a pivotal step in the response, aiming to expand preventive options in a setting with active transmission. The development underscores the urgent public health need within the outbreak and the international commitment to testing and deploying vaccines as part of containment efforts. This development reflects ongoing international efforts to address Ebola in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（死者4,600人超、同国17回目の流行）に対しWHOがワクチン治験を開始しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的対応の必要性が認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 死者4,600人という数値は過去のDRCエボラ流行と比較して非常に高く、情報の正確性について続報での確認が必要。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の有無については記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: نيجيريا تعلن رصد رابط جيني بين إصابة بفيروس إيبولا وحالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria announces detection of a genetic link between Ebola virus infection and a case.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports a single confirmed Ebola case with a genetic link to a Kenyan strain, marking the first genomic connection between outbreaks in Nigeria and Kenya. Nigeria says there is no evidence the Kenyan patient traveled to Nigeria or direct contact between patients; authorities are tracing contacts and quarantining them, with several contacts testing negative and others awaiting results. The Nigerian case involved a traveler who had visited Uganda, and Uganda remains Ebola-free but has tightened border controls and requires traveler-location forms for all arrivals, including a ban on entry for those who visited the Democratic Republic of Congo. Regional coordination among Nigeria, Kenya, and Uganda is emphasized, with laboratories ready to process samples and a commitment to transparent lab reporting. International health bodies monitor cross-border movement in East and West Africa as surveillance and containment efforts continue.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジーラがエボラウイルス感染症例とケニアの症例との遺伝学的関連を検出したと発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラという致死率の高い疾患で、ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ間の国境を越えた遺伝学的関連が確認され、渡航制限（ウガンダの入国禁止措置）も発生しているため、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題であるナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは『DRCを訪問した者の入国禁止』という文脈でのみ言及されており、DRC国内での発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: More Than Halloween Scares: Two Virus Cases Leave Scientists Searching for Answers
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in more than a decade amid Africa’s widest-spread outbreak, involving four countries (DRC, Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria). The patient is the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat living in Abuja; she had not travelled to DRC, and authorities are tracing exposure after she spent a two-week visit in Uganda before returning to Nigeria. Investigators aim to reconstruct transmission chains as the outbreak expands beyond borders. Separately, France reports its first documented human Shamonda virus infection; the virus, typically found in livestock and transmitted by midges, caused illness and death in an immunocompromised patient. The case, linked to eastern France during a period of animal circulation in spring–summer 2026, is considered isolated. WHO says a wider human-to-human spread is unlikely; no vaccines or specific treatments exist for Shamonda.

triage.headline_ja: ハロウィンの恐怖を超えて：2つのウイルス感染例、科学者たちが原因究明に奔走
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで10年ぶりとなるエボラ症例が確認され、DRC・ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアの4カ国にまたがる拡大アウトブレイクとなっており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラの主な発生・拡大国はDRC・ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアだが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。フランスのShamonda virus症例は孤立事例でヒトヒト感染リスクは低いとWHOが評価しており、対象国にも該当しないため本トリアージでは主にエボラ拡大を評価対象とした。

article.articleHeadline: Poliomielite, la prevenzione passa dal vaccino: sorveglianza attiva anche a Ferrara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Poliomyelitis: Prevention Depends on Vaccination; Active Surveillance Also in Ferrara.
article.articleSummary: Poliomyelitis surveillance and vaccination remain central in Ferrara and Emilia-Romagna as World Polio Day on 24 October highlights prevention and detection of Acute Flaccid Paralysis (AFP). Italy’s AFP network, run by the Ministry of Health with the ISS, enables rapid identification of AFP in people of all ages and suspected poliomyelitis, and monitors for poliovirus circulation. In Ferrara province, vaccination is offered free and actively by public health units in Ferrara, Cento, Comacchio, Codigoro, Portomaggiore and Bondeno. The history notes poliomyelitis described in 1789, more than 8,000 Italian cases in 1958, mandatory vaccination since 1966, last endemic case in 1982, and polio-free status for Italy and the WHO Europe region since 2002. Global cases fell to 688 (2022), 196 (2024), and 62 (2025). WPV1 remains endemic in Pakistan and Afghanistan; outbreaks persist in Afghanistan, DRC, Gaza, Somalia, Sudan, Yemen, Nigeria, and Pakistan.

triage.headline_ja: ポリオ:予防はワクチン接種から—フェラーラでも積極的サーベイランスを実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はイタリア・フェラーラ地域における世界ポリオデーに関連した予防啓発・サーベイランス体制の紹介であり、新規の発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。DRC等は背景情報として言及されているのみで記事の主題ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリア（対象国外）における啓発活動。DRC等は世界的な流行継続国のリストとして言及されているに過ぎず、具体的な新規発生報告ではないため対象国として扱わない。
